short_description.id: Unuqay adalah makhluk mengerikan dalam mitologi Azerbaijan, wujud kambing dari Hal anası, yang menghadang pengendara di dekat kuburan dan meninggalkan cacat seperti gagap atau pincang.
short_description.en: Unuqay is a monster of Azerbaijan mythology, the goat form of Hal anası, which waylays riders near cemeteries and leaves them with defects such as stammering or limping.

long_description.id: Unuqay adalah makhluk mengerikan dalam mitologi Azerbaijan, yang juga dipahami sebagai wujud kambing dari Hal anası. Ia biasanya menghadang penunggang kuda dan kusir kereta dalam rupa kambing tanpa pemilik, memperdaya mereka, lalu meninggalkan cacat yang lama seperti gagap atau pincang.
long_description.en: Unuqay is a monster of Azerbaijan mythology, understood as the goat form of Hal anası. It typically confronts riders and cart drivers as an ownerless goat, deceives them, and leaves them with lasting defects such as a stammer or a limp.

long_description.id: Makhluk ini terlihat di sekitar kuburan dan paling sering menampakkan diri saat senja. Wujud hewannya kambing jantan atau anak kambing, kebanyakan berwarna putih. Begitu orang sadar bahwa yang dibawanya bukan kambing biasa, kaki makhluk itu memanjang dan tenaganya bertambah; ia lalu duduk di punggung kuda seperti manusia dan menjepit si penunggang.
long_description.en: The creature is seen around cemeteries and appears most often at dusk. Its animal form is a billy goat or kid, mostly white. As soon as a person realises the goat is no ordinary animal, its legs stretch out and its strength increases; it then sits on the horse like a human and crushes the rider.

long_description.id: Seperti Hal, Unuqay takut jarum dan peniti, sehingga benda-benda itu dipakai untuk menangkapnya; titik lemahnya adalah leher dan urat pinggang. Kisah-kisah yang dicatat di Göynük menambahkan bahwa ia juga takut cahaya dan sekop, karena jarum menjahit kain kafan dan sekop menggali kubur. Dalam beberapa teks yang jarang, ia membawa orang ke dalam kuburan atau mencelakai bayi dalam kandungan.
long_description.en: Like Hal, Unuqay fears needles and pins, so these are used to catch it; its weak points are the neck and the lower-back vein. Accounts recorded in Göynük add that it also fears light and the shovel, since the needle sews the shroud and the shovel digs the grave. In a few rare texts it lures people into the cemetery or harms an unborn child.

long_description.id: Sebagian besar kisah Unuqay berasal dari desa-desa Göynük di Şəki, tempat 16 teks tentangnya dicatat. Penyusun kumpulan folklor dari daerah itu menyebut Unuqay sebagai tokoh yang sebelumnya tak dikenal dalam folklor Azerbaijan, tetapi punya padanan pada bangsa türk lain. Nama lainnya adalah Maşşax dan Kafdar.
long_description.en: Most Unuqay accounts come from the Göynük villages of Şəki, where 16 texts about it were recorded. The compiler of the folklore collection from that area calls Unuqay a figure previously unknown in Azerbaijan folklore but with analogues among other türk peoples. Its other names are Maşşax and Kafdar.

did_you_know.en: Unuqay's other name, Maşşax, is also used by Göynük people for blue-eyed persons.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa benda sehari-hari seperti jarum dan sekop dipercaya bisa menangkal makhluk gaib?
learning_questions.en: Why might everyday objects such as needles and shovels be believed to ward off supernatural beings?

claims.quote: Unuqay və ya Hal anasının keçi dönərgəsi — Azərbaycan mifologiyasında bədheybət.

statement.id: Unuqay, atau wujud kambing (keçi dönərgəsi) Hal anası, adalah makhluk mengerikan (bədheybət) dalam mitologi Azerbaijan (Azərbaycan).
statement.en: Unuqay, or the goat transformation (keçi dönərgəsi) of Hal anası, is a monster (bədheybət) in Azerbaijan (Azərbaycan) mythology.

claims.quote: Atlıların və arabaçıların qarşısına keçi formasında çıxaraq onları aldadır və uzun müddət davam edəcək tibbi qüsurlara (kəkələmə, axsama) səbəb olur.

statement.id: Ia muncul di depan penunggang kuda dan kusir dalam wujud kambing (keçi), menipu mereka, dan menimbulkan cacat yang lama (kəkələmə, axsama: gagap, pincang).
statement.en: It appears before riders and cart drivers in the form of a goat (keçi), deceives them, and causes long-lasting defects (kəkələmə, axsama: stammering, limping).

claims.quote: Unuqay qəbiristanlıq ətrafı ərazilərdə görülür. O, əsasən axşamüstü, qaranlıq çökərkən insanların rastına çıxır.

statement.id: Unuqay terlihat di sekitar kuburan (qəbiristanlıq) dan terutama menjumpai orang saat senja, ketika gelap turun (qaranlıq çökərkən).
statement.en: Unuqay is seen around cemeteries (qəbiristanlıq) and meets people mainly at dusk, as darkness falls (qaranlıq çökərkən).

claims.quote: Yolçu keçinin bədheybət olduğunu bildikdən sonra onun ayaqları uzanmağa başlayır. Ayaqlarının uzanması ilə birlikdə Unuqayın gücü də artır.

statement.id: Setelah pengembara tahu kambing itu makhluk mengerikan, kakinya mulai memanjang (ayaqları uzanmağa), dan seiring itu kekuatan (gücü) Unuqay bertambah.
statement.en: Once the traveller realises the goat is a monster, its legs begin to lengthen (ayaqları uzanmağa), and with this Unuqay's strength (gücü) grows.

claims.quote: Bir qədər yol getdikdən sonra isə canına istilənmə gələn keçinin ayaqları uzanır və atın üstündə adam kimi oturub atlını sıxır.

statement.id: Setelah beberapa lama di jalan, kaki kambing yang menghangat itu memanjang, lalu ia duduk di atas kuda seperti manusia (adam kimi) dan menjepit penunggangnya.
statement.en: After some way on the road, the warmed-up goat's legs lengthen, and it sits on the horse like a person (adam kimi) and squeezes the rider.

claims.quote: Halın qadın dönərgəsi kimi iynədən, sancaqdan qorxur. Buna görə də Unuqayı tutmaq üçün iynə və sancaq taxıb işlətmək olar.

statement.id: Seperti wujud perempuan Hal, ia takut jarum dan peniti (iynədən, sancaqdan); karena itu jarum dan peniti dapat dipakai untuk menangkap Unuqay.
statement.en: Like Hal's female form, it fears needles and pins (iynədən, sancaqdan); therefore needles and pins can be used to catch Unuqay.

claims.quote: Unuqayda iynənin sancılacağı zəif yerlər boyun və bel damarıdır.

statement.id: Titik lemah Unuqay tempat jarum ditusukkan adalah leher dan urat pinggang (boyun və bel damarı).
statement.en: Unuqay's weak spots where the needle is to be stuck are the neck and the vein of the lower back (boyun və bel damarı).

claims.quote: Nadir mətnlərdə Unuqay cinlərlə bağlı hekayələrdə olduğu kimi adamları aldadıb onları qəbiristanlığın içinə aparır və ya hamilə qadın yatarkən onun üstünə çıxıb uşağı tələf edir.

statement.id: Dalam teks yang jarang, seperti kisah tentang jin (cinlərlə), Unuqay memperdaya orang dan membawanya ke dalam kuburan, atau naik ke atas perempuan hamil yang tidur dan membinasakan bayinya.
statement.en: In rare texts, as in stories about jinn (cinlərlə), Unuqay lures people into the cemetery, or climbs on a sleeping pregnant woman and destroys the child.

claims.quote: Şəkinin Göynük kəndlərində (Aşağı Göynük və Baş Göynük) Unuqay mifoloji qəhrəmanına tez-tez rast gəlinir. Burada Unuqayla bağlı 16 mətn qeydə alınmışdır.

statement.id: Tokoh mitologis Unuqay sering dijumpai di desa-desa Göynük di Şəki (Aşağı Göynük dan Baş Göynük); di sana tercatat 16 teks tentang Unuqay.
statement.en: The mythological figure Unuqay is often met in the Göynük villages of Şəki (Aşağı Göynük and Baş Göynük); 16 texts about Unuqay were recorded there.

claims.quote: Unuqayda görülən ətraf üzvlərin uzanması xüsusiyyəti Naxçıvanın Sədərək rayonunda qeydə alınmış Çıntırqayış (Kəndirqayış) bədheybətində də vardır.

statement.id: Ciri anggota badan yang memanjang pada Unuqay juga ada pada makhluk Çıntırqayış (Kəndirqayış) yang tercatat di distrik Sədərək, Naxçıvan.
statement.en: The lengthening limbs seen in Unuqay also occur in the monster Çıntırqayış (Kəndirqayış), recorded in the Sədərək district of Naxçıvan.

claims.quote: Erkək keçi, oğlaq formasındadır. Keçinin rəngi mifoloji mətnlərin çoxunda ağ, yalnız bircə mətndə qaradır.

statement.id: Wujud hewannya kambing jantan atau anak kambing (oğlaq); dalam sebagian besar teks warnanya putih (ağ), hanya dalam satu teks hitam (qara).
statement.en: Its animal form is a billy goat or kid (oğlaq); in most texts it is white (ağ), and in only one text black (qara).

claims.quote: Nənəqay. Adı keçən mətn olmasa da, Unuqayın variantı hesab edilir.

statement.id: Nənəqay dianggap varian Unuqay, meskipun tidak ada teks yang menyebut namanya.
statement.en: Nənəqay is considered a variant of Unuqay, although no text mentions it by name.

claims.quote: Şəki mətnlərində keçi dönərgəsinə verilən əsas ad Unuqaydır. Digər istifadə olunan ad olan Maşşax göynüklülər tərəfindən gözlərinin rəngi göy olan insanlara da deyilir.

statement.id: Dalam teks Şəki nama utama wujud kambing itu Unuqay; nama lain, Maşşax, juga dipakai orang Göynük untuk orang bermata biru (göy).
statement.en: In the Şəki texts the main name of the goat form is Unuqay; another name, Maşşax, is also used by Göynük people for blue-eyed (göy) persons.

claims.quote: Bu bölgədən Azərbaycan folkloru üçün naməlum olan xeyli mifoloji personaj və mətn qeydə almışıq ki, onların analoji variantları ilə biz digər türk xalqlarının folklorunda qarşılaşırıq. Halın keçi dönərgəsi Unuqay

statement.id: Penyusun mencatat dari daerah ini banyak tokoh mitologis yang belum dikenal dalam folklor Azerbaijan (Azərbaycan), dengan padanan dalam folklor bangsa türk lain; salah satunya Unuqay, wujud kambing Hal (Halın keçi dönərgəsi).
statement.en: The compiler recorded from this area many mythological characters unknown to Azerbaijan (Azərbaycan) folklore, with analogues in the folklore of other türk peoples; one is Unuqay, the goat form of Hal (Halın keçi dönərgəsi).

claims.quote: Huna Maşşax diyilər, Unuqay diyilər, Kafdar diyilər. Əsas Unuqay diyilər.

statement.id: Seorang penutur berkata makhluk itu disebut Maşşax, Unuqay, dan Kafdar, tetapi yang utama Unuqay (Əsas Unuqay).
statement.en: A narrator said it is called Maşşax, Unuqay and Kafdar, but mainly Unuqay (Əsas Unuqay).

claims.quote: Xortdeydi, Unuqaydı, iyneynən lapatqadan qorxuylər. Ona görə ki, iyneynən kəfən tikiliy, lapatqeynən qavır qazılıy.

statement.id: Menurut penutur, xortdan dan Unuqay takut jarum dan sekop (iyneynən lapatqadan), karena dengan jarum kain kafan (kəfən) dijahit dan dengan sekop kubur (qavır) digali.
statement.en: According to the narrator, the xortdan and Unuqay fear the needle and the shovel (iyneynən lapatqadan), because the shroud (kəfən) is sewn with a needle and the grave (qavır) is dug with a shovel.

claims.quote: gördux ki, Unuqay oturufdu atın üsdünə, yapışıfdı. Boynünə, bel damarına iynə sanciylər.

statement.id: Dalam satu kisah, Unuqay didapati menempel di atas kuda (atın üsdünə), lalu orang menusukkan jarum (iynə) ke leher dan urat pinggangnya (bel damarına).
statement.en: In one account Unuqay was found stuck on top of the horse (atın üsdünə), and people stuck a needle (iynə) into its neck and lower-back vein (bel damarına).

claims.quote: İşıxdan qorxuy də. İynədən, işıxdan qorxuy.

statement.id: Seorang penutur menyebut Unuqay takut cahaya dan jarum (İynədən, işıxdan qorxuy).
statement.en: A narrator says Unuqay fears light and needles (İynədən, işıxdan qorxuy).

claims.quote: Unnan sora dili pəltehləşdi ho kişinin. Sora da başdiyi axsax gəzmağa.

statement.id: Setelah kejadian itu, lidah lelaki itu menjadi pelat (dili pəltehləşdi) dan ia mulai berjalan pincang (axsax).
statement.en: After that the man's speech became slurred (dili pəltehləşdi) and he began to walk with a limp (axsax).

short_description.id: Gogfran Gawr adalah raksasa dalam tradisi Wales yang dikenal sebagai ayah Gwenhwyfar, istri Arthur, dan dikaitkan dengan Powys serta Brycheiniog.
short_description.en: Gogfran Gawr is a giant of Welsh tradition known as the father of Gwenhwyfar, wife of Arthur, and linked with Powys and Brycheiniog.

long_description.id: Menurut sebagian tradisi Wales, raksasa Gogfran Gawr adalah ayah Gwenhwyfar, istri Arthur. Dalam salah satu Triad Wales disebut tiga Gwenhwyfar yang menikah dengan Arthur, dan yang ketiga adalah putri (G)og(y)rfan Gawr; dalam varian Triad lain hanya putri Gogfran Gawr yang disebut. Teks-teks Welsh Tengah juga menyebut raksasa Ogyruan atau Gogyrfan sebagai ayahnya. Adaptasi Wales atas karya Geoffrey, seperti Brut y Brenhinedd, juga menjadikannya putri raksasa Og[y]vran, dan penyair abad ke-14 Dafydd ap Gwilym menyebutnya putri Ogfran sang raksasa.
long_description.en: According to some Welsh traditions, the giant Gogfran Gawr was the father of Gwenhwyfar, wife of Arthur. One Welsh Triad names three Gwenhwyfars married to Arthur, the third being the daughter of (G)og(y)rfan Gawr; a variant of another Triad mentions only the daughter of Gogfran Gawr. Middle Welsh texts likewise name the giant Ogyruan or Gogyrfan as her father. Welsh versions of Geoffrey's history, such as Brut y Brenhinedd, also make her the giant Og[y]vran's daughter, and the 14th-century poet Dafydd ap Gwilym calls her the daughter of Ogfran the Giant.

long_description.id: Bentuk namanya beragam: Gogfran paling umum, tetapi ada juga Ogfran, Gogrfran, Gogyrfan, dan Ogrfan. Para penyair cywydd memahami unsur -fran sebagai brân (gagak), sedangkan nama sungai Ogran di Sir Fynwy memunculkan dugaan bahwa ogr- berarti tajam.
long_description.en: His name varies: Gogfran is most common, but Ogfran, Gogrfran, Gogyrfan and Ogrfan also occur. The cywydd poets understood the element -fran as brân (crow), while the stream name Ogran in Sir Fynwy has led to the suggestion that ogr- means sharp.

long_description.id: Raksasa ini dikaitkan dengan Powys dan Brycheiniog. Siôn Dafydd Rhys, dalam daftar raksasa yang disusun sekitar tahun 1600, menyebut Gogfran Gawr tinggal di Aber Ysgyr, di benteng di atas sungai dekat Aber Hodni (Aberhonddu). Daftar yang sama mengisahkan saudara-saudara Gwenhwyfar yang dipenjara raksasa lain dan diselamatkan Arthur.
long_description.en: The giant is linked with Powys and Brycheiniog. Siôn Dafydd Rhys, in a list of giants compiled around 1600, says Gogfran Gawr lived at Aber Ysgyr in the caer above the river near Aber Hodni (Aberhonddu). The same list tells of Gwenhwyfar's brothers, imprisoned by other giants and rescued by Arthur.

long_description.id: Rachel Bromwich berpendapat bahwa Og(y)rfan yang disebut dalam kaitan dengan Powys adalah seorang pahlawan awal, sehingga tradisinya tampak mencampur dua tokoh: pahlawan dari Powys dan raksasa ayah Gwenhwyfar. Nama Caer Ogyrfan pernah dipakai untuk benteng bukit Hen Ddinas dekat Croesoswallt.
long_description.en: Rachel Bromwich suggests that the Og(y)rfan linked with Powys was an early hero, so the tradition seems to mix two figures: a hero of Powys and the giant father of Gwenhwyfar. The name Caer Ogyrfan was once used for the hillfort Hen Ddinas near Croesoswallt.

who.id: Gogfran Gawr adalah raksasa dalam tradisi Wales.
who.en: Gogfran Gawr is a giant of Welsh tradition.

origin.id: Ia dikaitkan dengan kerajaan lama Powys dan Brycheiniog.
origin.en: He is linked with the old kingdoms of Powys and Brycheiniog.

role.id: Ia disebut sebagai ayah Gwenhwyfar, istri Arthur.
role.en: He is named as the father of Gwenhwyfar, wife of Arthur.

famous_for.id: Namanya muncul dalam sajak rakyat tentang putrinya, Gwenhwyfar.
famous_for.en: His name appears in a folk rhyme about his daughter Gwenhwyfar.

did_you_know.id: Sebuah sajak rakyat Wales menyebut Gwenhwyfar putri Ogrfan Gawr nakal waktu kecil dan lebih buruk waktu besar.
did_you_know.en: A Welsh folk rhyme calls Gwenhwyfar, daughter of Ogrfan Gawr, bad when little and worse when grown.

description.id: Tempat tinggal Gogfran Gawr menurut Siôn Dafydd Rhys, di benteng di atas sungai.
description.en: Where Gogfran Gawr lived according to Siôn Dafydd Rhys, in the caer above the river.

description.en: A hillfort near Croesoswallt formerly called Caer Ogyrfan.

note.id: Dalam mitologi Wales, raksasa ini menggantikan Leodegrance sebagai ayah Gwenhwyfar.
note.en: In Welsh mythology the giant takes the place of Leodegrance as Gwenhwyfar's father.

sources.title: The Giants of Wales and Their Dwellings (Peniarth MS 118)
sources.author: Sion Dafydd Rhys (trans. Hugh Owen)

claims.quote: Yn ôl rhai traddodiadau Cymraeg, tad Gwenhwyfar, gwraig Arthur, oedd Gogfran Gawr.

statement.id: Menurut sebagian tradisi Wales (Cymraeg), Gogfran Gawr adalah ayah Gwenhwyfar, istri Arthur.
statement.en: According to some Welsh (Cymraeg) traditions, Gogfran Gawr was the father of Gwenhwyfar, wife of Arthur.

claims.quote: Cysylltir y cawr â hen deyrnasoedd Powys a Brycheiniog.

statement.id: Raksasa (cawr) ini dikaitkan dengan kerajaan lama Powys dan Brycheiniog.
statement.en: The giant (cawr) is linked with the old kingdoms of Powys and Brycheiniog.

claims.quote: Gogfran yw'r ffurf fwyaf cyffredin, ond ceir yn ogystal y ffurf Ogfran. Ceir hefyd yr amrywiadau Gogrfran, Gogyrfran ac Ogrfran.

statement.id: Gogfran adalah bentuk nama yang paling umum; ada juga bentuk Ogfran serta varian Gogrfran, Gogyrfran, dan Ogrfran.
statement.en: Gogfran is the most common form (ffurf), but Ogfran also occurs, as do the variants Gogrfran, Gogyrfran and Ogrfran.

claims.quote: Ceir 'Caer Ogyrfan' yn hen enw ar fryngaer 'Hen Ddinas' ger Croesoswallt.

statement.id: 'Caer Ogyrfan' adalah nama lama benteng bukit (bryngaer) 'Hen Ddinas' dekat Croesoswallt.
statement.en: 'Caer Ogyrfan' is an old name for the hillfort (bryngaer) 'Hen Ddinas' near Croesoswallt.

claims.quote: Awgryma Rachel Bromwich mai arwr cynnar o Bowys oedd yr Og(y)rfan hwn.

statement.id: Rachel Bromwich berpendapat bahwa Og(y)rfan ini adalah pahlawan (arwr) awal dari Powys (Bowys).
statement.en: Rachel Bromwich suggests that this Og(y)rfan was an early hero (arwr) of Powys (Bowys).

claims.quote: Ymddengys yn debygol felly fod cymysgedd yn y traddodiad rhwng dau gymeriad gwahanol, un yn arwr o Bowys a'r Gororau a'r llall yn gawr sy'n dad i Wenhwyfar.

statement.id: Tampaknya dalam tradisi terjadi percampuran dua tokoh: seorang pahlawan dari Powys dan daerah Gororau, dan seorang raksasa (cawr) ayah Gwenhwyfar.
statement.en: It seems likely that the tradition mixes two different characters: a hero from Powys and the Gororau (Marches), and a giant (cawr) who is father of Gwenhwyfar.

claims.quote: Daw'n amlwg mai "brân" oedd yr elfen -fran yn yr enw i'r cywyddwyr.

statement.id: Bagi para penyair cywydd (cywyddwyr), unsur -fran dalam nama itu jelas dipahami sebagai "brân" (gagak).
statement.en: To the cywydd poets (cywyddwyr) the element -fran in the name was clearly "brân" (crow).

claims.quote: Ceir ffrwd o'r enw Ogran yn Sir Fynwy, ac ar sail hynny awgrymir mai "llym" yw ystyr yr elfen ogr-, os derbynnir y ffurf Ogrfan.

statement.id: Ada sungai kecil bernama Ogran di Sir Fynwy; atas dasar itu diduga unsur ogr- berarti "llym" (tajam) bila bentuk Ogrfan diterima.
statement.en: There is a stream (ffrwd) called Ogran in Sir Fynwy, on which basis the element ogr- is suggested to mean "llym" (sharp), if the form Ogrfan is accepted.

claims.quote: cyfeiria Siôn Dafydd Rhys at y cawr dan yr enw Gogfran Gawr a dweud ei fod yn trigo ger Aberhonddu ym Mrycheiniog.

statement.id: Siôn Dafydd Rhys menyebut raksasa (cawr) itu Gogfran Gawr dan mengatakan ia tinggal dekat Aberhonddu di Brycheiniog.
statement.en: Siôn Dafydd Rhys refers to the giant (cawr) as Gogfran Gawr and says he dwelt near Aberhonddu in Brycheiniog.

claims.quote: The first is the daughter of Cywryd of Gwent, the second of Gwythyr ap Greidawl (a supernatural figure), and the third of (G)og(y)rfan Gawr ("the Giant").

statement.id: Dalam salah satu Triad Wales ada tiga Gwenhwyfar yang menikah dengan Arthur; yang ketiga adalah putri (G)og(y)rfan Gawr ("Sang Raksasa").
statement.en: In one Welsh Triad there are three Gwenhwyfars married to Arthur; the third is the daughter of (G)og(y)rfan Gawr ("the Giant").

claims.quote: In a variant of another Welsh Triad (Trioedd Ynys Prydein ... only the daughter of Gogfran Gawr is mentioned.

statement.id: Dalam varian Triad Wales lain (Trioedd Ynys Prydein no. 54), hanya putri Gogfran Gawr yang disebut.
statement.en: In a variant of another Welsh Triad (Trioedd Ynys Prydein, no. 54), only the daughter of Gogfran Gawr is mentioned.

claims.quote: There was once a popular folk rhyme known in Wales concerning Gwenhwyfar: "Gwenhwyfar ferch Ogrfan Gawr / Drwg yn fechan, gwaeth yn fawr

statement.id: Dulu ada sajak rakyat populer di Wales tentang Gwenhwyfar: "Gwenhwyfar putri Ogrfan Gawr, nakal waktu kecil, lebih buruk waktu besar."
statement.en: There was once a popular folk rhyme in Wales about Gwenhwyfar: "Gwenhwyfar, daughter of Ogrfan Gawr, bad when little, worse when great."

claims.quote: Welsh adaptations of Geoffrey, such as Brut y Brenhinedd, portray her as a daughter of the giant Og[y]vran from a mother of Roman ancestry.

statement.id: Adaptasi Wales atas karya Geoffrey, seperti Brut y Brenhinedd, menggambarkan Gwenhwyfar sebagai putri raksasa Og[y]vran dari ibu keturunan Romawi.
statement.en: Welsh adaptations of Geoffrey, such as Brut y Brenhinedd, portray her as a daughter of the giant Og[y]vran by a mother of Roman ancestry.

claims.quote: The 14th-century Welsh poet Dafydd ap Gwilym alludes to it in one of his poems, calling her Ogfran the Giant's daughter.

statement.id: Penyair Wales abad ke-14, Dafydd ap Gwilym, menyebut Gwenhwyfar putri Ogfran sang raksasa dalam salah satu puisinya.
statement.en: The 14th-century Welsh poet Dafydd ap Gwilym calls her Ogfran the Giant's daughter in one of his poems.

claims.quote: In the land of Brycheiniog near to the town of Aber Hodni: Gogfran Gawr lived in Aber Ysgyr in the caer above the river.

statement.id: Di tanah Brycheiniog dekat kota Aber Hodni, Gogfran Gawr tinggal di Aber Ysgyr, di benteng (caer) di atas sungai.
statement.en: In the land of Brycheiniog near the town of Aber Hodni, Gogfran Gawr lived in Aber Ysgyr in the caer above the river.

claims.quote: there were some brothers to Gwenhwyfar, the daughter of Gogyrfan Gawr, who were imprisoned by some of these giants.

statement.id: Beberapa saudara laki-laki Gwenhwyfar, putri Gogyrfan Gawr, dikisahkan dipenjara oleh raksasa-raksasa di Bron Wrgan.
statement.en: Some brothers of Gwenhwyfar, daughter of Gogyrfan Gawr, were imprisoned by some of the giants at Bron Wrgan.

claims.quote: But Arthur saved them each one, killing the giants

statement.id: Arthur menyelamatkan mereka semua dan membunuh para raksasa itu.
statement.en: Arthur saved each one of them, killing the giants.

claims.quote: Sion Dafydd Rhys, ca. 1600 Peniarth MS 118 f.829-837

statement.id: Daftar raksasa ini disusun Sion Dafydd Rhys sekitar tahun 1600.
statement.en: This list of giants was compiled by Sion Dafydd Rhys around 1600.

claims.quote: In Welsh mythology, the father of Gwenhwyfar (Guinevere) is instead a giant named Ogyruan/Ogyrvan, or Gogyrfan, mentioned in Middle Welsh texts.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Wales, ayah Gwenhwyfar (Guinevere) adalah raksasa bernama Ogyruan/Ogyrvan atau Gogyrfan yang disebut dalam teks-teks Welsh Tengah.
statement.en: In Welsh mythology the father of Gwenhwyfar (Guinevere) is a giant named Ogyruan/Ogyrvan, or Gogyrfan, mentioned in Middle Welsh texts.

claims.quote: When his daughter, Princess Guinevere, marries Arthur, Leodegrance gives the young king the table in dowry.

statement.id: Dalam legenda Arthur, Leodegrance adalah ayah Guinevere; ketika putrinya menikah dengan Arthur, ia memberikan meja itu sebagai mas kawin.
statement.en: In Arthurian legend Leodegrance is Guinevere's father; when his daughter marries Arthur, he gives the young king the table as a dowry.

summary.id: Sebagian tradisi menyebutnya raksasa ayah Gwenhwyfar.
summary.en: Some traditions make him the giant father of Gwenhwyfar.

summary.id: Rachel Bromwich menganggap Og(y)rfan dari Powys sebagai pahlawan awal; tradisinya mungkin mencampur dua tokoh.
summary.en: Rachel Bromwich takes the Og(y)rfan of Powys to be an early hero; the tradition may merge two figures.

summary.id: Para penyair cywydd memahami -fran sebagai brân (gagak).
summary.en: The cywydd poets understood -fran as brân (crow).

summary.id: Bila bentuk Ogrfan diterima, ogr- mungkin berarti tajam.
summary.en: If the form Ogrfan is accepted, ogr- may mean sharp.

short_description.id: Hırtık adalah jin jahat dalam kepercayaan rakyat yang dipercaya tinggal di sungai, berbadan atas manusia dan berbadan bawah hewan, serta menyamar sebagai orang yang dikenal untuk memancing korbannya ke air.
short_description.en: Hırtık is a malevolent jinn of folk belief said to live in rivers, human above and animal below, which takes the guise of familiar people to lure its victims to the water.

long_description.id: Hırtık digambarkan sebagai jin atau makhluk jahat yang bagian atas tubuhnya seperti manusia dan bagian bawahnya seperti hewan. Badannya penuh bulu dan kakinya menghadap ke belakang. Ia dianggap tinggal di sungai, terutama di Sungai Fırat di daerah Elazığ, tempat ia juga disebut Çay hırtığı; nama lainnya adalah Kırtık dan Hırtıh.
long_description.en: Hırtık is described as a malevolent jinn or creature whose upper body is like a human's and whose lower body is like an animal's. Its body is covered in hair and its feet face backwards. It is held to live in rivers, above all the Fırat River in the Elazığ area, where it is also called Çay hırtığı; other names are Kırtık and Hırtıh.

long_description.id: Ia meniru rupa seseorang, lalu mendatangi sahabat atau kerabat orang itu, mengajak mereka bercakap, dan membawa mereka ke hutan atau tepi sungai untuk ditenggelamkan. Sumber kedua menambahkan bahwa ia memakan orang yang telah dicekiknya. Hırtık terutama muncul dalam gelap, dan satu-satunya perlindungan adalah api: orang yang curiga melewatkan api di sekitar tubuh atau di bawah kakinya. Karena sifatnya suka meniru, hırtık mengulangi gerakan itu, bulunya terbakar, dan ia lari menceburkan diri ke air.
long_description.en: It copies someone's appearance, then visits that person's friends or relatives, talks with them and leads them to a forest or riverbank to drown them. The second source adds that it eats the people it has strangled. Hırtık appears mostly in the dark, and the only protection is fire: a suspicious person passes fire around their body or under their feet. Being an imitator, the hırtık repeats the gesture, its hair catches fire, and it flees into the water.

long_description.id: Hırtık juga dipercaya menunggang kuda orang pada malam hari sambil menyamar, sehingga kuda-kuda ditemukan lelah dan berkeringat pada pagi hari. Untuk memeriksanya, pemilik kuda mengoleskan bahan perekat pada pelana atau punggung kuda; bulu hırtık akan menempel dan tercabut ketika ia turun, sehingga ia kesakitan dan tidak menunggang kuda itu lagi.
long_description.en: Hırtık is also believed to ride people's horses in disguise, so that the horses are found tired and sweaty in the morning. To check, owners smear a sticky substance on the saddle or back; the hırtık's hair sticks and is torn out when it dismounts, hurting it so that it leaves the animal alone.

cultural_context.id: Peneliti folklor memasukkan Hırtik ke dalam daftar makhluk demonik yang muncul dalam memorat, yaitu kisah pengalaman yang dipercaya benar-benar terjadi.
cultural_context.en: Folklorists list Hırtik among the demonic beings that appear in memorates, accounts of experiences believed to have really happened.

who.id: Jin jahat yang separuh manusia dan separuh hewan, berbulu dan berkaki terbalik.
who.en: A malevolent jinn, half human and half animal, hairy and backward-footed.

origin.id: Kepercayaan rakyat di sekitar sungai, terutama Sungai Fırat di daerah Elazığ.
origin.en: Folk belief along rivers, especially the Fırat River in the Elazığ area.

role.id: Ia menyamar sebagai orang yang dikenal untuk memancing korban ke hutan atau tepi sungai dan menenggelamkan mereka.
role.en: It disguises itself as someone familiar to lure victims to a forest or riverbank and drown them.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal karena sifatnya yang suka meniru, yang membuatnya terbakar ketika mengulangi gerakan api.
famous_for.en: It is known for its imitative nature, which makes it burn itself when it repeats the fire gesture.

did_you_know.id: Pemilik kuda mengoleskan perekat pada pelana untuk mengetahui apakah hırtık telah menunggangi kuda mereka pada malam hari.
did_you_know.en: Horse owners smeared glue on saddles to find out whether a hırtık had been riding their horses.

description.id: Mengambil rupa orang tertentu untuk mendekati sahabat atau kerabatnya.
description.en: Takes the form of a particular person to approach that person's friends or relatives.

description.id: Api adalah satu-satunya perlindungan; ketika meniru gerakan api, bulunya terbakar dan ia lari ke air.
description.en: Fire is the only protection; when it imitates the fire gesture its hair burns and it flees into the water.

description.id: Perekat pada pelana membuat bulunya menempel dan tercabut.
description.en: Glue on the saddle makes its hair stick and tear out.

description.id: Sungai tempat hırtık terutama dipercaya tinggal.
description.en: The river where the hırtık is chiefly believed to live.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa makhluk penyamar dalam cerita rakyat sering dikalahkan oleh sifat menirunya sendiri?
learning_questions.en: Why are disguising creatures in folklore often undone by their own habit of imitation?

claims.quote: Hırtık; üst kısmının insan, alt kısmının hayvan şeklinde olduğuna inanılan, bedeni tüylerle kaplı, ayakları ters kötücül cin, yaratık.

statement.id: Hırtık adalah jin atau makhluk jahat (kötücül cin) yang dipercaya bertubuh atas manusia dan bertubuh bawah hewan, badannya berbulu, dan kakinya terbalik (ayakları ters).
statement.en: Hırtık is a malevolent jinn or creature (kötücül cin) believed to be human above and animal below, with a hair-covered body and backward feet (ayakları ters).

claims.quote: Akarsularda (Elazığ yöresinde özellikle Fırat Nehri'nde) yaşadığı kabul edilir. Bu yörelerde adına Çay hırtığı da denilmektedir.

statement.id: Ia dianggap tinggal di sungai (akarsularda), terutama di Sungai Fırat (Efrat) di daerah Elazığ, dan di sana disebut juga Çay hırtığı.
statement.en: It is held to live in running waters (akarsularda), especially the Fırat (Euphrates) River in the Elazığ area, where it is also called Çay hırtığı.

claims.quote: Hırtık insan kılığına girip, kılığına girdiği kişinin yakın arkadaşlarına veya akrabalarına gidip, onlarla konuşarak orman ya da akarsu kıyısına götürüp boğmakta, öldürmektedir.

statement.id: Hırtık menyamar sebagai manusia (insan kılığına), mendatangi sahabat atau kerabat orang yang ditirunya, mengajak mereka bicara, membawa mereka ke hutan atau tepi sungai, lalu menenggelamkan dan membunuh mereka.
statement.en: Hırtık takes on a human guise (insan kılığına), goes to the close friends or relatives of the person it imitates, talks with them, leads them to a forest or riverbank, and drowns and kills them.

claims.quote: Özellikle karanlıkta ortaya çıkan hırtıktan korunmanın tek yolu ateş yakmaktır. Konuştukları kişinin hırtık olduğundan şüphelenen kişiler, vücutlarının çevresinden veya ayaklarının altından ateş geçirirler.

statement.id: Hırtık terutama muncul dalam gelap (karanlıkta), dan satu-satunya cara melindungi diri adalah menyalakan api (ateş); orang yang curiga lawan bicaranya hırtık melewatkan api di sekitar tubuh atau di bawah kaki mereka.
statement.en: Hırtık appears especially in the dark (karanlıkta), and the only protection is to light a fire (ateş); people who suspect the person they are talking to is a hırtık pass fire around their bodies or under their feet.

claims.quote: Yine hırtığın zaman zaman çeşitli kişilerin kılığında, ata binip gezdiğine ve atları yorduğuna inanılmaktadır.

statement.id: Dipercaya pula bahwa hırtık kadang menyamar sebagai berbagai orang, menunggang kuda (ata binip), dan membuat kuda-kuda kelelahan.
statement.en: It is also believed that the hırtık at times, in the guise of various people, rides horses about (ata binip) and tires them out.

claims.quote: Atlarını sabah yorgun ve terli bir şekilde bulan kişiler hayvanlarını hırtıkın götürüp götürmediğini anlamak için atların semerlerine veya sırtına yapıştırıcı maddeler sürmektedir.

statement.id: Orang yang menemukan kudanya lelah dan berkeringat pada pagi hari mengoleskan bahan perekat (yapıştırıcı maddeler) pada pelana atau punggung kuda untuk mengetahui apakah hırtık telah membawanya.
statement.en: People who find their horses tired and sweaty in the morning smear sticky substances (yapıştırıcı maddeler) on the saddles or backs to find out whether a hırtık has taken them.

claims.quote: Eşdeğer: KIRTIK. HIRTIH Yakaladığı insanları boğarak öldüren sonra da yiyen bir canavar olarak tanımlanır.

statement.id: Nama padanannya Kırtık dan Hırtıh; ia digambarkan sebagai monster (canavar) yang membunuh orang yang ditangkapnya dengan mencekik, lalu memakannya.
statement.en: Equivalent names are Kırtık and Hırtıh; it is described as a monster (canavar) that kills those it catches by strangling and then eats them.

claims.quote: Üst kısmının insan görünümlü, ayaklarıyla bacaklarının ise hayvan biçimli olduğuna inanılır. Bedeni tüylerle kaplı, ayakları terstir.

statement.id: Bagian atasnya dipercaya tampak seperti manusia, sedangkan kaki dan tungkainya berbentuk hewan; badannya berbulu (tüylerle kaplı) dan kakinya terbalik.
statement.en: Its upper part is believed to look human while its feet and legs are animal-shaped; its body is covered with hair (tüylerle kaplı) and its feet point backwards.

claims.quote: Öykünmeci (taklitçi) bir varlık olan Hırtık bu davranışı yineleyince tüyleri yanmaya başlar ve kaçarak kendisini suların içine atar.

statement.id: Karena Hırtık adalah makhluk peniru (öykünmeci, taklitçi), ketika ia mengulangi gerakan api itu bulunya mulai terbakar, dan ia lari lalu menceburkan diri ke air.
statement.en: Because Hırtık is an imitative being (öykünmeci, taklitçi), when it repeats the fire gesture its hair starts to burn, and it flees and throws itself into the water.

claims.quote: Böylece bu hayvana binen Hırtığın tüyleri oraya yapışır ve inerken bu tüyler kopacağı için canı yanar.

statement.id: Dengan begitu bulu Hırtık yang menunggang kuda itu menempel, dan saat turun bulunya tercabut sehingga ia kesakitan (canı yanar).
statement.en: In this way the hair of the Hırtık riding the animal sticks there, and when it dismounts the hair is torn out and it is hurt (canı yanar).

claims.quote: Memoratların Tematik Özellikleri kısmında yaptığı tasnif denemesi içerisinde şu demonik varlıklara yer vermiştir: Cinler, Ağırlık Basması-Karabasan, Congoloz, Erkebit, Hırtik

statement.id: Dalam klasifikasi tema memorat (memoratların tematik özellikleri) karya Çobanoğlu, Hırtik termasuk dalam daftar makhluk demonik bersama Cinler, Karabasan, Congoloz, dan Erkebit.
statement.en: In Çobanoğlu's classification of memorate themes (memoratların tematik özellikleri), Hırtik is listed among the demonic beings, along with Cinler, Karabasan, Congoloz and Erkebit.

short_description.id: Luupainaja adalah roh dalam mitologi Estonia yang menindih orang dan hewan yang sedang tidur pada malam hari, dan bisa diusir dengan menggerakkan ibu jari kaki atau menyalakan api.
short_description.en: The luupainaja is a spirit of Estonian mythology that presses on sleeping people and animals at night and can be driven off by moving the big toe or lighting a fire.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Estonia, luupainaja, yang juga disebut painaja, painak, atau tallaja, adalah roh yang menindih orang yang sedang tidur. Ia datang pada malam hari dan menekan tubuh korban sehingga korban tidak bisa bergerak. Orang tua dahulu percaya tindihan yang lama bisa membawa kematian, dan luupainaja juga menindih hewan pekerja untuk melemahkan tenaganya.
long_description.en: In Estonian mythology the luupainaja, also called painaja, painak or tallaja, is a spirit that presses down on sleepers. It comes at night and weighs on the victim's body so that they cannot move. The old folk believed prolonged pressing could kill, and the luupainaja also pressed on working animals to sap their strength.

long_description.id: Dalam kebanyakan cerita ia tampak sebagai perempuan muda, tetapi juga sebagai perempuan atau lelaki tua, atau sebagai kucing hitam, kuda, dan anjing. Untuk melepaskan diri, orang menggerakkan ibu jari kaki atau menyalakan api, karena luupainaja takut cahaya.
long_description.en: In most tales it appears as a young woman, but also as an old woman or old man, or as a black cat, horse or dog. To get free, people moved their big toe or lit a fire, since the luupainaja fears light.

long_description.id: M. J. Eisen mencatat bahwa luupainaja memilih korban dan menindihnya setiap malam seperti batu di dada. Menurut kisah yang dikenal luas, bila lubang masuknya ditutup dan api dinyalakan, ia tampak sebagai gadis muda yang kemudian dinikahi korbannya, sampai suaminya mencabut sumbat lubang itu dan sang istri lenyap. Eisen menyimpulkan bahwa luupainaja sebenarnya penyihir, manusia yang jiwanya meninggalkan tubuh dan mengambil berbagai wujud.
long_description.en: M. J. Eisen recorded that the luupainaja chooses a victim and presses on them nightly like a stone on the chest. In a widely known tale, when its entry hole is stopped and a light is struck it appears as a young girl whom the victim marries, until the husband pulls the plug from the hole and the wife vanishes. Eisen concluded that the luupainaja is really a witch, a human whose soul leaves the body and takes various forms.

who.id: Luupainaja adalah roh penindih orang tidur.
who.en: The luupainaja is a spirit that presses on sleepers.

role.id: Ia menindih manusia dan hewan pada malam hari.
role.en: It presses on people and animals at night.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal bisa diusir dengan menggerakkan ibu jari kaki.
famous_for.en: It is known to flee when the big toe is moved.

did_you_know.id: Menggerakkan ibu jari kaki konon cukup untuk mengusir luupainaja.
did_you_know.en: Moving the big toe was said to be enough to drive off a luupainaja.

description.id: Menggerakkan ibu jari kaki membuat tallaja lari.
description.en: Moving the big toe makes the tallaja flee.

description.id: Luupainaja takut cahaya, sehingga menyalakan api bisa mengusirnya.
description.en: The luupainaja fears light, so lighting a fire drives it off.

role.en: The vanishing wife

summary.id: Luupainaja yang tertangkap menjadi gadis muda dan dinikahi korbannya; bertahun-tahun kemudian sang suami mencabut sumbat lubang masuknya dan istrinya lenyap.
summary.en: A captured luupainaja becomes a young girl and marries her victim; years later the husband pulls the plug from her entry hole and she vanishes.

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana kepercayaan tentang luupainaja menjelaskan pengalaman sulit bergerak saat terbangun?
learning_questions.en: How might beliefs about the luupainaja explain the experience of being unable to move on waking?

claims.quote: Luupainaja on eesti mütoloogias magajaid painav vaim.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Estonia, luupainaja adalah roh yang menindih orang yang sedang tidur.
statement.en: In Estonian mythology the luupainaja is a spirit that presses down on sleepers.

claims.quote: Luupainaja teiste nimetuste hulka kuuluvad painaja, painak, panijas, paanjas, painakane, luupaanija, luupaine, luupatak, tallaja.

statement.id: Nama lain luupainaja antara lain painaja, painak, panijas, paanjas, painakane, luupaanija, luupaine, luupatak, dan tallaja.
statement.en: Other names of the luupainaja include painaja, painak, panijas, paanjas, painakane, luupaanija, luupaine, luupatak and tallaja.

claims.quote: Nimelt käivad tallajad öösiti oma ohvrit painamas. Nad rõhuvad oma ohvri keha, nii et too liigutada ei saa.

statement.id: Tallaja datang pada malam hari menindih korbannya, menekan tubuh korban sehingga ia tidak bisa bergerak.
statement.en: The tallajad come at night to press on their victim, weighing down the body so the victim cannot move.

claims.quote: Vanarahvas arvas, et pikaaegne painamine võib surma tuua. Tallajad ei käi ainult inimesi piinamas, vaid üritavad ka tööloomade jõudu oma rõhumisega nõrgendada.

statement.id: Orang tua dahulu percaya bahwa tindihan yang berlangsung lama bisa membawa kematian; tallaja tidak hanya menyiksa manusia tetapi juga berusaha melemahkan tenaga hewan pekerja dengan tindihannya.
statement.en: The old folk believed prolonged pressing could bring death; the tallajad torment not only people but also try to weaken working animals by pressing on them.

claims.quote: Enamikus juttudes on öeldud, et tallajad ilmutavad end noore naisena, kuid ei pelga ära ka vana naise ja vana mehena ilmumist. Samuti on loomadega – luupainajaid kirjeldatakse nii mustade kassidena, hobustena, koertena jne.

statement.id: Dalam kebanyakan cerita, tallaja menampakkan diri sebagai perempuan muda, tetapi juga sebagai perempuan tua atau lelaki tua; luupainaja juga digambarkan sebagai kucing hitam, kuda, anjing, dan sebagainya.
statement.en: In most tales the tallajad appear as a young woman, though also as an old woman or old man; luupainajad are also described as black cats, horses, dogs and so on.

claims.quote: Lihtsaim neist on suure varba liigutamine. Nimelt arvati, et kui tunned luupainajat end rõhuvat, tuleb suurt varvast liigutada ning siis tallaja põgeneb.

statement.id: Cara paling mudah untuk melepaskan diri adalah menggerakkan ibu jari kaki: orang percaya bila merasa ditindih luupainaja, ibu jari kaki harus digerakkan, maka tallaja akan lari.
statement.en: The simplest way to get free is to move the big toe: it was believed that if you feel the luupainaja pressing on you, you must move your big toe and the tallaja will flee.

claims.quote: Teiseks levinud võimaluseks oli tule põlema panemine, valgust pidavat luupainajad kartma.

statement.id: Cara umum lainnya adalah menyalakan api, karena luupainaja konon takut cahaya.
statement.en: Another common way was to light a fire, as the luupainajad were said to fear light.

claims.quote: Luupainaja valib enesele mingisuguse isiku ohvriks ja hakkab seda kas igal ööl ehk mõne öö takka painamas käima, nagu kivi rinnul ehk kehal lasudes

statement.id: Menurut M. J. Eisen, luupainaja memilih seseorang sebagai korban dan datang menindihnya setiap malam atau selang beberapa malam, seperti batu yang menimpa dada atau tubuh.
statement.en: According to M. J. Eisen, the luupainaja chooses a person as its victim and comes to press on them every night or every few nights, lying like a stone on the chest or body.

claims.quote: Laialt tuntakse lugu, mille järele sissetuleku-augu sulgumise ja tulesüütamise peale luupainaja ilmub noorena tütarlapsena, kelle painatav hiljemini enesele kosib.

statement.id: Dikenal luas kisah bahwa bila lubang masuknya ditutup dan api dinyalakan, luupainaja menampakkan diri sebagai gadis muda, yang kemudian dilamar oleh orang yang ditindihnya.
statement.en: A widely known tale says that when its entry hole is closed and a light is struck, the luupainaja appears as a young girl, whom the person she pressed later marries.

claims.quote: Mõlemad elavad õnnelikult, kuni abielumees 7 ehk 14 aastat pärast pulmi luupainaja sissetuleku-augu eest pulga võtab, ja kohe kaob naine nagu õhk toast.

statement.id: Keduanya hidup bahagia sampai sang suami, 7 atau 14 tahun setelah pernikahan, mencabut sumbat dari lubang masuk luupainaja, dan seketika sang istri lenyap dari ruangan seperti udara.
statement.en: Both live happily until the husband, 7 or 14 years after the wedding, pulls the plug from the luupainaja's entry hole, and at once the wife vanishes from the room like air.

claims.quote: Nagu eelmistest seletustest selgub, on luupainaja inimene, kuid mitte tavaline inimene, vaid niisugune, kes enesele iseäraliku tarkusega vaimude omaduse pärinud, teise sõnaga nõid.

statement.id: Eisen menyimpulkan bahwa luupainaja adalah manusia, tetapi bukan manusia biasa, melainkan orang yang dengan pengetahuan khusus memperoleh sifat roh, dengan kata lain seorang penyihir.
statement.en: Eisen concludes that the luupainaja is a human, but not an ordinary one: someone who by special knowledge has acquired the qualities of spirits, in other words a witch.

claims.quote: Tõepoolest ei muuda luupainaja inimlik keha ennast sugugi, vaid hing lahkub kehast, enesele lahkudes üht ehk teist kuju võttes.

statement.id: Tubuh manusia luupainaja sebenarnya tidak berubah; jiwanya yang meninggalkan tubuh dan mengambil satu atau lain wujud.
statement.en: The luupainaja's human body does not really change; rather the soul leaves the body, taking one form or another as it goes.

summary.id: Roh yang menindih orang tidur.
summary.en: A spirit that presses on sleepers.

summary.id: Penyihir manusia yang jiwanya meninggalkan tubuh (Eisen).
summary.en: A human witch whose soul leaves the body (Eisen).

short_description.id: Nihang adalah naga air bersurai emas dalam mitologi Chitrali di Pakistan barat laut. Kisah terkenalnya menceritakan naga danau di Mastuj yang dibunuh seorang pemberani dengan pedang beracun bergagang ganda.
short_description.en: The Nihang is a golden-maned water dragon of Chitrali mythology in northwestern Pakistan. Its best-known tale tells of a lake dragon at Mastuj slain by a brave man with a poisoned, double-hilted sword.

long_description.id: Nihang adalah naga air dalam mitologi Chitrali di Pakistan barat laut. Namanya diturunkan dari kata Persia nahang, yang berarti buaya tetapi juga dipakai untuk aneka makhluk laut. Makhluk ini dibayangkan sebagai ular bersayap yang sangat besar, bersisik, dan bersurai emas.
long_description.en: The Nihang is a water dragon of Chitrali mythology in northwestern Pakistan. Its name comes from the Persian word nahang, meaning crocodile but also applied to assorted sea creatures. It is imagined as a very large, scaly winged serpent with a golden mane.

long_description.id: Menurut artikel kedua, ciri tubuhnya mengingatkan pada naga Asia Timur: surai tebal seperti bulu, hidup di air, dan badan panjang ramping menyerupai ular. Bedanya, Nihang dipandang sebagai makhluk jahat yang menebar teror di sekitarnya. Penulis yang sama menilai kepercayaan pada makhluk penghuni danau sudah tua di pegunungan Hindu Kush.
long_description.en: According to the second source, its body recalls East Asian dragons: a thick fur-like mane, a watery home and a long slender snake-like body. Unlike them, however, the Nihang is seen as a malevolent creature spreading terror around it. The same author considers belief in lake-dwelling beings to be old in the Hindu Kush mountains.

long_description.id: Kisah paling terkenal terjadi di Mastuj. Dahulu sungai di sana membentuk danau besar di bawah kota, tempat seekor naga raksasa memangsa ikan, hewan, dan akhirnya manusia. Naga itu kebal senjata dan panah tidak dapat menjangkaunya dari jauh.
long_description.en: The best-known tale is set in Mastuj. Long ago the river there formed a large lake below the town, where a giant dragon preyed on fish, animals and eventually people. It could not be harmed by weapons, and arrows could not reach it from afar.

long_description.id: Seorang pemberani lalu memesan pedang panjang bergagang di kedua ujung dan melumuri matanya dengan racun. Saat naga menyedotnya ke dalam mulut, bilah itu membelah rahangnya dan racun menyelesaikan sisanya. Ia membawa pulang seikat rambut emas dari surai naga ke istana. Danau itu kini lenyap, tetapi tempatnya masih bernama Nahangu Chhat, yang dalam bahasa Khowar berarti Danau Naga.
long_description.en: A brave man then had a long sword made with a hilt at each end and poisoned its edge. When the dragon drew him into its mouth, the blade split its jaws and the poison did the rest. He carried a golden lock of the dragon's mane back to the palace. The lake has since vanished, yet the spot is still named Nahangu Chhat, meaning The Dragon's Lake in Khowar.

literal_meaning.id: buaya; juga dipakai untuk berbagai makhluk laut
literal_meaning.en: crocodile; also used for various sea creatures

who.id: Nihang adalah naga air bersurai emas dalam mitologi Chitrali.
who.en: The Nihang is a golden-maned water dragon of Chitrali mythology.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari tradisi Chitrali di Pakistan barat laut.
origin.en: It comes from the Chitrali tradition of northwestern Pakistan.

role.id: Dalam kisah, ia meneror penduduk di sekitar danau tempat tinggalnya.
role.en: In the tales it terrorizes the people living around its lake.

famous_for.id: Ia terkenal karena naga danau Mastuj yang dibunuh dengan pedang beracun bergagang ganda.
famous_for.en: It is famous for the Mastuj lake dragon slain with a poisoned double-hilted sword.

did_you_know.id: Danau tempat naga Mastuj tinggal sudah hilang, tetapi lokasinya masih dinamai Nahangu Chhat, Danau Naga.
did_you_know.en: The lake of the Mastuj dragon is gone, but the site is still named Nahangu Chhat, The Dragon's Lake.

description.id: Naga Mastuj kebal senjata biasa, tetapi tewas ketika pedang beracun bergagang di kedua ujung membelah rahangnya.
description.en: The Mastuj dragon resisted ordinary weapons but died when a poisoned sword hilted at both ends split its jaws.

role.id: Naga pemangsa yang menghuni danau di bawah kota.
role.en: The predatory dragon living in the lake below the town.

summary.id: Naga di danau Mastuj memangsa ikan, hewan, lalu manusia. Seorang pemberani memesan pedang bergagang ganda, meracuni bilahnya, dan membunuh naga itu saat disedot ke mulutnya; ia membawa seikat rambut emas surainya ke istana.
summary.en: The dragon of the Mastuj lake preyed on fish, animals and then people. A brave man had a double-hilted sword made, poisoned its blade and killed the dragon as it sucked him into its mouth; he brought a golden lock of its mane to the palace.

description.id: Bekas danau di bawah kota Mastuj tempat naga itu tinggal; danaunya sudah tidak ada, tetapi namanya bertahan.
description.en: Former lake below the town of Mastuj where the dragon lived; the lake is gone but the name survives.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa nama sebuah tempat bisa menyimpan ingatan tentang makhluk mitos walaupun danaunya sudah hilang?
learning_questions.en: Why might a place name keep the memory of a mythical creature even after the lake itself has disappeared?

claims.quote: Nihang are mythical water dragons from the Chitrali mythology in northwestern Pakistan.

statement.id: Nihang adalah naga air mitos (mythical water dragons) dalam mitologi Chitrali di Pakistan barat laut.
statement.en: Nihang are mythical water dragons from the Chitrali mythology in northwestern Pakistan.

claims.quote: Other creatures of fame in Chitrali Mythology are the lake-dwelling dragons, known as Nihang, the name being derived from the Persian word nahang for crocodiles but classically used for various sea creatures.

statement.id: Naga penghuni danau (lake-dwelling dragons) dalam mitologi Chitrali disebut Nihang; namanya berasal dari kata Persia nahang untuk buaya, yang secara klasik juga dipakai untuk berbagai makhluk laut.
statement.en: The lake-dwelling dragons of Chitrali mythology are called Nihang; the name derives from the Persian word nahang for crocodiles, classically also used for various sea creatures.

claims.quote: Perhaps a better term for these creatures would be winged serpents, also found in many parts of mainland Pakistan. These gigantic scaly creatures were known for their golden manes,

statement.id: Penulis menilai makhluk ini lebih tepat disebut ular bersayap (winged serpents); mereka raksasa bersisik yang dikenal karena surai emasnya (golden manes).
statement.en: The author suggests these creatures are better called winged serpents; they were gigantic scaly creatures known for their golden manes.

claims.quote: one of them inhabited a lake in Chitral where it terrorized the local populace, but its reign of terror ended when one day an ancient warrior stood up against it using a double-hilted sword.

statement.id: Salah satunya menghuni sebuah danau di Chitral dan meneror penduduk, sampai seorang pendekar kuno melawannya dengan pedang bergagang ganda (double-hilted sword).
statement.en: One of them inhabited a lake in Chitral and terrorized the populace until an ancient warrior stood up against it with a double-hilted sword.

claims.quote: the physical description of the dragon appears to be completely East Asian with the thick furlike mane, aquatic habitat, and a long slender serpent-like body, however, unlike the Eastern dragons, the Chitrali dragon appears to be a malevolent creature bent on keeping a reign of terror upon its vicinity.

statement.id: Wujud naga Chitrali tampak sepenuhnya Asia Timur (East Asian): surai tebal seperti bulu, habitat air, dan tubuh panjang ramping seperti ular; namun tidak seperti naga Timur, ia makhluk jahat (malevolent) yang meneror sekitarnya.
statement.en: The Chitrali dragon looks wholly East Asian, with a thick fur-like mane, aquatic habitat and long slender serpent-like body, but unlike Eastern dragons it is a malevolent creature that terrorizes its vicinity.

claims.quote: Lake dwelling creatures seem to be an ancient belief of the Hindu Kush mountains.

statement.id: Makhluk penghuni danau tampaknya merupakan kepercayaan kuno di pegunungan Hindu Kush (Hindu Kush mountains).
statement.en: Lake-dwelling creatures seem to be an ancient belief of the Hindu Kush mountains.

claims.quote: The river which flows by Mastuj, once formed a large lake just below the town. It is said that an enormous dragon lived in the lake. He preyed upon all living things, ranging from fish to animals. With the passage of time, he began to attack humans.

statement.id: Sungai yang mengalir di dekat Mastuj dulu membentuk danau besar di bawah kota; konon seekor naga raksasa (enormous dragon) tinggal di sana, memangsa segala makhluk hidup dari ikan hingga hewan, lalu mulai menyerang manusia.
statement.en: The river by Mastuj once formed a large lake below the town; an enormous dragon is said to have lived there, preying on all living things from fish to animals, and later began to attack humans.

claims.quote: The huge reptile was invulnerable to weapons. Arrows didn’t reach him from a long distance, while going near it was difficult and risky.

statement.id: Reptil raksasa itu kebal senjata (invulnerable to weapons); anak panah tidak mencapainya dari jauh, sedangkan mendekatinya sulit dan berbahaya.
statement.en: The huge reptile was invulnerable to weapons; arrows did not reach it from afar, and approaching it was difficult and risky.

claims.quote: Afterwards he ordered a blacksmith to make a long and sharp sword, with a hilt on both ends.

statement.id: Sang pemberani memesan kepada pandai besi (blacksmith) sebilah pedang panjang dan tajam dengan gagang di kedua ujungnya.
statement.en: The brave man had a blacksmith make a long sharp sword with a hilt on both ends.

claims.quote: As soon as he pulled the man towards its mouth, the razor sharp blade of the sword began slicing his jaws apart. Soon he went down to its belly, poison swiftly completed the rest of the job.

statement.id: Ketika naga menyedot sang pria ke mulutnya, bilah pedang yang sangat tajam membelah rahangnya (jaws), dan racun (poison) menuntaskan sisanya.
statement.en: When the dragon pulled the man towards its mouth, the razor-sharp blade sliced its jaws apart, and poison finished the job.

claims.quote: The brave man cut one of the golden locks from the dragon’s mane and galloped his horse towards the royal court.

statement.id: Sang pemberani memotong seikat rambut emas (golden locks) dari surai naga lalu memacu kudanya ke istana raja.
statement.en: The brave man cut one of the golden locks from the dragon's mane and rode to the royal court.

claims.quote: The Lake no more exists today but the place is still called Nahangu Chhat (The Dragon’s Lake).

statement.id: Danau itu kini sudah tidak ada, tetapi tempatnya masih disebut Nahangu Chhat (The Dragon's Lake, Danau Naga).
statement.en: The lake no longer exists, but the place is still called Nahangu Chhat (The Dragon's Lake).

claims.quote: Though the lake is gone, the place is still called Nahangu Chhat, which means "The Dragon’s Lake" in the Khowar language.

statement.id: Nama tempat Nahangu Chhat berarti Danau Naga (The Dragon's Lake) dalam bahasa Khowar.
statement.en: The place name Nahangu Chhat means The Dragon's Lake in the Khowar language.

short_description.id: Dyrnwch, juga disebut Diwrnach, adalah raksasa dalam mitologi Welsh yang memiliki kuali ajaib; merebut kuali itu menjadi salah satu tugas dalam kisah Culhwch ac Olwen.
short_description.en: Dyrnwch, also called Diwrnach, is a giant of Welsh mythology who owns a magic cauldron; winning that cauldron is one of the tasks in the tale Culhwch ac Olwen.

long_description.id: Dyrnwch adalah tokoh legenda dari mitologi Welsh yang berjuluk 'sang Raksasa'. Ia juga dikenal sebagai Diwrnach, berjuluk 'orang Irlandia', serta dengan ejaan Dyrnog dan Tyrnog; dalam bahasa Irlandia bentuknya Diugurach. Nama Diwrnach diturunkan dari Diugurach untuk menekankan asal Irlandia pemilik kuali, sedangkan Dyrnog dan Tyrnog dianggap penyesuaian Welsh atas nama asing itu.
long_description.en: Dyrnwch is a figure of Welsh mythology nicknamed 'the Giant'. He is also known as Diwrnach, nicknamed 'the Irishman', and by the spellings Dyrnog and Tyrnog; the Irish form is Diugurach. The name Diwrnach derives from Diugurach, emphasising the Irish origin of the cauldron's owner, while Dyrnog and Tyrnog are considered Welsh approximations of that foreign name.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Kulhwch ac Olwen, raksasa Ysbaddaden memberi pelamar putrinya serangkaian tugas berat. Salah satunya merebut kuali Dyrnwch, yang dalam teks disebut Diwrnach, untuk jamuan pernikahan; terjemahan Guest menyebutnya Diwrnach Wyddel, pengurus rumah tangga Odgar putra Aedd, raja Irlandia. Diwrnach menolak menyerahkan kuali itu dan bersumpah Arthur bahkan tidak boleh melihatnya. Bedwyr lalu merebut kuali itu, Diwrnach dan rombongannya dibunuh, dan Arthur membawa pulang kuali itu berisi penuh uang Irlandia.
long_description.en: In the tale Kulhwch ac Olwen, the giant Ysbaddaden sets his daughter's suitor a series of hard tasks. One is to win the cauldron of Dyrnwch, called Diwrnach in the text, for the wedding feast; Guest's translation calls him Diwrnach Wyddel, steward of Odgar the son of Aedd, king of Ireland. Diwrnach refuses to give it up and swears Arthur shall not even look at it. Bedwyr then seizes the cauldron, Diwrnach and his company are slain, and Arthur carries the cauldron away full of Irish money.

long_description.id: Kuali itu termasuk Tiga Belas Pusaka Pulau Britania (Tri Thlws ar Ddeg Ynys Prydain). Kuali itu membedakan orang baik dari orang jahat, atau pemberani dari pengecut: daging untuk pengecut tidak pernah mendidih di dalamnya, sedangkan daging untuk orang pemberani cepat matang. Menurut sebuah ensiklopedia daring, kisah kuali Dyrnwch dan kuali Diwrnach semula terpisah dan baru kemudian disatukan menjadi satu mitos.
long_description.en: The cauldron is one of the Thirteen Treasures of the Island of Britain (Tri Thlws ar Ddeg Ynys Prydain). It tells good people from bad, or the brave from the cowardly: meat for a coward never boils in it, while meat for a brave man cooks quickly. According to one online encyclopedia, the tales of Dyrnwch's cauldron and Diwrnach's cauldron were originally separate and were only later merged into a single myth.

literal_meaning.id: nama Diwrnach diturunkan dari bentuk Irlandia Diugurach
literal_meaning.en: the name Diwrnach derives from the Irish form Diugurach

who.id: Dyrnwch adalah raksasa pemilik kuali ajaib.
who.en: Dyrnwch is a giant who owns a magic cauldron.

origin.id: Ia tokoh mitologi Welsh, juga disebut Diwrnach orang Irlandia.
origin.en: He is a figure of Welsh mythology, also called Diwrnach the Irishman.

role.id: Kualinya menjadi salah satu tugas yang harus direbut untuk pernikahan Kulhwch.
role.en: His cauldron is one of the tasks that must be won for Kulhwch's wedding.

famous_for.id: Kualinya tidak mau merebus daging untuk pengecut.
famous_for.en: His cauldron refuses to boil meat for a coward.

did_you_know.id: Kuali Dyrnwch termasuk Tiga Belas Pusaka Pulau Britania.
did_you_know.en: Dyrnwch's cauldron is counted among the Thirteen Treasures of the Island of Britain.

title.en: Kulhwch ac Olwen: the winning of the cauldron

role.en: Owner of the cauldron who refuses to give it up

summary.id: Arthur meminta kuali itu, tetapi Diwrnach menolak; Bedwyr merebutnya, Diwrnach dan rombongannya dibunuh, dan kuali itu dibawa pulang berisi uang Irlandia.
summary.en: Arthur asks for the cauldron but Diwrnach refuses; Bedwyr seizes it, Diwrnach and his company are slain, and the cauldron is carried home full of Irish money.

note.id: Raksasa yang menetapkan perebutan kuali sebagai tugas.
note.en: The giant who sets the winning of the cauldron as a task.

note.id: Pemilik kuali dalam daftar Tiga Belas Pusaka; namanya kemungkinan berasal dari Diwrnach.
note.en: Owner of the cauldron in the Thirteen Treasures list; his name probably goes back to Diwrnach.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa sebuah kuali yang bisa membedakan pemberani dari pengecut dianggap pusaka?
learning_questions.en: Why would a cauldron that tells the brave from the cowardly be considered a treasure?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana dua kisah yang semula terpisah bisa bergabung menjadi satu tokoh?
learning_questions.en: How can two originally separate tales merge into a single figure?

sources.title: Thirteen Treasures of the Island of Britain
The Mabinogion — Kilhwch and Olwen, or the Twrch Trwyth
sources.author: Lady Charlotte Guest (translator)

claims.quote: Dyrnwch, Beiname „der Riese“, auch Diwrnach, Beiname „der Ire“, Dyrnog, Tyrnog, irisch Diugurach, ist eine Sagengestalt aus der walisischen Mythologie.

statement.id: Dyrnwch, berjuluk 'sang Raksasa' (der Riese), juga Diwrnach berjuluk 'orang Irlandia' (der Ire), Dyrnog, Tyrnog, dalam bahasa Irlandia Diugurach, adalah tokoh legenda (Sagengestalt) dari mitologi Welsh (walisischen Mythologie).
statement.en: Dyrnwch, nicknamed 'the Giant' (der Riese), also Diwrnach, nicknamed 'the Irishman' (der Ire), Dyrnog, Tyrnog, Irish Diugurach, is a figure of legend (Sagengestalt) from Welsh mythology (walisischen Mythologie).

claims.quote: In der Erzählung Kulhwch ac Olwen („Die Geschichte von Kulhwch und Olwen“) wird berichtet, dass Olwens Vater, der Riese Ysbaddaden, dem Freier Kulhwch einige schwere Aufgaben stellt

statement.id: Dalam kisah Kulhwch ac Olwen, ayah Olwen, raksasa (Riese) Ysbaddaden, memberi pelamar Kulhwch sejumlah tugas berat (schwere Aufgaben).
statement.en: In the tale Kulhwch ac Olwen, Olwen's father, the giant (Riese) Ysbaddaden, sets the suitor Kulhwch several hard tasks (schwere Aufgaben).

claims.quote: Eine der Aufgabe ist, den Kessel des irischen Riesen Dyrnwch, im Text Diwrnach genannt, für das Hochzeitsmahl zu erringen.

statement.id: Salah satu tugasnya adalah merebut kuali (Kessel) milik raksasa Irlandia (irischen Riesen) Dyrnwch, yang dalam teks disebut Diwrnach, untuk jamuan pernikahan (Hochzeitsmahl).
statement.en: One of the tasks is to win the cauldron (Kessel) of the Irish giant (irischen Riesen) Dyrnwch, called Diwrnach in the text, for the wedding feast (Hochzeitsmahl).

claims.quote: Dieser Kessel hat die mythische Bedeutung, böse von guten Menschen unterscheiden zu können. Für schlechte Menschen kocht er kein Essen, bei den anderen ist er schnellstens mit einer Speise fertig.

statement.id: Kuali (Kessel) itu dapat membedakan orang jahat (böse) dari orang baik (guten Menschen): bagi orang jahat ia tidak memasak makanan (Essen), bagi yang lain ia cepat sekali menyiapkan hidangan.
statement.en: The cauldron (Kessel) can tell bad people (böse) from good people (guten Menschen): for bad people it cooks no food (Essen), for the others it readies a dish very quickly.

claims.quote: Diwrnach weigert sich, den Kessel herzugeben.

statement.id: Diwrnach menolak (weigert sich) menyerahkan kuali (Kessel) itu.
statement.en: Diwrnach refuses (weigert sich) to hand over the cauldron (Kessel).

claims.quote: Deshalb entwendet Bedwyr fab Bedrawg den Kessel und lässt ihn wegbringen. Seine Gefährten töten Diwrnach und alle Iren, die um den Kessel kämpfen wollen.

statement.id: Karena itu Bedwyr fab Bedrawg mengambil kuali (Kessel) itu dan menyuruh membawanya pergi; rekan-rekannya membunuh (töten) Diwrnach dan semua orang Irlandia (Iren) yang hendak memperebutkannya.
statement.en: So Bedwyr fab Bedrawg takes the cauldron (Kessel) and has it carried away; his companions kill (töten) Diwrnach and all the Irish (Iren) who want to fight for it.

claims.quote: Dieser Kessel zählt zu den Tri Thlws ar Ddeg Ynys Prydain („Die dreizehn Schätze der Insel Britannien“).

statement.id: Kuali (Kessel) ini termasuk Tri Thlws ar Ddeg Ynys Prydain, 'Tiga Belas Pusaka Pulau Britania' (dreizehn Schätze der Insel Britannien).
statement.en: This cauldron (Kessel) is one of the Tri Thlws ar Ddeg Ynys Prydain, 'the Thirteen Treasures of the Island of Britain' (dreizehn Schätze der Insel Britannien).

claims.quote: Der kymrische Name Diwrnach wird vom irischen Diugurach abgeleitet, damit wird die irische Herkunft des Kesselbesitzers betont.

statement.id: Nama Welsh (kymrische Name) Diwrnach diturunkan dari bahasa Irlandia Diugurach (irischen Diugurach), sehingga asal Irlandia pemilik kuali itu ditekankan.
statement.en: The Welsh name (kymrische Name) Diwrnach derives from Irish Diugurach (irischen Diugurach), emphasising the Irish origin of the cauldron's owner.

claims.quote: Ursprünglich waren die Sagen vom Kessel Dyrnwchs und vom Kessel Diwrnachs getrenntes Erzählgut, in Culhwch ac Olwen wurden sie im Laufe der Zeit zu einem einzigen Mythos vereinigt.

statement.id: Semula kisah kuali Dyrnwch dan kisah kuali Diwrnach adalah cerita terpisah (getrenntes Erzählgut); dalam Culhwch ac Olwen keduanya lambat laun disatukan menjadi satu mitos (einzigen Mythos).
statement.en: Originally the tales of Dyrnwch's cauldron and Diwrnach's cauldron were separate (getrenntes Erzählgut); in Culhwch ac Olwen they were merged over time into a single myth (einzigen Mythos).

claims.quote: The Cauldron of Dyrnwch the Giant (Pair Dyrnwch Gawr ... "if meat for a coward were put in it to boil, it would never boil; but if meat for a brave man were put in it, it would boil quickly (and thus the brave could be distinguished from the cowardly)".

statement.id: Kuali Dyrnwch sang Raksasa (Pair Dyrnwch Gawr): daging untuk seorang pengecut tidak akan pernah mendidih di dalamnya, sedangkan daging untuk orang pemberani cepat mendidih, sehingga yang berani dapat dibedakan dari yang pengecut.
statement.en: The Cauldron of Dyrnwch the Giant (Pair Dyrnwch Gawr): meat for a coward would never boil in it, but meat for a brave man would boil quickly, so that the brave could be distinguished from the cowardly.

claims.quote: Although Dyrnwch is not himself described as an Irishman, it is probable that his name goes back to Diwrnach.

statement.id: Walaupun Dyrnwch sendiri tidak disebut orang Irlandia (Irishman), kemungkinan besar namanya berasal dari Diwrnach.
statement.en: Although Dyrnwch is not himself described as an Irishman, his name probably goes back to Diwrnach.

claims.quote: The extant manuscripts of Tri Thlws ar Ddeg also present such variant spellings as Dyrnog and Tyrnog, without the Irish-sounding ending, but on balance, these are best explained as Welsh approximations of a foreign name.

statement.id: Naskah Tri Thlws ar Ddeg juga memuat ejaan Dyrnog dan Tyrnog tanpa akhiran berbunyi Irlandia, yang paling baik dijelaskan sebagai penyesuaian Welsh atas nama asing.
statement.en: The manuscripts of Tri Thlws ar Ddeg also give the spellings Dyrnog and Tyrnog, without the Irish-sounding ending, best explained as Welsh approximations of a foreign name.

claims.quote: The cauldron of Diwrnach Wyddel, the steward of Odgar the son of Aedd, king of Ireland, to boil the meat for thy marriage feast.

statement.id: Dalam terjemahan Guest, tugas itu adalah mendapatkan kuali Diwrnach Wyddel, pengurus rumah tangga Odgar putra Aedd, raja Irlandia (Ireland), untuk merebus daging pesta pernikahan.
statement.en: In Guest's translation the task is to obtain the cauldron of Diwrnach Wyddel, the steward of Odgar the son of Aedd, king of Ireland, to boil the meat for the marriage feast.

claims.quote: Diwrnach said, “Heaven is my witness, if it would avail him anything even to look at it, he should not do so.”

statement.id: Diwrnach bersumpah bahwa Arthur bahkan tidak akan diizinkan melihat kuali itu.
statement.en: Diwrnach swore that Arthur should not even be allowed to look at the cauldron.

claims.quote: Bedwyr arose and seized hold of the cauldron, and placed it upon the back of Hygwyd, Arthur’s servant

statement.id: Bedwyr bangkit, merebut kuali itu, dan meletakkannya di punggung Hygwyd, pelayan Arthur.
statement.en: Bedwyr arose, seized the cauldron and placed it on the back of Hygwyd, Arthur's servant.

claims.quote: And they slew Diwrnach Wyddel and his company.

statement.id: Mereka membunuh Diwrnach Wyddel dan rombongannya.
statement.en: They slew Diwrnach Wyddel and his company.

claims.quote: Arthur with his men went forward to the ship, carrying away the cauldron full of Irish money.

statement.id: Arthur dan anak buahnya kembali ke kapal sambil membawa kuali itu berisi penuh uang Irlandia (Irish money).
statement.en: Arthur and his men went to the ship carrying away the cauldron full of Irish money.

summary.id: Satu ensiklopedia daring menyebutnya raksasa Irlandia dengan julukan 'sang Raksasa'.
summary.en: One online encyclopedia calls him an Irish giant nicknamed 'the Giant'.

summary.id: Terjemahan Guest menyebutnya Diwrnach Wyddel, pengurus rumah tangga raja Irlandia Odgar, tanpa menyebut raksasa.
summary.en: Guest's translation calls him Diwrnach Wyddel, steward of the Irish king Odgar, without calling him a giant.

summary.id: Ensiklopedia daring lain mencatat Dyrnwch dalam daftar pusaka tidak disebut orang Irlandia, tetapi namanya kemungkinan berasal dari Diwrnach.
summary.en: Another online encyclopedia notes that Dyrnwch in the treasure list is not described as an Irishman, though his name probably goes back to Diwrnach.

gaps.searched: Tidak ditemukan berkas Commons yang menggambarkan Dyrnwch atau Diwrnach.

Item ini (Q1269219) dan dyrnwch-gawr (Q20592798) tampaknya tokoh yang sama: Wikipedia Jerman menyamakan Dyrnwch dengan Diwrnach, dan Wikipedia Inggris menyebut nama Dyrnwch kemungkinan berasal dari Diwrnach. Entri ini mengikuti artikel Jerman (Dyrnwch = Diwrnach); entri dyrnwch-gawr mengikuti artikel Welsh.
Rujukan cetak (Birkhan, Bromwich, Koch, Sims-Williams) tidak dapat dibaca daring.

short_description.id: Erawan adalah bentuk Thailand dari gajah mitis Airavata: gajah putih raksasa berkepala banyak yang menjadi tunggangan Dewa Indra di surga Tavatimsa.
short_description.en: Erawan is the Thai form of the mythical elephant Airavata: a giant, many-headed white elephant that serves as the mount of the god Indra in the Tavatimsa heaven.

long_description.id: Erawan adalah bentuk Thailand dari gajah mitis Airavata. Ia gajah raksasa sebesar gunung, biasanya berkepala tiga dan kadang hingga 33, masing-masing dengan tujuh gading. Ia tunggangan Indra, dewa hujan dan guntur, penguasa surga Tavatimsa, tempat tinggal 33 dewa.
long_description.en: Erawan is the Thai form of the mythical elephant Airavata. He is a giant elephant as big as a mountain, usually with three heads and sometimes as many as 33, each bearing seven tusks. He is the mount of Indra, god of rain and thunder and ruler of the Tavatimsa heaven, home of 33 gods.

long_description.id: Karya Thailand abad ke-14, Traiphum Phra Ruang, menggambarkan Erawan bukan sebagai hewan, sebab di surga itu tidak ada hewan, melainkan devatā bernama "Devatā Erawan". Setiap kali Indra ingin berkuda untuk bersenang-senang, Devatā Erawan menjelma menjadi gajah putih yang sangat besar dengan 33 kepala; kepala di tengah, Sudassana, menjadi singgasana Indra.
long_description.en: The 14th-century Thai work Traiphum Phra Ruang describes Erawan not as an animal, since there are no animals in that heaven, but as a devatā called 'Devatā Erawan'. Whenever Indra wishes to ride out for pleasure, Devatā Erawan turns into an enormous white elephant with 33 heads; the central head, Sudassana, is Indra's throne.

long_description.id: Erawan adalah motif keagamaan penting di Thailand dan sering dipakai sebagai ornamen, misalnya pada tanda kehormatan Orde Chula Chom Klao dan pada berbagai monumen; nama I-rapote juga dipakai di Thailand.
long_description.en: Erawan is an important religious motif in Thailand and is often used as an ornament, for instance on the insignia of the Order of Chula Chom Klao and on monuments; the name I-rapote is also used in Thailand.

who.en: A many-headed white elephant.

role.en: The mount of the god Indra.

famous_for.id: Menjadi singgasana Indra.
famous_for.en: Serves as Indra's throne.

did_you_know.id: Menurut Traiphum Phra Ruang, setiap gading Erawan berisi tujuh kolam, masing-masing dengan tujuh tanaman teratai.
did_you_know.en: According to the Traiphum Phra Ruang, each of Erawan's tusks holds seven ponds, each with seven lotus plants.

note.id: Erawan adalah bentuk Thailand dari Airavata.
note.en: Erawan is the Thai form of Airavata.
Erawan is Indra's mount.

claims.quote: Erawan (in Thai: เอราวัณ) ist die thailändische Form des mythischen Elefanten Airavata.

statement.id: Erawan (Thai: เอราวัณ) adalah bentuk Thailand (thailändische) dari gajah mitis Airavata.
statement.en: Erawan (Thai: เอราวัณ) is the Thai (thailändische) form of the mythical elephant Airavata.

claims.quote: Er ist ein riesenhafter Elefant, groß wie ein Berg. Er hat meistens drei, manchmal sogar 33 Köpfe, jeder Kopf ist mit sieben Stoßzähnen ausgestattet.

statement.id: Erawan adalah gajah raksasa sebesar gunung, biasanya berkepala tiga, kadang sampai 33, tiap kepala bergading tujuh.
statement.en: Erawan is a giant elephant as big as a mountain, usually with three heads, sometimes 33, each with seven tusks.

claims.quote: Er ist das Reittier des hinduistischen Gottes des Regens und des Donners Indra, dem Herrscher über den Tavatimsa-Himmel, der Wohnstatt von 33 Göttern vedischen Ursprungs.

statement.id: Erawan adalah tunggangan Indra, dewa Hindu (hinduistischen) hujan dan guntur, penguasa surga Tavatimsa, kediaman 33 dewa berasal-usul Weda.
statement.en: Erawan is the mount of Indra, the Hindu god of rain and thunder, ruler of the Tavatimsa heaven, home of 33 gods of Vedic origin.

claims.quote: In der Stadt gibt es einen Elefanten mit Namen Erawan. Allerdings ist dieser Elefant kein Tier, denn in diesem Himmel gibt es keine Tiere, er ist ausschließlich von Devatā bewohnt. So gibt es dort einen Elefanten mit Namen „Devatā Erawan“.

statement.id: Menurut Traiphum Phra Ruang (abad ke-14), di kota Indra ada gajah bernama Erawan, tetapi ia bukan hewan karena di surga itu tidak ada hewan, hanya devatā; maka ia disebut "Devatā Erawan".
statement.en: Per the Traiphum Phra Ruang (14th century), in Indra's city there is an elephant named Erawan, but it is no animal, since that heaven holds no animals, only devatā; hence it is called 'Devatā Erawan'.

claims.quote: Wann immer König Indra zum Vergnügen ausreiten möchte, und er möchte dabei auf einem Elefanten reiten, verwandelt sich „Devatā Erawan“ in einen sehr großen weißen Elefanten. Dieser Elefant ist 1.200.000 Wa hoch und hat 33 Köpfe.

statement.id: Setiap kali Raja Indra ingin berkuda untuk bersenang-senang dengan menunggang gajah, Devatā Erawan menjelma menjadi gajah putih yang sangat besar, setinggi 1.200.000 wa dan berkepala 33.
statement.en: Whenever King Indra wishes to ride out for pleasure on an elephant, Devatā Erawan becomes a huge white elephant 1,200,000 wa tall with 33 heads.

claims.quote: Deze reusachtige witte olifant is het rijdier van Indra en bevindt zich in de hemel Tavatimsa. Het dier wordt afgebeeld met drie of meer driekoppige olifantskoppen. Ook de naam "I-rapote" wordt in Thailand gebruikt.

statement.id: Gajah putih raksasa ini tunggangan Indra dan berada di surga Tavatimsa; ia digambarkan dengan tiga kepala gajah atau lebih, dan nama I-rapote juga dipakai di Thailand.
statement.en: This giant white elephant is Indra's mount and dwells in the Tavatimsa heaven; it is shown with three or more elephant heads, and the name I-rapote is also used in Thailand.

claims.quote: De Erawan is een belangrijk religieus motief en de olifant wordt vaak als ornament gebruikt. Men ziet hem op Thaise onderscheidingen als de Orde van Chula Chom Klao waarin de erawan een centrale plaats in de keten kreeg en op monumenten.

statement.id: Erawan adalah motif keagamaan penting dan sering dipakai sebagai ornamen, misalnya pada tanda kehormatan Thailand (Thaise) Orde Chula Chom Klao dan pada monumen.
statement.en: Erawan is an important religious motif often used as ornament, as on Thai honours like the Order of Chula Chom Klao and on monuments.

claims.quote: In jedem Stoßzahn gibt es sieben Teiche, in jedem Teich sieben Lotuspflanzen; jede Lotuspflanze hat sieben Blüten, eine jede mit sieben Blütenblättern.

statement.id: Dalam setiap gading terdapat tujuh kolam, dalam setiap kolam tujuh tanaman teratai, setiap teratai bertujuh bunga, masing-masing bertujuh kelopak.
statement.en: In each tusk there are seven ponds, in each pond seven lotus plants; each lotus has seven flowers, each with seven petals.

claims.quote: Die Köpfe zur Mitte hin werden immer größer, der Kopf im Zentrum heißt Sudassana. Er ist der Thron Indras und hat einen Umfang von 24.000 Wa.

statement.id: Kepala-kepala makin besar ke arah tengah; kepala di tengah bernama Sudassana, singgasana Indra, dengan keliling 24.000 wa.
statement.en: The heads grow ever larger toward the middle; the central head is called Sudassana, Indra's throne, with a circumference of 24,000 wa.
