claims.quote: Göl boğaları ya da su boğaları, Artvin (özellikle Ardanuç, Şavşat ve Yusufeli ilçeleri) ve Posof yöresinde dağ göllerinde bulunduğuna inanılan düşsel varlıklar.

statement.id: Göl boğaları atau su boğaları (banteng danau/banteng air) adalah makhluk khayalan (düşsel varlıklar) yang dipercaya ada di danau-danau gunung (dağ göllerinde) di Artvin, terutama di distrik Ardanuç, Şavşat, dan Yusufeli, serta di daerah Posof.
statement.en: Göl boğaları or su boğaları (lake bulls/water bulls) are imaginary beings (düşsel varlıklar) believed to live in the mountain lakes (dağ göllerinde) of Artvin, especially the Ardanuç, Şavşat and Yusufeli districts, and of the Posof area.

claims.quote: Göl boğalarının sabahın ilk aydınlığında görülebildiğine ve daha sonrasında suya dalıp yittiklerine inanılır.

statement.id: Dipercaya bahwa banteng danau dapat terlihat pada cahaya pertama pagi hari (sabahın ilk aydınlığında), lalu menyelam ke air dan lenyap.
statement.en: Lake bulls are believed to be visible at the first light of morning (sabahın ilk aydınlığında) and then to dive into the water and vanish.

claims.quote: Hargiver Dağında (Arı Dağı) yer alan Boğa Gölleri isimlerini bu inançtan almaktadır.

statement.id: Danau-danau Boğa Gölleri di Gunung Hargiver (Arı Dağı) mendapat namanya dari kepercayaan ini.
statement.en: The Boğa Gölleri (Bull Lakes) on Mount Hargiver (Arı Dağı) take their name from this belief.

claims.quote: Göl içerisinden bu sesi işiten göl boğası, gölün kıyısına çıkarak orada bulunan adamın boğasıyla güreşmeye başlar.

statement.id: Dalam legenda, banteng danau yang mendengar lenguhan dari dalam danau naik ke tepi dan mulai bergulat (güreşmeye) dengan banteng milik seorang pria.
statement.en: In the legend, the lake bull hears the bellowing from inside the lake, comes up to the shore and starts to wrestle (güreşmeye) with a man's bull.

claims.quote: Halen göl içerisinde kırmızı taş ve toprağın su yüzüne aksettirmiş olduğu yol şeklindeki bir kırmızılığı, boğanın suya girdiği yer ve ondan kalan kan lekelerinin izi olduğuna inanılmaktadır.

statement.id: Sampai kini, jalur kemerahan di danau yang berasal dari pantulan batu dan tanah merah dipercaya sebagai tempat banteng itu masuk ke air dan bekas noda darahnya (kan lekelerinin).
statement.en: To this day, a road-like red streak in the lake, reflected from red stone and soil, is believed to mark where the bull entered the water and the traces of its blood (kan lekelerinin).

claims.quote: Yaralı göl boğasının demirci ve ailesine beddua ettiği, ailenin bu nedenden dolayı perişan olduğu rivayet edilir.

statement.id: Diriwayatkan bahwa banteng danau yang terluka mengutuk (beddua) si pandai besi (demirci) dan keluarganya, sehingga keluarga itu jatuh sengsara.
statement.en: It is related that the wounded lake bull cursed (beddua) the blacksmith (demirci) and his family, and that the family was ruined as a result.

claims.quote: Anadolu'da kimi yörelerde dağ göllerinde yaşadığına inanılan varlıklara Göl Boğası (Su Boğası) denilmektedir.

statement.id: Di beberapa daerah Anadolu (Anatolia), makhluk yang dipercaya hidup di danau-danau gunung disebut Göl Boğası (Su Boğası).
statement.en: In some areas of Anadolu (Anatolia), beings believed to live in mountain lakes are called Göl Boğası (Su Boğası).

claims.quote: Göl boğasından öcünü almak için çare düşünmüş. Kendi boğasına polat (çelik) boynuzlar yapmış.

statement.id: Untuk membalas dendam pada banteng danau, si pandai besi membuatkan tanduk baja (polat, çelik) bagi bantengnya sendiri.
statement.en: To take revenge on the lake bull, the blacksmith made steel (polat, çelik) horns for his own bull.

claims.quote: Van Gölü Canavarı söylentilerinde de pek çok kimse gördüğünü söylediği yaratığın boynuzlu ve hattâ mandaya benzediğini ifâde etmektedir.

statement.id: Sumber kedua mencatat bahwa dalam kabar tentang Van Gölü Canavarı (Monster Danau Van), banyak orang menyebut makhluk yang mereka lihat bertanduk, bahkan mirip kerbau (mandaya).
statement.en: The second source notes that in rumours of the Van Gölü Canavarı (Lake Van Monster), many people describe the creature they saw as horned and even like a water buffalo (mandaya).

claims.quote: Karçal dağlarındaki gölden boğa çıkıp çobanın boğasıyla güreşip tekrar göle giriyormuş.
claims.locator: Artvin Yöresinde Su ile İlgili Efsaneler: Boğa Gölü

statement.id: Dalam versi Boğa Gölü yang dihimpun di Ardanuç, seekor banteng keluar dari danau di pegunungan Karçal, bergulat dengan banteng seorang gembala (çobanın), lalu kembali ke danau.
statement.en: In the Boğa Gölü version collected in Ardanuç, a bull came out of a lake in the Karçal mountains, wrestled with a shepherd's (çobanın) bull and went back into the lake.

claims.quote: Çobanın boğasını yenince çoban sinirlenmiş boğanın boynuzlarını bilemiş.
claims.locator: Artvin Yöresinde Su ile İlgili Efsaneler: Boğa Gölü

statement.id: Ketika banteng itu mengalahkan banteng si gembala, si gembala marah lalu mengasah (bilemiş) tanduk bantengnya.
statement.en: When it beat the shepherd's bull, the angry shepherd sharpened (bilemiş) his bull's horns.

claims.quote: yaylalarında bulunan Ağgöl ... bir boğa yaşarmış. Gölden çıkıp Tütünlü köyünün boğasıyla güreşirmiş.
claims.locator: Artvin Yöresinde Su ile İlgili Efsaneler: Ağgöl

statement.id: Menurut kisah lain, di Ağgöl di padang tinggi (yaylalarında) hidup seekor banteng yang keluar dari danau dan bergulat dengan banteng desa Tütünlü.
statement.en: According to another tale, a bull lived in Ağgöl on the highland pastures (yaylalarında); it came out of the lake and wrestled with the bull of Tütünlü village.

claims.quote: Boğa da göle geri dönmüş. Kanının izi hâlen daha gölde durmaktadır
claims.locator: Artvin Yöresinde Su ile İlgili Efsaneler: Ağgöl

statement.id: Banteng itu kembali ke danau, dan bekas darahnya (kanının izi) dikatakan masih tampak di danau sampai sekarang.
statement.en: The bull went back into the lake, and the trace of its blood (kanının izi) is said to remain in the lake to this day.

short_description.id: Hıbılık adalah roh jahat dalam kepercayaan rakyat di beberapa daerah Turki yang menindih dada orang tidur hingga mereka tak bisa bergerak, bahkan dapat mencekik sampai mati.
short_description.en: Hıbılık is an evil spirit of folk belief in parts of Turkey that presses on the chests of sleepers so they cannot move, and may even throttle them to death.

long_description.id: Menurut orang di beberapa daerah Turki, Hıbılık, yang juga disebut Gıbılık, adalah makhluk jahat yang rupanya menyerupai Alkarısı. Bedanya, Alkarısı hanya mengganggu perempuan yang baru melahirkan, sedangkan Hıbılık mengusik siapa saja, perempuan maupun laki-laki. Dua kajian akademik tentang agama tradisional Turk mencatat perbedaan yang sama.
long_description.en: According to people in some parts of Turkey, Hıbılık, also called Gıbılık, is a malevolent being that looks like the Alkarısı. The difference is that the Alkarısı troubles only women who have just given birth, whereas Hıbılık bothers anyone, woman or man. Two scholarly studies of traditional Turkic religion record the same contrast.

long_description.id: Biasanya ia berwujud perempuan, meski ada pula yang berwujud laki-laki. Ia datang kepada orang yang sedang tidur, menindih dadanya, dan mencekik lehernya; korbannya tak dapat bergerak, lidahnya kelu, dan ia bermandi keringat. Sebagian sumber menyebut serangan ini bisa berakhir dengan kematian, terutama bila korban tidak dibangunkan. Bagi orang yang didatanginya, ia tampak seperti kucing, lalu menghilang diam-diam dalam gelap.
long_description.en: It usually takes a female form, though male ones exist as well. It comes to a sleeping person, sits on the chest and squeezes the throat; the victim cannot move, is tongue-tied and drenched in sweat. Some sources say such an attack can end in death, especially if the victim is not woken. To the person it visits it appears like a cat, and it then vanishes silently in the dark.

long_description.id: Hıbılık juga dikaitkan dengan kekayaan. Bila tertangkap, ia memberi banyak emas kepada penangkapnya agar dilepaskan. Di kepalanya ada börk, sejenis topi, yang ajaib, dan siapa pun yang berhasil merebut topi itu dipercaya akan menjadi kaya.
long_description.en: Hıbılık is also linked to wealth. If caught, it hands its captor plenty of gold to be let go. On its head it wears a magic börk, a kind of cap, and whoever manages to seize the cap is believed to become rich.

cultural_context.id: Para peneliti menempatkan Hıbılık di antara roh maut atau roh rakus pada lapisan bawah di bawah Erlik, bersama Aldaçı dan Alkarısı, dan menyebutnya sebagai salah satu makhluk demonik yang diberi sifat feminin.
cultural_context.en: Scholars place Hıbılık among the death or gluttonous spirits of the lower layers below Erlik, together with Aldaçı and Alkarısı, and count it among the demonic beings to which femininity is attributed.

who.id: Roh jahat yang menindih dada orang yang sedang tidur.
who.en: An evil spirit that presses on the chests of sleepers.

origin.id: Kepercayaan rakyat di beberapa daerah Turki.
origin.en: Folk belief in some parts of Turkey.

role.id: Ia mengganggu siapa saja, perempuan maupun laki-laki, dengan mencekik dan membuat korbannya tak bisa bergerak.
role.en: It troubles anyone, woman or man, throttling its victims and leaving them unable to move.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal karena topi ajaibnya yang dipercaya membuat kaya orang yang merebutnya.
famous_for.en: It is known for its magic cap, believed to make rich whoever seizes it.

did_you_know.id: Hıbılık yang tertangkap dipercaya akan menebus kebebasannya dengan banyak emas.
did_you_know.en: A captured hıbılık is believed to buy its freedom with plenty of gold.

description.id: Menindih dada orang yang tidur sehingga mereka tak bisa bergerak atau berbicara, dan mencekik leher mereka.
description.en: Presses on the chests of sleepers so that they cannot move or speak, and squeezes their throats.

description.id: Bila tertangkap, ia memberi emas kepada penangkapnya, dan topi ajaibnya dapat direbut.
description.en: If caught, it gives gold to its captor, and its magic cap can be seized.

note.id: Rupanya seperti Alkarısı, tetapi tidak hanya mengganggu perempuan yang baru melahirkan.
note.en: It looks like the Alkarısı but does not trouble only women who have just given birth.

note.id: Disebut sebagai roh jahat yang mirip Karabasan.
note.en: Described as an evil spirit similar to the Karabasan.

note.id: Ditempatkan di antara roh tingkat bawah di bawah Erlik.
note.en: Placed among the lower-level spirits below Erlik.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa banyak budaya mempunyai makhluk yang dipercaya menindih dada orang yang sedang tidur?
learning_questions.en: Why do many cultures have beings believed to press on the chests of sleepers?

claims.quote: Hıbılık, Türkiye'nin bazı yörelerinde yaşayan insanlara göre, görünüş olarak Alkarısı şeklinde olan kötücül bir varlık. Gıbılık da denir.

statement.id: Menurut orang di beberapa daerah Turki (Türkiye), Hıbılık adalah makhluk jahat (kötücül bir varlık) yang rupanya seperti Alkarısı; ia juga disebut Gıbılık.
statement.en: According to people in some parts of Turkey (Türkiye), Hıbılık is a malevolent being (kötücül bir varlık) that looks like the Alkarısı; it is also called Gıbılık.

claims.quote: Alkarısı sadece yeni doğum yapmış kadınları rahatsız eder. Oysa hıbılık kadın-erkek hiç kimseye rahat vermez.

statement.id: Alkarısı hanya mengganggu perempuan yang baru melahirkan, sedangkan hıbılık tidak memberi ketenangan kepada siapa pun, perempuan maupun laki-laki (kadın-erkek).
statement.en: The Alkarısı troubles only women who have just given birth, whereas the hıbılık gives no peace to anyone, woman or man (kadın-erkek).

claims.quote: Hıbılık genellikle yalnız kadın görünüşündedir ancak erkek görünüşlüsü de vardır. O, yanına gittiği kişinin göğsüne çöker ve nefesi kesilip ölene kadar boğazını sıkar.

statement.id: Hıbılık biasanya berwujud perempuan, tetapi ada juga yang berwujud laki-laki; ia menindih dada (göğsüne çöker) orang yang didatanginya dan mencekik lehernya hingga napasnya putus dan ia mati.
statement.en: The hıbılık usually has a woman's appearance, though there are male-looking ones too; it sits on the chest (göğsüne çöker) of the person it visits and squeezes their throat until their breath stops and they die.

claims.quote: İnanışa göre, hıbılık, onu yakalayan birine bol bol altın verir. Bazı yörelerdeki görüşlere göre, hıbılık uykudayken insanların üzerine çöken kötü ruhtur.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan, hıbılık memberi banyak emas (altın) kepada orang yang menangkapnya; di beberapa daerah ia dianggap roh jahat (kötü ruh) yang menindih orang yang sedang tidur.
statement.en: According to belief, the hıbılık gives plenty of gold (altın) to whoever catches it; in some areas it is regarded as an evil spirit (kötü ruh) that presses down on people while they sleep.

claims.quote: Hıbılık kimi basarsa, o insan yerinden kıpırdayamaz, dili tutulur ve ter basar.

statement.id: Orang yang ditindih hıbılık tidak dapat bergerak (kıpırdayamaz), lidahnya kelu, dan ia bermandi keringat.
statement.en: A person pressed by the hıbılık cannot move (kıpırdayamaz), becomes tongue-tied and breaks into a sweat.

claims.quote: Eşdeğer: 1. HIPILIK, HİBİLİK, HIBILIH 2. GIBİLİK, GIBILIH

statement.id: Nama padanan (eşdeğer) Hıbılık adalah Hıpılık, Hibilik, Hıbılıh, Gıbilik, dan Gıbılıh.
statement.en: Equivalent names (eşdeğer) for Hıbılık are Hıpılık, Hibilik, Hıbılıh, Gıbilik and Gıbılıh.

claims.quote: Başında sihirli bir börk (şapka) vardır. O şapkayı ele geçiren kişinin zengin olacağına inanılır.

statement.id: Di kepalanya ada börk (topi) ajaib; orang yang berhasil merebut topi itu dipercaya akan menjadi kaya (zengin).
statement.en: It wears a magic börk (cap) on its head; whoever seizes that cap is believed to become rich (zengin).

claims.quote: Kedi şeklinde görünür. Karanlıkta sessizce kaybolup gider. Bâzen ölümlere neden olur. Yakalanacak olursa kurtulmak için yakalayan kişiye bolca altın verir.

statement.id: Ia tampak dalam wujud kucing (kedi), menghilang diam-diam dalam gelap, kadang menyebabkan kematian, dan bila tertangkap ia memberi banyak emas kepada penangkapnya agar dilepaskan.
statement.en: It appears in the shape of a cat (kedi), slips silently away in the dark, sometimes causes deaths, and if caught gives its captor plenty of gold to be set free.

claims.quote: Erlik ile birlikte daha alt tabakalarda ise Aldaçı, Alkarısı ve Hıbılık gibi varlıklar söz konusudur.

statement.id: Dalam kajian tentang roh maut/roh rakus (ölüm/obur ruhlar), di bawah Erlik terdapat makhluk-makhluk tingkat lebih rendah seperti Aldaçı, Alkarısı, dan Hıbılık.
statement.en: In a study of death/gluttonous spirits (ölüm/obur ruhlar), beings of the lower layers below Erlik include Aldaçı, Alkarısı and Hıbılık.

claims.quote: Hıbılık, kadın-erkek ayrımı yapmaksızın kişinin göğsüne çökerek nefesi kesilip ölene kadar boğazını sıkan bir ruh olarak isimlendirilmektedir.

statement.id: Hıbılık disebut sebagai roh (ruh) yang, tanpa membedakan perempuan atau laki-laki, menindih dada seseorang dan mencekik lehernya sampai napasnya putus dan ia mati.
statement.en: Hıbılık is named as a spirit (ruh) that, without distinguishing women from men, sits on a person's chest and squeezes the throat until the breath stops and the person dies.

claims.quote: Alkarısı sadece yeni doğum yapmış kadınları rahatsız etmekte iken, kıbılık/hıbılık kadın-erkek ayrımı yapmamakta herkesi rahatsız etmektedir.

statement.id: Kajian tentang roh feminin dalam agama tradisional Turk (Türk) mencatat bahwa Alkarısı hanya mengganggu perempuan yang baru melahirkan, sedangkan kıbılık/hıbılık mengganggu semua orang tanpa membedakan perempuan dan laki-laki.
statement.en: A study of feminine spirits in traditional Turkic (Türk) religion notes that the Alkarısı troubles only women who have just given birth, while the kıbılık/hıbılık troubles everyone without distinguishing women from men.

claims.quote: bölgelerinde Karabasan ... benzer kötü bir ruh olarak bilinir ve genellikle kadın formunda tasavvur edilse de bazen erkek olarak da düşünülür. Uykuda olan insanların göğsüne basarak, onları hareket edemez ve konuşamaz hale getirir, hatta uyandırılmadıkları takdirde ölüme sebep olabilir.

statement.id: Hıbılık dikenal sebagai roh jahat (kötü bir ruh) yang mirip Karabasan; biasanya dibayangkan berwujud perempuan, kadang laki-laki. Ia menekan dada orang yang tidur sehingga mereka tak bisa bergerak dan berbicara, bahkan bisa menyebabkan kematian bila mereka tidak dibangunkan.
statement.en: Hıbılık is known as an evil spirit (kötü bir ruh) similar to the Karabasan; it is usually imagined in female form but sometimes as male. It presses on the chests of sleepers so that they cannot move or speak, and can even cause death if they are not woken.

claims.quote: Dişilliğin atfedildiği bir diğer varlık Hıbılıktır.

statement.id: Hıbılık adalah salah satu makhluk yang diberi sifat feminin (dişillik) dalam tradisi.
statement.en: Hıbılık is another of the beings to which femininity (dişillik) is attributed.

short_description.id: Halmasti adalah anjing langit jahat sebesar kuda dalam mitologi Chitrali di Pakistan utara. Ia diyakini muncul di tempat kelahiran dan kematian, dan besi dipercaya dapat mengusirnya.
short_description.en: Halmasti is a malevolent, horse-sized sky hound of Chitrali mythology in northern Pakistan. It is believed to appear where births and deaths take place, and iron is said to keep it away.

long_description.id: Halmasti, yang juga disebut Anjing Langit, adalah anjing jahat sebesar kuda dalam mitologi Chitrali di Pakistan utara. Namanya, yang berarti guntur dalam bahasa Khowar, menunjukkan hubungannya dengan langit. Ia digambarkan mirip serigala besar berbulu merah gelap, berkaki panjang, dan bermoncong lebar; beberapa cerita bahkan menyebutnya mampu menyemburkan api.
long_description.en: Halmasti, also called the Celestial Hound, is a malevolent horse-sized dog of Chitrali mythology in northern Pakistan. Its name, meaning thunder in Khowar, reflects its tie to the sky. It is pictured as a big wolf-like beast with dark red fur, long limbs and a wide muzzle, and some tales even credit it with breathing fire.

long_description.id: Menurut kepercayaan setempat, Halmasti terutama datang ke tempat kelahiran bayi dan tempat jenazah dimandikan. Karena itu kedua tempat tersebut dijaga selama tujuh hari tujuh malam: bacaan Quran dilantunkan berkeliling di dekat jenazah, sementara bayi dinyanyikan lagu nina bobo. Melihat makhluk ini pun dianggap pertanda sial.
long_description.en: In local belief, Halmasti mainly visits places where a baby has just been born or where a body is being washed. Both places were therefore watched for seven days and nights, with Quran recitation circling the dead and lullabies sung to the infant. Even catching sight of the creature was considered unlucky.

long_description.id: Bayi dianggap paling rentan, sehingga tidak pernah ditinggal sendirian. Bila keadaan memaksa, sebilah senjata besi diselipkan di bawah bantal bayi, sebab Halmasti diyakini membenci besi dan besi menjadi kelemahannya.
long_description.en: Infants were thought to be most at risk, so they were never left alone. When there was no choice, an iron weapon was slipped beneath the baby's pillow, because Halmasti was believed to loathe iron, which was its weak point.

long_description.id: Penulis artikel kedua menelusuri asal-usulnya ke iblis perempuan Littu dari Sumer kuno, yang kemudian dikenal sebagai Lillith, dan ke penyihir Al atau Hal di kalangan suku Iran barat. Nama Halmasti diduga diwarisi dari roh perempuan Turkik Al-Basti, tetapi wujudnya sebagai anjing langit lebih menyerupai Tiangou dari mitologi Tiongkok kuno, yang memakan matahari dan bulan. Karena itu ia dipandang sebagai contoh perpaduan dunia Turkik, Iran, dan Sinitik di Chitral.
long_description.en: The author of the second source traces it back to the Sumerian female demon Littu, later known as Lillith, and to the witch Al or Hal of western Iranic tribes. The name Halmasti is thought to come from the Turkic female spirit Al-Basti, but its form as a sky hound is closer to the Tiangou of ancient Chinese mythology, which devoured the sun and moon. It is therefore seen as an example of how Chitral blends Turkic, Iranic and Sinitic worlds.

who.id: Halmasti adalah anjing langit jahat dalam mitologi Chitrali.
who.en: Halmasti is an evil celestial hound of Chitrali mythology.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari tradisi Chitrali di Pakistan utara.
origin.en: It comes from the Chitrali tradition of northern Pakistan.

role.id: Ia dipercaya mendatangi tempat kelahiran dan tempat jenazah dimandikan, sehingga keduanya dijaga tujuh hari tujuh malam.
role.en: It is believed to visit places of birth and of washing the dead, so both were guarded for seven days and nights.

famous_for.id: Ia terkenal karena dianggap takut pada besi yang diletakkan di bawah bantal bayi.
famous_for.en: It is known for its supposed fear of iron placed under a baby's pillow.

did_you_know.id: Penulis artikel kedua menilai gambaran Halmasti lebih mirip Tiangou, anjing langit Tiongkok kuno penyebab gerhana, daripada roh perempuan Al-Basti yang namanya diwarisi.
did_you_know.en: The second source finds Halmasti closer to the Tiangou, the eclipse-causing sky dog of ancient China, than to Al-Basti, the female spirit whose name it inherited.

description.id: Beberapa cerita menyebut Halmasti dapat menyemburkan api.
description.en: Some stories say Halmasti can breathe out fire.

description.id: Halmasti diyakini membenci dan menghindari besi; senjata besi diletakkan di bawah bantal bayi untuk melindunginya.
description.en: Halmasti is believed to hate and avoid iron; an iron weapon was put under a baby's pillow to protect it.

note.id: Menurut artikel kedua, nama Halmasti kemungkinan diwarisi dari roh perempuan Turkik ini, tetapi tidak dengan wujud perempuannya.
note.en: According to the second source, Halmasti probably inherited its name from this Turkic female spirit, though not its female form.

note.id: Gambaran Halmasti di Chitral dinilai mirip anjing langit Tiongkok kuno ini.
note.en: The Chitrali image of Halmasti is said to mirror this celestial hound of ancient Chinese mythology.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa sebuah makhluk mitos bisa memadukan nama dari satu budaya dengan wujud dari budaya lain?
learning_questions.en: How might a mythical creature end up combining a name from one culture with a form from another?

learning_questions.id: Apa fungsi aturan menjaga bayi dan jenazah selama tujuh hari dalam kepercayaan tentang Halmasti?
learning_questions.en: What purpose might the rule of watching over babies and the dead for seven days serve in the beliefs about Halmasti?

claims.quote: Halmasti or the Celestial Hound is a large horse-sized evil hound in Chitrali mythology of northern Pakistan.

statement.id: Halmasti atau Anjing Langit (Celestial Hound) adalah anjing jahat sebesar kuda dalam mitologi Chitrali di Pakistan utara.
statement.en: Halmasti, or the Celestial Hound, is an evil horse-sized hound in the Chitrali mythology of northern Pakistan.

claims.quote: Halmasti is a demonic hound that occupies a position of sheer notoriety in Chitrali mythology and is associated with the heavens, as evident by its name, halmasti meaning 'thunder'.

statement.id: Halmasti adalah anjing iblis (demonic hound) yang sangat terkenal dalam mitologi Chitrali dan dikaitkan dengan langit; namanya, halmasti, berarti guntur (thunder).
statement.en: Halmasti is a notorious demonic hound of Chitrali mythology associated with the heavens; its name, halmasti, means thunder.

claims.quote: It is connected to the heavens, showing by its name, halmasti, which means 'thunder' in Khowar.

statement.id: Kaitannya dengan langit tampak dari namanya, halmasti, yang berarti guntur (thunder) dalam bahasa Khowar.
statement.en: Its link to the heavens shows in its name, halmasti, which means thunder in Khowar.

claims.quote: It resembles a large wolf in appearance and has a coat of dark red fur with long appendages and a large muzzle,

statement.id: Wujudnya menyerupai serigala besar (large wolf) berbulu merah gelap, dengan anggota tubuh panjang dan moncong besar.
statement.en: It looks like a large wolf with dark red fur, long appendages and a large muzzle.

claims.quote: Some stories say it can even breathe out fire.

statement.id: Beberapa cerita menyebut makhluk ini bahkan dapat menyemburkan api (breathe out fire).
statement.en: Some stories say it can even breathe out fire.

claims.quote: it mostly appears in places where either a child is born or a corpse is washed before burial. Neither place should be abandoned for seven days and nights;

statement.id: Halmasti kebanyakan muncul di tempat kelahiran anak atau tempat jenazah dimandikan sebelum dikubur; kedua tempat itu tidak boleh ditinggalkan selama tujuh hari tujuh malam (seven days and nights).
statement.en: It mostly appears where a child is born or a corpse is washed before burial; neither place should be left for seven days and nights.

claims.quote: rounds of recitation of the Quran were conducted around corpses and lullabies were sung to newborns.

statement.id: Pembacaan Quran dilakukan berkeliling di sekitar jenazah, dan bayi yang baru lahir dinyanyikan lagu nina bobo (lullabies).
statement.en: Rounds of Quran recitation were held around corpses, and lullabies were sung to newborns.

claims.quote: People were more cautious around newborns since the Halmasti could physically harm them and that is why babies were not abandoned for a moment, but if an extreme need arose, a weapon of iron would be placed under the newborn's pillow for protection.

statement.id: Orang lebih berhati-hati terhadap bayi karena Halmasti dapat mencelakai mereka; bayi tidak ditinggal sesaat pun, dan bila terpaksa, senjata dari besi (weapon of iron) diletakkan di bawah bantalnya sebagai pelindung.
statement.en: People were especially careful with newborns because the Halmasti could harm them; babies were never left alone, and if necessary an iron weapon was placed under the pillow for protection.

claims.quote: It was believed that the Halmasti hated and avoided the metal and that iron was its weakness.

statement.id: Diyakini Halmasti membenci dan menghindari logam itu, dan besi (iron) adalah kelemahannya.
statement.en: It was believed that the Halmasti hated and avoided the metal and that iron was its weakness.

claims.quote: Seeing a Halmasti was thought to bring bad luck.

statement.id: Melihat Halmasti dianggap membawa nasib buruk (bad luck).
statement.en: Seeing a Halmasti was thought to bring bad luck.

claims.quote: The origin of Halmasti was in ancient Sumer where it was known as a female demon known as Littu which was adopted by the Semitic people as Lillith and spread all over European mythology, mainly as a child snatcher, whereas the Western Iranic tribes adopted it by the name of 'Al' or 'Hal', another child-snatching witch.

statement.id: Menurut penulis artikel kedua, asal-usul Halmasti ada di Sumer kuno sebagai iblis perempuan Littu, yang diambil bangsa Semit sebagai Lillith (penculik anak), sedangkan suku Iran barat menyebutnya Al atau Hal, penyihir penculik anak.
statement.en: According to the second source, Halmasti originated in ancient Sumer as the female demon Littu, adopted by Semitic peoples as Lillith, a child snatcher, while western Iranic tribes called it Al or Hal, a child-snatching witch.

claims.quote: In the Turkic world, a female spirit known as Al-Basti hunts guilty souls from whom the Chitralis most probably inherited it. The Chitralis adopted its Turkic name but not its description as a female entity,

statement.id: Di dunia Turkik ada roh perempuan Al-Basti yang memburu jiwa bersalah; orang Chitral kemungkinan besar mewarisi nama Turkiknya, tetapi tidak menggambarkannya sebagai sosok perempuan.
statement.en: In the Turkic world a female spirit, Al-Basti, hunts guilty souls; the Chitralis most probably inherited its Turkic name but not its female description.

claims.quote: the Chitrali description of the Halmasti mirrors the Tiangou (Heavenly Dog) which was a celestial hound of ancient Chinese mythology that used to descend from the skies with thunderous lightning to eat the sun and moon to cause eclipses

statement.id: Gambaran Halmasti di Chitral mirip Tiangou (Heavenly Dog), anjing langit mitologi Tiongkok kuno yang turun dari langit dengan kilat bergemuruh untuk memakan matahari dan bulan sehingga terjadi gerhana.
statement.en: The Chitrali image of Halmasti mirrors the Tiangou (Heavenly Dog), a celestial hound of ancient Chinese mythology that came down from the skies with thunderous lightning to eat the sun and moon, causing eclipses.

claims.quote: The Halmasti is certainly the most peculiar creature of Chitrali mythology because it shows not only how folklore develops differently in different regions but also how Chitral, at the juncture of the Turkic, Iranic, and Sinitic worlds, shows a synthesis of all three.

statement.id: Penulis menilai Halmasti makhluk paling unik dalam mitologi Chitrali karena memperlihatkan perpaduan dunia Turkik, Iran, dan Sinitik (Turkic, Iranic, and Sinitic) di Chitral.
statement.en: The author considers Halmasti the most peculiar creature of Chitrali mythology because it shows Chitral's synthesis of the Turkic, Iranic and Sinitic worlds.

gaps.searched: Gambar di artikel pertama menggambarkan tokoh Tiongkok yang memanah Tiangou, bukan Halmasti; tidak ditemukan berkas Commons yang dibuat sebagai gambaran Halmasti.
Kedua sumber tidak menyebut periode kapan kepercayaan ini tercatat.
Artikel pertama sebagian besar bersandar pada World History Encyclopedia; rujukan buku cetak lain di artikel itu tidak dapat dibaca daring.

short_description.id: İmrə adalah jin musim semi dalam budaya rakyat Turk dan Altai yang dipercaya membentuk Cemre, kehangatan yang jatuh berturut-turut ke udara, air, dan tanah pada awal musim semi.
short_description.en: İmrə is the spring jinn of Turkic and Altai folk culture, believed to make up the Cemre, the warmth that falls in turn into the air, water and earth at the start of spring.

long_description.id: İmrə, yang juga disebut İmere, Əmrə, Emire, atau Emre, adalah jin musim semi dalam budaya rakyat dan mitologi Turk dan Altai. Ia dipercaya membentuk Cemre, yaitu kenaikan panas pada awal musim semi yang muncul berselang tujuh hari: mula-mula di udara, lalu di air dan tanah. Menurut sumber, Cemre pertama jatuh ke udara pada 20 Februari.
long_description.en: İmrə, also called İmere, Əmrə, Emire or Emre, is the spring jinn of Turkic and Altai folk culture and mythology. It is believed to make up the Cemre, the rise in warmth at the start of spring that comes at seven-day intervals: first in the air, then in water and earth. According to the source, the first Cemre falls into the air on 20 February.

long_description.id: Pada musim semi İmrə muncul dan naik ke langit sambil memancarkan cahaya yang bergetar. Setelah itu ia jatuh ke atas es dan mencairkannya, lalu masuk ke dalam tanah, sehingga uap naik dari tanah yang sudah hangat. Dalam kepercayaan rakyat Anadolu, Cemre digambarkan sebagai bara api legendaris yang jatuh ke udara, air, dan tanah serta menghangatkannya; sebuah ensiklopedia daring menyebutnya tiga bara yang dikirim oleh jin pada akhir musim dingin.
long_description.en: In spring İmrə appears and rises to the sky, giving off flickering lights. It then falls onto the ice and melts it, and enters the ground, so that steam rises from the warmed earth. In Anadolu folk belief the Cemre is pictured as a legendary ember that falls into the air, water and earth and warms them; an online encyclopedia calls them three embers sent by a genie at the end of winter.

long_description.id: İmrə melambangkan datangnya musim semi. Di kalangan orang Bulgar, makhluk ini dikenal sebagai Zemire, dan sumber kedua menganggap jin Zemire itu sebagai bentuk tertua konsep ini.
long_description.en: İmrə represents the coming of spring. Among the Bulgars it is known as Zemire, and the second source regards that jinn Zemire as the oldest form of the concept.

who.id: Jin musim semi yang membentuk Cemre.
who.en: The spring jinn that makes up the Cemre.

origin.id: Budaya rakyat dan mitologi Turk dan Altai.
origin.en: Turkic and Altai folk culture and mythology.

role.id: Ia jatuh ke atas es, mencairkannya, dan menghangatkan tanah.
role.en: It falls onto the ice, melts it and warms the ground.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal sebagai tanda datangnya musim semi.
famous_for.en: It is known as the sign of spring's arrival.

did_you_know.id: Menurut kepercayaan, Cemre pertama jatuh ke udara pada 20 Februari, lalu ke air dan tanah dengan selang tujuh hari.
did_you_know.en: According to belief, the first Cemre falls into the air on 20 February, then into the water and the earth at seven-day intervals.

description.id: Nama makhluk ini di kalangan orang Bulgar; dianggap bentuk tertua konsep ini.
description.en: The name of this being among the Bulgars; considered the oldest form of the concept.

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana kepercayaan tentang İmrə membantu orang memahami pergantian musim?
learning_questions.en: How might the belief in İmrə have helped people make sense of the change of seasons?

sources.title: Türk Söylence Sözlüğü
sources.author: Deniz Karakurt
sources.publisher: Internet Archive (digital edition by the author)

claims.quote: İmrə , Yaz başlanğıcında Cemreyi (yeddi gün ara ilə əvvəl hava, sonra su və torpaqda meydana gəldiyi sanılan istilik artımını) təşkil edən cin.

statement.id: İmrə adalah jin (cin) yang membentuk Cemre, yaitu kenaikan panas pada awal musim semi yang dipercaya muncul berselang tujuh hari, pertama di udara, lalu di air dan tanah.
statement.en: İmrə is the jinn (cin) that makes up the Cemre, the rise in warmth at the start of spring believed to arise at seven-day intervals, first in the air and then in water and earth.

claims.quote: Türk və altay xalq mədəniyyətində və mifologiyasında İmrə (İmere və ya Əmrə) yazda görünüb titrək işıqlar saçaraq göyə yüksəlir.

statement.id: Dalam budaya rakyat dan mitologi Turk dan Altai (Türk və altay), İmrə (İmere atau Əmrə) muncul pada musim semi dan naik ke langit sambil memancarkan cahaya yang bergetar.
statement.en: In Turkic and Altai (Türk və altay) folk culture and mythology, İmrə (İmere or Əmrə) appears in spring and rises to the sky, shedding flickering lights.

claims.quote: Sonra buzların üzərinə düşərək onları əridir. Oradan da yerə girər. Bundan sonra istilənmiş torpaqdan buxar yüksələr.

statement.id: Lalu ia jatuh ke atas es (buzların) dan mencairkannya, kemudian masuk ke tanah; setelah itu uap naik dari tanah yang telah hangat.
statement.en: Then it falls onto the ice (buzların) and melts it, and from there enters the ground; afterwards steam rises from the warmed earth.

claims.quote: İmrə baharın gəlişini təmsil edir. Bulqarlarda Zemire olaraq iştirak edər.

statement.id: İmrə melambangkan datangnya musim semi (baharın gəlişini); di kalangan orang Bulgar (Bulqarlarda) ia dikenal sebagai Zemire.
statement.en: İmrə represents the coming of spring (baharın gəlişini); among the Bulgars (Bulqarlarda) it appears as Zemire.

claims.quote: Anadolu Türkcəsində, Ərəbcədən gəlmə Cemre sözcüyünün əslində bu adın bənzətmə ilə dəyişmiş halı olduğu deyilə bilər.

statement.id: Dapat dikatakan bahwa kata Cemre dalam bahasa Turki Anadolu, yang berasal dari bahasa Arab (Ərəbcədən), sebenarnya adalah bentuk nama ini yang berubah karena kemiripan.
statement.en: It can be said that the word Cemre in Anadolu Turkish, which comes from Arabic (Ərəbcədən), is in fact a form of this name altered by analogy.

claims.quote: İlk Cemre 20 Fevralda havaya və yeddi gün ara ilə də suya və torpağa düşər.

statement.id: Cemre pertama jatuh ke udara pada 20 Februari (20 Fevralda), lalu dengan selang tujuh hari ke air dan ke tanah.
statement.en: The first Cemre falls into the air on 20 February (20 Fevralda), and at seven-day intervals into the water and the earth.

claims.quote: Eşdeğer: İMERE, EMİRE, EMRE Bahar Cinidir.

statement.id: Nama padanan İmre adalah İmere, Emire, dan Emre; ia adalah jin musim semi (bahar cini).
statement.en: Equivalent names of İmre are İmere, Emire and Emre; it is the spring jinn (bahar cini).

claims.quote: Bulgarlardaki Zemire adlı cinin bu kavramın en eski biçimi olduğu anlaşılmaktadır.

statement.id: Jin bernama Zemire di kalangan orang Bulgar (Bulgarlardaki) dipahami sebagai bentuk tertua konsep ini.
statement.en: The jinn called Zemire among the Bulgars (Bulgarlardaki) is understood to be the oldest form of this concept.

claims.quote: Anadolu halk inanışında Cemre doğal unsurlara temas ederek onların ısınmasını sağlayar efsânevî ateştir. Havaya, suya ve toprağa düşen kor parçasıdır.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan rakyat Anadolu, Cemre adalah api legendaris (efsânevî ateş) yang menghangatkan unsur-unsur alam dengan menyentuhnya; ia adalah bara (kor) yang jatuh ke udara, air, dan tanah.
statement.en: In Anadolu folk belief the Cemre is a legendary fire (efsânevî ateş) that warms the natural elements by touching them; it is an ember (kor) falling into the air, the water and the earth.

claims.quote: Sözcük Arapça kökenlidir ve Camra/Camrah kelimesi bu dilde kor veyâ köz mânâsı taşır.

statement.id: Kata Cemre berasal dari bahasa Arab (Arapça); dalam bahasa itu Camra/Camrah berarti bara (kor, köz).
statement.en: The word Cemre is of Arabic (Arapça) origin; in that language Camra/Camrah means ember (kor, köz).

claims.quote: Celal Beydili'ne göre; bazı sözlüklerde gösterildiği gibi, Arap dilinden geldiğini söylemek doğru değildir.

statement.id: Menurut Celal Beydili, tidak benar mengatakan bahwa kata Cemre berasal dari bahasa Arab (Arap dilinden), seperti yang tertulis di beberapa kamus.
statement.en: According to Celal Beydili, it is not correct to say, as some dictionaries do, that the word Cemre comes from Arabic (Arap dilinden).

claims.quote: In Turkish folklore, three embers sent by a genie fall from the heavens at the end of the winter, and in turn, warm up the air, the water and the earth, one by one.

statement.id: Dalam folklor Turki (Turkish folklore), tiga bara yang dikirim oleh jin (genie) jatuh dari langit pada akhir musim dingin dan menghangatkan udara, air, dan tanah satu per satu.
statement.en: In Turkish folklore, three embers sent by a genie fall from the heavens at the end of winter and warm the air, the water and the earth one by one.

claims.quote: Arapça olan sözcük kor durumunda ateş anlamına gelir.

statement.id: Artikel ketiga menyebut kata Cemre berasal dari bahasa Arab (Arapça) dan berarti api dalam keadaan bara (kor).
statement.en: The third article says the word Cemre is Arabic (Arapça) and means fire in the state of embers (kor).

summary.id: Kata Cemre berasal dari bahasa Arab dan berarti bara; menurut artikel pertama, kata Arab itu berubah bentuk karena kemiripan dengan nama İmrə.
summary.en: The word Cemre comes from Arabic and means ember; according to the first article, that Arabic word changed by analogy with the name İmrə.

summary.id: Menurut Celal Beydili, tidak benar mengatakan kata itu berasal dari bahasa Arab.
summary.en: According to Celal Beydili, it is wrong to say the word comes from Arabic.

gaps.searched: Sumber kedua mengaitkan nama ini dengan akar İm dan kata Amra/Emre (kekasih), tetapi sebagai kemungkinan; kalimatnya memuat tanda kutip, sehingga tidak dijadikan etimologi.
Sumber hanya menyebut budaya Turk dan Altai, Anadolu, dan orang Bulgar, tanpa negara modern.
Wikimedia Commons dicari dengan nama makhluk ini; tidak ditemukan berkas yang judul, kategori, atau pemakaiannya di Wikipedia menunjukkan makhluk ini.

short_description.id: El Familiar adalah roh berwujud anjing hitam raksasa dari pabrik gula Argentina barat laut yang memberi kekayaan kepada pemilik pabrik dengan imbalan nyawa pekerja.
short_description.en: El Familiar is a huge black dog spirit of the sugar mills of north-western Argentina that brings mill owners wealth in exchange for workers' lives.

long_description.id: El Familiar adalah roh pendamping pemakan manusia yang legendanya tersebar di pabrik gula Argentina barat laut. Ia paling sering digambarkan sebagai anjing hitam raksasa setinggi manusia dengan mata menyala, dan pada malam hari dapat menjadi ular yang melingkari barak pekerja. Ia memberi kekuasaan dan uang kepada pemiliknya dengan imbalan nyawa manusia.
long_description.en: El Familiar is a man-eating familiar spirit whose legend is widespread in the sugar mills of north-western Argentina. It is most often a huge black dog as tall as a man with blazing eyes, and at night it can become a snake coiling round the workers' sheds. It gives its owner power and money in exchange for human lives.

long_description.id: Legenda ini sering melibatkan perjanjian pemilik pabrik dengan Iblis, dibayar dengan nyawa pekerja; Ingenio Santa Ana di Tucumán disebut yang pertama memilikinya. Hilangnya para pekerja di masa kediktatoran pun dikaitkan dengan El Familiar.
long_description.en: The legend often involves a pact between mill owners and the Devil, paid for with workers' lives; the Ingenio Santa Ana in Tucumán is said to have been the first to have one. Workers' disappearances under the dictatorship were also blamed on El Familiar.

who.en: A man-eating dog spirit.

origin.en: The sugar mills of north-western Argentina.

role.en: Grants wealth for lives.

claims.quote: El Familiar, también conocido como El cuñado, El Tío o Perro Familiar​ es un tipo de espíritu familiar devorador de hombres, cuya leyenda se halla muy difundida en los ingenios azucareros del noroeste argentino.

statement.id: El Familiar, dikenal juga sebagai El cuñado, El Tío, atau Perro Familiar, adalah sejenis roh pendamping pemakan manusia yang legendanya tersebar luas di pabrik gula Argentina barat laut.
statement.en: El Familiar, also known as El cuñado, El Tío or Perro Familiar, is a man-eating familiar spirit whose legend is widespread in the sugar mills of north-western Argentina.

claims.quote: Se han descrito diferentes versiones de esta entidad, pero la más conocida lo identifica con una especie de criatura demoníaca con aspecto de cánido que da poder y dinero a su poseedor a cambio, generalmente, de vidas humanas.

statement.id: Versi paling terkenal menggambarkannya sebagai makhluk iblis berwujud anjing yang memberi kekuasaan dan uang kepada pemiliknya dengan imbalan, biasanya, nyawa manusia.
statement.en: The best-known version makes it a demonic dog-like creature that gives its owner power and money in exchange, usually, for human lives.

claims.quote: A veces, la leyenda involucra un pacto entre los dueños de los ingenios y el Diablo, que asegura la prevalencia de su estatus socioeconómico a cambio de sus almas y de la vida de algunos de sus trabajadores, arrebatadas periódicamente por el Familiar.

statement.id: Kadang legenda ini melibatkan perjanjian antara pemilik pabrik gula dan Iblis yang menjamin kedudukan mereka dengan imbalan jiwa mereka dan nyawa sebagian pekerja, yang diambil El Familiar secara berkala.
statement.en: Sometimes the legend involves a pact between the mill owners and the Devil, securing their status in exchange for their souls and the lives of some workers, taken periodically by the Familiar.

claims.quote: Muchas desapariciones de zafreros del Ingenio Ledesma y otros sucedidas durante el Proceso de Reorganización Nacional han sido vinculadas con el accionar del Familiar.

statement.id: Banyak hilangnya pekerja tebu di Ingenio Ledesma dan pabrik lain pada masa kediktatoran Proceso de Reorganización Nacional dikaitkan dengan El Familiar.
statement.en: Many disappearances of cane workers at the Ingenio Ledesma and other mills during the Proceso de Reorganización Nacional dictatorship have been linked to the Familiar.

claims.quote: La forma física més difosa d'aquest ésser monstruós és com un gos negre i enorme, que fins i tot pot arribar a l'altura d'un home. Té una mirada refulgent, fins a arribar a llançar foc pels seus ulls, segons alguns relats.

statement.id: Wujudnya yang paling umum adalah anjing hitam raksasa setinggi manusia, bermata menyala yang menurut sebagian kisah menyemburkan api.
statement.en: Its most common form is a huge black dog as tall as a man, with blazing eyes that in some accounts shoot fire.

claims.quote: De nit, pot adoptar la forma d'una serp, voltant d'aquesta manera els coberts on dormen els treballadors.

statement.id: Pada malam hari ia dapat berwujud ular dan melingkari barak tempat para pekerja tidur.
statement.en: At night it can take the form of a snake, coiling around the sheds where the workers sleep.

claims.quote: S'atribueix a l'Ingenio Santa Ana de Tucumán, propietat de Clodomiro Hileret, d'haver estat el primer a aconseguir el seu propi Familiar

statement.id: Ingenio Santa Ana di Tucumán milik Clodomiro Hileret disebut sebagai yang pertama memiliki El Familiar sendiri.
statement.en: The Ingenio Santa Ana in Tucumán, owned by Clodomiro Hileret, is said to have been the first to obtain its own Familiar.

short_description.id: Kaldaz (Kaldaz Xanım) adalah dewi api dalam mitologi Turk dan Altai; menurut pandangan lain ia pelindung ternak dan hewan bertanduk besar.
short_description.en: Kaldaz (Kaldaz Xanım) is a goddess of fire in Turkic and Altaic mythology; according to another view she is the protector of livestock and large horned animals.

long_description.id: Menurut artikel pertama, Kaldaz xanım adalah dewi api dalam mitologi Turk dan Altai. Kamus kedua menyebutnya pelindung api. Kedua sumber mencatat pandangan lain bahwa ia melindungi ternak dan hewan besar.
long_description.en: According to the first article, Kaldaz xanım is a goddess of fire in Turkic and Altaic mythology. The second source, a dictionary, calls her the protector of fire. Both sources record another view in which she protects livestock and large animals.

long_description.id: Makhluk yang berada di bawah perintahnya diberi nama Kaldazın. Sebagai entri tersendiri, Kaldazın digambarkan sebagai jin api yang bermain di dalam api, bertubuh pendek, berjanggut tujuh jengkal yang seperti duri landak, dan dapat berubah menjadi sable kuning.
long_description.en: The beings under her command are given the name Kaldazın. As an entry of their own, the Kaldazın is described as a fire jinn that plays in the fire, is short, has a seven-span beard like hedgehog quills, and can turn into a yellow sable.

long_description.id: Namanya dijelaskan sebagai gabungan kata Kal, yang berarti api atau botak, dan Daz, yang berarti botak atau tak berambut.
long_description.en: Her name is explained as a combination of the words Kal, meaning fire or bald, and Daz, meaning bald or hairless.

literal_meaning.id: Kal berarti api (atəş) dan Daz berarti botak (keçəl); sumber kedua memberi Kal sebagai Kel atau Ateş dan Daz sebagai Saçsız.
literal_meaning.en: Kal means fire (atəş) and Daz means bald (keçəl); the second source gives Kal as Kel or Ateş and Daz as Saçsız.

who.id: Kaldaz adalah dewi api dalam mitologi Turk dan Altai.
who.en: Kaldaz is a goddess of fire in Turkic and Altaic mythology.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari mitologi Turk dan Altai.
origin.en: She comes from Turkic and Altaic mythology.

role.id: Ia dipandang sebagai pelindung api, atau menurut pandangan lain pelindung ternak dan hewan besar.
role.en: She is seen as the protector of fire, or, according to another view, of livestock and large animals.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal sebagai dewi api yang namanya juga dipakai untuk makhluk-makhluk di bawah perintahnya.
famous_for.en: She is known as a fire goddess whose name is also given to the beings under her command.

note.id: Makhluk di bawah perintah Kaldaz disebut Kaldazın; sebagai entri tersendiri, Kaldazın adalah jin api berjanggut tujuh jengkal.
note.en: The beings under Kaldaz's command are called Kaldazın; as an entry of its own, the Kaldazın is a fire jinn with a seven-span beard.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa dewi api bisa juga dipandang sebagai pelindung ternak?
learning_questions.en: Why might a fire goddess also be regarded as a protector of livestock?

claims.quote: Kaldaz xanım - türk və altay mifologiyasında od ilahəsi.

statement.id: Kaldaz xanım (Kaldaz Hanım) adalah dewi api (od ilahəsi) dalam mitologi Turk (türk) dan Altai (altay).
statement.en: Kaldaz xanım (Lady Kaldaz) is a goddess of fire (od ilahəsi) in Turkic (türk) and Altaic (altay) mythology.

claims.quote: Başqa bir görüşə görə mal və iribuynuzlu heyvanların qoruyucusudur. Əmrindəki olan canlılara Kaldazın adı verilər.

statement.id: Menurut pandangan lain, ia pelindung ternak (mal) dan hewan bertanduk besar (iribuynuzlu); makhluk di bawah perintahnya disebut Kaldazın.
statement.en: According to another view she is the protector of livestock (mal) and large horned animals (iribuynuzlu); the beings under her command are called Kaldazın.

claims.quote: Ateşin koruyucusu olarak görülür. Başka bir görüşe göre mal (sığır) ve büyükbaş hayvanların koruyucusudur.

statement.id: Ia dipandang sebagai pelindung api (koruyucusu); menurut pandangan lain ia pelindung ternak (mal, sığır) dan hewan besar (büyükbaş).
statement.en: She is regarded as the protector (koruyucusu) of fire; according to another view she is the protector of livestock (mal, sığır) and large animals (büyükbaş).

claims.quote: Emrindeki olan canlılara Kaldazın adı verilir.

statement.id: Makhluk yang berada di bawah perintahnya diberi nama Kaldazın.

claims.quote: Kal (atəş) və Daz (keçəl) sözlərinin birləşmiş halıdır.

statement.id: Namanya gabungan kata Kal (atəş, api) dan Daz (keçəl, botak).
statement.en: The name is a combination of the words Kal (atəş, fire) and Daz (keçəl, bald).

claims.quote: Anlam: Kal (Kel veyâ Ateş) ve Daz (Saçsız) sözcüklerinin bileşiminden oluşur.

statement.id: Namanya terdiri dari gabungan kata Kal (Kel atau Ateş) dan Daz (Saçsız, tak berambut).
statement.en: The name is formed from the words Kal (Kel or Ateş) and Daz (Saçsız, hairless).

claims.quote: Kaldazın - türk və altay xalq inancında atəş cini. Odun içində oynayır. Qısa boyludur. Saqqalı yeddi qarışdır.

statement.id: Kaldazın adalah jin api (atəş cini) dalam kepercayaan rakyat; ia bermain di dalam api, bertubuh pendek, dan janggutnya tujuh jengkal (yeddi qarış).
statement.en: A Kaldazın is a fire jinn (atəş cini) in folk belief; it plays inside the fire, is short in stature, and its beard is seven spans (yeddi qarış).

claims.quote: Saqqalları kirpi oxu kimidir. Sarı bir samura çevrilə bilər.

statement.id: Janggutnya seperti duri landak (kirpi oxu) dan ia dapat berubah menjadi musang sable kuning (sarı samur).
statement.en: Its beard is like a hedgehog quill (kirpi oxu) and it can turn into a yellow sable (sarı samur).

claims.quote: Ateşin içinde oynar. Kısa boyludur. Kirpi oku gibi olan sakalı yedi karıştır. Sarı bir samura dönüşebilir.

statement.id: Kaldazın (Ateş Cini) bermain di dalam api, bertubuh pendek, janggutnya tujuh jengkal (yedi karıştır), dan dapat berubah menjadi sable kuning (sarı bir samur).
statement.en: The Kaldazın (Ateş Cini) plays in the fire, is short, has a beard seven spans long (yedi karıştır), and can turn into a yellow sable (sarı bir samur).

summary.id: Menurut kamus kedua, ia dipandang sebagai pelindung api.

summary.id: Menurut pandangan lain di kedua sumber, ia pelindung ternak dan hewan besar.
summary.en: According to another view in both sources, she is the protector of livestock and large animals.

short_description.id: Kawaakago adalah yōkai Jepang yang digambar sebagai bayi di dekat air.
short_description.en: Kawaakago is a Japanese yōkai depicted as a baby near water.

long_description.id: Kawaakago adalah yōkai Jepang yang digambar sebagai bayi di dekat air. Ilustrasi Sekien menunjukkan bagian atas tubuhnya di dekat buluh tepi sungai. Kisah belakangan memberinya penampilan bayi kecil berkulit merah.
long_description.en: Kawaakago is a Japanese yōkai depicted as a baby near water. Sekien’s illustration shows its upper body beside riverside reeds. A later account gives it the appearance of a small red-skinned baby.

long_description.id: Kisah itu menyebut ia meniru tangisan bayi untuk menarik orang yang lewat. Cerita belakangan menyebut leluconnya dapat berakhir dengan orang tenggelam. Satu tafsir peneliti menganggap gambar itu sebagai permainan kata, bukan makhluk yang tercatat dalam tradisi rakyat.
long_description.en: That account says it imitates a baby’s crying to attract passersby. The later story warns that its prank can end in drowning. One scholarly interpretation regards the image as wordplay rather than a recorded folk creature.

short_description.id: Kayberen adalah roh baik hati dalam kepercayaan orang Kirgiz yang tinggal di pegunungan, melindungi hewan pemamah biak, dan dimintai bantuan oleh pemburu serta orang yang terancam bahaya di gunung.
short_description.en: Kayberen are benevolent spirits in Kyrgyz belief who live in the mountains, protect ruminant animals and are called upon by hunters and by people facing danger in the mountains.

long_description.id: Orang Kirgiz menggolongkan Kayberen sebagai roh baik hati yang menetap di gunung dan menjaga hewan pemamah biak. Roh-roh ini membuat ternak dan satwa bertambah banyak, tetapi bila marah mereka bisa membinasakan hewan. Karena itu, sebelum berburu orang memohon pertolongan mereka agar perburuan beruntung.
long_description.en: The Kyrgyz class the Kayberen as kindly spirits who dwell in the mountains and look after cud-chewing animals. These spirits let herds and game grow in number, yet when angered they can wipe animals out. For that reason people seek their help before a hunt so that it will go well.

long_description.id: Kayberen juga menjadi iye, yaitu pemilik gaib, dari gunung dan bebatuan tempat mereka tinggal, dan orang yang menghadapi bahaya di gunung meminta bantuan mereka. Kamus kedua mencatat bahwa dalam kepercayaan rakyat Kirgiz mereka adalah orang-orang suci tak kasatmata yang disebut juga Yitik Eren atau Kayıp Eren. Kepercayaan ini bercampur dengan sosok Çiltan, empat puluh penjaga gunung yang juga melindungi hewan.
long_description.en: The Kayberen are also the iye, the spirit owners, of the mountains and rocks they inhabit, and those in danger in the mountains call on them for help. The second source notes that in Kyrgyz folk belief they are unseen holy ones, also known as Yitik Eren or Kayıp Eren. The belief has blended with the Çiltan, forty mountain guardians who likewise protect animals.

long_description.id: Artikel pertama mengaitkan kepercayaan Kayberen dengan kultus leluhur dan mencatat bahwa namanya dikenal di banyak bangsa Turk. Di kalangan orang Turk Anatolia, kayberen dipahami sebagai roh para wali yang mengambil rupa manusia, dan penduduk setempat menyembelih kurban untuk mereka setiap musim panas dan musim gugur.
long_description.en: The first article ties the Kayberen belief to the ancestor cult and notes that the name is known among many Turkic peoples. Among the Anatolian Turks, the kayberen are understood as the spirits of saints in human guise, and local people offer sacrifices to them every summer and autumn.

long_description.id: Sebuah legenda menceritakan pasangan tua yang lama mendambakan anak. Ketika mereka sudah renta, Tuhan memberi mereka empat puluh anak, yang lalu ditinggalkan di gunung karena tak sanggup diasuh. Kayberen datang membesarkan anak-anak itu, dan setelah dewasa mereka berubah menjadi pelindung yang tidak terlihat oleh manusia.
long_description.en: A legend tells of an old couple who had long wished for children. When they were already frail, God granted them forty children, whom they left on a mountain because they could not care for them. The Kayberen came and raised the children, who on growing up turned into protectors unseen by people.

who.id: Kayberen adalah roh pelindung hewan yang tinggal di gunung.
who.en: Kayberen are animal-protecting spirits who live in the mountains.

origin.id: Mereka berasal dari kepercayaan orang Kirgiz, dan namanya dikenal di banyak bangsa Turk.
origin.en: They come from Kyrgyz belief, and the name is known among many Turkic peoples.

role.id: Mereka menjaga dan memperbanyak hewan serta menolong orang yang terancam bahaya di gunung.
role.en: They guard and multiply animals and help people in danger in the mountains.

famous_for.id: Mereka dikenal dalam legenda empat puluh anak yang mereka besarkan menjadi pelindung tak terlihat.
famous_for.en: They are known from the legend of forty children they raised to become unseen protectors.

did_you_know.id: Nama Kayberen dibentuk dari kayıp yang berarti tak terlihat dan eren yang berarti suci.
did_you_know.en: The name Kayberen is formed from kayıp, meaning invisible, and eren, meaning holy.

title.en: The forty children and the Kayberen

role.en: Foster carers of the abandoned children

summary.id: Pasangan tua diberi empat puluh anak oleh Tuhan lalu meninggalkan mereka di gunung; Kayberen membesarkan mereka hingga menjadi pelindung yang tak terlihat.
summary.en: An old couple were given forty children by God and left them on a mountain; the Kayberen raised them until they became unseen protectors.

note.id: Empat puluh Çiltan juga tinggal di gunung dan melindungi hewan; kepercayaan tentang keduanya bercampur.
note.en: The forty Çiltan also live in the mountains and protect animals; beliefs about the two have blended.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa pemburu dan penggembala meminta izin kepada roh penjaga hewan?
learning_questions.en: Why do hunters and herders seek permission from spirits that guard animals?

claims.quote: Kayberen, Kırgızlar'ın iyiliksever ruhlar arasına dahil ettikleri ve ... dağlarda yaşarlar ... ve geviş getiren hayvanları korurlar.

statement.id: Kayberen adalah roh yang digolongkan orang Kirgiz ke dalam roh-roh baik hati; mereka tinggal di pegunungan (dağlarda yaşarlar) dan melindungi hewan pemamah biak (geviş getiren hayvanları korurlar).
statement.en: Kayberen are spirits whom the Kyrgyz count among the benevolent spirits; they live in the mountains (dağlarda yaşarlar) and protect ruminant animals (geviş getiren hayvanları korurlar).

claims.quote: Kırgızlar'ın inancına göre bu ruhlar, hayvanların artıp çoğalmasını sağlar. Ancak kızdıkları zaman da hayvanları telef edebilir.

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan orang Kirgiz (Kırgızlar), roh-roh ini membuat hewan bertambah dan berkembang biak (artıp çoğalmasını), tetapi ketika marah (kızdıkları zaman) mereka juga dapat membinasakan hewan (telef edebilir).
statement.en: According to the belief of the Kyrgyz (Kırgızlar), these spirits make animals increase and multiply (artıp çoğalmasını), but when angry (kızdıkları zaman) they can also destroy animals (telef edebilir).

claims.quote: Bunun için de ava çıkmadan önce, uğurlu geçmesi için

statement.id: Karena itu sebelum berburu (ava çıkmadan önce), orang meminta bantuan kepada kayberen agar perburuan membawa keberuntungan (uğurlu geçmesi için).
statement.en: Therefore before going hunting (ava çıkmadan önce), people ask the kayberen for help so that it goes auspiciously (uğurlu geçmesi için).

claims.quote: Dağlarda, taşlarda yaşayan ve hayvanları koruyan bu ruhlar aynı zamanda yaşadıkları yerin iyesidirler.

statement.id: Roh-roh yang tinggal di gunung dan bebatuan serta melindungi hewan ini sekaligus adalah iye (pemilik, iyesidirler) tempat tinggal mereka.
statement.en: These spirits, living in mountains and rocks and protecting animals, are at the same time the iye (owners, iyesidirler) of the places they inhabit.

claims.quote: Çiltanlar (Kırklar)da Kayberenler gibi dağda yaşayıp hayvanları korurlardı. Onların sayısı 40 olduğu için kırk çiltan denilirdi.

statement.id: Çiltan (Kırklar) juga tinggal di gunung dan melindungi hewan seperti Kayberen; karena jumlahnya 40, mereka disebut kırk çiltan (empat puluh çiltan).
statement.en: The Çiltan (Kırklar) also lived in the mountains and protected animals like the Kayberen; because they numbered 40 they were called kırk çiltan (the forty çiltan).

claims.quote: Kayberen inancı ata kültüyle bağlıdır. Onun adına, Türk halklarının birçoğunda rastlanır.

statement.id: Kepercayaan Kayberen terkait dengan kultus leluhur (ata kültü), dan namanya dijumpai di banyak bangsa Turk (Türk halklarının).
statement.en: The Kayberen belief is linked to the ancestor cult (ata kültü), and its name is found among many Turkic peoples (Türk halklarının).

claims.quote: Anadolu Türkleri'nde "kayb erenleri" şeklinde rastlanır ve eski inanışların bir izi gibi, evliyalar hakkında görüşlerden kaynaklanan bir anlayışı ifade eder. Bu inanışa göre "kayberenler", evliyaların insan kılığına girmiş ruhlarıdır.

statement.id: Di kalangan orang Turk Anatolia (Anadolu Türkleri) dikenal kayb erenleri; menurut kepercayaan ini, kayberen adalah roh para wali (evliyaların) yang mengambil rupa manusia (insan kılığına girmiş).
statement.en: Among the Anatolian Turks (Anadolu Türkleri) they are known as kayb erenleri; according to this belief the kayberen are the spirits of saints (evliyaların) who have taken human guise (insan kılığına girmiş).

claims.quote: Yerli halk tarafından her yılın yazı ve sonbaharında

statement.id: Penduduk setempat (yerli halk) menyembelih kurban untuk kayberen setiap musim panas dan musim gugur (yazı ve sonbaharında).
statement.en: The local people (yerli halk) slaughter sacrifices for the kayberen every summer and autumn (yazı ve sonbaharında).

claims.quote: Kayberenler gelip onları yedirir, içirir ve büyütür. Bu kırk çocuk büyüdükten sonra, insanların gözüne görünmeyen koruyuculara dönüşürler.

statement.id: Dalam legenda, Kayberen datang memberi makan, minum, dan membesarkan anak-anak itu (yedirir, içirir ve büyütür); setelah dewasa, keempat puluh anak itu (kırk çocuk) menjadi pelindung yang tak terlihat manusia (gözüne görünmeyen koruyuculara).
statement.en: In the legend, the Kayberen come and feed, water and raise the children (yedirir, içirir ve büyütür); once grown, these forty children (kırk çocuk) become protectors invisible to human eyes (gözüne görünmeyen koruyuculara).

claims.quote: Bir karı kocanın hiç çocukları yoktu. Ömürleri boyunca çocuk sahibi olmak için Tanrı'ya yalvardılar.

statement.id: Sepasang suami istri (karı koca) tidak punya anak dan sepanjang hidup memohon kepada Tuhan (Tanrı) agar diberi anak.
statement.en: A husband and wife (karı koca) had no children and all their lives begged God (Tanrı) for a child.

claims.quote: göze görünmez anlamındaki "kayıp" ile kutsal, nur yüzlü anlamındaki "eren"den gelmektedir.

statement.id: Nama Kayberen berasal dari kayıp yang bermakna tak terlihat (göze görünmez) dan eren yang bermakna suci, berwajah cahaya (kutsal, nur yüzlü).
statement.en: The name Kayberen comes from kayıp, meaning invisible (göze görünmez), and eren, meaning holy, light-faced (kutsal, nur yüzlü).

claims.quote: Kırgızların halk inanışlarına göre gözle görülemeyen, gözlerden ırak dağlarda yaşayan Yitik Eren (Yitkin Eren / İtkin Eren) veya

statement.id: Menurut kepercayaan rakyat Kirgiz (Kırgızların), ada orang-orang suci yang tak terlihat mata (gözle görülemeyen) dan tinggal di gunung yang jauh, disebut Yitik Eren (Yitkin Eren, İtkin Eren).
statement.en: According to Kyrgyz (Kırgızların) folk beliefs, there are holy ones invisible to the eye (gözle görülemeyen) who live in remote mountains, called Yitik Eren (Yitkin Eren, İtkin Eren).

claims.quote: adı verilen ermişler hayvanları korurlar. Onlar yaşadıkları yerin İyesi'dirler (sahibidirler). Dağda bir tehlike ile karşılaşanlar ondan yardım isterler.

statement.id: Orang-orang suci yang juga disebut Kayıp Eren (Kayberen, Kaybaran) itu melindungi hewan (hayvanları korurlar), menjadi iye atau pemilik tempat tinggalnya, dan orang yang menghadapi bahaya di gunung meminta bantuan mereka (yardım isterler).
statement.en: These holy ones, also called Kayıp Eren (Kayberen, Kaybaran), protect animals (hayvanları korurlar), are the iye or owners of the places they live in, and those who meet danger in the mountains ask them for help (yardım isterler).

claims.quote: Kayberenler gelip onları himâyelerine alırlar ve büyütürler. Bu kırk çocuk daha sonra göze görünmeyen Dağ İyeleri'ne (koruyucu ruhlara) dönüşürler.

statement.id: Kayberen mengambil anak-anak itu di bawah perlindungan mereka (himâyelerine) dan membesarkannya; keempat puluh anak itu (kırk çocuk) kemudian menjadi Dağ İyeleri (roh pelindung gunung) yang tak terlihat.
statement.en: The Kayberen take the children under their protection (himâyelerine) and raise them; the forty children (kırk çocuk) later become invisible Dağ İyeleri (mountain guardian spirits).

summary.id: Dalam kepercayaan Kirgiz, Kayberen adalah roh pelindung hewan dan pemilik gunung.
summary.en: In Kyrgyz belief the Kayberen are animal-protecting spirits and owners of the mountains.

summary.id: Di kalangan orang Turk Anatolia, kayberen adalah roh para wali yang mengambil rupa manusia; kamus kedua juga menyebut mereka orang-orang suci tak terlihat.
summary.en: Among the Anatolian Turks the kayberen are spirits of saints in human guise; the second source also calls them unseen holy ones.

short_description.id: Raja Goldemar adalah kurcaci atau kobold dari mitologi dan folklor Jermanik, yang pada Abad Pertengahan dianggap raja para kurcaci.
short_description.en: King Goldemar is a dwarf or kobold of Germanic myth and folklore, regarded by the Middle Ages as king of the dwarfs.

long_description.id: Raja Goldemar (juga Goldmar, Vollmar, Volmar) adalah kurcaci atau kobold dari mitologi dan folklor Jermanik; pada Abad Pertengahan ia telah menjadi raja kurcaci dalam kepercayaan Jerman. Penggalan puisi epik Goldemar karya Albrecht von Kemenaten mengisahkan pertemuan Dietrich dengan raja kurcaci itu, dan ia juga muncul dalam "Der junge König und die Schäferin" karya Ludwig Uhland. Saudara-saudaranya, Alberich (Elberich) dan Elbegast, tampil dalam puisi lain.
long_description.en: King Goldemar (also Goldmar, Vollmar, Volmar) is a dwarf or kobold of Germanic myth and folklore who by the Middle Ages was held in German belief to rule the dwarfs. Surviving fragments of Albrecht von Kemenaten's epic Goldemar describe Dietrich meeting the dwarf king, and he also figures in Ludwig Uhland's 'Der junge König und die Schäferin'. His brothers Alberich (Elberich) and Elbegast appear in other poems.

long_description.id: Menurut legenda yang dicatat Thomas Keightley pada 1850, Goldemar adalah kobold, roh rumah, yang tinggal bersama Neveling von Hardenberg di Kastel Hardenstein di tepi Sungai Ruhr. Ia pandai bermain harpa, gemar berjudi dadu, membawa keberuntungan, dan tak mau dilihat meski boleh diraba. Setelah tiga tahun, seorang yang penasaran menaburkan abu untuk melihat jejaknya; Goldemar mencincang orang itu, memasak dan memakannya, lalu pergi sambil meninggalkan pesan bahwa rumah itu akan sial sebagaimana dulu beruntung.
long_description.en: In a legend Thomas Keightley recorded in 1850, Goldemar was a kobold, a household spirit, living with Neveling von Hardenberg at Castle Hardenstein by the River Ruhr. He played the harp well, liked dice, brought luck to the house, and would be felt but never seen. After three years a curious man scattered ashes to find his footprints; Goldemar hacked him apart, cooked and ate him, and departed, leaving word that the house would now be as unlucky as it had been lucky.

short_description.id: Knochenfund von Seweckenberge adalah "unicorn fosil" yang direkonstruksi pada akhir abad ke-17 dan awal abad ke-18 dari tulang-tulang zaman Pleistosen yang ditemukan pada 1663 di dekat Quedlinburg, Jerman.
short_description.en: The Seweckenberge bone find is a 'fossil unicorn' reconstructed in the late 17th and early 18th centuries from Pleistocene bones found in 1663 near Quedlinburg, Germany.

long_description.id: Temuan tulang Seweckenberge merujuk pada dugaan rekonstruksi seekor unicorn fosil pada akhir abad ke-17 atau awal abad ke-18. Pada 1663 para pekerja tambang gipsum dan batu kapur di perbukitan Seweckenberge, tenggara Quedlinburg di Sachsen-Anhalt, menemukan tulang-tulang mamalia besar dari zaman Pleistosen yang belum memfosil, termasuk tengkorak bertanduk, rusuk, tulang belakang, tulang belikat, dan tulang kaki.
long_description.en: The Seweckenberge bone find refers to the supposed reconstruction of a fossil unicorn in the late 17th or early 18th century. In 1663 workers quarrying gypsum and limestone in the Seweckenberge hills south-east of Quedlinburg in Saxony-Anhalt uncovered unfossilised Pleistocene bones of large mammals, including a skull with a horn, ribs, spine, shoulder blades and leg bones.

long_description.id: Otto von Guericke kemudian menulis bahwa di gunung Seveckenberg ditemukan kerangka unicorn dengan kepala terangkat dan tanduk panjang setebal paha manusia di dahinya; kerangka itu dipecahkan karena ketidaktahuan, lalu kepala, tanduk, dan sebagian tulangnya diserahkan kepada kepala biara perempuan Quedlinburg. Gambar "unicorn fosil" dengan hanya dua kaki depan kemudian diterbitkan oleh Michael Bernhard Valentini (1704) dan dalam Protogaea karya Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz (1749).
long_description.en: Otto von Guericke later wrote that a unicorn skeleton had been found in the Seveckenberg hill, with a raised head and a long horn as thick as a human thigh on its forehead; it was broken up through ignorance, and the head, horn and some bones were given to the princess-abbess of Quedlinburg. Pictures of a 'fossil unicorn' with only two forelegs were later published by Michael Bernhard Valentini (1704) and in Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz's Protogaea (1749).

long_description.id: Berdasarkan gambar-gambar itu, tulangnya dapat dikenali sebagai milik beberapa hewan berbeda: badak berbulu atau hewan berkuku lain, mamut berbulu, dan narwal masa kini sebagai "tanduk"-nya. Rekonstruksi ini menjadi ikon kriptozoologi dan paleontologi awal; banyak penulis kemudian keliru menyebut Guericke sebagai penemu dan perakitnya, padahal sebenarnya ia tidak terlibat.
long_description.en: From those pictures the bones can be assigned to several different animals: a woolly rhinoceros or other hoofed animal, the woolly mammoth, and a modern narwhal as the 'horn'. The reconstruction became an icon of cryptozoology and early palaeontology; many later writers wrongly named Guericke as its finder and assembler, though he in fact took no part.

who.en: A reconstructed fossil unicorn.

role.id: Tanduk dari narwal, tulang dari mamut.
role.en: Horn from a narwhal, bones from a mammoth.

famous_for.id: Ikon kriptozoologi.
famous_for.en: An icon of cryptozoology.

did_you_know.id: "Tanduk" unicorn fosil Quedlinburg kemungkinan besar berasal dari narwal masa kini, sementara tulangnya dari badak berbulu dan mamut berbulu.
did_you_know.en: The 'horn' of the Quedlinburg fossil unicorn most likely came from a modern narwhal, while its bones belonged to a woolly rhinoceros and a woolly mammoth.

traditional.id: Pada abad ke-17, tulang-tulang zaman Pleistosen dari Seweckenberge ditafsirkan sebagai kerangka unicorn.
traditional.en: In the 17th century, Pleistocene bones from Seweckenberge were interpreted as a unicorn skeleton.

modern.id: Kini rekonstruksi itu ditampilkan sebagai model tiga dimensi setinggi beberapa meter di Museum für Naturkunde Magdeburg dan dipakai untuk promosi gua wisata Einhornhöhle.
modern.en: Today the reconstruction is shown as a several-metre-high 3D model in the Museum für Naturkunde Magdeburg and used to promote the Einhornhöhle show cave.

claims.quote: Der Knochenfund von Seweckenberge bezieht sich auf die vermeintliche Rekonstruktion eines fossilen Einhorns im späten 17. beziehungsweise frühen 18. Jahrhundert. ... Teilweise wird die vermeintliche Rekonstruktion als Guericke-Einhorn bezeichnet, jedoch war Otto von Guericke weder an dem Fund noch an der Rekonstruktion selbst beteiligt.

statement.id: Temuan tulang Seweckenberge merujuk pada dugaan rekonstruksi unicorn fosil pada akhir abad ke-17 atau awal abad ke-18; kadang disebut Guericke-Einhorn, padahal Guericke tidak terlibat dalam temuan maupun rekonstruksinya.
statement.en: The Seweckenberge bone find refers to the supposed reconstruction of a fossil unicorn in the late 17th or early 18th century; it is sometimes called the Guericke-Einhorn, though Guericke had no part in the find or the reconstruction.

claims.quote: In den Seweckenbergen südöstlich von Quedlinburg in Sachsen-Anhalt wurden seit dem Mittelalter Kalkstein und Gips abgebaut. In einer Schlotte wurden 1663 von Arbeitern nicht fossilierte Knochen großer Säugetiere aus dem Pleistozän gefunden.

statement.id: Di perbukitan Seweckenberge, tenggara Quedlinburg di Sachsen-Anhalt (Jerman), batu kapur dan gipsum ditambang sejak Abad Pertengahan; pada 1663 para pekerja menemukan di sebuah rongga tulang mamalia besar dari Pleistosen (Pleistozän) yang belum memfosil.
statement.en: In the Seweckenberge hills south-east of Quedlinburg in Saxony-Anhalt (Germany), limestone and gypsum were quarried from the Middle Ages; in 1663 workers found unfossilised Pleistocene (Pleistozän) bones of large mammals in a cavity.

claims.quote: Die gefundenen Knochen enthielten einen Schädel mit dem Horn, einige Rippen, Wirbelsäule, Schulterblätter und Beinknochen. Auf der Basis der veröffentlichten „Rekonstruktionen“ konnten die abgebildeten Knochen verschiedenen Tierarten zugeordnet werden: Wollnashorn oder andere Huftiere, das Wollhaarmammut und ein rezenter Narwal als Spender des „Horns“.

statement.id: Tulang yang ditemukan meliputi tengkorak bertanduk, rusuk, tulang belakang, belikat, dan tulang kaki; dari "rekonstruksi" yang diterbitkan, tulang-tulang itu dapat dikaitkan dengan badak berbulu atau hewan berkuku lain, mamut berbulu, dan narwal masa kini sebagai sumber "tanduk".
statement.en: The bones included a skull with the horn, ribs, spine, shoulder blades and leg bones; from the published 'reconstructions' they can be assigned to woolly rhinoceros or other ungulates, the woolly mammoth, and a modern narwhal as donor of the 'horn'.

claims.quote: Es trug sich auch in eben diesem Jahre 1663 zu, daß man bei Quedlinburg in einem Berge, der Seveckenberg geheißen, wo man auf Gips gräbt, und zwar in einer Felsspalte, das Gerippe eines Einhorns fand

statement.id: Guericke menulis bahwa pada 1663 di dekat Quedlinburg, di gunung bernama Seveckenberg tempat orang menggali gipsum, ditemukan kerangka unicorn (Einhorns) di celah batu.
statement.en: Guericke wrote that in 1663 near Quedlinburg, in a hill called Seveckenberg where gypsum is dug, the skeleton of a unicorn (Einhorns) was found in a rock fissure.

claims.quote: den Kopf aber erhoben und auf der Stirn nach vorn ein langgestrecktes Horn von der Dicke eines menschlichen Oberschenkels hatte ... Dies Tiergerippe wurde zunächst zwar aus Unverstand zerbrochen ... schließlich aber der Kopf samt dem Horn und einigen Rippen, der Wirbelsäule und den Beinknochen der hochwürdigsten Fürstäbtissin übergeben

statement.id: Kerangka itu berkepala terangkat dengan tanduk panjang di dahi setebal paha manusia; kerangka dipecahkan karena ketidaktahuan, tetapi kepala, tanduk, beberapa rusuk, tulang belakang, dan tulang kaki diserahkan kepada kepala biara perempuan (Fürstäbtissin) Quedlinburg.
statement.en: The skeleton had a raised head with a long horn on the forehead as thick as a human thigh; it was broken up through ignorance, but the head with horn, some ribs, spine and leg bones were handed to the princess-abbess (Fürstäbtissin) of Quedlinburg.

claims.quote: 1749, und damit mehr als 40 Jahre nach seinem Tod, wurde Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz’ Protogaea erstmals veröffentlicht. Darin übernahm er die Schilderung Guerickes fast wörtlich. Er fügte auch eine Tafel mit einem Kupferstich von Nikolaus Seeländer bei. Die Darstellung zeigt eine frappierende Ähnlichkeit mit Valentinis Abbildung aus dem Jahr 1704.

statement.id: Protogaea karya Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz terbit pertama 1749, lebih dari 40 tahun setelah ia wafat; ia mengutip uraian Guericke hampir kata demi kata dan menambahkan ukiran tembaga Nikolaus Seeländer yang sangat mirip gambar Michael Bernhard Valentini (Valentinis) tahun 1704 dalam Museum Museorum.
statement.en: Gottfried Wilhelm Leibniz's Protogaea was first published in 1749, over 40 years after his death; he took over Guericke's account almost verbatim and added a copperplate by Nikolaus Seeländer strikingly like Michael Bernhard Valentini's 1704 image in Museum Museorum.

claims.quote: L'unicorno di Magdeburgo (in tedesco Magdeburger Einhorn, anche conosciuto come Guericke-Einhorn, lett. "unicorno di von Guericke") è un presunto reperto fossile di cui si hanno testimonianze tra il XVII e il XVIII secolo, composto dal teschio di un rinoceronte lanoso, le zampe di un mammut lanoso e il corno di un narvalo.

statement.id: Unicorn Magdeburg (Magdeburger Einhorn, juga Guericke-Einhorn) adalah dugaan temuan fosil yang tercatat antara abad ke-17 dan ke-18, tersusun dari tengkorak badak berbulu, kaki mamut berbulu, dan tanduk narwal.
statement.en: The Magdeburg unicorn (Magdeburger Einhorn, also Guericke-Einhorn) is a supposed fossil find attested in the 17th–18th centuries, made up of a woolly rhinoceros skull, woolly mammoth legs and a narwhal horn.

claims.quote: Die Knochen-Rekonstruktion ist eine Ikone der Kryptozoologie und der frühen Paläontologie.

statement.id: Rekonstruksi tulang ini adalah ikon kriptozoologi dan paleontologi awal.
statement.en: The bone reconstruction is an icon of cryptozoology and early palaeontology.

claims.quote: Das Museum für Naturkunde Magdeburg zeigt in seiner Eingangshalle die Knochen-Rekonstruktion als ein mehrere Meter hohes dreidimensionales Modell. Eine ähnliche Nachbildung wird von der Gesellschaft Unicornu fossile, den Betreibern der Schauhöhle Einhornhöhle im Harz, für Werbezwecke verwendet.

statement.id: Museum für Naturkunde Magdeburg menampilkan rekonstruksi ini sebagai model tiga dimensi setinggi beberapa meter di aula masuknya, dan replika serupa dipakai pengelola gua wisata Einhornhöhle di Harz untuk promosi.
statement.en: The Museum für Naturkunde Magdeburg shows the reconstruction as a several-metre-high 3D model in its entrance hall, and a similar replica is used for promotion by the operators of the Einhornhöhle show cave in the Harz.

statement.en: According to the Polish article, the Magdeburg unicorn was the work of the physicist, engineer and mayor of Magdeburg Otto von Guericke (Ottona von Geuricke).
