statement.id: Gokusotsu (獄卒, ごくそつ) adalah makhluk berwujud ganjil (異形) di neraka (地獄) yang dipercaya menyiksa orang mati (亡者) dengan berbagai siksaan.
statement.en: Gokusotsu (獄卒, ごくそつ) are strange-formed beings (異形) in hell (地獄) believed to torment the dead (亡者) with various punishments.

claims.quote: いわゆる地獄の鬼。閻羅人。閻魔卒。転じて、囚人を直接取り扱う下級の役人。獄吏。牢番。看守。

statement.id: Mereka disebut juga oni neraka (地獄の鬼), 閻羅人 atau 閻魔卒; dalam arti turunan, kata ini berarti pegawai rendah yang menangani tahanan (獄吏, 牢番, 看守).
statement.en: They are also called hell oni (地獄の鬼), 閻羅人 or 閻魔卒; in an extended sense the word means a low-ranking official handling prisoners (獄吏, 牢番, 看守).

claims.quote: 仏語。地獄で亡者の罪を責めたてる鬼。地獄の鬼。 獄卒②〈地獄草紙〉 [初出の実例]「閻魔獄卒構レ獄断レ罪」(出典：秘蔵宝鑰（830頃）上)
claims.locator: 精選版 日本国語大辞典, sense ②

statement.id: Dalam istilah Buddhis (仏語), gokusotsu adalah oni (鬼) yang menghukum dosa orang mati di neraka; contoh tertulis pertama dikutip dari 秘蔵宝鑰 (sekitar 830).
statement.en: As a Buddhist term (仏語), gokusotsu is an oni (鬼) that punishes the sins of the dead in hell; the first cited example is from 秘蔵宝鑰 (around 830).

claims.quote: ２ 地獄で死者を責めるという悪鬼。 ３ 義理や人情を解さない人をののしっていう語。

statement.id: Kamus デジタル大辞泉 menjelaskan gokusotsu sebagai iblis jahat (悪鬼) yang konon menyiksa orang mati (死者) di neraka, dan juga sebagai makian bagi orang yang tak tahu budi (義理や人情を解さない人).
statement.en: The デジタル大辞泉 dictionary defines gokusotsu as an evil demon (悪鬼) said to torment the dead (死者) in hell, and also as an insult for a person without a sense of duty or compassion (義理や人情を解さない人).

claims.quote: （術語）在地獄之內，現種種可畏之形，以種種之苦具，殘害罪人者。然是非實之有情，則於罪人之業力而見之如有情也。
claims.locator: 佛學大辭典, entry 獄卒

statement.id: Menurut 佛學大辭典, 獄卒 adalah istilah (術語) untuk sosok di dalam neraka (地獄) yang menampakkan berbagai wujud menakutkan dan mencelakai pendosa (罪人) dengan alat siksa; mereka bukan makhluk hidup sejati (有情), melainkan tampak demikian karena karma (業力) pendosa.
statement.en: According to 佛學大辭典, 獄卒 is a term (術語) for figures in hell (地獄) who show fearsome forms and harm sinners (罪人) with instruments of torment; they are not real sentient beings (有情) but appear so through the sinners' karma (業力).

claims.quote: 俱舍論十一曰：「諸地獄卒是有情不？有說非情如何動作？有情業力，如成劫風
claims.locator: 佛學大辭典, entry 獄卒 (citing 俱舍論 11)

statement.id: Kamus itu mengutip 俱舍論 jilid 11 yang mempertanyakan apakah para penjaga neraka (諸地獄卒) adalah makhluk hidup (有情), dan bagaimana mereka bergerak bila bukan makhluk hidup (非情).
statement.en: The dictionary cites 俱舍論 volume 11, which asks whether the hell guards (諸地獄卒) are sentient beings (有情), and how they move if they are not (非情).

claims.quote: 見他苦欣悅，死作琰魔卒。琰魔王使諸邏剎婆，擲諸有情置地獄者，名琰魔卒。是實有情，非地獄中害有情者
claims.locator: 佛學大辭典, entry 獄卒 (citing 俱舍論 11)

statement.id: Kutipan itu menyebut orang yang senang melihat penderitaan orang lain akan menjadi 琰魔卒 setelah mati; 琰魔卒 adalah para rākṣasa (邏剎婆) utusan raja 琰魔 yang melempar makhluk ke neraka, dan mereka makhluk hidup sejati (是實有情), berbeda dari yang mencelakai di dalam neraka.
statement.en: The passage says those who rejoice at others' suffering become 琰魔卒 after death; 琰魔卒 are the rākṣasas (邏剎婆) sent by King 琰魔 to cast beings into hell, and they are real sentient beings (是實有情), unlike those who harm beings inside hell.

claims.quote: 牛頭馬頭（ごずめず）とは、仏教において地獄にいるとされる亡者達を責め苛む獄卒で、牛の頭に体は人身の姿をした牛頭と、馬の頭に体は人身の姿をした馬頭をいう。

statement.id: Gozu-mezu (牛頭馬頭, ごずめず) adalah gokusotsu (獄卒) dalam Buddhisme (仏教) yang menyiksa orang mati di neraka: 牛頭 berkepala sapi dan 馬頭 berkepala kuda, keduanya bertubuh manusia.
statement.en: Gozu-mezu (牛頭馬頭, ごずめず) are gokusotsu (獄卒) in Buddhism (仏教) who torment the dead in hell: 牛頭 with an ox head and 馬頭 with a horse head, both with human bodies.

claims.quote: 仏教の思想に基づく地獄の獄卒は、六朝以後の中国の小説類にも散見される。日本でも地獄の登場する説話や、地獄の様子を描いた『六道輪廻図』、『六道道』、『十王図』、『地獄草紙』などの絵画にその姿が決まって描かれている。

statement.id: Gokusotsu neraka yang berdasar pemikiran Buddhis (仏教の思想) muncul dalam cerita-cerita Tiongkok (中国) sejak masa 六朝, dan di Jepang (日本) sosoknya selalu digambarkan dalam kisah tentang neraka serta lukisan seperti 『地獄草紙』 dan 『十王図』.
statement.en: Hell gokusotsu based on Buddhist thought (仏教の思想) appear in fiction of China (中国) from the 六朝 period onward, and in Japan (日本) their figures are invariably depicted in tales of hell and in paintings such as 『地獄草紙』 and 『十王図』.

claims.quote: 阿傍羅刹（あぼう らせつ）は地獄にいるとされる獄卒である。阿防羅刹、獄卒阿傍、阿防夜叉とも。

statement.id: 阿傍羅刹 (Abō rasetsu, あぼう らせつ) adalah salah satu gokusotsu (獄卒) yang dipercaya berada di neraka, disebut juga 阿防羅刹, 獄卒阿傍, atau 阿防夜叉.
statement.en: 阿傍羅刹 (Abō rasetsu, あぼう らせつ) is a gokusotsu (獄卒) believed to dwell in hell, also called 阿防羅刹, 獄卒阿傍 or 阿防夜叉.

claims.quote: 現世で悪事をなした人間が地獄に堕ちたとき、彼らによって閻魔のもとにともなわれて行き、百千万歳のあいだ呵責（かしゃく）をあたえられる。

statement.id: Orang yang berbuat jahat di dunia (悪事) dan jatuh ke neraka dibawa oleh mereka ke hadapan 閻魔 (Enma), lalu disiksa (呵責) selama ratusan ribu juta tahun (百千万歳).
statement.en: People who did evil (悪事) in this world and fall into hell are taken by them before 閻魔 (Enma) and tormented (呵責) for hundreds of millions of years (百千万歳).

topic.en: Whether gokusotsu are real sentient beings

short_description.id: Wollunqua adalah dewa ular hujan dan kesuburan suku Warramunga di Australia, variasi Ular Pelangi yang panjangnya bermil-mil.
short_description.en: Wollunqua is the snake god of rain and fertility of the Warramunga of Australia, a miles-long variant of the Rainbow Serpent.

long_description.id: Wollunqua adalah dewa ular hujan dan kesuburan suku Warramunga (Warumungu) di Northern Territory, Australia, variasi Ular Pelangi yang dikenal banyak suku Aborigin. Ia muncul dari lubang air Kadjinara di Pegunungan Murchison, panjangnya bermil-mil, dan dapat menaruh pelangi di langit. Di depan umum ia disebut urkulu nappaurinnia agar tidak lepas kendali dan melahap orang.
long_description.en: Wollunqua is the snake god of rain and fertility of the Warramunga (Warumungu) of Australia's Northern Territory, a variant of the Rainbow Serpent known to many Aboriginal peoples. He emerged from the Kadjinara waterhole in the Murchison Ranges, is many miles long and can place the rainbow in the sky. In public he is called urkulu nappaurinnia so that he will not break loose and devour people.

long_description.id: Ia leluhur totem paruh Uluuru suku Warramunga. Dalam perjalanannya ia bergerak di bawah tanah, muncul untuk melakukan upacara, dan meninggalkan anak-anak roh yang menjadi pusat totem; ia begitu panjang sehingga ekornya tetap di Kadjinara meski kepalanya sudah jauh.
long_description.en: He is the totemic ancestor of the Warramunga's Uluuru moiety. On his journey he travelled underground, surfaced to perform ceremonies and left spirit children that became totemic centres; he was so long that his tail stayed at Kadjinara while his head was far away.

who.en: A rain snake god.

role.en: Totemic ancestor.

famous_for.id: Panjang bermil-mil.
famous_for.en: Many miles long.

note.en: Wollunqua is a variant of it.

claims.quote: Wollunqua, also written Wollunka or Wollunkua, is a snake-god of rain and fertility in Australian Aboriginal mythology of the Warramunga people of the Northern Territory of Australia, a variation of the "Rainbow Serpent" present in the mythology of many other Aboriginal Australian peoples.

statement.en: Wollunqua, also written Wollunka or Wollunkua, is a snake god of rain and fertility in the Aboriginal mythology of the Warramunga people of Australia's Northern Territory, a variant of the "Rainbow Serpent" known to many other Aboriginal peoples.

claims.quote: The snake, which emerged from a watering hole called Kadjinara in the Murchison Ranges, is said to be many miles long.

statement.id: Ular itu muncul dari lubang air bernama Kadjinara di Pegunungan Murchison dan konon panjangnya bermil-mil.
statement.en: The snake, which emerged from a waterhole called Kadjinara in the Murchison Ranges, is said to be many miles long.

claims.quote: When speaking of the Wollunqua snake in public, the name urkulu nappaurinnia is used, because if they were to call it too often by its real name they would lose control and it would come out and devour them all. It can place the rainbow in the sky at will.

statement.id: Di depan umum ular ini disebut urkulu nappaurinnia, karena bila nama aslinya terlalu sering disebut ia akan lepas kendali, keluar, dan melahap semua orang; ia dapat menaruh pelangi di langit sesuka hati.
statement.en: In public the snake is called urkulu nappaurinnia, because calling its real name too often would make it break loose, come out and devour everyone; it can place the rainbow in the sky at will.

claims.quote: Wollunqua is a totemic ancestor of the Warramunga people, specifically the Uluuru moiety of the tribe.

statement.id: Wollunqua adalah leluhur totem suku Warramunga, khususnya paruh Uluuru suku itu.
statement.en: Wollunqua is a totemic ancestor of the Warramunga, specifically the tribe's Uluuru moiety.

claims.quote: Setting out towards the east, he travelled at first underground, coming up at various spots where he performed ceremonies and left behind large numbers of spirit children, forming local totemic centres when he passed on.

statement.id: Dalam perjalanannya ke timur ia mula-mula bergerak di bawah tanah, muncul di berbagai tempat untuk melakukan upacara dan meninggalkan banyak anak roh yang menjadi pusat totem setempat.
statement.en: Heading east, he first travelled underground, surfacing at various spots to perform ceremonies and leaving many spirit children that became local totemic centres.

claims.quote: for he was so long that although he had travelled very many miles away from his home at Kadjinara, his tail end still remained there.

statement.id: Ia begitu panjang sehingga meski kepalanya sudah bermil-mil dari Kadjinara, ekornya masih berada di sana.
statement.en: He was so long that though his head had travelled many miles from Kadjinara, his tail was still there.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Aborigin, Wollunqua adalah dewa ular hujan dan kesuburan suku Warumungu di Northern Territory, Australia.
statement.en: In Aboriginal mythology Wollunqua is a snake god of rain and fertility of the Warumungu people in Australia's Northern Territory.

short_description.id: Xecotcovach adalah dewa Maya dalam Popol Vuh.
short_description.en: Xecotcovach is a Maya deity in the Popol Vuh.

long_description.id: Xecotcovach adalah dewa Maya dalam Popol Vuh. Para dewa memusnahkan manusia kayu yang tidak memiliki jiwa dan kebijaksanaan. Ia muncul bersama tiga pemusnah lainnya saat banjir.
long_description.en: Xecotcovach is a Maya deity in the Popol Vuh. The gods destroy wooden people who lack souls and wisdom. He appears with three other destroyers during the flood.

long_description.id: Perannya adalah mencungkil mata manusia kayu. Penceritaan Spence menyebut Xecotcovach burung yang mencabut mata. Spence menempatkan pemusnahan dalam banjir Hurakan terhadap manusia kayu.
long_description.en: His role is to gouge out the wooden people’s eyes. Spence’s retelling calls Xecotcovach a bird who tears out eyes. Spence places the destruction in Hurakan’s flood against wooden people.

short_description.id: Yama adalah dewa kematian dan keadilan Hindu yang dikaitkan dengan hukuman di Naraka.
short_description.en: Yama is the Hindu god of death and justice associated with punishment in Naraka.

long_description.id: Yama adalah dewa kematian dan keadilan Hindu yang dikaitkan dengan hukuman di Naraka. Kala dan Dharmaraja merupakan nama lain Yama.
long_description.en: Yama is the Hindu god of death and justice associated with punishment in Naraka. Kala and Dharmaraja are other names of Yama.

long_description.id: Dalam tradisi Weda ia adalah manusia pertama yang meninggal dan menemukan jalan ke tempat orang mati. Ia disebut saudara kembar Yami serta putra Surya dan Sanjna. Ia menilai jiwa dan menempatkannya menurut perbuatan ke alam leluhur, Naraka, atau kelahiran kembali. Yama menjaga arah selatan sebagai salah satu Lokapala. Ia sering digambarkan berkulit gelap dan menunggang kerbau. Jerat atau gada menjadi perlengkapan untuk menangkap jiwa dalam penggambarannya. Yama berarti kembar dalam salah satu penjelasan etimologinya. Pashi adalah sebutan yang bermakna pembawa jerat. Yama kerap diidentifikasi dengan Dharmadeva dalam tradisi. Vettam Mani membedakan Yama dan Dharmadeva sebagai dua dewa dengan kisah asal berbeda. Sosok Yama diadaptasi sebagai raja neraka dalam mitologi Buddha dan sejumlah tradisi Asia Timur serta Tibet. Dalam kisah Savitri yang diceritakan Mackenzie, Yama melepaskan Satyavan dan menjanjikan hidup panjang bagi pasangan itu. Britannica 1911 menyebut tiga himne Rigveda ditujukan kepada Yama.
long_description.en: In Vedic tradition he is the first mortal to die and find the path to the abode of the dead. He is described as Yami's twin and the son of Surya and Sanjna. He judges souls and assigns them according to their deeds to the ancestors' realm, Naraka, or rebirth. Yama guards the south as one of the Lokapalas. He is often depicted with dark skin and riding a buffalo. A noose or mace is equipment for capturing souls in his depictions. Yama means twin in one explanation of his name. Pashi is an epithet meaning bearer of a noose. Yama is often identified with Dharmadeva in tradition. Vettam Mani distinguishes Yama and Dharmadeva as two deities with different origin stories. Yama's figure is adapted as king of hell in Buddhist mythology and several East Asian and Tibetan traditions. In the Savitri story retold by Mackenzie, Yama releases Satyavan and promises the couple long life. The 1911 Britannica says three Rigveda hymns are addressed to Yama.

long_description.id: Yamaoroshi adalah yōkai yang digambar dalam Hyakki Tsurezure Bukuro karya Sekien. Kisah belakangan memberi parutan itu tubuh dengan duri menonjol dari kepala. Peneliti menafsirkannya sebagai permainan kata Sekien atas parutan dan landak.
long_description.en: Yamaoroshi is a yōkai illustrated in Sekien’s Hyakki Tsurezure Bukuro. The later account gives the grater a body with spines protruding from its head. Researchers interpret it as Sekien’s pun on a grater and porcupine.

long_description.en: Its design is compared with porcupine-like figures in older scrolls. A later account gives the neglected grater a body and spiny head. The later account identifies oroshi as the Japanese word for grater.

short_description.id: Yaztumşuq adalah canavar berhidung besi dalam kepercayaan rakyat Turk dan Altai. Dalam wujud perempuan ia sangat cantik, tetapi menyembunyikan hidungnya.
short_description.en: Yaztumşuq is an iron-nosed canavar of Turkic and Altaic folk belief. In the guise of a woman it is very beautiful but hides its nose.

long_description.id: Yaztumşuq adalah canavar berhidung besi dalam kepercayaan rakyat Turk dan Altai. Ia juga disebut Castumşuk, dan kamus mitologi Turk mencatatnya sebagai Jastumşuk dengan beberapa padanan nama lain.
long_description.en: Yaztumşuq is an iron-nosed canavar of Turkic and Altaic folk belief. It is also called Castumşuk, and the dictionary of Turkic mythology lists it as Jastumşuk with several equivalent names.

long_description.id: Menurut kamus, hidungnya terbuat dari besi atau tembaga. Dalam wujud perempuan ia sangat cantik tetapi menyembunyikan hidungnya. Di sebagian daerah dikatakan ia berlengan dan berbadan besi, dan artikel pertama menyebut bahwa ia dihubungkan dengan Yaztırnak.
long_description.en: According to the dictionary, its nose is made of iron or copper. In the guise of a woman it is very beautiful but hides its nose. In some regions it is said to have iron arms and body, and the first article says it is thought to be related to Yaztırnak.

long_description.id: Namanya diuraikan dari akar yang bermakna besi, perunggu, dan logam, ditambah kata yang berarti hidung. Kamus menambahkan bahwa kata tumşuk berarti hidung di beberapa dialek, dan kata Tomşık dalam bahasa Tatar berarti paruh.
long_description.en: Its name is explained as a root meaning iron, bronze and metal plus a word meaning nose. The dictionary adds that the word tumşuk means nose in some dialects, and that the Tatar word Tomşık means beak.

literal_meaning.id: Akar yang bermakna besi, perunggu, dan logam, ditambah tumşuq yang berarti hidung; jadi kira-kira hidung logam.
literal_meaning.en: A root meaning iron, bronze and metal plus tumşuq meaning nose; roughly iron nose.

statement.en: The name derives from the root Yaz/Yas/Yaş/Cas/Çaş meaning iron, bronze and metal (dəmir, tunc və metal), while Tumşuq means nose (burun).

claims.quote: JASTUMŞUK: Demir Burunlu Canavar. [ TKA : Jastumşuq ] Eşdeğer: CASTUMŞUK, JAZTUMŞUK, YAZTUMŞUK, YASTUMŞUK, CIZTUMŞUK

statement.id: Kamus mencatat entri Jastumşuk (Demir Burunlu Canavar, monster berhidung besi) dengan padanan nama Castumşuk, Jaztumşuk, Yaztumşuk, Yastumşuk, dan Ciztumşuk.
statement.en: The dictionary has an entry Jastumşuk (Demir Burunlu Canavar, iron-nosed monster) with the equivalent names Castumşuk, Jaztumşuk, Yaztumşuk, Yastumşuk and Ciztumşuk.

claims.quote: Demirden veyâ bakırdan bir burnu vardır. Kadın kılığında olduğunda çok güzeldir fakat burnunu saklar.

statement.id: Hidungnya terbuat dari besi atau tembaga (demirden veyâ bakırdan); dalam wujud perempuan ia sangat cantik tetapi menyembunyikan hidungnya (burnunu saklar).
statement.en: Its nose is of iron or copper (demirden veyâ bakırdan); in the guise of a woman it is very beautiful but hides its nose (burnunu saklar).

claims.quote: Bazı yörelerde demir kollu, demir gövdeli olduğu da söylenir.

statement.id: Di sebagian daerah dikatakan pula bahwa ia berlengan besi dan berbadan besi (demir kollu, demir gövdeli).
statement.en: In some regions it is also said to have iron arms and an iron body (demir kollu, demir gövdeli).

claims.quote: sözcüğü kimi lehçelerde burun anlamına geir. Tatarca'da Tomşık kelimesi gaga mânâsı taşır.

statement.id: Kata Tumşuk di beberapa dialek bermakna hidung (burun), dan dalam bahasa Tatar (Tatarca) kata Tomşık bermakna paruh (gaga).
statement.en: The word Tumşuk means nose (burun) in some dialects, and in Tatar (Tatarca) the word Tomşık means beak (gaga).

short_description.id: Zezengorri adalah roh gua dalam mitologi Basque yang keluar berwujud banteng merah dan menjaga gua serta harta.
short_description.en: Zezengorri is a cave spirit of Basque mythology that emerges as a red bull and guards caves and treasure.

long_description.id: Zezengorri, "banteng merah", adalah roh mitologi Basque yang tinggal di gua dan keluar berwujud banteng merah; di beberapa daerah ia sapi betina merah bernama Behigorri. Banteng-banteng gua ini umumnya agresif dan menyerang atau menghalangi orang masuk. Seekor banteng api menjaga gua-gua Mari di Austokieta, dan banteng merah penyembur api menjaga harta di gua Atxulaur.
long_description.en: Zezengorri, "red bull", is a Basque spirit living in caves that emerges as a red bull; in some areas it is a red cow called Behigorri. These cave bulls are mostly aggressive, attacking people or barring their way. A fire bull guards the caves of Mari at Austokieta, and a fire-breathing red bull guards treasure in the cave of Atxulaur.

long_description.id: Penelitian baru mengaitkan Zezengorri dan makhluk serupa dengan gua-gua yang memiliki gambar hewan yang sama dari zaman Paleolitik.
long_description.en: Recent studies link Zezengorri and similar beings to caves with Palaeolithic images of the same animals.

who.en: A red-bull cave spirit.

role.en: Guards caves and treasure.

note.en: A fire bull guards her caves.

note.id: Makhluk sejenis yang dikaitkan dengan gambar Paleolitik.
note.en: A related being linked to Palaeolithic images.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Basque, Zezengorri ("banteng merah", dari zezen "banteng" dan gorri "merah") adalah roh yang tinggal di gua atau rongga bawah tanah dan berwujud banteng merah saat keluar.
statement.en: In Basque mythology Zezengorri ('red bull', from zezen 'bull' and gorri 'red') is a spirit living in caves or underground cavities that takes the form of a red bull when it comes out.

claims.quote: Segons la zona o la llegenda, en comptes d'un toro és una vaca vermella i aleshores se l'anomena Behigorri (behi és 'vaca' en basc).

statement.en: In some areas or legends it is a red cow instead, called Behigorri.

statement.id: Banteng-banteng gua dalam mitologi Basque umumnya agresif, dapat menyerang dan menakuti orang di gua atau melarang mereka masuk.
statement.en: The cave bulls of Basque mythology are mostly aggressive and may attack and frighten people in the cave or refuse them entry.

claims.quote: Un toro de foc (o d'or, segons les variants) habita la cova d'Austokieta, a la muntanya d'Oxabi (Lizartza) i és el guardià de les coves de Mari.

statement.id: Seekor banteng api (atau emas) tinggal di gua Austokieta di gunung Oxabi, Lizartza, dan menjaga gua-gua Mari.
statement.en: A fire bull (or gold, in some versions) lives in the cave of Austokieta on Mount Oxabi (Lizartza) and guards the caves of Mari.

claims.quote: Un toro vermell que treu foc per la boca i el musell guarda un tresor a la cova d'Atxulaur (prop d'Orozko ).

statement.id: Seekor banteng merah yang menyemburkan api dari mulut dan moncongnya menjaga harta di gua Atxulaur dekat Orozko.
statement.en: A red bull breathing fire from its mouth and muzzle guards a treasure in the cave of Atxulaur near Orozko.

claims.quote: Estudis recents han demostrat que tant Zezengorri, Behigorri i Aatxe com altres entitats mitològiques (Ihizi, els laminak), s'associen amb llocs on aquests mateixos animals van ser representats pels homes del Paleolític.

statement.id: Penelitian baru menunjukkan Zezengorri, Behigorri, Aatxe, dan makhluk lain dikaitkan dengan tempat-tempat yang memiliki gambar hewan yang sama dari manusia Paleolitik.
statement.en: Recent studies show that Zezengorri, Behigorri, Aatxe and other beings are linked to places where Palaeolithic people depicted those same animals.

short_description.id: Abyzou adalah setan perempuan dalam tradisi Timur Dekat dan Eropa yang dikaitkan dengan keguguran dan kematian bayi.
short_description.en: Abyzou is a female demon in Near Eastern and European traditions associated with miscarriage and infant death.

long_description.id: Abyzou adalah setan perempuan dalam tradisi Timur Dekat dan Eropa yang dikaitkan dengan keguguran dan kematian bayi. Nama Alabasandria dalam tradisi Koptik dan Gylou dalam tradisi Bizantium dihubungkan dengan Abyzou.
long_description.en: Abyzou is a female demon in Near Eastern and European traditions associated with miscarriage and infant death. Coptic tradition links her with Alabasandria, while Byzantine tradition associates her with Gylou.

long_description.id: Penggambaran sastra lengkapnya terdapat dalam Testament of Solomon. Jimat menggambarkannya dengan unsur ikan atau ular. Testament of Solomon mengisahkan Solomon membelenggu rambutnya dan memajangnya di depan kuil. Obizuth dalam terjemahan Testament of Solomon berkata ia berkeliling pada malam hari dan menyerang anak yang baru lahir.
long_description.en: Her fuller literary depiction occurs in the Testament of Solomon. Amulets depict her with fishlike or serpentine attributes. The Testament of Solomon tells of Solomon binding her hair and displaying her before the temple. Obizuth in the translated Testament of Solomon says she roams at night and attacks newborn children.

short_description.id: Ahura Mazda adalah ilahi tertinggi dalam Zoroastrianism, dipandang sebagai pencipta yang bijak dan pemelihara tatanan kebenaran.
short_description.en: Ahura Mazda is the supreme divinity of Zoroastrianism, regarded as a wise creator and sustainer of truth and order.

long_description.id: Ahura Mazda berasal dari agama Old Iranian dan ditempatkan oleh Zoroaster sebagai God. Penafsiran nama Mazdā sebagai 'kebijaksanaan' atau 'bijak' masih diperdebatkan; Ahura berarti tuan. Tradisi Zoroastrianism menghubungkannya dengan aša, tatanan dan kebenaran kosmis, serta keadilan.
long_description.en: Ahura Mazda comes from ancient Iranian religion and was elevated by Zoroaster as God. Scholars debate whether Mazdā means 'wisdom' or 'wise', while Ahura means lord. Sources on Zoroastrianism link him to aša, cosmic truth and order, and to justice.

long_description.id: Dalam uraian Zoroaster yang dibahas Kajian ini, Ahura Mazda tidak diciptakan dan memunculkan enam wujud agung. Manusia diberi pilihan moral; kejahatan berasal dari sumber selain Ahura Mazda. Uraian akademik itu juga mengingatkan bahwa gagasan Zoroaster tentang kuasanya tidak sama dengan konsep kemahakuasaan yang berkembang kemudian.
long_description.en: In the account of Zoroaster discussed by an academic source, Ahura Mazda is uncreated and emanates six great beings. Humans have moral choice, while evil has a source other than Ahura Mazda. Zoroaster did not conceive of Ahura Mazda as omnipotent.

long_description.id: Prasasti Darius menyebut Ahuramazda sebagai pencipta bumi, langit, manusia, dan kebahagiaan, serta sumber legitimasi kerajaan dan perlindungan. Bentuk nama Ahuramazda, Hormazd, dan Ohrmazd berubah menurut periode. Kajian ini menyatakan belum ada penggambaran Ahuramazda yang tercatat dari masa Achaemenid awal.
long_description.en: Darius's inscription calls Ahuramazda creator of earth, sky, people, and happiness, as well as the source of royal legitimacy and protection. The forms Ahuramazda, Hormazd, and Ohrmazd vary by period. An academic source says no depiction of Ahuramazda is recorded for the early Achaemenid period.

short_description.id: Ajina adalah tokoh iblis dalam mitologi bangsa Asia Tengah, terutama Uzbek dan Turkmen, yang tinggal di tempat sepi dan dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak.
short_description.en: Ajina is a demonic figure of Central Asian, especially Uzbek and Turkmen, mythology that haunts lonely places and is used to frighten children.

long_description.id: Ajina adalah tokoh iblis dalam mitologi Turkik bangsa Asia Tengah, terutama Uzbek dan Turkmen, dan sebagian Tajik, yang dipandang lahir dari kepercayaan animistik tentang roh jahat. Ia tinggal di tempat sepi dan terbengkalai, rumah runtuh, hutan lebat, serta padang dan stepa kosong, dan lazim dipakai untuk menakut-nakuti anak yang tidak patuh.
long_description.en: Ajina is a demonic figure in the Turkic mythology of Central Asian peoples, especially Uzbeks and Turkmens and partly Tajiks, seen as born of animistic belief in evil spirits. It lives in lonely, abandoned places, ruined houses, dense forests and empty steppes, and is commonly used to scare disobedient children.

long_description.id: Wujudnya berbeda menurut daerah: makhluk mirip manusia yang menakutkan, gadis atau bayi menyeramkan, nenek berambut panjang, atau kambing bertanduk bermata merah. Namanya diturunkan dari kata Persia janin, "embrio", atau dari kata Arab jinn.
long_description.en: Its form varies by region: a frightening humanlike being, a terrifying maiden or infant, a long-haired old woman, or a horned red-eyed goat. Its name is derived from Persian janin, "embryo", or from Arabic jinn.

short_description.id: Akagashira adalah yōkai Jepang yang diilustrasikan dalam gulungan monster.
short_description.en: Akagashira is a Japanese yōkai illustrated in monster scrolls.

long_description.id: Akagashira adalah yōkai Jepang yang diilustrasikan dalam gulungan monster. Hyakki Yagyō Emaki koleksi Matsui menggambarkan rambut merah dan hidung atau tanduk merah. Gulungan tidak menjelaskan tindakan makhluk ini.
long_description.en: Akagashira is a Japanese yōkai illustrated in monster scrolls. The Matsui collection’s Hyakki Yagyō Emaki depicts red hair and a red nose or horns. The scroll does not explain what this creature does.

long_description.id: Hubungannya dengan roh Shikoku yang sama-sama berambut merah tetap tidak pasti. Meyer menggambarkannya bertubuh gempal, berlengan panjang, berkaki pendek, dan berkulit abu-abu. Meyer mengidentifikasi gulungannya sebagai karya Oda Gōchō tahun 1832.
long_description.en: Connections with similarly red-haired Shikoku spirits remain uncertain. Meyer describes it as stocky, long-armed, short-legged and gray-skinned. Meyer identifies its scroll as Oda Gōchō’s work of 1832.

claims.quote: 真っ赤な髪の毛、顔に赤い鼻か角のようなものの生えた姿で熊本県八代市の松井文庫所蔵品である妖怪絵巻『百鬼夜行絵巻』に描かれている。

statement.id: Hyakki Yagyō Emaki koleksi Matsui menggambarkan rambut merah dan hidung atau tanduk merah.
statement.en: The Matsui collection’s Hyakki Yagyō Emaki depicts red hair and a red nose or horns.

claims.quote: Akagashira exists in picture form only, so nothing is known about what it supposedly does.

statement.id: Gulungan tidak menjelaskan tindakan makhluk ini.
statement.en: The scroll does not explain what this creature does.

claims.quote: 四国に分布する赤シャグマや、高知県吾川郡生賀瀬（現・いの町）の「赤頭」（あかがしら）など、民間伝承にある妖怪たちの中に「赤い髪をしている」とされ特徴も似ているものがあるが、絵巻物に描かれた「赤がしら」がそれを意図して描かれたものであるかどうかは類例も乏しく未詳である。

statement.id: Hubungannya dengan roh Shikoku yang sama-sama berambut merah tetap tidak pasti.
statement.en: Connections with similarly red-haired Shikoku spirits remain uncertain.

claims.quote: Akagashira is a squat yōkai with long arms, short legs, and grayish skin.

statement.id: Meyer menggambarkannya bertubuh gempal, berlengan panjang, berkaki pendek, dan berkulit abu-abu.
statement.en: Meyer describes it as stocky, long-armed, short-legged and gray-skinned.

claims.quote: Akagashira appears in Hyakki yagyō emaki , a yokai picture scroll painted in Tenpō 3 (1832) by Oda Gōchō.

statement.id: Meyer mengidentifikasi gulungannya sebagai karya Oda Gōchō tahun 1832.
statement.en: Meyer identifies its scroll as Oda Gōchō’s work of 1832.

short_description.id: Amabiko adalah yōkai peramal yang konon muncul dari laut dalam kisah Jepang.
short_description.en: Amabiko is a prophetic yōkai said to emerge from the sea in Japanese accounts.

long_description.id: Amabiko adalah yōkai peramal yang konon muncul dari laut dalam kisah Jepang. Teks akhir Edo dan Meiji menyebarkan gambarnya bersama laporan tertulis. Kisah meramalkan panen, wabah, dan perlindungan melalui penyalinan gambarnya.
long_description.en: Amabiko is a prophetic yōkai said to emerge from the sea in Japanese accounts. Late Edo and Meiji texts circulate its image together with written reports. Accounts predict harvests, epidemics and protection through copying its image.

long_description.id: Ilustrasinya umumnya berambut, berwajah mirip kera, dan berkaki tiga atau empat. Kisah belakangan meramalkan panen berlimpah yang disusul bencana dan penyakit. Uraian belakangan menyebut surat kabar menyebarkan gambar sebagai jimat pelindung rumah.
long_description.en: Its illustrations commonly have hair, ape-like features and three or four legs. A later account predicts abundant harvests followed by disaster and disease. The later account describes newspapers circulating images as household protective charms.

claims.quote: アマビコ（海彦、天彦、天日子、尼彦、あま彦、雨彦）、または天彦入道・尼彦入道（あまびこにゅうどう）は、肥後国熊本ほか各地に伝わる妖怪。海中などから出現をして吉凶にまつわる予言めいたことを言い残したとされる。

statement.id: Amabiko adalah yōkai peramal yang konon muncul dari laut dalam kisah Jepang.
statement.en: Amabiko is a prophetic yōkai said to emerge from the sea in Japanese accounts.

claims.quote: アマビコは、江戸時代後期から明治中期にかけての資料や新聞記事などで確認されている妖怪で、絵と文がいっしょに書かれた形式で人々の間に広まった噂話・風説として記録されたり、根拠不明あるいは時代遅れの迷信として報道されている。

statement.id: Teks akhir Edo dan Meiji menyebarkan gambarnya bersama laporan tertulis.
statement.en: Late Edo and Meiji texts circulate its image together with written reports.

claims.quote: その内容の多くは、異様な生物（3本足など）のような絵と、絵に示された存在が人間の言葉で「自分の名前」や「人間の大多数が死に絶えること」あるいは「豊作や疫病が発生すること」そして「自分の姿をかきしるした者は難をのがれることが出来ること」を告げて去ったということを記載している。

statement.id: Kisah meramalkan panen, wabah, dan perlindungan melalui penyalinan gambarnya.
statement.en: Accounts predict harvests, epidemics and protection through copying its image.

claims.quote: 外見は、ほとんどが体毛におおわれた（顔が無毛、坊主頭の例あり）三本足か四足動物のようで、容貌は猿似か等とされる。

claims.quote: It foretells a period of bountiful harvest, followed by a period of disaster and disease.

short_description.id: Amenotokotachi adalah salah satu dewa langit awal dalam mitologi Jepang.
short_description.en: Amenotokotachi is one of the primordial heavenly deities in Japanese mythology.

long_description.id: Amenotokotachi adalah salah satu dewa langit awal dalam mitologi Jepang. Kojiki menempatkan dewa ini terakhir di antara lima dewa langit pertama. Narasi awal menggambarkan Amenotokotachi sebagai dewa tunggal.
long_description.en: Amenotokotachi is one of the primordial heavenly deities in Japanese mythology. The Kojiki places this deity last among the first five heavenly deities. The early narrative describes Amenotokotachi as a solitary deity.

long_description.id: Narasi tersebut menyebut dewa itu menyembunyikan tubuhnya. Dewa itu muncul dalam versi alternatif Nihon Shoki, bukan kisah utamanya. Versi tersebut menempatkan dewa itu sebelum Umashiashikabihikoji dan Kuninotokotachi.
long_description.en: That narrative says the deity hid its body. The deity appears in a Nihon Shoki variant rather than its main account. That variant places the deity before Umashiashikabihikoji and Kuninotokotachi.

claims.quote: 天之常立神（アメノトコタチ）は、日本神話に登場する神。別天津神のうちの一柱である。

statement.id: Amenotokotachi adalah salah satu dewa langit awal dalam mitologi Jepang.
statement.en: Amenotokotachi is one of the primordial heavenly deities in Japanese mythology.

claims.quote: 天地開闢の際、別天津神五柱の最後に現れた神である。独神であり、現れてすぐに身を隠した。

statement.id: Kojiki menempatkan dewa ini terakhir di antara lima dewa langit pertama.
statement.en: The Kojiki places this deity last among the first five heavenly deities.

claims.quote: Next Ame no tokotachi no kami 天之常立神 (9) [appeared]. These two deities also came into existence as solitary deities and hid their bodies.

short_description.id: Antaboga adalah dewa ular dalam tradisi Jawa dan Sunda yang juga hadir dalam kisah wayang Jawa.
short_description.en: Antaboga is a serpent deity of Javanese and Sundanese traditions who also appears in Javanese wayang tales.

long_description.id: Antaboga dikenal sebagai dewa ular dalam tradisi Jawa dan Sunda. Dalam kisah wayang Jawa, ia disebut pula Anantaboga dan digambarkan berwujud ular.
long_description.en: Antaboga is known as a serpent deity in Javanese and Sundanese traditions. Javanese wayang tales also call him Anantaboga and portray him as a snake.

long_description.id: Kisah wayang menempatkan Antaboga di kahyangan Saptapratala. Aji Kamayan miliknya dikisahkan memungkinkan ia berubah menjadi manusia. Ia juga disebut kerap membantu Pandawa.
long_description.en: Wayang narratives place Antaboga in Saptapratala. His Aji Kamayan is said to let him take human form. He is also described as often helping the Pandawa.

description.id: Aji Kamayan memungkinkan Antaboga berubah menjadi manusia.
description.en: Aji Kamayan enables Antaboga to become a human.

claims.quote: is a serpent deity in Javanism and Sundanism (later also adopted in Balinese Hinduism).

statement.id: Antaboga adalah dewa ular dalam tradisi Jawa dan Sunda.
statement.en: Antaboga is a serpent deity in Javanese and Sundanese traditions.

claims.quote: Description in the Javanese wayang retellings: Sometimes known as Anantaboga.

short_description.id: Anuket adalah dewi Mesir bagi katarak Nil dan Nubia Hilir.
short_description.en: Anuket is an Egyptian goddess of the Nile cataracts and Lower Nubia.

long_description.id: Anuket adalah dewi Mesir bagi katarak Nil dan Nubia Hilir. Ia terutama dipuja di Elephantine dekat katarak pertama. Namanya berarti pemeluk atau perengkuh.
long_description.en: Anuket is an Egyptian goddess of the Nile cataracts and Lower Nubia. She is especially worshipped at Elephantine near the First Cataract. Her name means Clasper or Embracer.

long_description.id: Dalam interpretasi Yunani ia disetarakan dengan Hestia atau Vesta. Salah satu hubungan awal menempatkannya sebagai putri Ra. Ia melindungi perbatasan selatan Mesir dan berhubungan dengan banjir Nil. Hubungannya dengan arus cepat turut menghubungkannya dengan papirus. Ia membentuk triad bersama Khnum dan Satis.
long_description.en: In Greek interpretation she is equated with Hestia or Vesta. One early association makes her a daughter of Ra. She protects Egypt’s southern border and is connected with the Nile flood. Her association with swift water also connects her with papyrus. She forms a triad with Khnum and Satis.

long_description.id: Kuilnya dibangun di Pulau Seheil. Kultus Elephantine mencakup prosesi sungai pada awal Shemu. Sumber sejarah pendamping menghubungkan Anuket dengan kesuburan dan katarak Aswan. Terjemahan Budge menempatkan Anqet dalam daftar dewa Rumah Ilahi Khnum. Festival Anuket dimulai saat banjir tahunan Nil. Peserta mempersembahkan koin, emas, perhiasan, dan hadiah ke sungai. Larangan memakan ikan tertentu dicabut saat festivalnya.
long_description.en: Her temple is built on Seheil Island. The Elephantine cult includes a river procession at the start of Shemu. The accompanying historical source connects Anuket with fertility and the Aswan cataract. Budge’s translation places Anqet in the list of gods of Khnum’s Divine House. Anuket’s festival begins with the annual Nile flood. Participants offer coins, gold, jewellery and gifts to the river. The taboo on eating certain fish is lifted during her festival.

cultural_context.id: Larangan memakan ikan tertentu dicabut saat festivalnya.
cultural_context.en: The taboo on eating certain fish is lifted during her festival.

note.id: Ia membentuk triad bersama Khnum dan Satis.
note.en: She forms a triad with Khnum and Satis.

claims.quote: Her name meant the "Clasper" or "Embracer".

statement.id: Namanya berarti pemeluk atau perengkuh.

claims.quote: Anuket was the goddess of the Nile flood and a protective goddess of the southern border of Egypt. Her posing with her arms outstretched may have been a visual reference to the shape of the Nile, with its two tributaries, and influenced her being called "the Embracer".

statement.id: Ia melindungi perbatasan selatan Mesir dan berhubungan dengan banjir Nil.
statement.en: She protects Egypt’s southern border and is connected with the Nile flood.

claims.quote: She was associated with swift moving water, and this was the reason for her association with papyruses.

statement.en: Her association with swift water also connects her with papyrus.

claims.quote: A temple dedicated to Anuket was erected on the Island of Seheil. Inscriptions show that a shrine or altar was dedicated to her at this site by the 13th Dynasty pharaoh Sobekhotep III. Much later, during the 18th Dynasty, Amenhotep II dedicated a chapel to the goddess.

short_description.id: Ardhanarisvara adalah bentuk Shiva yang menyatu dengan Parvati.
short_description.en: Ardhanarishvara is a form of Shiva united with Parvati.

long_description.id: Ardhanarisvara adalah bentuk Shiva yang menyatu dengan Parvati. Wujudnya dibagi sama rata menjadi setengah laki-laki dan setengah perempuan.
long_description.en: Ardhanarishvara is a form of Shiva united with Parvati. The form is divided equally into half male and half female.

long_description.id: Ia melambangkan penyatuan energi maskulin dan feminin atau Purusha dan Prakriti. Bagian kanan biasanya Shiva laki-laki. Penggambaran awal berasal dari periode Kushan dan berkembang pada era Gupta. Nama Ardhanarisvara berarti Tuhan yang setengah perempuan. Deskripsi Cleveland tentang Ardhanarisvara memperlihatkan sisi kiri perempuan dan sisi kanan laki-laki.
long_description.en: It symbolizes the union of masculine and feminine energies or Purusha and Prakriti. The right half is usually male Shiva. Early depictions date to the Kushan period and develop in the Gupta era. The name Ardhanarishvara means the Lord who is half woman. Cleveland's description of Ardhanarishvara shows the left side female and the right side male.

note.en: Male component of the composite form.
Female component of the composite form.

sources.title: Trident with Shiva as Half-Woman (Ardhanarishvara) | Cleveland Museum of Art

The union of these principles is exalted as the root and womb of all creation.

short_description.id: Árvakr ("bangun pagi") adalah salah satu dari dua kuda dalam mitologi Nordik, bersama Alsviðr, yang setiap hari menarik kereta matahari Sól melintasi langit.
short_description.en: Árvakr ('early awake') is one of the two horses of Norse mythology, together with Alsviðr, that pull Sól's sun chariot across the sky each day.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Árvakr ("bangun pagi") dan Alsviðr ("sangat cepat") adalah kuda-kuda yang setiap hari menarik matahari, atau kereta Sól, melintasi langit. Keduanya disebut dalam Gylfaginning dan Grímnismál, dan nama mereka kerap dikaitkan dengan gambaran matahari.
long_description.en: In Norse mythology Árvakr ('early awake') and Alsviðr ('very quick') are the horses that draw the sun, or Sól's chariot, across the sky every day. Both appear in Gylfaginning and Grímnismál, and their names are often linked with descriptions of the Sun.

long_description.id: Menurut mitosnya, para dewa membentuk matahari dari percikan api Muspelheim, tetapi matahari diam tanpa pengemudi, maka Sól diculik untuk mengemudikannya dalam kereta yang ditarik dua kuda. Untuk melindungi kuda-kuda itu dari panas matahari yang luar biasa, para dewa memasang dua puputan (ísarnkol, "besi dingin") di bawah bahu mereka. Sól tak boleh berhenti, sebab serigala Sköll akan menangkap dan menelan matahari, seperti yang diperkirakan terjadi pada hari Ragnarök.
long_description.en: According to the myth, the gods shaped the Sun from a spark of Muspelheim's flame, but it stood still without a driver, so Sól was abducted to drive it in a chariot drawn by two horses. To shield the horses from the Sun's tremendous heat, the gods set two bellows (ísarnkol, 'cold iron') beneath their shoulders. Sól cannot stop, for the wolf Sköll would catch and swallow the Sun, as is expected to happen on the day of Ragnarök.

long_description.id: Motif matahari yang ditarik kuda tidak khas Nordik atau Jermanik; banyak mitologi lain memiliki dewa matahari atau kereta matahari yang ditarik kuda. Mitos Árvakr dan Alsviðr diduga mengilhami lakon The Triumph of Peace (1663) karya dramawan Inggris James Shirley.
long_description.en: The motif of a horse-drawn sun is not unique to Norse or Germanic religion; many other mythologies have a sun god or sun chariot drawn by horses. English playwright James Shirley's The Triumph of Peace (1663) may have drawn on the story of these two horses.

who.en: A horse that pulls the sun.

role.en: Cooled by bellows under its shoulders.

famous_for.id: Berlari dikejar serigala Sköll.
famous_for.en: Runs ahead of the wolf Sköll.

did_you_know.id: Para dewa Nordik konon memasang puputan berisi "besi dingin" di bawah bahu Árvakr dan Alsviðr agar kedua kuda itu tidak kepanasan oleh matahari.
did_you_know.en: The Norse gods were said to fit bellows of 'cold iron' under the shoulders of Árvakr and Alsviðr so the horses would not overheat from the sun.

note.id: Kuda kedua yang menarik kereta matahari bersama Árvakr.
note.en: The second horse pulling the sun chariot with Árvakr.

note.id: Pengemudi kereta matahari yang ditarik Árvakr.
note.en: Driver of the sun chariot Árvakr pulls.

claims.quote: In Norse mythology, Árvakr (Old Norse "early awake") and Alsviðr ("very quick") are the horses which pull the sun, or Sól's chariot, across the sky each day.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Árvakr (Nordik Kuno, "bangun pagi") dan Alsviðr ("sangat cepat") adalah kuda-kuda yang setiap hari menarik matahari, atau kereta Sól, melintasi langit.
statement.en: In Norse mythology Árvakr (Old Norse 'early awake') and Alsviðr ('very quick') are the horses that pull the sun, or Sól's chariot, across the sky each day.

claims.quote: Both horses are mentioned in Gylfaginning and Grímnismál and their names are frequently associated with descriptions of the Sun.

statement.id: Kedua kuda disebut dalam Gylfaginning dan Grímnismál, dan nama mereka sering dikaitkan dengan gambaran Matahari (Sun).
statement.en: Both horses are named in Gylfaginning and Grímnismál, and their names often go with descriptions of the Sun.

claims.quote: Sól is kidnapped by the gods to drive the Sun in a chariot pulled by two horses. Two large bellows (ísarnkol; cold iron) were placed under the shoulders of the two horses to protect them from the immense heat of the Sun.

statement.id: Sól diculik para dewa untuk mengemudikan Matahari (Sun) dalam kereta yang ditarik dua kuda; dua puputan besar (ísarnkol, "besi dingin") dipasang di bawah bahu kedua kuda untuk melindunginya dari panas Matahari.
statement.en: Sól is abducted by the gods to drive the Sun in a chariot drawn by two horses; two large bellows (ísarnkol, 'cold iron') were set under the horses' shoulders against the Sun's immense heat.

claims.quote: Sól is unable to stop driving the chariot or else Sköll will catch the Sun and devour it; the Sun is expected to be caught and devoured on the day of Ragnarök.

statement.id: Sól tak bisa berhenti mengemudikan kereta, sebab Sköll akan menangkap dan menelan Matahari; hal itu diperkirakan terjadi pada hari Ragnarök.
statement.en: Sól cannot stop driving, else Sköll will catch and devour the Sun; this is expected on the day of Ragnarök.

claims.quote: The myth of Árvakr and Alsviðr is thought to have inspired English dramatist and poet James Shirley's play The Triumph of Peace (1663).

statement.id: Mitos Árvakr dan Alsviðr diduga mengilhami lakon The Triumph of Peace (1663) karya dramawan dan penyair Inggris (English) James Shirley.
statement.en: The myth of Árvakr and Alsviðr is thought to have inspired English dramatist James Shirley's play The Triumph of Peace (1663).

statement.id: Årvången (Árvakr) dalam mitologi Nordik (nordisk) adalah salah satu dari dua kuda yang menarik matahari melintasi langit.
statement.en: Årvången (Árvakr) in Norse (nordisk) mythology is one of the two horses pulling the sun across the sky.

claims.quote: In Nordic mythology, gods govern the passage of days, nights, and seasons, and shape the Sun from a spark of the flame Muspelheim, but the Sun stands still without a driver.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, para dewa mengatur peredaran siang, malam, dan musim, serta membentuk Matahari dari percikan api Muspelheim, tetapi Matahari diam tanpa pengemudi.
statement.en: In Nordic mythology the gods govern days, nights and seasons and shape the Sun from a spark of Muspelheim's flame, but the Sun stands still without a driver.

claims.quote: The myth of the Sun pulled by horses is not exclusive to Norse or Germanic religion. Many other mythologies and religions contain a solar deity or carriage of the Sun pulled by horses.

statement.id: Mitos Matahari yang ditarik kuda tidak khas agama Nordik atau Jermanik; banyak mitologi dan agama lain memiliki dewa matahari atau kereta Matahari yang ditarik kuda.
statement.en: The horse-drawn Sun myth is not exclusive to Norse or Germanic religion; many other mythologies have a solar deity or Sun chariot drawn by horses.

short_description.en: Ashur, or Assur, is the supreme Assyrian deity.

long_description.id: Ashur atau Assur adalah dewa tertinggi Asyur. Ashur berasal sebagai dewa lokal kota Ashur.
long_description.en: Ashur, or Assur, is the supreme Assyrian deity. Ashur originates as the local deity of the city bearing his name.

long_description.id: Ashur adalah dewa langit dan perang bergelar Penguasa Seluruh Langit. Raja Asyur menyerukan Ashur sebagai sekutu yang kuat. Penggambarannya mencakup pemanah berjubah bulu yang menaiki ular atau naga. Mackenzie menyebut Ashur kadang dipuja dalam kuil dewa-dewa lain.
long_description.en: Ashur governs the sky and war, with the title Lord of the Whole Heavens. Assyrian kings invoke Ashur as a powerful ally. His depictions include a feather-robed archer riding a serpent or dragon. Mackenzie notes Ashur sometimes being worshipped in other gods’ temples.

short_description.id: Atum adalah dewa primordial Mesir yang menjadi asal segala sesuatu.
short_description.en: Atum is an Egyptian primordial god from whom everything arises.

long_description.id: Atum adalah dewa primordial Mesir yang menjadi asal segala sesuatu. Ia menciptakan dirinya sendiri. Ia adalah ayah Shu dan Tefnut.
long_description.en: Atum is an Egyptian primordial god from whom everything arises. He creates himself. He is the father of Shu and Tefnut.

long_description.id: Atum erat terkait matahari senja. Namanya dikaitkan dengan kata kerja yang berarti melengkapi atau menyelesaikan. Teks Piramida memadukannya dengan Ra sebagai Ra-Atum. Teologi Memphis mengisahkan Ptah menciptakan Atum melalui pikiran dan ucapan. Dalam kosmogoni Heliopolis ia muncul dari air primordial pada benben.
long_description.en: Atum is closely associated with the evening sun. His name is connected with a verb meaning to complete or finish. The Pyramid Texts combine him with Ra as Ra-Atum. Memphite theology tells of Ptah creating Atum through thought and speech. In Heliopolitan cosmogony he emerges from primordial waters on the benben mound.

long_description.id: Ia dipercaya mengangkat jiwa raja dari piramida ke langit berbintang. Teks Peti Mati menggambarkan Atum dan Osiris bertahan sebagai ular pada akhir alam semesta. Sumber ini menempatkan Atum sebagai dewa pertama Ennead. Ia memakai daya magis Heka dalam penciptaan. Ia juga disebut pencipta umat manusia. Budge membedakan Atum sebagai penutup hari dari Ptah sebagai pembuka hari. Budge menyatakan bentuk manusia Atum dikenal pada masa raja Dinasti Kelima.
long_description.en: He is believed to lift a king’s soul from his pyramid to the starry heavens. The Coffin Texts depict Atum and Osiris surviving as serpents at the universe’s end. This source places Atum as the first god of the Ennead. He uses Heka’s magical power in creation. He is also described as creator of humankind. Budge distinguishes Atum as closer of the day from Ptah as opener of the day. Budge states that Atum’s human form was known under Fifth-Dynasty kings.

cultural_context.id: Budge menyatakan bentuk manusia Atum dikenal pada masa raja Dinasti Kelima.
cultural_context.en: Budge states that Atum’s human form was known under Fifth-Dynasty kings.

note.en: He is the father of Shu and Tefnut.

note.en: He is the father of Shu and Tefnut.

claims.quote: Atum's name is thought to be derived from the verb tm which means 'to complete' or 'to finish'. Thus, he has been interpreted as being the "complete one" and also the finisher of the world, which he returns to watery chaos at the end of the creative cycle. As creator, he was seen as the progenitor of the world, the deities and universe having received his vital force or ka.

statement.en: His name is connected with a verb meaning to complete or finish.

statement.en: The Pyramid Texts combine him with Ra as Ra-Atum.

claims.quote: The Memphites (priests of Memphis), on the other hand, believed that Ptah created Atum in a more intellectual way, using his speech and thought, as told on the Shabaka Stone.

statement.id: Teologi Memphis mengisahkan Ptah menciptakan Atum melalui pikiran dan ucapan.
statement.en: Memphite theology tells of Ptah creating Atum through thought and speech.

claims.quote: In the Heliopolitan Cosmogony, Atum was considered to be the first god, having created himself, sitting on a mound (benben) (or identified with the mound itself), and rose from the primordial waters (Nu). Early myths state that Atum created the god Shu and goddess Tefnut by spitting them out of his mouth.

statement.en: In Heliopolitan cosmogony he emerges from primordial waters on the benben mound.

claims.quote: In the Old Kingdom, the Egyptians believed that Atum lifted the dead king's soul from his pyramid to the starry heavens. He was also a solar deity, associated with the primary sun god Ra. Atum was linked specifically with the evening sun, while Ra or the closely linked god Khepri were connected with the sun at morning and midday.

statement.id: Ia dipercaya mengangkat jiwa raja dari piramida ke langit berbintang.
statement.en: He is believed to lift a king’s soul from his pyramid to the starry heavens.

claims.quote: after millions of years he and Osiris would be the only ones to survive the end of time as serpents.

statement.en: The Coffin Texts depict Atum and Osiris surviving as serpents at the universe’s end.

claims.quote: first god of the Ennead (tribunal of nine gods)

short_description.id: Azıktı adalah jin jalan penipu dalam kepercayaan Turk dan Altai yang menyamar sebagai orang dekat dan menyesatkan pengelana hingga mati.
short_description.en: Azıktı is a deceiving road jinn in Turk and Altai belief that disguises itself as someone close and leads travellers astray to their death.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan rakyat Turk dan Altai, Azıktı adalah jin tersesat atau jin jalan (kayıp cini, yol cini). Artikel pertama menyebutnya makhluk jahat dalam kepercayaan Kırgız dan Özbek sebelum Islam, sedangkan sumber kedua menyebutnya makhluk penipu yang dalam kepercayaan Asia sebelum Islam dipandang sebagai wujud setan.
long_description.en: In Turk and Altai folk belief, Azıktı is a lost jinn or road jinn (kayıp cini, yol cini). The first article calls it a demonic being in the pre-Islamic beliefs of the Kırgız and Özbek, while the second source calls it a deceiving creature seen as demonic in pre-Islamic Asian beliefs.

long_description.id: Makhluk ini dapat menyamar dalam rupa apa pun, termasuk orang yang paling dekat dengan korban. Ia memanggil pengelana yang berjalan sendirian dengan suara orang yang dikenalnya; bila yang mendengar menoleh ke belakang, ia membawanya pergi dan menghilangkannya.
long_description.en: It can take any disguise, including that of the person closest to its victim. It calls out to a lone traveller in the voice of someone he knows; if the listener looks back, it takes him away and makes him lost.

long_description.id: Dengan menyesatkan orang, ia menuntunnya ke gunung, jurang, atau sungai dan menjatuhkannya hingga mati. Di sumber kedua, nama Azıktı dicantumkan bersama Azıtkı dan Azatkı sebagai padanan nama Azmıç. Artikel pertama juga mencatat bahwa kata Eski Moğolca Ad/Ada dan Eski Türkçe Ada/Aza menyatakan bahaya (tehlike).
long_description.en: By leading people astray it takes them to a mountain, precipice or river and makes them fall to their death. In the second source, the name Azıktı is listed together with Azıtkı and Azatkı as synonyms of Azmıç. The first article also notes that the Eski Moğolca words Ad/Ada and Eski Türkçe Ada/Aza express danger (tehlike).

literal_meaning.id: Akar kata (Az/Aş) berarti yang menyesatkan jalan atau yang meninggalkan lalu kabur, yaitu yang menyimpangkan orang dari jalan.
literal_meaning.en: The root (Az/Aş) means one who makes people lose their way or abandons them and flees, that is, one who leads astray.

who.id: Azıktı adalah jin jalan penipu dalam kepercayaan Turk dan Altai.
who.en: Azıktı is a deceiving road jinn in Turk and Altai belief.

origin.id: Ia berasal dari kepercayaan Kırgız dan Özbek sebelum Islam.
origin.en: It comes from the pre-Islamic beliefs of the Kırgız and Özbek.

role.id: Ia menyesatkan pengelana hingga mereka celaka.
role.en: It leads travellers astray until they come to harm.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal karena menyamar sebagai orang terdekat korban dan memanggil dengan suara orang yang dikenal.
famous_for.en: It is known for taking the form of the person closest to its victim and calling in a familiar voice.

description.id: Ia dapat menyamar dalam rupa apa pun, termasuk orang terdekat korban.
description.en: It can take any disguise, including the person closest to its victim.

description.id: Ia memanggil pengelana dengan suara orang yang dikenalnya.
description.en: It calls out to the traveller in the voice of someone he knows.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa kisah tentang suara yang dikenal dan larangan menoleh ke belakang berguna sebagai peringatan bagi pengelana?
learning_questions.en: Why might stories about a familiar voice and the warning not to look back work as a caution for travellers?

claims.quote: Azıktı, Türk ve Altay halk inancında bir kayıp cini.

claims.quote: İnsanlara kendilerine en yakın olan kişi şeklinde görülebilir. Bu şekilde kılığa giren Azıktı insanı azdırıp, uçuruma, dağa veya bir akarsuya götürerek öldürebilir.

statement.en: In Turk and Altai folk belief it is a road jinn (yol cini), a deceiving creature (Aldatıcı Cin).

claims.quote: Tek başına yola çıkan insanları kandırıp götüren ve kaybeden kötü ruhtur, insanları kandırmak için her türlü kılığa girer.

statement.id: Ia roh jahat (kötü ruh) yang menipu dan menghilangkan orang yang berjalan sendirian, dan menyamar dalam rupa apa pun untuk menipu.
statement.en: It is an evil spirit (kötü ruh) that deceives and makes lost the people who set out alone on a road, taking any disguise to deceive them.

claims.quote: Tanıdığı birisinin sesiyle yolcuya seslenir. Eğer bu sesi duyan kişi geriye dönüp bakarsa onu alır götürür ve kaybeder.

statement.id: Ia memanggil pengelana dengan suara orang yang dikenalnya; bila yang mendengar menoleh ke belakang, ia membawanya pergi dan menghilangkannya.
statement.en: It calls out to the traveller in the voice of someone he knows; if the person who hears the voice looks back, it takes him away and makes him lost.

claims.quote: Böylece insanları peşine takıp azıtarak (yolunu şaşırtarak), dağa, uçuruma, ırmağa götürüp, buralara düşürerek ölmesine neden olur.

statement.id: Dengan cara itu ia membuat orang mengikutinya dan tersesat, membawanya ke gunung, jurang, atau sungai, dan menjatuhkannya hingga mati.
statement.en: Thus it makes people follow it and lose their way (azıtarak), takes them to a mountain, precipice or river and makes them fall to their death.

statement.en: The name's root (Az/Aş) means one who makes people lose their way or leaves them and flees, that is, one who leads astray (azdıran).

statement.en: Under the entry Azmıç (road jinn), Azıtkı, Azatkı and Azıktı are listed as synonyms (Eşanlam).

short_description.id: Balarama adalah dewa Hindu dan kakak Krishna.
short_description.en: Balarama is a Hindu deity and Krishna's elder brother.

long_description.id: Balarama adalah dewa Hindu dan kakak Krishna. Ia penting sebagai salah satu tiga dewa dalam tradisi Jagannath.
long_description.en: Balarama is a Hindu deity and Krishna's elder brother. He is important as one of the three deities in the Jagannath tradition.

long_description.id: Nama lainnya mencakup Baladeva, Balabhadra, dan Sankarshana. Epitet Haladhara dan Halayudha berhubungan dengan bajak dan pertanian. Ia biasanya dipandang sebagai inkarnasi Shesha, tetapi sebagian tradisi menempatkannya sebagai avatar Vishnu. Mackenzie menjelaskan Balarama sebagai inkarnasi ular dunia Shesha.
long_description.en: His other names include Baladeva, Balabhadra, and Sankarshana. The epithets Haladhara and Halayudha connect him with the plough and farming. He is usually regarded as an incarnation of Shesha, but some traditions count him as an avatar of Vishnu. Mackenzie describes Balarama as an incarnation of the world serpent Shesha.

short_description.id: Bangpūtys adalah dewa laki-laki dalam mitologi Lituania (dan Prusia), yang direkonstruksi sebagai dewa laut, badai, angin, dan ombak.
short_description.en: Bangpūtys is a male deity of Lithuanian (and Prussian) mythology, reconstructed as a god of sea, storm, wind and waves.

long_description.id: Bangpūtys adalah dewa laki-laki dalam mitologi Lituania dan Prusia, dewa badai laut, angin, dan ombak; namanya berarti "yang meniup ombak". Berdasarkan sumber yang sangat sedikit, sebagian ahli mitologi merekonstruksinya sebagai dewa laut dan badai yang keras dan tak kenal ampun. Menurut rekonstruksi itu ia berjanggut, bersayap, dan bermuka dua, biasanya memegang ikan di tangan kiri, perkakas di tangan kanan, dan seekor ayam jantan di kepalanya.
long_description.en: Bangpūtys is a male god of Lithuanian and Prussian mythology, god of sea storms, wind and waves; his name means "he who blows the waves". From very scanty sources some mythologists have reconstructed him as a stern and unrelenting god of sea and storm. In these reconstructions he is bearded, winged and two-faced, usually holding a fish in his left hand and a utensil in his right, with a rooster on his head.

long_description.id: Anak-anaknya adalah dewa-dewa angin Rytys, Pietys, Šiaurys, dan Vakaris. Ia dianggap sangat pendendam: dalam satu kisah ia ingin menenggelamkan Auštaras, yang membuat badai saat berenang di laut. Pada abad ke-18 ia dianggap dewa laut dan dibandingkan dengan Neptunus; ia paling sering digambarkan sebagai malaikat bersayap besar, dan orang mempersembahkan jerami kepadanya agar laut tidak berbadai.
long_description.en: His sons are the wind gods Rytys, Pietys, Šiaurys and Vakaris. He is held to be very vindictive: one story tells how he wished to drown Auštaras, who made a storm while swimming in the sea. In the 18th century he was considered a sea god and compared to Neptune; he was most often shown as a great-winged angel, and people offered him straw so the sea would not storm.

short_description.id: Baphomet adalah figur okultisme Barat yang berawal dari tuduhan berhala terhadap ordo Knights Templar pada abad ke-14.
short_description.en: Baphomet is a figure of Western occultism originating from 14th-century accusations of demonic idol worship against the Knights Templar.

long_description.id: Baphomet berakar dalam tradisi okultisme Barat. Namanya pertama kali mengemuka pada abad ke-14 selama Trials of the Knights Templar ketika ordo tersebut dituduh memuja berhala iblis. Pada abad ke-19, nama ini dihidupkan kembali dalam perdebatan seputar penindasan Kesatria Kenisah.
long_description.en: Associated with Western esoteric thought, the figure known as Baphomet arose during 14th-century inquisitorial proceedings against the Knights Templar on charges of venerating an idolatrous demon. Occultists later revived discussions of the entity throughout nineteenth-century controversies regarding the order.

long_description.id: Penggambaran populernya dibentuk oleh Éliphas Lévi pada tahun 1856 dalam karyanya Dogme et Rituel de la Haute Magie. Ilustrasi Sabbatic Goat menampilkan makhluk hibrida manusia dan kambing bersayap yang melambangkan keseimbangan serta sintesis pertentangan dalam simbolisme okultisme.
long_description.en: Its popular image was established by Éliphas Lévi in 1856 in Dogme et Rituel de la Haute Magie. His Sabbatic Goat depicts a winged human-goat hybrid representing equilibrium and the reconciliation of opposites in occultism.

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana tuduhan persidangan abad pertengahan bertransformasi menjadi lambang okultisme modern?
learning_questions.en: How did medieval trial accusations transform into an iconic symbol of modern occultism?

short_description.id: Bedik adalah "jin hiburan" dalam kepercayaan rakyat Turk dan Tatar, roh jahat yang diusir dari rumah lewat upacara yang lama-kelamaan berubah menjadi pesta.
short_description.en: Bedik is the "jinn of merriment" in Turkic and Tatar folk belief, an evil spirit driven out of houses through ceremonies that gradually turned into festivities.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan rakyat Turk dan Tatar, Bedik dikenal sebagai jin hiburan (eğlence cini). Sumber kedua menyebutnya salah satu makhluk dengan kisah paling menarik dalam mitologi Turk.
long_description.en: In Turkic and Tatar folk belief Bedik is known as the jinn of merriment (eğlence cini). The second source calls it one of the beings with the most interesting story in Turkic mythology.

long_description.id: Mulanya Bedik adalah roh jahat yang mencelakai manusia dan hewan, sehingga orang ingin mengusirnya dari rumah. Untuk itu diadakan upacara atas namanya; karena upacara-upacara itu makin lama makin meriah, Bedik pun ikut bersenang-senang.
long_description.en: At first Bedik was an evil spirit that harmed people and animals, so people wanted to drive it out of their houses. Ceremonies were held in its name for this purpose; as these gradually became merry occasions, Bedik too began to enjoy itself.

long_description.id: Dalam upacara itu Bedik dimohon pergi dengan doa atau syair berima. Jika ia tidak mau mendengar, orang bahkan memakai ancaman dan hinaan. Ia digambarkan sebagai makhluk yang suka menyeringai dan menjengkelkan.
long_description.en: In these ceremonies Bedik is asked to leave with rhymed prayers or verses. If it will not listen, people even resort to threats and insults. It is described as a grinning, irritating being.

cultural_context.id: Upacara pengusiran Bedik menjadi contoh bagaimana ritual menolak roh jahat dapat berubah menjadi acara hiburan.
cultural_context.en: The ceremonies for driving Bedik away show how a ritual against an evil spirit could turn into an occasion for merriment.

literal_meaning.id: Akar Bed/Bet mengandung makna wajah dan rupa; kata Turk Kuno Bedük berarti besar.
literal_meaning.en: The root Bed/Bet carries the meanings of face and appearance; Old Turkic Bedük means great.

did_you_know.en: If Bedik would not leave after being asked with rhymed prayers, people turned to threats and insults.

short_description.id: Belenus (Belenos) adalah dewa penyembuh Kelt kuno, dipuja terutama di Aquileia dan Noricum, yang dalam sumber Romawi disamakan dengan Apollo.
short_description.en: Belenus (Belenos) is an ancient Celtic healing god, worshipped chiefly at Aquileia and in Noricum, and equated with Apollo in Roman sources.

long_description.id: Belenus (Galia: Belenos, Belinos) adalah dewa penyembuh Kelt (Celtic) kuno yang pemujaannya tercatat di sebagian besar dunia berbahasa Kelt. Pusat pemujaan utamanya di Aquileia, Italia timur laut, dan ia terutama dikaitkan dengan wilayah Noricum, tetapi namanya juga ditemukan dari Italia sampai Kepulauan Britania, termasuk Galia, Aquitania, dan Britania. Dalam sumber dan prasasti Romawi ia biasa disamakan dengan Apollo, terutama dalam kaitan dengan penyembuhan dan mata air berkhasiat.
long_description.en: Known in Gaulish as Belenos or Belinos, Belenus was an old Celtic god of healing, worshipped across much of the Celtic-speaking world. His main sanctuary was at Aquileia in north-eastern Italy, and he is chiefly tied to the Noricum region, yet references to him reach as far as Gaul, Aquitania and Britain in the north-west. Roman sources and inscriptions usually equate him with Apollo, especially where healing and curative springs are concerned.

long_description.id: Penulis kuno seperti Tertullian dan Herodian menggambarkannya sebagai dewa pelindung kota, terutama di Aquileia, tempat ia dianggap dewa pelindung kota itu; bukti arkeologi dan prasasti mengaitkan pemujaannya dengan air berkhasiat, tempat suci, dan di beberapa daerah fungsi orakel. Namanya muncul dalam sekitar 51 prasasti, kebanyakan di Aquileia. Menurut artikel de, sesudah Epona, Belenus adalah dewa Kelt yang paling banyak disebut penulis kuno; asal namanya diperdebatkan, antara "yang bersinar", "dewa mata air", atau kata Kelt untuk tanaman bilsenkraut (henbane).
long_description.en: Ancient writers such as Tertullian and Herodian describe him as a protective civic god, above all at Aquileia, where he was the city's patron; archaeology and inscriptions tie his cult to healing waters, sanctuaries and, in some places, oracles. His name appears in about 51 inscriptions, mostly at Aquileia. According to the de article, after Epona he is the Celtic god most often named by ancient authors; the origin of his name is disputed, between "shining one", "spring god", or the Celtic word for the plant henbane.

claims.quote: is an ancient Celtic healing god whose cult is attested across much of the Celtic-speaking world. While his principal centre of worship lay at Aquileia in northeastern Italy, and the deity is primarily associated with the Noricum region, mentions extend from the Italian peninsula to the British Isles, including Gaul, Aquitania, and Britain.

statement.id: Belenus adalah dewa penyembuh Kelt (Celtic) kuno, berpusat di Aquileia, Italia (Italy) timur laut, terkait Noricum, dan disebut dari Italia sampai Kepulauan Britania (British Isles), Galia (Gaul), Aquitania, dan Britania (Britain).
statement.en: Belenus is an ancient Celtic healing god centred at Aquileia in north-eastern Italy, tied to Noricum, attested from Italy to the British Isles, Gaul, Aquitania and Britain.

claims.quote: In Roman sources and inscriptions, Belenus was commonly identified with Apollo through interpretatio romana, especially in contexts associated with healing and therapeutic springs.

statement.id: Dalam sumber Romawi (Roman), Belenus disamakan dengan Apollo, terutama terkait penyembuhan dan mata air berkhasiat.
statement.en: In Roman sources Belenus was identified with Apollo, especially for healing and therapeutic springs.

claims.quote: Ancient authors such as Tertullian and Herodian describe him as a prominent protective and civic deity, notably at Aquileia, where he was regarded as the city's patron god. Archaeological and epigraphic evidence further indicate that his cult was closely connected with medicinal waters, sanctuaries, and, in some regions, oracular functions.

statement.id: Tertullian dan Herodian menyebutnya dewa pelindung kota, terutama di Aquileia; pemujaannya terkait air berkhasiat, tempat suci, dan orakel.
statement.en: Tertullian and Herodian call him a protective civic deity, notably at Aquileia; his cult tied to medicinal waters, sanctuaries and oracles.

claims.quote: which is a latinised form of the Gaulish Belenos (or Belinos), appears in some 51 inscriptions. Although most of them are located in Aquileia (Friuli, Italy), the main centre of his cult

statement.id: Nama Belenus, bentuk Latin dari Belenos (Gaulish, Galia), muncul dalam sekitar 51 prasasti, kebanyakan di Aquileia (Friuli, Italia).
statement.en: Belenus, the Latin form of Gaulish Belenos, appears in some 51 inscriptions, mostly at Aquileia (Friuli, Italy).

claims.quote: Traditionally, the name has been interpreted as meaning 'bright one' or the 'shining one'

statement.id: Secara tradisional namanya diartikan "yang cerah" atau "yang bersinar" (shining one).
statement.en: Traditionally the name is read as 'bright one' or 'shining one'.

claims.quote: Belenus, latinisierte Form von Belenos, Belinos, war ein keltischer Gott, der nach der Interpretatio Romana mit dem römischen Apollon gleichgesetzt wurde. Nach Epona ist er die von antiken Autoren am meisten genannte keltische Gottheit.

statement.id: Belenus (Belenos, Belinos) adalah dewa Kelt (keltischer Gott) yang disamakan dengan Apollon Romawi (römischen); sesudah Epona ia dewa Kelt yang paling banyak disebut penulis kuno (antiken Autoren).
statement.en: Belenus (Belenos, Belinos) was a Celtic god (keltischer Gott) equated with the Roman (römischen) Apollon; after Epona he is the Celtic deity most named by ancient authors (antiken Autoren).

claims.quote: Für die Deutung von Belenus als Heilgottheit spricht die Etymologie als „Quellgott“

statement.id: Etimologi sebagai dewa mata air (Quellgott) mendukung tafsiran Belenus sebagai dewa penyembuh (Heilgottheit).
statement.en: The etymology as a spring god (Quellgott) supports reading Belenus as a healing deity (Heilgottheit).

short_description.id: Boann adalah dewi Irlandia untuk Sungai Boyne, ibu Aengus dari hubungannya dengan Dagda, yang menurut legenda menciptakan sungai itu lalu tenggelam di dalamnya.
short_description.en: Boann is the Irish goddess of the River Boyne, mother of Aengus by the Dagda, who in legend created the river and drowned in it.

long_description.id: Boann atau Boand adalah dewi Irlandia (Irish) untuk Sungai Boyne (Bóinn) di provinsi bersejarah Meath. Menurut Lebor Gabála Érenn dan Táin Bó Fraích ia saudari Befind dan putri Delbáeth, putra Elada, dari Tuatha Dé Danann; suaminya disebut Nechtan atau Elcmar, dan dari kekasihnya, Dagda, ia melahirkan Aengus. Dalam dinsenchas namanya ditafsirkan sebagai "sapi putih". Untuk menyembunyikan kehamilannya dari Elcmar, Dagda membuat "matahari berhenti" sehingga sembilan bulan berlalu seperti sehari.
long_description.en: Boann, also spelled Boand, is the Irish deity of the River Boyne (Bóinn), which flows through the historic province of Meath. In the Lebor Gabála Érenn and Táin Bó Fraích she is a sister of Befind, and her father is Delbáeth, whose own father was Elada of the Tuatha Dé Danann; her husband is given as Nechtan or Elcmar, and by her lover the Dagda she bore Aengus. The dinsenchas read her name as 'white cow'. To hide the pregnancy from Elcmar, the Dagda made 'the sun stand still', so nine months passed like a single day.

long_description.id: Menurut Dindsenchas, Boann menciptakan Sungai Boyne: meski dilarang suaminya, Nechtan, ia mendatangi Well of Segais yang dikelilingi sembilan pohon hazel ajaib dan menantang kekuatannya dengan berjalan mengitarinya tuathal (melawan arah matahari). Airnya meluap dan menerjang ke laut sehingga terbentuk Sungai Boyne, dan Boann kehilangan lengan, kaki, dan mata, lalu nyawanya. Artikel de juga mencatat bahwa daerah di sekitar makam prasejarah Newgrange di lembah Boyne dinamai menurut dia, Brug na Boinne.
long_description.en: According to the Dindsenchas, Boann made the Boyne: though her husband Nechtan forbade it, she went to the Well of Segais, ringed by nine magic hazels, and defied it by circling it tuathal, against the sun. Its waters burst out and raced to the sea, forming the Boyne, and Boann lost an arm, a leg and an eye, then her life. The de article adds that the land around the prehistoric tombs of Newgrange in the Boyne valley is named Brug na Boinne after her.

role.en: Name means white cow.

famous_for.en: Drowned as the river formed.

did_you_know.id: Menurut legenda, Sungai Boyne tercipta ketika Boann berjalan mengitari Well of Segais melawan arah matahari dan airnya meluap.
did_you_know.en: In legend the River Boyne formed when Boann walked against the sun around the Well of Segais and its waters burst forth.

claims.quote: Boann or Boand is the Irish goddess of the River Boyne (Bóinn), an important river in Ireland's historical province of Meath. According to the Lebor Gabála Érenn and Táin Bó Fraích she was the sister of Befind and daughter of Delbáeth, son of Elada, of the Tuatha Dé Danann. Her husband is variously Nechtan or Elcmar.

statement.id: Boann (Boand) dewi Irlandia (Irish) Sungai Boyne (River Boyne, Bóinn) di Meath; menurut Lebor Gabála Érenn dan Táin Bó Fraích saudari Befind, putri Delbáeth putra Elada dari Tuatha Dé Danann; suaminya Nechtan atau Elcmar; ibu Aengus dengan Dagda (the Dagda); di Irlandia (Ireland).
statement.en: Boann (Boand) is the Irish goddess of the River Boyne (Bóinn) in Meath; per the Lebor Gabála Érenn and Táin Bó Fraích, sister of Befind, daughter of Delbáeth son of Elada of the Tuatha Dé Danann; husband Nechtan or Elcmar; mother of Aengus by the Dagda.

claims.quote: Her name is interpreted as "white cow" (Irish: bó fhionn ; Old Irish: bó find ) in the dinsenchas, where she is also called "White Boand".

statement.id: Dalam dinsenchas namanya ditafsirkan sebagai sapi putih (white cow).
statement.en: In the dinsenchas her name is read as white cow.

claims.quote: To hide the pregnancy from Elcmar, the Dagda casts a spell on him, making "the sun stand still" so he will not notice the passing of time. Meanwhile, nine months pass and Boann gives birth to Aengus.

statement.id: Dagda membuat matahari berhenti agar Elcmar tak sadar; sembilan bulan berlalu dan Boann melahirkan Aengus, di Brú na Bóinne.
statement.en: The Dagda made the sun stand still so Elcmar would not notice; nine months passed and Boann bore Aengus, at Brú na Bóinne.

claims.quote: Though forbidden to by her husband, Nechtan, Boann approached the magical Well of Segais (also known as the Connla's Well), which was surrounded, according to the legend, by nine magic hazel-trees.

statement.id: Menurut Dindsenchas, meski dilarang Nechtan, Boann mendatangi Well of Segais (Connla's Well) yang dikelilingi sembilan pohon hazel ajaib.
statement.en: Per the Dindsenchas, though Nechtan forbade it, Boann approached the Well of Segais (Connla's Well), ringed by nine magic hazels.

claims.quote: Boann challenged the power of the well by walking around it tuathal; this caused the waters to surge up violently and rush down to the sea, creating the Boyne. In this catastrophe, she was swept along in the rushing waters, and lost an arm, leg and eye, and ultimately her life, in the flood.

statement.id: Boann mengitari sumur itu tuathal; air meluap ke laut menciptakan Boyne, dan ia kehilangan lengan, kaki, mata, lalu nyawanya.
statement.en: Boann circled the well tuathal; the waters surged to the sea creating the Boyne, and she lost an arm, leg, eye and then her life.

claims.quote: ist eine Figur der keltischen Mythologie Irlands und dort die Flussgöttin des Boyne. Die Mythologie erzählt, sie habe die geheime Quelle ihres Gatten Nechtan im Síd durch Herumgehen gegen den Sonnenlauf (tuaithbel) entweiht, worauf sie darin ertrunken sei und der Boyne entstand.

statement.id: Bóann tokoh mitologi Kelt Irlandia (Irlands), dewi sungai (Flussgöttin) Boyne; ia menodai mata air rahasia Nechtan di Síd dengan berjalan melawan matahari (tuaithbel), tenggelam, dan Boyne pun tercipta.
statement.en: Bóann is a figure of Irish Celtic myth, river goddess (Flussgöttin) of the Boyne; she profaned Nechtan's secret spring in the Síd by walking against the sun (tuaithbel), drowned, and the Boyne arose.

claims.quote: Die Gegend um die vorkeltischen Grabhügel bei Newgrange im Boyne-Tal wird nach ihr Brug na Boinne genannt.

statement.id: Daerah sekitar makam prasejarah (vorkeltischen Grabhügel) Newgrange di lembah Boyne (Boyne-Tal) dinamai Brug na Boinne menurut dia.
statement.en: The land around the pre-Celtic mounds of Newgrange in the Boyne valley (Boyne-Tal) is called Brug na Boinne after her.
