short_description.id: Mairu adalah raksasa mitologi Basque yang membangun dolmen dan kromlek di pegunungan, namanya berarti "orang Moor" atau non-Kristen.
short_description.en: The Mairu are giants of Basque mythology who built the mountain dolmens and cromlechs, their name meaning 'Moor' or non-Christian.

long_description.id: Mairu atau mairuak, juga disebut Maideak, Mairiak, atau Intxisu, adalah raksasa mitologi Basque yang membangun dolmen dan kromlek di pegunungan, seperti di Zugarramurdi, Oiartzun, dan Buluntza; kromlek kecil disebut Mairu-baratze, "kebun Mairu", dan di Oiartzun dianggap kuburan mereka. Namanya mungkin berarti "orang Moor" dalam arti non-Kristen, dan asal-usulnya dianggap setua mouros encantados Portugal.
long_description.en: The Mairu or mairuak, also called Maideak, Mairiak or Intxisu, are Basque giants who built mountain dolmens and cromlechs such as those of Zugarramurdi, Oiartzun and Buluntza; small cromlechs are called Mairu-baratze, 'Mairu's garden', and at Oiartzun are thought to be their graves. Their name may mean 'Moor' in the sense of non-Christian, and their origin is held to be as old as the Portuguese mouros encantados.

long_description.id: Dalam sebagian legenda, Mairu-beso, tulang lengan Mairu atau sebenarnya lengan bayi yang belum dibaptis, dipakai sebagai obor ajaib untuk menidurkan penghuni rumah.
long_description.en: In some legends Mairu-beso, a Mairu's arm bone, in practice an unbaptised baby's arm, is used as a magic torch that sends a household to sleep.

who.en: Megalith-building giants.

role.en: Built dolmens and cromlechs.

famous_for.id: Mairu-baratze, kebun Mairu.
famous_for.en: Mairu-baratze, Mairu's garden.

note.id: Mairu disebut juga raksasa atau jentil.
note.en: The Mairu is also called a giant or jentil.
The Portuguese counterpart.

claims.quote: Mairu (plural: mairuak), also called Maideak, Mairiak, Saindi Maidi (in Lower Navarre), Intxisu in the Bidasoa valley are creatures of Basque mythology.

statement.id: Mairu (jamak: mairuak), juga disebut Maideak, Mairiak, Saindi Maidi (di Navarra Bawah), atau Intxisu di lembah Bidasoa, adalah makhluk mitologi Basque.
statement.en: The Mairu (plural mairuak), also called Maideak, Mairiak, Saindi Maidi (in Lower Navarre) or Intxisu in the Bidasoa valley, are creatures of Basque mythology.

claims.quote: The Mairu were giants who built dolmens or harrespil. Like the dolmens, they are only found in mountains. They are often associated with lamia, though these are known in all the Basque Country.

statement.id: Mairu adalah raksasa pembangun dolmen atau lingkaran batu harrespil yang, seperti dolmen, hanya ada di pegunungan, dan sering dikaitkan dengan lamia.
statement.en: The Mairu were giants who built dolmens or harrespil stone circles, found like the dolmens only in the mountains, and are often linked with the lamia.

claims.quote: Mairu could mean "moor" in Basque. This term is used with the sense of 'non-Christian' to refer to former civilizations or megalithic monuments.

statement.id: Mairu mungkin berarti "orang Moor" dalam bahasa Basque, dipakai dalam arti "non-Kristen" untuk peradaban lama atau monumen megalitik.
statement.en: Mairu may mean 'Moor' in Basque, used in the sense of 'non-Christian' for former civilisations or megalithic monuments.

claims.quote: The origin of the Mairu is thought to be as old as the "mouros encantados" in Portuguese (Spanish: moros encantados), who are thought to be the remnant of old pre-Roman deities.

statement.id: Asal-usul Mairu dianggap setua mouros encantados di Portugal (Spanyol: moros encantados), yang dianggap sisa dewa-dewa pra-Romawi.
statement.en: The Mairu's origin is thought to be as old as the Portuguese mouros encantados (Spanish moros encantados), considered remnants of old pre-Roman deities.

claims.quote: On attribue aux Mairuak la construction de certains dolmens et cromlechs comme ceux d'Ibañeta à Zugarramurdi, d'Oiartzun et de Buluntza.

statement.id: Mairuak dianggap membangun sejumlah dolmen dan kromlek, seperti di Ibañeta di Zugarramurdi, Oiartzun, dan Buluntza.
statement.en: The Mairuak are credited with building dolmens and cromlechs such as those of Ibañeta at Zugarramurdi, Oiartzun and Buluntza.

claims.quote: Mairu-baratze (littéralement 'jardin de Mairu') désigne un petit cromlech.

statement.id: Mairu-baratze, harfiah "kebun Mairu", adalah sebutan untuk kromlek kecil.
statement.en: Mairu-baratze, literally 'Mairu's garden', means a small cromlech.

claims.quote: Dans certaines légendes, Mairu-beso est le bras desséché ou un os du bras de Mairu qui possède des vertus mystérieuses. Plus concrètement, c'est le bras d'un nouveau-né non baptisé.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian legenda, Mairu-beso adalah lengan kering atau tulang lengan Mairu yang berkhasiat gaib, yang sebenarnya lengan bayi yang belum dibaptis.
statement.en: In some legends Mairu-beso is the dried arm or arm bone of a Mairu with mysterious powers, in practice the arm of an unbaptised newborn.

claims.quote: Dans les narrations, le protagoniste utilise cet os comme torche pour s'éclairer et parfois pour endormir les habitants de la maison dans laquelle il s'est introduit.

statement.id: Dalam kisahnya, tokoh utama memakai tulang itu sebagai obor dan kadang untuk menidurkan penghuni rumah yang dimasukinya.
statement.en: In the stories the protagonist uses the bone as a torch and sometimes to put the household he has broken into to sleep.

claims.quote: Mairu (Mairuak au pluriel en basque) est un géant ou jentil construisant des châteaux, dolmens et autres monuments mégalithiques dans la mythologie du Pays basque.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, Mairu adalah raksasa atau jentil yang membangun kastel, dolmen, dan monumen megalitik lain dalam mitologi Basque.
statement.en: According to the French article, the Mairu is a giant or jentil who builds castles, dolmens and other megaliths in Basque mythology.

claims.quote: En Oyarzun llaman intxitxu a los constructores de los crómlechs de la región y dicen que son cementerios de estos genios.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Spanyol, di Oiartzun para pembangun kromlek disebut intxitxu, dan kromlek itu dikatakan kuburan mereka.
statement.en: According to the Spanish article, in Oiartzun the builders of the cromlechs are called intxitxu and the cromlechs are said to be their graveyards.

short_description.id: Mara dalam kisah pencerahan Siddhartha tampil sebagai dewa kuat yang berupaya menggagalkan pencerahannya.
short_description.en: Mara in Siddhartha's awakening story appears as a powerful deity trying to obstruct his awakening.

long_description.id: Mara dalam kisah pencerahan Siddhartha tampil sebagai dewa kuat yang berupaya menggagalkan pencerahannya. Ia menggunakan pasukan surgawi dan penampakan perempuan cantik; beberapa legenda menyebut mereka putrinya.
long_description.en: Mara in Siddhartha's awakening story appears as a powerful deity trying to obstruct his awakening. He uses a celestial army and a vision of beautiful women; some legends call them his daughters.

long_description.id: Dalam kosmologi Buddhis, Mara dikaitkan dengan kematian, kelahiran kembali, dan hasrat. Epitet Papiyan menggambarkan sosok yang berkaitan dengan kejahatan, kesedihan, dan kemalangan. Nama Mara berasal dari akar Sanskerta yang berkaitan dengan menyebabkan kematian atau membunuh. Kajian Guruge mengutip definisi Mara sebagai personifikasi kematian, kejahatan, dan godaan.
long_description.en: In Buddhist cosmology Mara is associated with death, rebirth, and desire. The epithet Papiyan describes a being associated with evil, sorrow, and misfortune. Mara's name derives from a Sanskrit root associated with causing death or killing. Guruge's study quotes a definition of Mara as personification of Death, the Evil One, and the Tempter.

sources.title: The Buddha's Encounters with Mara the Tempter: Their Representation in Literature and Art
sources.author: Ananda W. P. Guruge
sources.publisher: Buddhist Publication Society; Access to Insight

claims.quote: In the story of the Awakening of Prince Siddhartha Māra appears as a powerful deva, trying to seduce him with his celestial army and a vision of beautiful maidens (accharā) who, in various legends, are often said to be Mara's daughters. In other iterations, Māra is inspired by Hindu myths about asuras, a class of titans or lesser deities.

claims.quote: His name is first mentioned in the Atharva Veda (1200 BCE–1000 BCE) as  Mrtyu and Agha Mara, the evil slayer. He is called the "evil one who kills" and "Papiyan", denoting a being which is not only morally bad but intertwined with sorrow, pain and misfortune.

short_description.id: Mariamman adalah dewi cuaca Hindu yang terutama dipuja di pedesaan India Selatan.
short_description.en: Mariamman is a Hindu weather goddess mainly venerated in rural South India.

long_description.id: Mariamman adalah dewi cuaca Hindu yang terutama dipuja di pedesaan India Selatan. Pemujaan memohon hujan dan penyembuhan penyakit seperti kolera dan cacar.
long_description.en: Mariamman is a Hindu weather goddess mainly venerated in rural South India. Worship seeks rain and healing of diseases such as cholera and smallpox.

long_description.id: Ia dipandang sebagai wujud Mahadevi dan aspek Kali atau Durga. Penduduk desa India Selatan memandangnya sebagai dewi penjaga. Nama Tamil Mari berarti hujan dan Amman berarti ibu. NHB Singapura menyebut Mariamman sebagai dewa utama kuil Sri Mariamman dan mengaitkannya dengan hujan yang menopang kehidupan.
long_description.en: She is regarded as a form of Mahadevi and an aspect of Kali or Durga. South Indian villagers regard her as a guardian deity. The Tamil name Mari means rain and Amman means mother. Singapore's NHB calls Mariamman Sri Mariamman Temple's chief deity and associates her with rain sustaining life.

short_description.id: Marid adalah jenis setan dalam tradisi Islam.
short_description.en: A marid is a type of devil in Islamic tradition.

long_description.id: Marid adalah jenis setan dalam tradisi Islam. Kata Arab marid berarti pembangkang dan diterapkan pada makhluk gaib ini.
long_description.en: A marid is a type of devil in Islamic tradition. The Arabic word marid means rebellious and applies to these supernatural beings.

long_description.id: Kamus Hans Wehr mendefinisikan marid sebagai iblis atau raksasa. Edisi MacNaghten dari Seribu Satu Malam menggunakan marid dan ifrit secara bergantian. Menurut uraian Amira El-Zein, marid mencoba meramal masa depan dengan naik ke langit dan menguping malaikat. Terjemahan As-Saffat 37:7 memakai frasa setiap setan pembangkang; ayat ini menjadi rujukan penggunaan sifat marid.
long_description.en: Hans Wehr’s dictionary defines marid as demon or giant. MacNaghten’s edition of One Thousand and One Nights treats marid and ifrit as interchangeable terms. In Amira El-Zein’s account, marid tries to predict the future by ascending to heaven and eavesdropping on angels. As-Saffat 37:7 uses the phrase every rebellious devil, cited for the adjective marid.

short_description.id: Matlalcueye, "yang berrok biru", adalah dewi hujan dan air Tlaxcala, permaisuri Tlaloc, yang memberi nama pada gunung api La Malinche.
short_description.en: Matlalcueye, 'she of the blue skirt', is the goddess of rain and waters of Tlaxcala, consort of Tlaloc, who gave her name to the volcano La Malinche.

long_description.id: Matlalcueye atau Matlalcueitl, "yang berrok biru", adalah dewi hujan, air di bumi, dan nyanyian dalam mitologi Tlaxcala. Ia permaisuri dewa hujan Tlaloc, istri keduanya setelah Xochiquetzal, dan juga disebut Chalchiuhtlicue, "roknya dari giok". Gunung api La Malinche atau Malintzin, yang dari kakinya mengalir sungai, memakai namanya.
long_description.en: Matlalcueye or Matlalcueitl, 'she of the blue skirt', is the goddess of rain, earthly waters and song of Tlaxcala. She is the consort of the rain god Tlaloc, his second wife after Xochiquetzal, and is also called Chalchiuhtlicue, 'her skirt of jade'. The volcano La Malinche or Malintzin, from whose slopes rivers flow, bears her name.

long_description.id: Seperti gunung pemberi hujan lain ia disebut Coatlicue, karena ular awan dipercaya lahir di gunungnya. Orang Otomi menyebutnya Mhu Ye dan, seperti bangsa berbahasa Nahuatl, menggambarkannya sebagai perempuan setengah ular.
long_description.en: Like other rain mountains she was called Coatlicue, since cloud serpents were thought born on her mountain. The Otomi call her Mhu Ye and, like Nahuatl speakers, depict her as half woman, half snake.

who.en: Goddess of rain and waters.

role.en: Gives rain and rivers.

famous_for.en: The volcano La Malinche.

statement.id: Matlalcueitl adalah dewi hujan dan nyanyian dalam mitologi Tlaxcala, yang memberi nama pada gunung api yang lebih dikenal sebagai La Malinche.
statement.en: Matlalcueitl is the goddess of rain and songs in Tlaxcala mythology, who gave her name to a volcano better known as La Malinche.

statement.en: According to the Tlaxcalans, Matlalcueye is the goddess of rain and earthly waters, consort of Tlaloc the rain god; she was also known as Chalchiuhtlicue.

claims.quote: Su nombre quiere decir textualmente "la de la falda azul", por su color evidente y sus laderas largas. Su otro nombre, Chalchiuhtlicue, quiere decir "su falda (de) jade".

statement.id: Namanya berarti "yang berrok biru", sesuai warna dan lereng panjang gunungnya; nama lainnya, Chalchiuhtlicue, berarti "roknya dari giok".
statement.en: Her name literally means 'she of the blue skirt', from the mountain's colour and long slopes; her other name, Chalchiuhtlicue, means 'her skirt of jade'.

claims.quote: Después de Xochiquetzal , es la segunda esposa de Tláloc: Malintzin, montaña de cuya falda efectivamente brotan ríos.

statement.id: Setelah Xochiquetzal, ia istri kedua Tlaloc: Malintzin, gunung yang dari kakinya memang mengalir sungai-sungai.
statement.en: After Xochiquetzal she is Tlaloc's second wife: Malintzin, the mountain from whose skirts rivers truly flow.

statement.id: Seperti gunung pemberi hujan lain, ia juga disebut Coatlicue ("yang berrok ular"), karena awan diumpamakan ular dan ular awan (mixkoatl) dikatakan lahir di gunung itu.
statement.en: Like other rain-giving mountains she was also called Coatlicue ('she of the serpent skirt'), since clouds were likened to snakes and cloud serpents (mixkoatl) were said to be born on the mountain.

claims.quote: En lengua yumhu se llama Mhu Ye (Diosa de la lluvia) y como los pueblos nahuahablantes, la representan como una mujer mitad humana y mitad culebra y se narra que se aparece de esa forma a los pobladores tlaxcaltecas.

statement.id: Dalam bahasa Yumhu (Otomi) ia disebut Mhu Ye, "Dewi Hujan", dan seperti bangsa berbahasa Nahuatl mereka menggambarkannya sebagai perempuan setengah manusia setengah ular yang menampakkan diri kepada penduduk Tlaxcala.
statement.en: In the Yumhu (Otomi) language she is Mhu Ye, 'Rain Goddess', and like the Nahuatl-speaking peoples they depict her as half woman, half snake, appearing so to the people of Tlaxcala.

statement.en: The Italian article calls Matlalcueitl or Matlalcueyetl, 'she who wears a blue skirt', a life-giving goddess of rain and song in Tlaxcala mythology.

claims.quote: Nella mitologia azteca veniva identificata con Chalchiuhtlicue e con il consorte, l'antico dio della pioggia Tlaloc.

short_description.id: Meretseger adalah dewi kobra Thebes yang melindungi nekropolis dan Lembah Para Raja.
short_description.en: Meretseger is a Theban cobra goddess protecting the necropolis and Valley of the Kings.

long_description.id: Meretseger adalah dewi kobra Thebes yang melindungi nekropolis dan Lembah Para Raja. Namanya berarti Yang Mencintai Keheningan, dengan tafsir lain berkaitan dengan Osiris.
long_description.en: Meretseger is a Theban cobra goddess protecting the necropolis and Valley of the Kings. Her name means She Who Loves Silence, with another interpretation connected with Osiris.

long_description.id: Ia menjadi pelindung perajin dan pekerja Deir el-Medina. Kuil batu kecil didedikasikan kepada Meretseger. Ia dipercaya menghukum pelanggaran dengan gigitan beracun tetapi menyembuhkan orang yang bertobat. Ensiklopedia pendamping menegaskan perlindungannya atas Lembah Para Raja.
long_description.en: She is patron of Deir el-Medina’s artisans and workers. Small rock temples are dedicated to Meretseger. She is believed to punish transgressions with a poisonous bite but heal the repentant. The accompanying encyclopedia confirms her protection of the Valley of the Kings.

Her cult was typical of the New Kingdom of Egypt (1550–1070 BC).

short_description.id: Mino-bi adalah fenomena cahaya gaib mirip kunang-kunang yang dikisahkan dekat Danau Biwa di Shiga.
short_description.en: Mino-bi is a firefly-like ghost-light phenomenon reported near Lake Biwa in Shiga.

long_description.id: Mino-bi adalah fenomena cahaya gaib mirip kunang-kunang yang dikisahkan dekat Danau Biwa di Shiga. Melepaskan jas hujan menghilangkannya, sedangkan mengibaskan membuat cahayanya bertambah. Penjelasannya berbeda antara roh orang tenggelam dan gas alam.
long_description.en: Mino-bi is a firefly-like ghost-light phenomenon reported near Lake Biwa in Shiga. Removing the raincoat disperses it, while brushing it makes the lights multiply. Explanations differ between drowned spirits and natural gas.

long_description.id: Kisah lain menyebut para pendamping mungkin tidak melihat cahaya itu. Kisah belakangan kerap mengaitkannya dengan kitsune, itachi, atau tanuki yang usil. Tafsir lainnya menyamakannya dengan kunang-kunang atau ulat kantong.
long_description.en: Other accounts say companions may fail to see the lights. The later account often attributes it to mischievous kitsune, itachi or tanuki. Other interpretations identify it with fireflies or bagworms.

claims.quote: Often it appears near bodies of water such as rivers or lakes, such as Lake Biwa in Shiga Prefecture. Minobi appears as a number of tiny fireballs which glow like fireflies.

short_description.id: Mitra adalah nama ilahi Indo-Iran yang terkait dengan Mitra Rigveda dan Mithra Avesta.
short_description.en: Mitra is an Indo-Iranian divine name connected with Rigvedic Mitra and Avestan Mithra.

long_description.id: Mitra adalah nama ilahi Indo-Iran yang terkait dengan Mitra Rigveda dan Mithra Avesta. Bahasa Avesta mempertahankan makna perjanjian untuk miθra.
long_description.en: Mitra is an Indo-Iranian divine name connected with Rigvedic Mitra and Avestan Mithra. Avestan miθra preserves the meaning covenant.

long_description.id: Dalam bahasa Sanskerta dan Indo-Arya modern, mitra berarti sahabat. Dalam tradisi Persia, Mithra dihubungkan dengan matahari terbit, perjanjian, dan persahabatan. Sumber membedakan Mithra Persia dari Mithras kultus misteri Romawi. Mitra Weda dihubungkan dengan perjanjian, fajar, kesuburan panen, dan kebenaran. Pasangan Mitra-Varuna menghubungkan Mitra dengan dewa langit Varuna. Mithra Persia digambarkan menaiki kereta bercahaya yang ditarik kuda putih. Persenjatannya mencakup tombak perak, busur dan anak panah emas, pisau, kapak, serta gada. Mithra memberikan farr atau karunia ilahi kepada raja yang layak. Nama Mithra dipanggil dalam prasasti Kekaisaran Akhemeniyah. Mihr Yasht menyebut Mithra membela pihak seiman maupun yang berbeda iman dalam perjanjian. Mihr Yasht menyebut Mithra memberikan kecepatan kepada kuda. Himne menggambarkan Mithra memiliki seribu telinga dan sepuluh ribu mata. Mithra dipuji sebagai kuat, tidak tidur, dan selalu terjaga.
long_description.en: In Sanskrit and modern Indo-Aryan languages, mitra means friend. Persian tradition associates Mithra with the rising sun, contracts, covenants, and friendship. The source distinguishes Persian Mithra from the Mithras of the Roman mystery cult. Vedic Mitra is associated with contracts, sunrise, harvest fertility, and truth. The Mitra-Varuna pairing connects Mitra with the sky god Varuna. Persian Mithra rides a bright chariot drawn by white horses. His weapons include a silver spear, a bow and golden arrows, daggers, axes, and a mace. Mithra bestows farr, divine grace, on a worthy monarch. Mithra’s name is invoked in Achaemenid inscriptions. The Mihr Yasht says Mithra stands for both the faithful and the unfaithful in contracts. The Mihr Yasht attributes swiftness for horses to Mithra. The hymn depicts Mithra with a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes. Mithra is praised as strong, sleepless, and always awake.

description.id: Memberikan kecepatan kepada kuda
description.en: Granting swiftness to horses

note.id: Mitra dipasangkan dengan Varuna dalam tradisi Weda.
note.en: Vedic tradition pairs Mitra with Varuna.

sources.title: AVESTA: KHORDA AVESTA (English): MIHR YASHT ('Hymn to Mithra')

claims.quote: Mitra (Proto-Indo-Iranian: *mitrás) is the name of an Indo-Iranian divinity that came out of the Rigvedic Mitrá and Avestan Mithra.

statement.id: Mitra adalah nama ilahi Indo-Iran yang terkait dengan Mitra Rigveda dan Mithra Avesta.
statement.en: Mitra is an Indo-Iranian divine name connected with Rigvedic Mitra and Avestan Mithra.

claims.quote: This meaning is preserved in Avestan miθra "covenant".

statement.id: Bahasa Avesta mempertahankan makna perjanjian untuk miθra.
statement.en: Avestan miθra preserves the meaning covenant.

claims.quote: In Sanskrit and modern Indo-Aryan languages, mitra means "friend"

statement.id: Dalam bahasa Sanskerta dan Indo-Arya modern, mitra berarti sahabat.
statement.en: In Sanskrit and modern Indo-Aryan languages, mitra means friend.

claims.quote: Mithra is the Persian god of the rising sun, contracts, covenants, and friendship.

statement.id: Dalam tradisi Persia, Mithra dihubungkan dengan matahari terbit, perjanjian, dan persahabatan.
statement.en: Persian tradition associates Mithra with the rising sun, contracts, covenants, and friendship.

claims.quote: these are two different deities, although Mithras is loosely derived from Mithra.

statement.id: Sumber membedakan Mithra Persia dari Mithras kultus misteri Romawi.
statement.en: The source distinguishes Persian Mithra from the Mithras of the Roman mystery cult.

claims.quote: The Vedic Mitra (sometimes given as Mitra-Varuna) was the god of contracts and the sunrise, fertility in the form of rain and good harvests, and keeper of truth.

statement.id: Mitra Weda dihubungkan dengan perjanjian, fajar, kesuburan panen, dan kebenaran.
statement.en: Vedic Mitra is associated with contracts, sunrise, harvest fertility, and truth.

claims.quote: The Mitra-Varuna coupling joined the god of the sunrise with the powerful sky god Varuna

statement.id: Pasangan Mitra-Varuna menghubungkan Mitra dengan dewa langit Varuna.
statement.en: The Mitra-Varuna pairing connects Mitra with the sky god Varuna.

claims.quote: He rides in a bright chariot drawn by white horses

statement.id: Mithra Persia digambarkan menaiki kereta bercahaya yang ditarik kuda putih.
statement.en: Persian Mithra rides a bright chariot drawn by white horses.

claims.quote: armed with a silver spear, a bow and arrows of gold, daggers, axes, and the mace

statement.id: Persenjatannya mencakup tombak perak, busur dan anak panah emas, pisau, kapak, serta gada.
statement.en: His weapons include a silver spear, a bow and golden arrows, daggers, axes, and a mace.

claims.quote: bestowing the farr (divine grace) on a worthy monarch

statement.id: Mithra memberikan farr atau karunia ilahi kepada raja yang layak.
statement.en: Mithra bestows farr, divine grace, on a worthy monarch.

claims.quote: Mithra's name was invoked in inscriptions during the Achaemenid Empire

statement.id: Nama Mithra dipanggil dalam prasasti Kekaisaran Akhemeniyah.
statement.en: Mithra’s name is invoked in Achaemenid inscriptions.

claims.quote: For Mithra stands for both the faithful and the unfaithful.

statement.id: Mihr Yasht menyebut Mithra membela pihak seiman maupun yang berbeda iman dalam perjanjian.
statement.en: The Mihr Yasht says Mithra stands for both the faithful and the unfaithful in contracts.

claims.quote: Mithra, the lord of wide pastures, gives swiftness to the horses

statement.id: Mihr Yasht menyebut Mithra memberikan kecepatan kepada kuda.
statement.en: The Mihr Yasht attributes swiftness for horses to Mithra.

claims.quote: with a thousand ears, well-shapen, with ten thousand eyes

statement.id: Himne menggambarkan Mithra memiliki seribu telinga dan sepuluh ribu mata.
statement.en: The hymn depicts Mithra with a thousand ears and ten thousand eyes.

claims.quote: strong, sleepless, and ever awake

statement.id: Mithra dipuji sebagai kuat, tidak tidur, dan selalu terjaga.
statement.en: Mithra is praised as strong, sleepless, and always awake.

short_description.id: Momonjii adalah yōkai dalam cerita rakyat Jepang.
short_description.en: Momonjii is a yōkai in Japanese folklore.

long_description.id: Momonjii adalah yōkai dalam cerita rakyat Jepang. Ia mengambil bentuk laki-laki tua berbulu yang berkeliaran di alam liar. Ia menyerang orang yang lewat, terutama anak yang menangis atau berperilaku buruk.
long_description.en: Momonjii is a yōkai in Japanese folklore. It takes the form of a hairy old man wandering the wilds. It attacks passersby, especially crying or badly behaved children.

long_description.id: Ilustrasi Sekien memperlihatkannya bersembunyi di tumpukan daun maple. Kisah belakangan menempatkannya di jalan berangin kencang dan menyebut perjumpaan menyebabkan sakit. Kisah belakangan memberinya asal dari nobusuma yang berumur panjang.
long_description.en: Sekien’s illustration shows it hiding in a pile of maple leaves. The later account places it on roads with strong winds and says encounters cause sickness. The later account gives it an origin in a long-lived nobusuma.

claims.quote: Momonjii (bahasa Jepang Kanji: 百々爺, Hiragana: ももんじい) adalah yokai dalam cerita rakyat Jepang.

statement.id: Momonjii adalah yōkai dalam cerita rakyat Jepang.
statement.en: Momonjii is a yōkai in Japanese folklore.

claims.quote: Momonjii mengambil bentuk berupa lelaki tua berbulu yang berkeliaran di alam liar.

statement.id: Ia mengambil bentuk laki-laki tua berbulu yang berkeliaran di alam liar.
statement.en: It takes the form of a hairy old man wandering the wilds.

claims.quote: Ia menyerang orang-orang yang ditemuinya, terutama anak-anak yang menangis atau yang berperilaku buruk.

statement.id: Ia menyerang orang yang lewat, terutama anak yang menangis atau berperilaku buruk.
statement.en: It attacks passersby, especially crying or badly behaved children.

claims.quote: Ia pertama kali mengilustrasikan momonjii sebagai makhluk yang bersembunyi di tumpukan daun maple.

statement.id: Ilustrasi Sekien memperlihatkannya bersembunyi di tumpukan daun maple.
statement.en: Sekien’s illustration shows it hiding in a pile of maple leaves.

claims.quote: Momonjii appear late at night on the road, when the wind blows strongly, and those who meet them suddenly become very sick.

statement.en: The later account places it on roads with strong winds and says encounters cause sickness.
statement.id: Kisah belakangan menempatkannya di jalan berangin kencang dan menyebut perjumpaan menyebabkan sakit.

claims.quote: A momonjii is born from a long-lived nobusuma, a yokai which was originally born from a long-lived bat.

statement.id: Kisah belakangan memberinya asal dari nobusuma yang berumur panjang.
statement.en: The later account gives it an origin in a long-lived nobusuma.

short_description.id: Monster Danau Fagua adalah makhluk rekaan bersayap kelelawar dan berwajah manusia yang disajikan sebagai nyata dalam cetakan Paris tahun 1784, konon ditangkap di danau di Chili yang sebenarnya tidak ada.
short_description.en: The Monster of Lake Fagua is an invented bat-winged, human-faced creature presented as real in Paris prints of 1784, supposedly caught in a lake in Chile that does not exist.

long_description.id: Pada 1784 surat kabar Courier de L'Europe dan cetakan gambar yang dijual di Paris mengabarkan bahwa monster telah ditangkap di Danau Fagua dekat Santa Fe, Chili, dan akan dipamerkan di Eropa. Ia digambarkan panjang 20 kaki, berwajah manusia, bertanduk banteng, bertelinga keledai, bersayap kelelawar, dengan tubuh bawah naga berekor dua, dan memangsa ternak pada malam hari.
long_description.en: In 1784 the Courier de L'Europe and prints sold in Paris reported that a monster had been caught in Lake Fagua near Santa Fe, Chile, and would be shown in Europe. It was described as 20 feet long, human-faced, bull-horned, donkey-eared and bat-winged, with a two-tailed dragon's lower body, preying on livestock at night.

long_description.id: Danau itu sebenarnya tidak ada, dan makhluk ini adalah rekaan; meski begitu "harpy" ini begitu populer di Paris hingga mengilhami gaya rambut, dan Annie Duprat menafsirkannya sebagai karikatur Marie Antoinette.
long_description.en: The lake did not exist and the creature was an invention; even so this 'harpy' was so popular in Paris that it inspired hairstyles, and Annie Duprat read it as a caricature of Marie Antoinette.

who.en: An invented lake monster.

famous_for.id: Tren gaya rambut di Paris.
famous_for.en: A hairstyle craze in Paris.

description.id: Courier de L'Europe dan cetakan Paris mengabarkan monster itu.
description.en: The Courier de L'Europe and Paris prints report the monster.

claims.quote: The Monster of Lake Fagua is a legendary creature, which it was claimed had been found in a lake near a place called Santa Fe, in Chile. An article about the creature was written in the Courier de L'Europe in France in 1784 stating that it had been captured and was going to be on display in Europe.

statement.id: Monster Danau Fagua adalah makhluk legendaris yang diklaim ditemukan di danau dekat Santa Fe, Chili; sebuah artikel di Courier de L'Europe di Prancis tahun 1784 menyebutnya telah ditangkap dan akan dipamerkan di Eropa.
statement.en: The Monster of Lake Fagua is a legendary creature claimed to have been found in a lake near Santa Fe, Chile; a 1784 article in the Courier de L'Europe in France said it had been caught and would be shown in Europe.

claims.quote: The creature is described as being 20 feet (6.1 m) long, with a human face, bull-like horns, huge donkey-like ears, lion-like teeth, bat-like wings, and the lower body of a dragon with two long pointed tails which it used to sting and attack enemies.

statement.id: Makhluk itu digambarkan sepanjang 20 kaki (6,1 m), berwajah manusia, bertanduk seperti banteng, bertelinga keledai besar, bergigi singa, bersayap kelelawar, dan bertubuh bawah naga dengan dua ekor panjang runcing untuk menyengat musuh.
statement.en: The creature is described as 20 feet (6.1 m) long, with a human face, bull-like horns, huge donkey ears, lion's teeth, bat wings, and a dragon's lower body with two long pointed tails for stinging enemies.

claims.quote: It was said to be nocturnal and its diet consisted of livestock, like cattle and pigs.

statement.id: Ia konon aktif pada malam hari dan memakan ternak seperti sapi dan babi.
statement.en: It was said to be nocturnal and to eat livestock such as cattle and pigs.

claims.quote: Le monstre du lac Fagua est une créature lacustre imaginaire, présentée comme réelle sur plusieurs estampes vendues à Paris en octobre 1784.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Prancis, monster danau Fagua adalah makhluk danau khayalan yang disajikan sebagai nyata dalam beberapa cetakan gambar yang dijual di Paris pada Oktober 1784.
statement.en: According to the French article, the monster of Lake Fagua is an imaginary lake creature presented as real in several prints sold in Paris in October 1784.

claims.quote: L'engouement pour cette « harpie » est tel qu'il inspire de nouvelles fantaisies aux coiffeurs des élégantes, qui appréciaient alors les coiffures extravagantes.

statement.id: Kegemaran pada "harpy" ini begitu besar sehingga mengilhami gaya rambut baru para perempuan modis.
statement.en: The craze for this 'harpy' was such that it inspired new fancies among fashionable ladies' hairdressers.

claims.quote: ところが、この説明に登場する「ファグア湖」は実在せず、架空の地名であるため、生物の報告も同様に疑わしい。

statement.id: Artikel bahasa Jepang mencatat bahwa "Danau Fagua" tidak ada dan merupakan nama tempat rekaan, sehingga laporan tentang makhluk itu juga meragukan.
statement.en: The Japanese article notes that 'Lake Fagua' does not exist and is an invented place name, so the creature report is equally doubtful.

claims.quote: アニー・デュプラはこれをマリー・アントワネットの風刺画であると解釈した。

statement.id: Annie Duprat menafsirkannya sebagai karikatur Marie Antoinette.
statement.en: Annie Duprat interpreted it as a caricature of Marie Antoinette.

short_description.id: Mummu adalah dewa Mesopotamia; namanya diperkirakan berasal dari kata Akkadia untuk daya kreatif.
short_description.en: Mummu is a Mesopotamian deity whose name may derive from Akkadian for creative force.

long_description.id: Mummu adalah dewa Mesopotamia; namanya diperkirakan berasal dari kata Akkadia untuk daya kreatif. Dalam Enuma Elish, Mummu tampil sebagai pelayan Apsu.
long_description.en: Mummu is a Mesopotamian deity whose name may derive from Akkadian for creative force. In the Enuma Elish, Mummu appears as Apsu’s servant.

long_description.id: Mummu dikalahkan bersama tuannya oleh Ea. Teks ritual memperlakukan Mummu sebagai dewa primordial yang tinggal di dunia bawah. Mummu juga tercatat sebagai gelar dewa-dewa lain. Sumber pendamping menyebut Mummu sebagai dewa perajin Babilonia.
long_description.en: Mummu is defeated together with his master by Ea. Ritual texts treat Mummu as a primordial deity residing in the underworld. Mummu also occurs as an epithet of other deities. The accompanying source describes Mummu as a Babylonian god of craftsmen.

short_description.id: Nabu adalah dewa Babilonia pelindung baca tulis, juru tulis, kebijaksanaan, dan seni rasional.
short_description.en: Nabu is a Babylonian patron of literacy, scribes, wisdom, and rational arts.

long_description.id: Nabu adalah dewa Babilonia pelindung baca tulis, juru tulis, kebijaksanaan, dan seni rasional. Nabu dihubungkan dengan Merkurius dalam astronomi Babilonia.
long_description.en: Nabu is a Babylonian patron of literacy, scribes, wisdom, and rational arts. Babylonian astronomy associates Nabu with Mercury.

long_description.id: Nabu disebut sebagai putra Marduk. Nabu dipuja di Borsippa. Tashmet disebut sebagai istri Nabu. Nabu digambarkan memegang pena tulis sambil menaiki atau berdiri di samping naga Mushhushshu.
long_description.en: Nabu is identified as Marduk’s son. Nabu is worshipped at Borsippa. Tashmet is named as Nabu’s wife. Nabu is depicted holding a stylus while riding or standing beside a Mushhushshu dragon.

short_description.id: Naga dalam legenda Sri Lanka adalah kelompok makhluk supermanusia berwujud ular di dunia bawah tanah.
short_description.en: The Nagas of Sri Lankan legend are a class of superhuman serpent beings in a subterranean world.

long_description.id: Naga dalam legenda Sri Lanka adalah kelompok makhluk supermanusia berwujud ular di dunia bawah tanah. Mereka disebut dalam Mahavamsa dan Manimekala.
long_description.en: The Nagas of Sri Lankan legend are a class of superhuman serpent beings in a subterranean world. They are mentioned in the Mahavamsa and Manimekala.

long_description.id: Nagadeepa dan Kalyani disebut sebagai tempat tinggal mereka. Buddha mendamaikan raja naga Chulodara dan Mahodara yang bersengketa tentang takhta berpermata. Maniakkhita, raja naga Kalyani, mengundang Buddha untuk kunjungan ketiganya ke pulau. Terjemahan Geiger menyebut Mahodara sebagai raja berkekuatan ajaib di kerajaan naga di samudra.
long_description.en: Nagadeepa and Kalyani are mentioned as their abodes. The Buddha reconciles naga kings Chulodara and Mahodara disputing a jeweled throne. Maniakkhita, naga king of Kalyani, invites the Buddha for his third visit to the island. Geiger's translation calls Mahodara a king with miraculous power in an ocean naga kingdom.

cultural_context.id: Entri membahas naga dalam teks dan legenda Lanka; kisah ini tidak membuktikan identitas etnis masyarakat modern.
cultural_context.en: This entry concerns nagas in Lankan texts and legends; the tale does not establish modern ethnic identities.

statement.id: Naga dalam legenda Sri Lanka adalah kelompok makhluk supermanusia berwujud ular di dunia bawah tanah.
statement.en: The Nagas of Sri Lankan legend are a class of superhuman serpent beings in a subterranean world.

statement.en: They are mentioned in the Mahavamsa and Manimekala.

claims.quote: Certain places such as Nagadeepa in Jaffna and Kalyani in Gampaha are mentioned as their abodes. The names of some Naga kings in Sri Lankan Ancient legend and the cult of Naga prevailed in India up to medieval times.

statement.en: Nagadeepa and Kalyani are mentioned as their abodes.

short_description.id: Nakisawame adalah dewi dalam mitologi Jepang.
short_description.en: Nakisawame is a goddess in Japanese mythology.

long_description.id: Nakisawame adalah dewi dalam mitologi Jepang. Namanya merujuk pada perempuan yang menangis. Cerita kelahirannya terjadi setelah Izanami meninggal akibat melahirkan dewa api.
long_description.en: Nakisawame is a goddess in Japanese mythology. Her name refers to a weeping female. Her birth story follows Izanami’s death after bearing the fire deity.

long_description.id: Nakisawame muncul dari air mata Izanagi. Ia dianggap sebagai roh mata air. Satu tradisi menempatkannya di kaki Gunung Kagu.
long_description.en: Nakisawame emerges from Izanagi’s tears. She is regarded as a spirit of spring water. A tradition places her at the foot of Mount Kagu.

claims.quote: Nakisawame (Japanese: ナキサワメ; recorded in the Kojiki as 泣沢女神 and in the Nihon Shoki as 啼沢女命, sometimes also written as 哭沢女命) is a female kami in Japanese mythology.

statement.id: Nakisawame adalah dewi dalam mitologi Jepang.
statement.en: Nakisawame is a goddess in Japanese mythology.

claims.quote: Her name means "crying weeping female".

statement.id: Namanya merujuk pada perempuan yang menangis.
statement.en: Her name refers to a weeping female.

claims.quote: During the myth of the Birth of the Gods, in which the goddess Izanami died after giving birth to the fire deity Kagu-tsuchi, Izanagi clung to his wife's dead body and cried.

statement.id: Cerita kelahirannya terjadi setelah Izanami meninggal akibat melahirkan dewa api.
statement.en: Her birth story follows Izanami’s death after bearing the fire deity.

claims.quote: From his tears the deity who lives under the trees on the ridge of Kaguyama 香山 mountain came into existence (16). Its name is Nakisawame no kami 泣沢女神 (17).

statement.en: Nakisawame emerges from Izanagi’s tears.

claims.quote: She is considered a spirit of spring water.

statement.id: Ia dianggap sebagai roh mata air.
statement.en: She is regarded as a spirit of spring water.

claims.quote: According to the Shinto creation myth, she lives at the foot of Mount Kagu.

statement.id: Satu tradisi menempatkannya di kaki Gunung Kagu.
statement.en: A tradition places her at the foot of Mount Kagu.

short_description.id: Nappateuctli adalah salah satu Tlaloque, dewa hujan Mexica, yang menumbuhkan alang-alang dan menurut Sahagún menciptakan seni membuat tikar.
short_description.en: Nappateuctli is one of the Tlaloque, the Mexica rain gods, who makes reeds grow and, according to Sahagún, invented the art of mat-making.

long_description.id: Nappateuctli, "empat kali tuan" dalam bahasa Nahuatl, adalah salah satu Tlaloque, para dewa hujan dan sumber air pembantu Tlaloc dalam mitologi Mexica, yang membagikan hujan dan menumbuhkan alang-alang. Menurut Bernardino de Sahagún ia menciptakan seni membuat tikar, sehingga para pembuat tikar memujanya.
long_description.en: Nappateuctli, 'four times lord' in Nahuatl, is one of the Tlaloque, the rain and spring gods who helped Tlaloc in Mexica mythology, sharing out rain and making reeds grow. According to Bernardino de Sahagún he invented mat-making, so mat makers worshipped him.

long_description.id: Ia digambarkan bertubuh hitam, memegang perisai berbentuk tumbuhan air dan tongkat berbunga kertas. Pada perayaannya, seorang budak yang didandani menyerupai dewa itu dikorbankan, setelah memercikkan air dari cawan hijau kepada semua orang.
long_description.en: He was shown with a black-painted body, holding a water-plant shield and a staff of paper flowers. At his feast a slave dressed to look like the god was sacrificed, after sprinkling everyone with water from a green bowl.

who.en: A rain god, one of the Tlaloque.

role.en: Distributes rain and makes reeds grow.

famous_for.id: Dewa para pembuat tikar.
famous_for.en: God of the mat makers.

note.en: The rain god he served.

statement.id: Nappateuctli (bahasa Nahuatl, "empat kali tuan") dalam mitologi Mexica adalah salah satu Tlaloque, dewa hujan dan sumber air sungai, sehingga ia menumbuhkan alang-alang dan mawar.
statement.en: Nappateuctli (Nahuatl, 'four times lord') in Mexica mythology is one of the Tlaloque, gods of rain and river springs, and so makes reeds and roses sprout.

claims.quote: Según Bernardino de Sahagún en el capítulo XX de su Historia general de las cosas de Nueva España que este (Nappateuctli) es el que inventó el arte de hacer esteras y por eso lo adoran por dios los de este oficio que hacen esteras, que llaman petates.

statement.id: Menurut Bernardino de Sahagún dalam bab XX Historia general de las cosas de Nueva España, Nappateuctli menciptakan seni membuat tikar, sehingga para pembuat tikar (petate) memujanya sebagai dewa.
statement.en: According to Bernardino de Sahagún in chapter XX of his Historia general de las cosas de Nueva España, Nappateuctli invented the art of mat-making, so mat makers (of petates) worship him as their god.

short_description.en: Narayana is one of Vishnu's forms and epithets.

long_description.id: Narayana adalah salah satu bentuk dan epitet Vishnu. Wujud ini digambarkan tidur dalam yoga di bawah samudra surgawi.
long_description.en: Narayana is one of Vishnu's forms and epithets. This form is depicted in yogic slumber beneath the celestial ocean.

long_description.id: Ia juga dikenal sebagai Purushottama. Dalam Waisnawisme Narayana dipandang sebagai Yang Mahatinggi. Penjelasan dalam Manusmriti menghubungkan narah, air, dengan ayana, tempat tinggal pertama. Mackenzie menuturkan Narayana sebagai wujud Vishnu yang bangun pada awal setiap yuga dari air primordial.
long_description.en: He is also known as Purushottama. In Vaishnavism Narayana is regarded as the Supreme Being. The Manusmriti explanation connects narah, waters, with ayana, the first residence. Mackenzie recounts Narayana as Vishnu's form awakening at each yuga's dawn from primordial waters.

He is also known as Purushottama, and is considered the Supreme Being in Vaishnavism.

short_description.id: Nechtan adalah tokoh mitologi Irlandia yang dikaitkan dengan mata air sumber Sungai Boyne, Nechtan's Well atau Well of Wisdom, dan suami dewi Boann.
short_description.en: Nechtan is a figure of Irish myth tied to the spring at the source of the River Boyne, Nechtan's Well or the Well of Wisdom, and husband of the goddess Boann.

long_description.id: Nechtan adalah tokoh mitologi Irlandia (Irish) yang dikaitkan dengan mata air penanda sumber Sungai Boyne (River Boyne), yang dikenal sebagai Nechtan's Well atau Well of Wisdom. Ia suami Boann, dewi yang namanya menjadi nama Sungai Boyne, dan diyakini nama lain bagi Nuada. Menurut Georges Dumézil, namanya mungkin sekerabat dengan dewa Romawi-Britania Nodens, dewa Romawi Neptunus, dan dewa Persia dan Weda Apam Napat. Nechtan sering dikaitkan dengan kuda, dan dalam bahasa Irlandia namanya dipakai bergantian dengan Elcmar.
long_description.en: Nechtan is an Irish mythological figure linked with the spring at the source of the River Boyne, called Nechtan's Well or the Well of Wisdom. He was husband of Boann, the goddess who gave the Boyne its name, and is thought to be another name for Nuada. Georges Dumézil suggested his name may be related to the Romano-British Nodens, the Roman Neptunus and the Persian and Vedic Apam Napat. Nechtan is often tied to horses, and in Irish his name is used interchangeably with Elcmar.

long_description.id: Ia tinggal di Síd Nechtain dunia lain, wujud mitos dari Carbury Hill. Hanya Nechtan dan tiga pembawa cawannya, Flesc, Lam, dan Luam, yang boleh mendatangi Tobar Segais atau "Well of Wisdom", tempat sembilan pohon hazel suci menjatuhkan buahnya yang membawa kebijaksanaan dan tempat Salmon of Wisdom berenang. Dalam Book of Invasions, Nechtan membunuh Cairpre lalu dibunuh oleh Sigmall, cucu Midir. Menurut artikel de, Boand menodai mata air rahasianya di síd dengan berjalan melawan arah matahari lalu tenggelam di dalamnya, dan dari situ lahir Sungai Boyne.
long_description.en: He dwelt in the otherworldly Síd Nechtain, the mythic form of Carbury Hill. Only Nechtan and his three cup-bearers Flesc, Lam and Luam could visit the Tobar Segais or 'Well of Wisdom', where nine sacred hazels dropped their wisdom-bearing nuts and the Salmon of Wisdom swam. In the Book of Invasions Nechtan killed Cairpre and was killed in turn by Sigmall, Midir's grandson. According to the de article Boand profaned his secret spring in the síd by walking against the sun and drowned in it, and so the Boyne was born.

short_description.id: Nefertem adalah dewa Mesir yang muncul sebagai teratai dari air primordial saat penciptaan.
short_description.en: Nefertem is an Egyptian god emerging as a lotus from primordial waters at creation.

long_description.id: Nefertem adalah dewa Mesir yang muncul sebagai teratai dari air primordial saat penciptaan. Ia mewakili sinar matahari pertama dan aroma teratai biru Mesir.
long_description.en: Nefertem is an Egyptian god emerging as a lotus from primordial waters at creation. He represents the first sunlight and the scent of the Egyptian blue lotus.

long_description.id: Ptah menjadi ayahnya, sedangkan Sekhmet atau Bastet dapat disebut ibunya. Ia sering berupa pemuda dengan bunga teratai biru di kepala. Patung kepala Tutankhamun muncul dari teratai merupakan penggambaran terkenal Nefertem. Nefertem dipanggil untuk penyembuhan melalui aroma dalam pengobatan Mesir.
long_description.en: Ptah becomes his father, while Sekhmet or Bastet may be called his mother. He is often a young man with blue lotus flowers around his head. A bust of Tutankhamun emerging from a lotus is a notable depiction of Nefertem. Nefertem is invoked for healing through aromas in Egyptian medicine.

short_description.id: Nephthys adalah dewi Mesir anggota Ennead Heliopolis.
short_description.en: Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead.

long_description.id: Nephthys adalah dewi Mesir anggota Ennead Heliopolis. Ia putri Nut dan Geb. Isis adalah saudarinya dan pasangan dalam ritual pemakaman.
long_description.en: Nephthys is an Egyptian goddess belonging to the Heliopolitan Ennead. She is a daughter of Nut and Geb. Isis is her sister and partner in funerary rites.

long_description.id: Ia disebut saudari sekaligus istri Set. Ia dikaitkan dengan perkabungan, malam, dan perlindungan. Namanya lazim diterjemahkan sebagai Nyonya Rumah atau Nyonya Kuil. Bersama Isis ia melambangkan gerbang pylon kuil. Ia dipandang sebagai dewi pelindung yang melambangkan pengalaman kematian.
long_description.en: She is described as Set’s sister and wife. She is associated with mourning, night and protection. Her name is usually translated as Lady of the House or Lady of the Temple. With Isis she symbolizes a temple’s pylon gateway. She is viewed as a protective goddess symbolizing the death experience.

long_description.id: Sebagian mitos menjadikannya ibu Anubis; kisah lain memberi Anubis ibu berbeda. Ia juga berperan sebagai pengasuh firaun. Ia dikenal sebagai Sahabat Orang Mati. Peratap profesional disebut Layang-Layang Nephthys. Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys dipakai dalam festival, ibadah, dan pemakaman. Dalam teks tersebut ia memanggil jiwa Osiris kembali dari kematian. Budge menyebut tempat Nephthys dalam bahtera matahari saat penciptaan dan kaitannya dengan senja.
long_description.en: Some myths make her Anubis’s mother; others give him a different mother. She also acts as a nurse to the pharaoh. She is known as Friend of the Dead. Professional mourners are called the Kites of Nephthys. The Lamentations of Isis and Nephthys is used at festivals, services and funerals. In that text she calls Osiris’s soul back from death. Budge describes Nephthys’s place in the solar boat at creation and her connection with twilight.

cultural_context.en: Budge describes Nephthys’s place in the solar boat at creation and her connection with twilight.

short_description.id: Nike adalah dewi kemenangan yang sering digambarkan bersayap dan membawa karangan kemenangan.
short_description.en: Nike is a Greek goddess of victory often shown with wings and a victory wreath.

long_description.en: Nike personifies victory. Styx and the Titan Pallas are her parents; Zelus, Cratos and Bia are her sisters. They remain near Zeus on Olympus.

long_description.en: Nike's name appears in the epithet Athena Nike; a temple of Athena as Victory stood on the Acropolis of Athens. Nike statues commemorated military victories, and large divine statues held a statue of Nike. A famous Nike was sculpted by Paionios.

long_description.en: Ninurta is depicted as a fierce deity relying on physical strength. One myth describes his mother attempting to kill Ninurta with thrown rocks. The Babylonian deity of the same name is traced to Sumerian Ninurta. Shahur is Ninurta’s speaking mace.

short_description.id: Nodens adalah dewa penyembuh Kelt yang dipuja di Britania kuno, terutama di tempat suci Lydney Park, dan dikaitkan dengan anjing.
short_description.en: Nodens is a Celtic healing god worshipped in ancient Britain, chiefly at the shrine of Lydney Park, and linked with dogs.

long_description.id: *Nodens, *Nodons, atau *Nudens (direkonstruksi dari bentuk datif Nodenti atau Nodonti) adalah dewa penyembuh Kelt (Celtic) yang dipuja di Britania kuno. Tidak ada gambar dirinya yang bertahan, tetapi plakat persembahan dari tempat suci di Lydney Park (Gloucestershire) menunjukkan kaitannya dengan anjing, hewan yang pada zaman kuno melambangkan penyembuhan. Dewa ini hanya dikenal di satu tempat lain, Cockersand Moss (Lancashire). Dalam kebanyakan prasasti ia disamakan dengan Mars sebagai penyembuh, bukan pejuang, dan namanya sekerabat dengan tokoh mitologi Kelt kemudian seperti Nuada dari Irlandia dan Nudd dari Wales.
long_description.en: Known as Nodens, Nodons or Nudens, a name rebuilt from the dative forms Nodenti and Nodonti, this is a Celtic god of healing in ancient Britain. No image of him survives, but votive plaques from a shrine at Lydney Park (Gloucestershire) show a link with dogs, beasts tied to healing in antiquity. He is known from just one other place, Cockersand Moss (Lancashire). Most inscriptions equate him with Mars as healer rather than warrior, and his name is related to later Celtic figures such as the Irish Nuada and the Welsh Nudd.

long_description.id: Filolog dan penulis J. R. R. Tolkien diundang menyelidiki prasasti Latin di Lydney Park, dan para sarjana mencatat beberapa kemungkinan pengaruhnya pada tulisan Middle-earth, termasuk Celebrimbor sang pandai besi pembuat Rings of Power, yang namanya, seperti julukan Nuada Airgetlám, berarti "Tangan Perak". Nodens juga muncul dalam karya Arthur Machen dan Cthulhu Mythos H. P. Lovecraft. Menurut artikel de, di Lydney Park ditemukan patung perunggu kereta yang ditarik empat kuda, monumen seorang lelaki membunuh ikan bertuliskan nama Nodons, dan persembahan lain bernama Nodons.
long_description.en: The philologist and author J. R. R. Tolkien was asked to study the Latin inscription at Lydney Park, and scholars note likely influences on his Middle-earth writings, including the Elvish smith Celebrimbor, maker of the Rings of Power, whose name, like Nuada's epithet Airgetlám, means 'Silver-hand'. Nodens also appears in the works of Arthur Machen and in H. P. Lovecraft's Cthulhu Mythos. According to the de article, Lydney Park yielded a bronze of a chariot drawn by four horses, a monument of a man killing a fish inscribed with the name Nodons, and other offerings naming Nodons.

statement.en: At Lydney Park were found offerings naming Nodons, a bronze (Bronzestatue) of a four-horse (vier Pferden) chariot, and a monument of a man killing a fish (Fisch).

short_description.id: Ægir (juga Hlér atau Gymir) adalah jötunn dan personifikasi laut dalam mitologi Nordik, tuan rumah pesta para dewa yang dikaitkan dengan pembuatan bir.
short_description.en: Ægir (also Hlér or Gymir) is a jötunn and personification of the sea in Norse mythology, host of the gods' feasts and associated with brewing ale.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik, Ægir (dieja Aegir; dalam Old Norse berarti "laut"), Hlér, atau Gymir adalah jötunn dan personifikasi laut. Dalam sumber Old Norse ia menjamu para dewa di aulanya dan dikaitkan dengan pembuatan bir. Bersama istrinya Rán, dewi yang juga mempersonifikasikan laut, ia memiliki sembilan putri yang mempersonifikasikan ombak, dan putranya adalah Snær, personifikasi salju. Dalam puisi skald, kapal disebut "kuda Ægir" dan ombak "putri-putri Ægir".
long_description.en: In Norse mythology, Ægir (anglicised Aegir; Old Norse for "sea"), also known as Hlér or Gymir, is a jötunn who embodies the sea. The Old Norse texts show him entertaining the gods in his halls and link him with brewing ale. With his wife Rán, a goddess who also embodies the sea, he has nine daughters who embody the waves, and his son is Snær, who embodies snow. In skaldic poetry a ship is "Ægir's horse" and the waves are the "daughters of Ægir".

long_description.id: Dalam Hymiskviða, para dewa yang haus setelah berburu mendapati bahwa di tempat Ægir tersedia banyak kuali; Ægir yang kesal meminta Thor mengambilkan kuali yang sangat besar agar ia dapat menyeduh bir untuk mereka semua. Menurut pengantar prosa Lokasenna, Ægir, yang juga disebut Gymir, mengadakan pesta dengan kuali besar itu; Loki membunuh pelayan Ægir, Fimafeng, lalu kembali ke aula dan memicu pertengkaran.
long_description.en: In Hymiskviða the gods, thirsty after a hunt, find that Ægir has plenty of cauldrons; the annoyed Ægir asks Thor to fetch an enormous cauldron so he can brew ale for them all. According to the prose introduction to Lokasenna, Ægir, also called Gymir, hosts a feast with that great cauldron; Loki kills Ægir's servant Fimafeng, then returns to the hall and stirs up strife.

long_description.id: Dalam Edda Prosa, Ægir atau Hler tinggal di pulau Hler (Hler's Isle, kini Læsø), dan mahir dalam sihir; ia berkunjung ke Asgard, duduk di samping dewa puisi Brage, dan mendengar kisah-kisah para dewa. Kenning "api Ægir" untuk emas berasal dari kisah bahwa Ægir menerangi aulanya dengan emas yang menyala. Rán, istrinya, memiliki jala untuk menangkap semua orang yang melaut.
long_description.en: In the Prose Edda, Ægir or Hler lives on Hler's Isle, now Læsø, and is skilled in magic; he visits Asgard, sits beside the poet-god Brage and hears the tales of the gods. The kenning "Ægir's fire" for gold comes from the story that Ægir lit his hall with glowing gold. Rán, his wife, had a net in which she caught everyone who went to sea.

long_description.id: Para sarjana memperdebatkan statusnya. Anthony Faulkes mencatat bahwa penulis modern sering menyebutnya dewa laut, padahal Edda Prosa tidak pernah menyebutnya dewa dan memasukkannya ke daftar jötnar; menurut Rudolf Simek, walau tercatat sebagai jötunn, Ægir memiliki ciri-ciri dewa laut. Mineral aegirine dan eksoplanet Epsilon Eridani b dinamai menurut Ægir.
long_description.en: Scholars debate his status. Anthony Faulkes notes that modern writers often call him a god of the sea, though the Prose Edda never calls him a god and lists him among the jötnar; according to Rudolf Simek, while attested as a jötunn, Ægir has the traits of a sea god. The mineral aegirine and the exoplanet Epsilon Eridani b are named after Ægir.

claims.quote: In Norse mythology, Ægir (anglicised as Aegir, Old Norse: 'sea'), Hlér (Old Norse: 'sea'), or Gymir (Old Norse less clearly: 'sea' or 'engulfer'), is a jötunn and personification of the sea. In the Old Norse record, Ægir hosts the gods in his halls and is associated with brewing ale.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Nordik (Norse), Ægir (Aegir), Hlér, atau Gymir adalah jötunn dan personifikasi laut (Old Norse 'sea') yang menjamu dewa dan dikaitkan dengan bir (ale).
statement.en: In Norse mythology Ægir (Aegir), Hlér or Gymir is a jötunn and personification of the sea (Old Norse 'sea') who hosts the gods and is associated with brewing ale.

claims.quote: For instance, a ship is described as "Ægir's horse" and the waves as the "daughters of Ægir".

statement.id: Dalam puisi skald kapal disebut "kuda Ægir" (Ægir's horse) dan ombak "putri Ægir" (daughters of Ægir).
statement.en: In skaldic poetry a ship is "Ægir's horse" and the waves the "daughters of Ægir".

claims.quote: In Hymiskviða, Ægir plays a major role. In the poem, the gods have become thirsty after a successful hunt, and are keen to celebrate with drink.

statement.id: Dalam Hymiskviða, para dewa haus setelah berburu dan ingin berpesta minum di tempat Ægir.
statement.en: In Hymiskviða the gods are thirsty after a hunt and keen to celebrate with drink at Ægir's.

claims.quote: He asks Thor to fetch a particular cauldron, and that with it he could brew ale for them all.

statement.id: Ægir meminta Thor mengambil kuali (cauldron) tertentu agar ia dapat menyeduh bir untuk semua.
statement.en: Ægir asks Thor to fetch a particular cauldron so he can brew ale for them all.

claims.quote: According to the prose introduction to Lokasenna, "Ægir, who is also called Gymir", was hosting a feast "with the great cauldron which has just been told about", which many of the gods and elves attended.

statement.en: According to the prose introduction to Lokasenna, Ægir, also called Gymir, hosted a feast with the great cauldron, attended by many gods and elves.

short_description.id: Nyx ialah dewi purba dan personifikasi malam dalam mitologi Yunani.
short_description.en: Nyx is a primordial goddess and personification of night in Greek mythology.

long_description.id: Dalam Theogony karya Hesiod, Malam lahir dari Chaos dan bersama Erebus melahirkan Aether serta Day. Nyx juga disebut melahirkan sejumlah roh, di antaranya Sleep, Death, Strife, dan Pain.
long_description.en: In Hesiod's Theogony, Night comes from Chaos and with Erebus bears Aether and Day. Nyx also bears spirits including Sleep, Death, Strife, and Pain.

long_description.id: Gambaran kuno menampilkan Nyx bersayap atau mengendarai kereta. Hemera, personifikasi Day, bergantian dengannya; keduanya tidak tinggal di rumah Tartarus pada waktu yang sama. Ia juga digambarkan berselubung hitam atau berbintang saat menaiki kereta.
long_description.en: Ancient depictions show Nyx with wings or a chariot. Hemera, the personification of Day, alternates with her; they are never at home in Tartarus at the same time. She is also depicted with a black or starry veil while driving the chariot.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Iliad, Hypnos mengatakan bahwa Nyx melindunginya dari Zeus. Bukti pemujaannya di kuil sangat sedikit, meskipun Pausanias menyebut orakel Malam di Megara.
long_description.en: In the Iliad, Hypnos says Nyx protected him from Zeus. Evidence of temple worship is sparse, though Pausanias mentions an Oracle of Night in Megara.

note.id: Dalam Theogony, Chaos adalah asal Nyx.
note.en: In the Theogony, Chaos is Nyx's origin.
Nyx bore Hemera with Erebus.

short_description.id: Ōkuninushi adalah kami penguasa bumi dalam kisah Kojiki yang menolong Kelinci Inaba dan kemudian menyerahkan kuasa atas tanah.
short_description.en: Ōkuninushi is an earthly lord kami in the Kojiki who helps the Rabbit of Inaba and later yields control of the land.

long_description.id: Ōkuninushi adalah kami yang namanya berarti penguasa tanah besar; Kojiki mengaitkannya dengan Negeri Tengah Dataran Alang-alang. Dalam kisah Kelinci Inaba, ia berjalan bersama saudara-saudaranya yang hendak meminang Yagamihime dan menolong seekor kelinci yang terluka. Yagamihime memilih Ōkuninushi, sehingga saudara-saudaranya menjadi iri dan membunuhnya dua kali. Ibunya menghidupkannya kembali, lalu ia melarikan diri ke negeri bawah. Di sana ia melewati ujian Susanoo dengan bantuan Suseribime.
long_description.en: Ōkuninushi is a kami whose name means great land master; the Kojiki links him with the Central Land of Reed Plains. In the Rabbit of Inaba tale, he travels with brothers courting Yagamihime and helps a wounded rabbit. Yagamihime chooses him, provoking his brothers to kill him twice. His mother revives him, and he escapes to the underworld, where Suseribime helps him survive Susanoo’s trials.

long_description.id: Dengan bantuan Sukunahikona, Ōkuninushi kemudian membangun negeri. Kisah penyerahan tanah menyatakan bahwa Amaterasu menghendaki keturunannya memerintah bumi; Ōkuninushi setuju menyerahkan kuasa dan sebagai balasannya dibangun kuil besar untuk menghormatinya. Kuil Izumo Ōyashiro kini memujanya sebagai dewa utama dan mengaitkannya dengan en-musubi, ikatan antarmanusia yang mencakup hubungan keluarga serta masyarakat. Di kompleks kuil terdapat patung pertemuannya dengan Kelinci Inaba.
long_description.en: With Sukunahikona’s help, Ōkuninushi develops the land. In the land transfer story, Amaterasu wants her descendants to rule the earth; Ōkuninushi agrees to yield control and a grand shrine is built in his honor. Izumo Ōyashiro now worships him as its principal deity and links him to en-musubi, bonds among people in families and wider communities. A statue on the shrine grounds shows his meeting with the Rabbit of Inaba.

claims.quote: Each time he was killed, Ōkuninushi was revived by his mother, and he finally escaped to the underword Ne no kuni.

statement.id: Ibu Ōkuninushi menghidupkannya kembali, lalu ia melarikan diri ke negeri bawah.
statement.en: Ōkuninushi’s mother revives him and he escapes to the underworld.

claims.quote: Susanoo, lord of the underworld, posed various trials, all of which Ōkuninushi succeeded in passing with the help of Susanoo's daughter Suseribime.

statement.id: Suseribime menolong Ōkuninushi melewati ujian Susanoo.
statement.en: Suseribime helps Ōkuninushi survive Susanoo’s trials.

claims.quote: Okuninushi serves as the protector of connections between people—whether those relationships are at home, at work, or in the larger community.

statement.id: En-musubi mencakup hubungan di rumah, pekerjaan, dan masyarakat.
statement.en: His protection of social bonds extends to home, work, and community.

short_description.id: Orca di Ebuda adalah monster laut dalam Orlando furioso karya Ariosto yang memangsa perempuan tawanan di pulau Ebuda sampai dibunuh Orlando.
short_description.en: The Orc of Ebuda is a sea monster in Ariosto's Orlando furioso that devours captive women on the isle of Ebuda until Orlando kills it.

long_description.id: Orca di Ebuda adalah monster laut dalam Orlando furioso karya Ludovico Ariosto, mirip monster dalam mitos Perseus dan Andromeda. Ia tinggal di dasar laut dekat pulau Ebuda, dan penduduknya yang bajak laut mempersembahkan perempuan tawanan sebagai makanannya, sesuai perintah Proteus sejak dahulu kala. Wujudnya lebih mirip ular laut berkulit keras daripada paus orca.
long_description.en: The Orc of Ebuda is a sea monster in Ludovico Ariosto's Orlando furioso, like the monster in the myth of Perseus and Andromeda. It lives on the seabed by the isle of Ebuda, whose pirate inhabitants feed it captive women, as Proteus had commanded since ancient times. Its shape is more like a hard-skinned sea serpent than a killer whale.

long_description.id: Ruggero yang menunggang Hippogriff menyelamatkan Angelica dengan membuat monster itu pusing dengan perisainya. Orlando kemudian masuk ke mulutnya, mengganjal rahangnya dengan jangkar, dan membunuhnya dari dalam. Kisah ini mengilhami tragedi Gabriello Chiabrera dan lukisan Ingres.
long_description.en: Ruggero, riding the Hippogriff, saves Angelica by stunning the monster with his shield. Orlando later enters its mouth, wedges its jaws with an anchor and kills it from within. The episode inspired a tragedy by Gabriello Chiabrera and paintings by Ingres.

who.en: A sea monster.

role.en: Devours captive women.

famous_for.id: Dibunuh Orlando dari dalam.
famous_for.en: Killed by Orlando from within.

note.id: Dewa laut yang memerintahkan persembahan untuknya.
note.en: The sea god who ordered the sacrifices to it.
Ruggero's mount when fighting it.

description.id: Tragedi yang menampilkan pertarungan Ruggero dengan Orca.
description.en: A tragedy featuring Ruggero's fight with the Orc.

claims.quote: L'Orca di Ebuda è un mostro marino che appare nell'Orlando furioso di Ludovico Ariosto. Non si tratta di un esemplare di orca marina, ma di una vera e propria creatura mostruosa, molto simile a quella che appare nel mito concernente Perseo e Andromeda.

statement.id: Orca di Ebuda adalah monster laut dalam Orlando furioso karya Ludovico Ariosto; bukan paus orca, melainkan makhluk mengerikan yang sangat mirip monster dalam mitos Perseus dan Andromeda.
statement.en: The Orc of Ebuda is a sea monster in Ludovico Ariosto's Orlando furioso; not a killer whale but a true monster, much like the one in the myth of Perseus and Andromeda.

claims.quote: l'Orca ha la sua dimora in fondo al mare, presso uno scoglio dell'isola di Ebuda (da identificare probabilmente con una delle Ebridi), i cui abitanti, dediti alla pirateria, offrono in pasto al mostro tutte le giovani donne da loro catturate.

statement.id: Orca tinggal di dasar laut dekat sebuah karang di pulau Ebuda (mungkin salah satu Hebrides), yang penduduknya bajak laut dan mempersembahkan semua perempuan muda tawanan mereka sebagai makanannya.
statement.en: The Orc lives on the seabed by a rock of the isle of Ebuda (probably one of the Hebrides), whose piratical inhabitants feed it every young woman they capture.

claims.quote: Il poeta inoltre precisa che tali sacrifici umani si protraevano da tempi antichissimi su imposizione di Proteo, a seguito dell'uccisione da parte di un re della sua stessa figlia, ingravidata dal dio marino.

statement.id: Pengorbanan manusia ini sudah berlangsung sejak dahulu atas perintah Proteus, setelah seorang raja membunuh putrinya sendiri yang dihamili dewa laut itu.
statement.en: These human sacrifices had gone on since ancient times at Proteus's command, after a king killed his own daughter, made pregnant by the sea god.

claims.quote: la principessa del Catai trova la salvezza grazie a Ruggero, che in groppa all'Ippogrifo stordisce l'Orca con il suo scudo abbagliante per poi rompere le catene che tenevano Angelica avvinta allo scoglio.

statement.id: Angelica, putri Cathay, diselamatkan Ruggero yang menunggang Hippogriff dan membuat Orca pusing dengan perisainya yang menyilaukan, lalu memutus rantai Angelica.
statement.en: Angelica, princess of Cathay, is saved by Ruggero, who rides the Hippogriff, stuns the Orc with his dazzling shield and breaks her chains.

claims.quote: dopo essere entrato nella sua bocca e averne bloccato le fauci con un'ancora,  il paladino riuscirà a uccidere l'Orca assestandole un colpo di spada dall'interno.

statement.id: Orlando masuk ke mulut monster itu, mengganjal rahangnya dengan jangkar, dan membunuhnya dengan tebasan pedang dari dalam.
statement.en: Orlando enters its mouth, wedges its jaws open with an anchor and kills the Orc with a sword stroke from inside.

claims.quote: Forma bestiae potius similis formae serpentis marini quam formae orcinae est quia, ut ipse Ariostus scripsit, "Orca formam animalem, praeter caput, non habet" atque quia cutis monstri marini dura est.

statement.id: Wujudnya lebih mirip ular laut daripada orca, karena menurut Ariosto Orca tidak berbentuk hewan kecuali kepalanya, dan kulitnya keras.
statement.en: Its shape is more like a sea serpent than an orca, because Ariosto wrote that the Orc has no animal form except its head, and its skin is hard.

claims.quote: Il combattimento di Ruggero con l'Orca è presente anche nella tragedia Angelica in Ebuda del poeta barocco Gabriello Chiabrera e inoltre ha ispirato diversi pittori come Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres

statement.id: Pertarungan Ruggero dengan Orca juga muncul dalam tragedi Angelica in Ebuda karya Gabriello Chiabrera dan mengilhami pelukis seperti Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres.
statement.en: Ruggero's fight with the Orc also appears in Gabriello Chiabrera's tragedy Angelica in Ebuda and inspired painters such as Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres.

short_description.id: Oymaq iyəsi adalah roh pelindung kabilah atau suku dalam mitologi türk, monqol, dan altay; sering dikaitkan dengan leluhur pendiri yang namanya dipakai kelompok itu.
short_description.en: Oymaq iyəsi is the guardian spirit of a clan or tribe in türk, monqol and altay mythology, often linked with the founding ancestor whose name the group bears.

long_description.id: Oymaq iyəsi adalah roh pelindung kabilah atau suku dalam mitologi türk, monqol, dan altay. Ia juga disebut Oyu iyəsi (Oyuv, Uyıv), dan istilah Uruk iyəsi kadang dipakai dengan makna serupa. Orang Monqol menyebutnya Aymag Ezen.
long_description.en: Oymaq iyəsi is the guardian spirit of a clan or tribe in türk, monqol and altay mythology. It is also called Oyu iyəsi (Oyuv, Uyıv), and the term Uruk iyəsi is sometimes used in a similar sense. The Monqol people call it Aymag Ezen.

long_description.id: Sumber kedua, sebuah kamus mitos, menjelaskan bahwa setiap oymak, yakni kabilah, punya roh pelindungnya sendiri. Di kalangan Turk kuno, oymak merupakan jenjang pertama organisasi masyarakat di atas keluarga dan garis keturunan, dan beberapa oymak bergabung menjadi boy atau suku.
long_description.en: The second source, a myth dictionary, explains that each oymak, or clan, has a guardian spirit of its own. Among the old Turks the oymak was the first level of social organization above the family and lineage, and several oymaks joined together into a boy, or tribe.

long_description.id: Banyak oymak dan boy memiliki leluhur pendiri yang namanya menjadi nama kelompok itu. Leluhur ini umumnya dianggap pelindung kelompoknya, dan lama-kelamaan bahkan pelindung seluruh bangsa. Contohnya Kırgız Han, pendiri bangsa Kırgız yang bersemayam di hulu Sungai Yenisey, dan Merde Xan, leluhur orang Altay yang dapat menurunkan hujan.
long_description.en: Many oymaks and boys have a founding ancestor whose name the group bears. This ancestor is generally regarded as the group's protector, and in time even as protector of the whole nation. Examples include Kırgız Han, founder of the Kırgız nation who dwells at the source of the Yenisey, and Merde Xan, ancestor of the Altay people, who can bring rain.

long_description.id: Sosok yang dekat dengannya adalah Oba iyəsi, roh pelindung oba atau perkemahan. Artikel pertama menyarankan keduanya dibahas bersama karena sifat-sifatnya mirip.
long_description.en: A closely related figure is Oba iyəsi, guardian spirit of the oba, or encampment. The first article suggests treating the two together because their features are alike.

literal_meaning.id: Dari akar Oy/Uy/Ay; padanan Monqol Oyoh berarti mengikat.
literal_meaning.en: From the root Oy/Uy/Ay; the Monqol cognate Oyoh means to bind.

who.id: Oymaq iyəsi adalah roh pelindung kabilah atau suku.
who.en: Oymaq iyəsi is the guardian spirit of a clan or tribe.

origin.id: Ia dikenal dalam mitologi türk, monqol, dan altay.
origin.en: It is known in türk, monqol and altay mythology.

role.id: Ia melindungi oymak, dan sering diwujudkan sebagai leluhur pendiri kelompok.
role.en: It protects the oymak and is often embodied as the group's founding ancestor.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal karena tiap kabilah dipercaya memiliki roh pelindungnya sendiri.
famous_for.en: It is known because every clan is believed to have its own guardian spirit.

did_you_know.id: Merde Xan, leluhur pelindung orang Altay, dipercaya mampu menurunkan hujan.
did_you_know.en: Merde Xan, the guardian ancestor of the Altay people, is believed to be able to bring rain.

note.id: Roh pelindung oba (perkemahan) yang sifatnya mirip dan perlu dibahas bersama.
note.en: Guardian spirit of the oba (encampment) with similar features, to be considered together.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa leluhur pendiri sebuah kelompok bisa dipandang sebagai roh pelindungnya?
learning_questions.en: Why might a group's founding ancestor come to be seen as its guardian spirit?

claims.quote: Oymaq iyəsi — türk, monqol və altay mifologiyalarında qəbilənin və ya tayfanın qoruyucu ruhu.

statement.id: Oymaq iyəsi adalah roh pelindung (qoruyucu ruhu) kabilah atau suku dalam mitologi türk, monqol, dan altay.
statement.en: Oymaq iyəsi is the protective spirit (qoruyucu ruhu) of a clan or tribe in türk, monqol and altay mythologies.

claims.quote: Oymaq iyəsi və ya Oyu (Oyuv, ​​Uyıv) iyəsi olaraq da bilinər.

statement.id: Ia juga dikenal sebagai Oyu (Oyuv, Uyıv) iyəsi.
statement.en: It is also known as Oyu (Oyuv, Uyıv) iyəsi.

claims.quote: Bəzən Uruk (Uruğ, Urıv) iyəsi təbiri də bənzər bir məna ifadə etmək üçün istifadə edilir. Monqollar Aymag Ezen olaraq bilərlər. Hər tayfanın fərqli bir qoruyucu ruhu vardır.

statement.id: Istilah Uruk (Uruğ, Urıv) iyəsi kadang dipakai dengan makna serupa; orang Monqol (Monqollar) mengenalnya sebagai Aymag Ezen; setiap suku punya roh pelindung sendiri.
statement.en: The term Uruk (Uruğ, Urıv) iyəsi is sometimes used with a similar meaning; the Monqollar (Mongols) know it as Aymag Ezen; every tribe has its own protective spirit.

claims.quote: OYMAK İYESİ: Oymağın Koruyucu Ruhu.

statement.id: Kamus mencatat Oymak İyesi sebagai roh pelindung oymak (Oymağın Koruyucu Ruhu).
statement.en: The dictionary lists Oymak İyesi as the protective spirit of the oymak (Oymağın Koruyucu Ruhu).

claims.quote: Her oymağın (aşîretin) kendi koruyucu ruhu vardır. Eski Türklerde aile ve sülale gibi alt birimlerin üzerinde, toplumsal örgütlenmenin ilk aşaması oymaklardır.

statement.id: Setiap oymak (aşîret, kabilah) memiliki roh pelindung sendiri; pada orang Turk kuno (Eski Türklerde), oymak adalah tahap pertama organisasi sosial di atas keluarga dan dinasti.
statement.en: Every oymak (aşîret, clan) has its own protective spirit; among the old Turks (Eski Türklerde), the oymak was the first stage of social organization above family and lineage.

claims.quote: Oymaklar bir araya gelerek boyları oluşturur. Pek çok boyun veyâ oymağın kurucusu olan ve kendi adını taşıyan bir atası bulunur. Bu ata genellikle o oymağın (ve zamanla boyun, hattâ ulusun) koruyucusu olarak kabul görür.

statement.id: Gabungan oymak membentuk boy (suku); banyak boy atau oymak memiliki leluhur pendiri yang namanya dipakai, dan leluhur (ata) itu umumnya dianggap pelindung oymak, kemudian boy, bahkan bangsa.
statement.en: Oymaks join to form boys (tribes); many a boy or oymak has a founding ancestor bearing its name, and this ancestor (ata) is generally regarded as the protector of the oymak, and in time of the boy and even the nation.

claims.quote: Kırgız Han: Kırgız ulusunun kurucucusudur. Yenisey Irmağı'nın kaynağında oturur.

statement.id: Contohnya Kırgız Han, pendiri bangsa Kırgız, yang bersemayam di hulu Sungai Yenisey (Yenisey Irmağı).
statement.en: An example is Kırgız Han, founder of the Kırgız nation, who dwells at the source of the Yenisey river (Yenisey Irmağı).

claims.quote: Merde Xan: Altay türklərinin atası və qoruyucusu olduğuna inanılar. Yağış yağdırma gücü vardır.

statement.id: Merde Xan dipercaya sebagai leluhur dan pelindung orang Altay türk, dan memiliki kekuatan menurunkan hujan (Yağış yağdırma gücü).
statement.en: Merde Xan is believed to be the ancestor and protector of the Altay Turks and has the power to bring rain (Yağış yağdırma gücü).

claims.quote: Oba iyəsi, türk xalq inancında obanın qoruyucu ruhudur. Hər obanın öz qoruyucu ruhu olduğuna inanırlar.

statement.id: Oba iyəsi adalah roh pelindung oba (perkemahan) dalam kepercayaan rakyat türk; setiap oba dipercaya punya roh pelindung sendiri.
statement.en: Oba iyəsi is the protective spirit of the oba (encampment) in türk folk belief; each oba is believed to have its own protective spirit.

claims.quote: Oba iyəsi də Oymak iyəsi ilə birlikdə qiymətləndirilməsi lazım olan, çünki bənzər və yaxın xüsusiyyətlər daşıyan bir varlıqdır.

statement.id: Oba iyəsi perlu dinilai bersama Oymak iyəsi karena memiliki sifat yang mirip dan dekat (bənzər və yaxın).
statement.en: Oba iyəsi should be considered together with Oymak iyəsi because it has similar and close (bənzər və yaxın) features.

claims.quote: (Oy/Uy/Ay) kökündən törəmişdir. Monqolca Aymag, mancur dilində Ayman olaraq keçər. Monqolca Oyoh bağlamaq mənası daşıyır.

statement.id: Kata ini berasal dari akar (Oy/Uy/Ay); dalam bahasa Monqol menjadi Aymag, dalam bahasa mancur Ayman, dan Oyoh dalam bahasa Monqol berarti mengikat (bağlamaq).
statement.en: The word derives from the root (Oy/Uy/Ay); in Monqol it appears as Aymag, in mancur as Ayman, and Monqol Oyoh means to bind (bağlamaq).
