short_description.id: Pir adalah sosok pelindung berbagai pekerjaan, hewan, dan golongan dalam mitologi bangsa-bangsa berbahasa Turk; dalam epos ia menyertai dan menolong para pahlawan.
short_description.en: A pir is a patron figure of various trades, animals and groups in the mythology of the Turkic-speaking peoples; in the epic it accompanies and aids heroes.

long_description.id: Pir adalah pelindung berbagai pekerjaan dan golongan dalam mitologi bangsa-bangsa berbahasa Turk. Namanya diambil dari kata Iran yang berarti tua atau orang tua yang berilmu. Sumber kedua, sebuah kamus mitos, menyebutnya pemimpin spiritual, sosok atau makhluk yang dipercaya mengepalai makhluk-makhluk suci dan menunjukkan jalan, serta pendiri suatu profesi, misalnya Pir para pandai besi.
long_description.en: A pir is the patron of various trades and groups in the mythology of the Turkic-speaking peoples. The name comes from an Iranian word meaning old or a learned elder. The second source, a myth dictionary, calls it a spiritual leader, a person or being believed to head the blessed beings and show the way, and the founder of a profession, such as the Pir of the blacksmiths.

long_description.id: Konsep ini berkembang luas dalam mitologi Turk, dan setelah datangnya Islam banyak pir baru muncul dalam mitologi Muslim. Ada pir untuk anjing, air, domba, dan banyak lagi; misalnya pir anjing adalah Кумайык dan pir domba adalah Чолпон-Ата. Orang memuja nama-nama pir ini dan percaya akan perlindungannya.
long_description.en: The concept is widely developed in Turkic mythology, and after the coming of Islam many new pirs appeared in Muslim mythology. There are pirs of dogs, of water, of sheep and many more; the pir of dogs, for instance, is Кумайык and the pir of sheep is Чолпон-Ата. People worshipped in the names of these pirs and trusted in their protection.

long_description.id: Dalam epos, pir menyertai pahlawan atau orang bijak dan menolongnya pada saat genting, dan kadang menampakkan diri kepada orang yang dilindunginya. Seekor rusa putih bercabang dua belas yang menyusui bayi Семетей disebut sebagai pir yang menjaganya sejak lahir. Dalam kepercayaan agama, pir dipandang suci seperti arwah leluhur.
long_description.en: In the epic, a pir accompanies a hero or sage and aids him in moments of danger, sometimes even showing itself to the one it guards. A white deer with twelve tines that suckled the infant Семетей is described as the pir that had watched over him from birth. In religious belief the pir is held sacred, like the ancestral spirits.

long_description.id: Sebutan pir juga dapat diberikan kepada orang tua yang sangat dihormati dan bijaksana. Walaupun pir pelindung seseorang bisa banyak, menjabat tangan dua belas pir dan memperoleh perlindungan mereka diterima dalam epos sebagai sebuah ritus keagamaan.
long_description.en: The title pir may also be given to a highly respected and wise elder. Although a person may have many protecting pirs, clasping hands with twelve of them and gaining their protection is accepted in the epic as a religious rite.

literal_meaning.id: tua; orang tua; orang tua yang berilmu

who.id: Pir adalah pelindung berbagai pekerjaan dan golongan.
who.en: A pir is the patron of various trades and groups.

origin.id: Ia dikenal dalam mitologi bangsa-bangsa berbahasa Turk dan berkembang pula dalam mitologi Muslim.
origin.en: It is known in the mythology of the Turkic-speaking peoples and also developed in Muslim mythology.

role.id: Dalam epos ia menyertai pahlawan dan menolongnya saat genting.
role.en: In the epic it accompanies the hero and helps him in times of need.

famous_for.id: Ia dikenal sebagai rusa putih yang menyusui dan menjaga bayi Семетей.
famous_for.en: It is known as the white deer that nursed and guarded the infant Семетей.

did_you_know.id: Dalam epos, menjabat tangan dua belas pir dianggap sebagai ritus keagamaan untuk memperoleh perlindungan mereka.
did_you_know.en: In the epic, clasping hands with twelve pirs is treated as a religious rite to gain their protection.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa banyak masyarakat membayangkan pelindung khusus untuk setiap pekerjaan atau hewan?
learning_questions.en: Why do many societies imagine a special patron for each trade or animal?

claims.quote: Пир (иранча эски, кары, билерман кары) — түрк тилдүү элдердин мифологиясында ар кандай иштин колдоочусу.

statement.id: Pir (Пир; dari bahasa Iran: tua, orang tua, orang tua yang berilmu) adalah pelindung (колдоочусу) berbagai pekerjaan dalam mitologi bangsa-bangsa berbahasa Turk (түрк тилдүү элдердин).
statement.en: Pir (Пир; Iranian for old, elder, knowledgeable elder) is the patron (колдоочусу) of various occupations in the mythology of Turkic-speaking peoples (түрк тилдүү элдердин).

claims.quote: Түрк мифологиясында кеңири өнүккөн. Ислам дининин пайда болушу менен мусулман мифологиясында көптөгөн П-лер келип чыккан.

statement.id: Konsep ini berkembang luas dalam mitologi Turk; dengan munculnya agama Islam (Ислам), banyak pir muncul dalam mitologi Muslim (мусулман).
statement.en: The concept is widely developed in Turkic mythology; with the rise of Islam (Ислам), many pirs appeared in Muslim (мусулман) mythology.

claims.quote: Мисалы, иттин П-н — Кумайык, суунун П-и — Сулайман, Койдун П-и — Чолпон-Ата,

statement.id: Misalnya, pir anjing adalah Кумайык, pir air adalah Сулайман, dan pir domba adalah Чолпон-Ата.
statement.en: For example, the pir of dogs is Кумайык, the pir of water is Сулайман, and the pir of sheep is Чолпон-Ата.

claims.quote: Элдер ошол П-лердин атына сыйынган, алар колдойт деп ишенишкен.

statement.id: Orang-orang memuja nama para pir itu dan percaya bahwa mereka melindungi (колдойт).
statement.en: People worshipped in the names of these pirs and believed that they protected (колдойт) them.

claims.quote: Эпосто П. өзгөчө касиетке ээ, баатыр, акылман адамды жылоолоп жүргөн, кыйын-кыстоо жерде аны колдогон. П. кээде колдоочу адамынын көзүнө көрүнгөн.

statement.id: Dalam epos (Эпосто), pir menyertai pahlawan atau orang bijak yang memiliki keistimewaan dan menolongnya di saat sulit; kadang pir menampakkan diri kepada orang yang dilindunginya.
statement.en: In the epic (Эпосто), the pir accompanies a hero or wise person of special virtue and helps him in hard times; sometimes the pir becomes visible to the person it protects.

claims.quote: Диний ишенимде П. арбак сыяктуу эле касиеттүү ыйык делип эсептелет.

statement.id: Dalam kepercayaan agama, pir dianggap suci dan keramat seperti arwah leluhur (арбак).
statement.en: In religious belief, the pir is considered sacred and holy like the ancestral spirits (арбак).

claims.quote: Кундагынан суурулуп чыгып кеткен баланы 12 айры ак бугу эмизип турган болот.

statement.id: Bayi yang tergelincir dari bedongnya ditemukan sedang disusui rusa putih (ак бугу) bercabang 12.
statement.en: The baby who had slipped out of his swaddling was found being suckled by a white deer (ак бугу) with 12 tines.

claims.quote: Демек, ак бугу Семетейди төрөлгөндөн эле колдоп жүргөн П-и катары айтылат.

statement.id: Jadi rusa putih itu disebut sebagai pir yang telah melindungi Семетей sejak lahir.
statement.en: Thus the white deer is spoken of as the pir that had protected Семетей since birth.

claims.quote: Кээде зоболосу бийик, ашкере акылман, көсөм карыя, бирөөлөр ыйык туткан адамы да П. деп эсептелет.

statement.id: Kadang orang tua yang terpandang, sangat bijak, dan dihormati sebagai suci oleh sebagian orang (адамы) juga dianggap pir.
statement.en: Sometimes a highly respected, very wise elder held sacred by some people (адамы) is also regarded as a pir.

claims.quote: Ошондуктан, адамды колдоочу П-лер көп болсо да, анын он экисине кол берүү, он экисинин колдоосуна ээ болуу эпосто да диний ырым катары кабыл алынган.

statement.id: Walaupun pir pelindung manusia banyak, berjabat tangan dengan dua belas (он экисине) di antaranya dan memperoleh perlindungan mereka diterima dalam epos sebagai ritus keagamaan.
statement.en: Although the pirs protecting a person are many, shaking hands with twelve (он экисине) of them and gaining their protection is accepted in the epic as a religious rite.

claims.quote: Pir (Farsça, Pir): Manevî önder. Kutlu varlıkların başında bulunduğuna, yol gösterdiğine inanılan kişi veya varlık.

statement.id: Kamus menjelaskan Pir (dari Farsça) sebagai pemimpin spiritual (Manevî önder): sosok atau makhluk (varlık) yang dipercaya mengepalai makhluk-makhluk suci dan memberi petunjuk jalan.
statement.en: The dictionary defines Pir (from Farsça) as a spiritual leader (Manevî önder): a person or being (varlık) believed to head the blessed beings and to show the way.

claims.quote: Bir mesleğin kurucusu olarak da kabul edilir. Örneğin; Demircilerin Piri gibi...

statement.id: Pir juga dianggap pendiri sebuah profesi, misalnya Pir para pandai besi (Demircilerin Piri).
statement.en: A pir is also regarded as the founder of a profession, for example the Pir of the blacksmiths (Demircilerin Piri).

topic.id: Pir sebagai makhluk gaib atau manusia
topic.en: Pir as supernatural being or human

summary.id: Pir adalah pelindung gaib suatu pekerjaan atau golongan, bahkan dapat berwujud hewan seperti rusa putih.
summary.en: A pir is a supernatural patron of a trade or group, and can even take animal form, like the white deer.

summary.id: Sebutan pir juga diberikan kepada orang tua yang sangat dihormati, dan kamus menyebutnya sosok atau makhluk.
summary.en: The title pir is also given to highly respected elders, and the dictionary calls it a person or a being.

short_description.id: Prithvi adalah dewi personifikasi bumi dalam Hindu dan merupakan dewi ibu dalam agama Weda.
short_description.en: Prithvi is the goddess personifying earth in Hinduism and a mother goddess in Vedic religion.

long_description.id: Prithvi adalah dewi personifikasi bumi dalam Hindu dan merupakan dewi ibu dalam agama Weda. Dalam Weda ia digambarkan subur, murah hati, dan memberi makan semua makhluk.
long_description.en: Prithvi is the goddess personifying earth in Hinduism and a mother goddess in Vedic religion. In the Vedas she is described as fertile, generous, and sustaining all beings.

long_description.id: Rigveda mengaitkannya dengan Dyaus, Bapa Langit; Atharvaveda menampilkannya sebagai dewi mandiri. Dalam Hindu klasik sosoknya digantikan Bhumi, dengan Prithvi menjadi salah satu epitet Bhumi. Kisah Prithu menuturkan dewi bumi berubah menjadi sapi. Rigveda 5.84 menyeru Prithvi yang membawa alat pembelah bukit dan menghidupkan bumi.
long_description.en: The Rigveda associates her with Dyaus, Father Sky; the Atharvaveda presents her as an independent goddess. In classical Hinduism her figure is supplanted by Bhumi, with Prithvi becoming an epithet of Bhumi. The Prithu narrative recounts the earth goddess changing into a cow. Rigveda 5.84 invokes Prithvi bearing the tool that rends hills and quickening earth.

name.en: Cow form in the Prithu narrative

description.en: Cow form in the Prithu narrative

claims.quote: is the Sanskrit name for the Earth, as well as the name of the goddess-personification of it in Hinduism. The goddess Prithvi is an archetypal Mother Goddess, and one of the most important goddesses in the historical Vedic religion.

statement.id: Prithvi adalah dewi personifikasi bumi dalam Hindu dan merupakan dewi ibu dalam agama Weda.
statement.en: Prithvi is the goddess personifying earth in Hinduism and a mother goddess in Vedic religion.

claims.quote: She is depicted as a stable, fertile, and benevolent presence in the Vedas. She is frequently addressed as a mother, and a nurturing, generous goddess who provides sustenance to all beings living on her vast, firm expanse. While the Rigveda predominantly associates her with Dyaus ('Father Sky'), the Atharvaveda and later texts portray her as an independent deity.

statement.id: Dalam Weda ia digambarkan subur, murah hati, dan memberi makan semua makhluk.
statement.en: In the Vedas she is described as fertile, generous, and sustaining all beings.

claims.quote: She is depicted as a stable, fertile, and benevolent presence in the Vedas. She is frequently addressed as a mother, and a nurturing, generous goddess who provides sustenance to all beings living on her vast, firm expanse. While the Rigveda predominantly associates her with Dyaus ('Father Sky'), the Atharvaveda and later texts portray her as an independent deity.

statement.id: Rigveda mengaitkannya dengan Dyaus, Bapa Langit; Atharvaveda menampilkannya sebagai dewi mandiri.
statement.en: The Rigveda associates her with Dyaus, Father Sky; the Atharvaveda presents her as an independent goddess.

claims.quote: In classical Hinduism, the figure of Prithvi is supplanted by the goddess Bhumi, while the term Prithvi serves as one of her epithets. She becomes significantly associated with Vishnu, one of the most important gods in later Hinduism, and two of his dashavatars—Varaha and Prithu.

statement.id: Dalam Hindu klasik sosoknya digantikan Bhumi, dengan Prithvi menjadi salah satu epitet Bhumi.
statement.en: In classical Hinduism her figure is supplanted by Bhumi, with Prithvi becoming an epithet of Bhumi.

claims.quote: Another connection is found between Prithvi and the mythological figure Prithu (Sanskrit: पृथु, Pṛthu), who chases the goddess Prthvi, shapeshifted as a cow. His name means 'far, wide, broad' and in later texts, the term Prithvi is treated as patronym for Earth derived from his name.

statement.en: The Prithu narrative recounts the earth goddess changing into a cow.

claims.quote: THOU, of a truth, O Prthivi, bearest the tool that rends the hills: ... Thou rich in torrents, who with might quickenest earth, O Mighty One.

statement.en: Rigveda 5.84 invokes Prithvi bearing the tool that rends hills and quickening earth.

short_description.id: Ptah adalah dewa pencipta Mesir dan pelindung perajin serta arsitek.
short_description.en: Ptah is an Egyptian creator god and patron of craftsmen and architects.

long_description.id: Ptah adalah dewa pencipta Mesir dan pelindung perajin serta arsitek. Dalam triad Memphis, ia menjadi suami Sekhmet. Nefertem dianggap sebagai putranya.
long_description.en: Ptah is an Egyptian creator god and patron of craftsmen and architects. In the Memphis triad he is Sekhmet’s husband. Nefertem is regarded as his son.

long_description.id: Ptah menciptakan dunia melalui gagasan dan ucapan. Batu Shabaka menghubungkan pemberian kehidupan dengan hati dan lidahnya. Bentuknya kadang digambarkan sebagai sosok kerdil. Pemujaannya menyebar ke kawasan Mediterania timur. Penggambaran umum memperlihatkan laki-laki berkulit hijau dalam kain pembungkus.
long_description.en: Ptah creates the world through conception and speech. The Shabaka Stone connects his giving life with his heart and tongue. He is sometimes represented as a dwarf. His worship spread to the eastern Mediterranean. A common depiction shows a green-skinned man in a shroud.

long_description.id: Simbol tongkatnya menggabungkan kuasa, kehidupan, dan kestabilan. Sinkretisme menghasilkan Ptah-Sokar-Osiris. World History Encyclopedia menghubungkan Ptah dengan pohon moringa. Dalam peran pencipta, ia juga disebut Ptah-Nun atau Ptah-Naunet. Gambarnya memakai penutup kepala rapat dan memegang tongkat was. Sumber itu menyebut Ptah telah muncul pada Dinasti Pertama. Budge mengaitkan Ptah dengan pembukaan mulut para dewa dalam Kitab Orang Mati.
long_description.en: His staff symbols combine power, life and stability. Syncretism produces Ptah-Sokar-Osiris. World History Encyclopedia connects Ptah with the moringa tree. In his creative role he is also called Ptah-Nun or Ptah-Naunet. His image wears a skullcap and holds a was-sceptre. That source states that Ptah appears in the First Dynasty. Budge associates Ptah with opening the gods’ mouths in the Book of the Dead.

short_description.id: Pustecki adalah roh tambang batu bara di Silesia Cieszyn, berwujud penambang tua berjanggut putih yang menolong penambang rajin dan memperingatkan bahaya.
short_description.en: Pustecki is a coal-mine spirit of Cieszyn Silesia, an old grey-bearded miner who helps hard-working miners and warns of danger.

long_description.id: Pustecki atau Pustecký adalah roh tambang dalam kepercayaan rakyat Polandia dan Ceko yang menghuni tambang batu bara di sekitar Karviná di Silesia Cieszyn. Ia tampak seperti penambang berseragam dengan janggut putih panjang, lampu karbit emas di helm, dan beliung perak di tangan. Wataknya mirip skarbnik.
long_description.en: Pustecki or Pustecký is a mine spirit of Polish and Czech folk belief living in the coal mines around Karviná in Cieszyn Silesia. He looks like a uniformed miner with a long grey beard, a golden carbide lamp on his helmet and a silver pick in his hands. In character he resembles the skarbnik.

long_description.id: Ia roh yang baik: menolong penambang yang rajin dan menghadiahi mereka emas, menuntun yang tersesat ke permukaan, dan merawat jiwa mereka yang tewas di tambang. Ia memperingatkan bahaya dengan berubah menjadi tikus yang mencicit keras, dan bahkan muncul di permukaan untuk memperingatkan bencana. Namun ia menghukum orang yang bersiul di tambang.
long_description.en: He is a kind spirit: he helps hard-working miners and rewards them with gold, leads the lost to the surface and cares for the souls of those who died in the mines. He warns of danger by turning into a loudly squeaking mouse and even appears above ground to warn of disasters. Yet he punishes those who whistle in the mines.

claims.quote: — дух или призрак в польской и чешской мифологиях, обитающий на территории угольной шахты рядом с Карвиной в Тешинской Силезии. Выглядит подобно шахтёру, в форме, с длинной седой бородой. На каску у него надета золотая карбидная лампа, в руках он держит серебряную кирку. По характеру Пустецкого связывают со скарбником.

statement.id: Pustecki adalah roh atau hantu dalam mitologi Polandia dan Ceko yang menghuni tambang batu bara dekat Karviná di Silesia Cieszyn; ia tampak seperti penambang berseragam berjanggut putih panjang, dengan lampu karbit emas di helm dan beliung perak di tangan, dan wataknya dikaitkan dengan skarbnik.
statement.en: Pustecki is a spirit or ghost of Polish and Czech mythology living in a coal mine near Karviná in Cieszyn Silesia; he looks like a miner in uniform with a long grey beard, a golden carbide lamp on his helmet and a silver pick in his hands, and in character he is linked with the skarbnik.

claims.quote: Добрый и заботливый дух. Всегда помогает трудолюбивым шахтёрам, награждает их золотом. Выручает потерявшихся под землёй, выводит их на поверхность. Заботится о душах умерших в шахтах.

statement.id: Ia roh yang baik dan penuh perhatian: selalu menolong penambang yang rajin dan menghadiahi mereka emas, menyelamatkan yang tersesat di bawah tanah dan menuntun mereka ke permukaan, serta merawat jiwa mereka yang tewas di tambang.
statement.en: He is a kind and caring spirit: he always helps hard-working miners and rewards them with gold, rescues those lost underground and leads them to the surface, and cares for the souls of those who died in the mines.

claims.quote: Пустецкий предупреждает шахтёров о возможной опасности во время работы. Он превращается в какое-нибудь маленькое животное, например, в мышь, и сильно визжит.

statement.id: Pustecki memperingatkan penambang akan bahaya saat bekerja dengan berubah menjadi hewan kecil, misalnya tikus, lalu mencicit keras.
statement.en: Pustecki warns miners of possible danger at work by turning into a small animal, such as a mouse, and squeaking loudly.

claims.quote: Pustecki, cz. Pustecký - důlní duch – duch z wierzeń ludowych Śląska Cieszyńskiego, zamieszkujący kopalnie węgla kamiennego w okolicach Karwiny. W swym charakterze podobny skarbnikowi.

statement.id: Pustecki (bahasa Ceko: Pustecký) adalah roh tambang dalam kepercayaan rakyat Silesia Cieszyn yang menghuni tambang batu bara di sekitar Karviná, dengan watak mirip skarbnik.
statement.en: Pustecki (Czech Pustecký) is a mine spirit of the folk beliefs of Cieszyn Silesia, inhabiting the coal mines around Karviná, similar in character to the skarbnik.

claims.quote: Nie tolerował jednak pewnych zachowań, m.in. gwizdania w kopalniach, za co karał.

statement.id: Namun ia tidak menoleransi perilaku tertentu, antara lain bersiul di tambang, dan menghukum pelakunya.
statement.en: However, he did not tolerate certain behaviour, including whistling in the mines, and punished it.

claims.quote: Pustecki pojawiał się również na powierzchni, niejednokrotnie ostrzegając zdążających do pracy górników przed mającymi nastąpić katastrofami.

statement.id: Pustecki juga muncul di permukaan, berkali-kali memperingatkan penambang yang hendak berangkat kerja akan bencana yang akan terjadi.
statement.en: Pustecki also appeared above ground, more than once warning miners on their way to work of disasters about to happen.

short_description.id: Pyewacket adalah roh pendamping (familiar) yang disebut dalam pengakuan seorang perempuan yang dituduh Matthew Hopkins sebagai penyihir di Manningtree, Essex, pada Maret 1644.
short_description.en: Pyewacket is a familiar spirit named in the confession of a woman accused of witchcraft by Matthew Hopkins at Manningtree, Essex, in March 1644.

long_description.id: Pyewacket dikatakan salah satu roh pendamping seorang penyihir terpidana yang dituduh Matthew Hopkins pada Maret 1644 di kota Manningtree, Essex, Inggris. Hopkins mengaku memata-matai pertemuan para penyihir dekat rumahnya dan mendengar mereka menyebut nama seorang perempuan setempat.
long_description.en: One of the familiar spirits attributed to a convicted witch, Pyewacket belongs to the case brought by Matthew Hopkins in March 1644 at Manningtree, Essex, England. Hopkins said he secretly watched the witches meet close to his home and overheard a local woman being named.

long_description.id: Perempuan itu ditangkap dan dicegah tidur empat malam, lalu mengaku dan menyebut nama roh pendampingnya beserta bentuk yang akan mereka ambil. Menurut Hopkins, ia memanggil mereka pada malam keempat dengan sepuluh orang hadir, dan menyebut nama imp lain, antara lain Elemanzer, Pyewacket, dan Peckin the Crown.
long_description.en: The woman was arrested and kept from sleep for four nights, then confessed and named her familiars and the forms they would take. According to Hopkins she called them on the fourth night with ten people present, and named other imps, including Elemanzer, Pyewacket and Peckin the Crown.

long_description.id: Nama Pyewacket kemudian dipakai dalam budaya populer: kucing Siam milik penyihir dalam film Bell, Book and Candle (1958), serta judul sebuah film horor 2017.
long_description.en: The name Pyewacket was later reused in popular culture: as the witch's Siamese cat in the film Bell, Book and Candle (1958) and as the title of a 2017 horror film.

short_description.id: Radha adalah dewi Hindu dan pasangan utama Krishna.
short_description.en: Radha is a Hindu goddess and Krishna's chief consort.

long_description.id: Radha adalah dewi Hindu dan pasangan utama Krishna. Radhika merupakan nama lain Radha.
long_description.en: Radha is a Hindu goddess and Krishna's chief consort. Radhika is another name for Radha.

long_description.id: Ia dipuja sebagai dewi cinta, kelembutan, kasih sayang, dan bakti. Sejumlah kitab menyebutnya penjelmaan Lakshmi dan daya batin Krishna yang disebut hladini shakti. Nimbarka dan banyak tradisi Waisnawa memujanya sebagai istri abadi Krishna. Tradisi Gaudiya Waisnawa menekankan Radha sebagai kekasih serta pasangan ilahi Krishna. Radha Vallabha dan Haridasi memujanya sebagai sosok tertinggi. Ia disebut pemimpin para gopi Braj dan ratu Goloka serta Braj. Nama Radha dijelaskan bermakna kemakmuran, keberhasilan, kesempurnaan, dan kekayaan. Narada Pancharatra mencatat 1008 namanya dalam Shri Radha Saharsnama Strotam. Pada gerakan Bhakti abad keenam belas, cinta Radha kepada Krishna menjadi lebih menonjol. Gita Govinda karya Jayadeva pada abad kedua belas menjadi salah satu penampilan sastra utamanya. Kajian yang diringkas artikel membedakan Radha sebagai gopi dan sebagai dewi. Kajian Archer menyebut Gita Govinda menuturkan perpisahan, kerinduan, dan pertemuan kembali Radha dengan Krishna. Terjemahan Arnold menggambarkan Radha menanti Krishna di tepi hutan pada musim semi.
long_description.en: She is revered as a goddess of love, tenderness, compassion, and devotion. Some scriptures call her Lakshmi's incarnation and Krishna's internal potency called hladini shakti. Nimbarka and many Vaishnava traditions worship her as Krishna's eternal wife. Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition emphasises Radha as Krishna's beloved and divine consort. Radha Vallabha and Haridasi venerate her as the supreme being. She is called chief of the Braj gopis and queen of Goloka and Braj. Radha's name is explained as prosperity, success, perfection, and wealth. The Narada Pancharatra records 1008 of her names in the Shri Radha Saharsnama Strotam. In the sixteenth century Bhakti movement, Radha's love for Krishna became more prominent. Jayadeva's twelfth century Gita Govinda is one of her major literary appearances. Scholarship summarised by the article distinguishes Radha as a gopi and as a goddess. Archer's study says the Gita Govinda recounts separation, longing, and reunion between Radha and Krishna. Arnold's translation depicts Radha awaiting Krishna by the wood in spring.

long_description.id: Rahu kala merupakan waktu yang dianggap tidak menguntungkan dalam tradisi astrologi. Kisah Purana menuturkan Svarbhanu menyamar untuk meminum amrita. Kepala yang dipotong Vishnu disebut Rahu, sedangkan tubuhnya disebut Ketu. Mackenzie menggambarkan Rahu sebagai demon yang menyebabkan gerhana dengan menelan Matahari dan Bulan.
long_description.en: Rahu kala is a time considered inauspicious in the astrological tradition. The Puranic narrative recounts Svarbhanu disguising himself to drink amrita. The head severed by Vishnu is called Rahu, while the body is called Ketu. Mackenzie depicts Rahu as a demon causing eclipses by swallowing the sun and moon.

short_description.en: Renenutet is an Egyptian goddess of grain, grapes, nourishment and harvest.

long_description.id: Renenutet adalah dewi Mesir untuk biji-bijian, anggur, nutrisi, dan panen. Ia digambarkan sebagai kobra atau perempuan berkepala kobra.
long_description.en: Renenutet is an Egyptian goddess of grain, grapes, nourishment and harvest. She is shown as a cobra or cobra-headed woman.

long_description.id: Ia merawat firaun sejak lahir hingga wafat. Ia adalah pasangan feminin Shai dan pelindung kewenangan kerajaan. Gambarnya berada di dapur dan tempat penyimpanan untuk menjaga persediaan makanan. Dalam akhirat ia memiliki gelar Nyonya Pembenaran yang menghubungkannya dengan Maat.

claims.quote: The verbs "to fondle, to nurse, or rear" help explain the name Renenutet. This goddess was a "nurse" who took care of the pharaoh from birth to death. She was also called "the mistress of provisions", "Renenutet mistress of the offerings", "Renenutet mistress of the food", and "Renenutet the venerable of the double granary", and "who maintains everybody".

statement.id: Ia merawat firaun sejak lahir hingga wafat.
statement.en: She cares for the pharaoh from birth to death.

claims.quote: She was the female counterpart of Shai, "destiny", who represented the positive destiny of the child. Renenutet was called Thermouthis or Hermouthis in Greek. She embodied the fertility of the fields (both the vegetation and the soil itself) and was the protector of the royal office and power.

statement.id: Ia adalah pasangan feminin Shai dan pelindung kewenangan kerajaan.
statement.en: She is Shai’s feminine counterpart and protector of royal power.

claims.quote: Offerings to Renenutet were depicted in Egyptian wine making scenes, and shrines to her were set up in vineyards. Images of her were found in kitchens, near ovens, in granaries, and in cellars. These images often invoked her to protect food stores against insects, mice, and snakes, not just as a provider of food. Her image also appears on stamps and stoppers for wine containers.

statement.id: Gambarnya berada di dapur dan tempat penyimpanan untuk menjaga persediaan makanan.
statement.en: Her images occur in kitchens and stores to protect food supplies.

claims.quote: In the afterlife she appeared as the "Lady of Justification" linking her with the goddess Ma'at.

short_description.en: Sati is the Hindu goddess of marital felicity and longevity and an aspect of Shakti.

long_description.id: Sati adalah dewi Hindu kebahagiaan perkawinan dan umur panjang, serta aspek Shakti. Ia merupakan istri pertama Shiva; Parvati dipandang sebagai kelahirannya kembali.
long_description.en: Sati is the Hindu goddess of marital felicity and longevity and an aspect of Shakti. She is Shiva's first wife; Parvati is regarded as her reincarnation.

long_description.id: Dalam legenda, ia menikahi Shiva bertentangan dengan keinginan ayahnya, Daksha. Bagian tubuh Sati yang jatuh ke bumi dikaitkan dengan tempat suci Shakti pitha. Nama Sati dijelaskan berarti benar, berbudi, atau mulia dalam bahasa Sanskerta. Mackenzie menuturkan Sati terjun ke api pengorbanan setelah ayahnya menghina suaminya.
long_description.en: In legend she marries Shiva against her father Daksha's wishes. Sati's body parts falling to earth are associated with sacred Shakti pithas. The name Sati is explained as truthful, virtuous, or noble in Sanskrit. Mackenzie recounts Sati entering the sacrificial fire after her father slighted her husband.

As Sati, Shiva's wife is the ideal of a true and virtuous
Hindu woman. When Sati's husband was slighted by
her father, the Deva-rishi, Daksha, she cast herself on

pyres of their husbands were called Sati[184], because in performing

short_description.id: Scrofa semilanuta adalah babi betina berbulu domba pada separuh depan tubuhnya, makhluk dalam legenda pendirian Milan dan lambang kuno kota itu.
short_description.en: The scrofa semilanuta is a sow woolly on the front half of its body, a creature of Milan's founding legend and the city's ancient emblem.

long_description.id: Scrofa semilanuta, "babi setengah berbulu domba", adalah makhluk legendaris dan lambang kuno Milan. Menurut legenda yang sebagian bersumber dari Livius, pangeran Galia Belloveso tiba di Lembah Po setelah seorang dewi menunjukkan dalam mimpi tempat kota itu akan berdiri; di sana ia melihat babi betina berbulu domba panjang pada separuh depan tubuhnya. Versi Esperanto menyebut kota itu lalu dinamai Mediolanum.
long_description.en: The scrofa semilanuta, 'half-woollen sow', is a legendary creature and the ancient emblem of Milan. By a legend partly drawn from Livy, the Gaulish prince Belloveso came to the Po Valley after a goddess showed him in a dream where the city would rise; there he saw a sow with long wool on the front half of its body. The Esperanto version says the city was then named Mediolanum.

long_description.id: Penulis kuno seperti Sidonius Apollinaris, Datius, dan Alciato menghubungkannya dengan nama Mediolanum, tafsiran yang kini ditolak para sarjana; versi lain menyebutnya Khimaira setengah babi hutan setengah domba. Claudianus menyebutnya dalam sebuah epitalamium. Relief di Palazzo della Ragione dari masa pembangunan gedung itu (1228–1233) menjadi kunci perdebatan, dan lambang ini dipakai sampai munculnya biscione Visconti.
long_description.en: Ancient writers such as Sidonius Apollinaris, Datius and Alciato tied it to the name Mediolanum, a reading scholars now reject; another version calls it a Chimera, half boar and half ram. Claudian mentions it in an epithalamium. A relief on the Palazzo della Ragione from the building's construction (1228–1233) is central to the debate, and the emblem lasted until the Visconti biscione.

who.en: A half-woollen sow.

role.en: Marked where the city would rise.

famous_for.en: Milan's ancient emblem.

claims.quote: The scrofa semilanuta (English: "half-woollen boar") is an ancient emblem of the city of Milan, Italy, dating back at least to the Middle Ages — and, according to a local legend, to the very foundation of Milan.

statement.id: Scrofa semilanuta ("babi setengah berbulu domba") adalah lambang kuno kota Milan, Italia, yang berasal setidaknya dari Abad Pertengahan dan, menurut legenda setempat, dari saat kota itu didirikan.
statement.en: The scrofa semilanuta ('half-woollen boar') is an ancient emblem of the city of Milan, Italy, dating at least from the Middle Ages and, by local legend, from the city's very foundation.

claims.quote: La scrofa semilanuta è una creatura leggendaria, simbolo della città di Milano prima dell'età comunale, che si riallaccia alla fondazione del capoluogo lombardo, avvenuta ad opera dei Celti.

statement.id: Scrofa semilanuta adalah makhluk legendaris, lambang Milan sebelum masa komune, yang terkait dengan pendirian ibu kota Lombardia itu oleh bangsa Kelt.
statement.en: The scrofa semilanuta is a legendary creature, the symbol of Milan before the communal age, tied to the founding of the Lombard capital by the Celts.

claims.quote: According to this legend (which partially draws from Livy's writings), the founder of Milan was a Gaul prince named Belloveso. Belloveso reached the Po Valley following a vision he had had in a dream, where a goddess showed him the place where the city would rise.

statement.id: Menurut legenda yang sebagian bersumber dari tulisan Livius, pendiri Milan adalah pangeran Galia bernama Belloveso, yang tiba di Lembah Po setelah dalam mimpi seorang dewi menunjukkan tempat kota itu akan berdiri.
statement.en: By this legend, partly drawn from Livy, Milan's founder was a Gaulish prince named Belloveso, who reached the Po Valley after a goddess showed him in a dream where the city would rise.

claims.quote: In this dream, he saw a sow with unusually long wool on the front half of its body.

statement.id: Dalam mimpi itu ia melihat babi betina berbulu domba sangat panjang pada separuh depan tubuhnya.
statement.en: In the dream he saw a sow with unusually long wool on the front half of its body.

claims.quote: La kelta estro decidis tie konstrui sian urbon kaj nomigi ĝin Mediolanum, tio estas "semilanuta" (medio-lanum, duonlaneca).

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Esperanto, pemimpin Kelt itu membangun kotanya di sana dan menamainya Mediolanum, yakni "semilanuta" (medio-lanum, setengah berbulu domba).
statement.en: According to the Esperanto article, the Celtic chief built his city there and named it Mediolanum, that is 'semilanuta' (medio-lanum, half-woollen).

claims.quote: Several ancient sources (including Sidonius Apollinaris, Datius, and, more recently, Andrea Alciato) have argued that the scrofa semilanuta is connected to the etymology of the ancient name of Milan, "Mediolanum", and this is still occasionally mentioned in modern sources, although this interpretation has long been dismissed by scholars.

statement.id: Beberapa sumber kuno, termasuk Sidonius Apollinaris, Datius, dan kemudian Andrea Alciato, mengaitkan scrofa semilanuta dengan asal nama kuno Milan, Mediolanum, tetapi tafsiran ini sudah lama ditolak para sarjana.
statement.en: Several ancient sources, including Sidonius Apollinaris, Datius and later Andrea Alciato, linked the scrofa semilanuta to the origin of Milan's ancient name, Mediolanum, but scholars have long dismissed this.

claims.quote: Other ancient sources (most notably the aforementioned Alciato, who in turns credits Ambrose for his account) report that the half-woolly sow is actually a sort of Chimera — half boar and half ram — and that the emblem came about when the Bituriges and the Aedui, having as their emblems a ram and a boar respectively, joined in the Po Valley.

statement.id: Sumber kuno lain, terutama Alciato yang merujuk Ambrosius, menyebutnya semacam Khimaira setengah babi hutan setengah domba jantan, lambang yang lahir saat kaum Bituriges (lambang domba) dan Aedui (lambang babi hutan) bersatu di Lembah Po.
statement.en: Other ancient sources, notably Alciato citing Ambrose, call it a sort of Chimera, half boar and half ram, an emblem born when the Bituriges (ram) and the Aedui (boar) joined in the Po Valley.

claims.quote: Claudio Claudiano la citò nell'Epithalamium de nuptiis Honorii Augusti.

statement.id: Claudianus menyebutnya dalam Epithalamium de nuptiis Honorii Augusti.
statement.en: Claudian mentioned it in the Epithalamium de nuptiis Honorii Augusti.

claims.quote: A key element of this controversy is a bas relief affixed to the walls of the Palazzo della Ragione, former broletto (administrative building) of the medieval commune of Milan. The bas relief is reportedly a medieval copy of an older one, found during the excavations when the Palazzo was built (1228–1233).

statement.id: Kunci perdebatannya adalah relief di dinding Palazzo della Ragione, gedung pemerintahan komune Milan abad pertengahan, yang konon salinan relief lebih tua yang ditemukan saat gedung itu dibangun (1228–1233).
statement.en: Key to the debate is a bas relief on the wall of the Palazzo della Ragione, the medieval commune's administrative building, reportedly a copy of an older relief found while the Palazzo was built (1228–1233).

claims.quote: In any case, the "scrofa semilanuta" was thereafter adopted as the main emblem of Milan, at least until the advent of the biscione of the House of Visconti. Another (more recent) representation of the "scrofa semilanuta" is found in the internal courtyard of Palazzo Marino (Milan's city hall).

statement.id: Sejak itu scrofa semilanuta menjadi lambang utama Milan setidaknya sampai munculnya biscione Wangsa Visconti; gambaran yang lebih baru ada di halaman dalam Palazzo Marino, balai kota Milan.
statement.en: Thereafter the scrofa semilanuta was Milan's main emblem at least until the Visconti biscione arrived; a more recent depiction is in the inner courtyard of Palazzo Marino, Milan's city hall.

short_description.id: Seileag adalah monster danau dalam cerita rakyat Skotlandia yang dipercaya tinggal di Loch Shiel dan digambarkan berpunuk tiga serta sepanjang 70 kaki.
short_description.en: The Seileag is a loch monster of Scottish folklore believed to live in Loch Shiel, described as having three humps and being 70 feet long.

long_description.id: Seileag adalah monster (ollphéist) yang dipercaya tinggal di Loch Shiel, yang dalam bahasa Gael disebut Loch Seile, di wilayah Highland. Ia termasuk dalam daftar danau di Skotlandia yang menurut cerita rakyat Skotlandia dihuni monster, dan digambarkan memiliki tiga punuk serta panjang 70 kaki.
long_description.en: The Seileag is a monster (ollphéist) believed to live in Loch Shiel, called Loch Seile in Gaelic, in the Highland area. It appears in a list of Scottish lochs said to hold monsters in Scottish folklore, where it is described as having three humps and being 70 feet long.

long_description.id: Loch Shiel adalah danau air tawar yang dalam, sekitar 20 kilometer di sebelah barat Fort William di Lochaber, Skotlandia, dengan kedalaman 120 m. Sifat danau ini berubah di sepanjang badannya: dalam dan diapit pegunungan di timur laut, dangkal dan dikelilingi rawa serta padang rumput kasar di barat daya.
long_description.en: Loch Shiel is a deep freshwater loch some 20 kilometres west of Fort William in Lochaber, Scotland, 120 m deep. Its character changes along its length: deep and enclosed by mountains in the north east, shallow and surrounded by bog and rough pasture in the south west.

short_description.id: Serket adalah dewi Mesir pelindung terhadap sengatan dan gigitan kalajengking.
short_description.en: Serket is an Egyptian goddess protecting against scorpion stings and bites.

long_description.id: Serket adalah dewi Mesir pelindung terhadap sengatan dan gigitan kalajengking. Ia digambarkan dengan kalajengking di kepala, ankh, dan tongkat was.
long_description.en: Serket is an Egyptian goddess protecting against scorpion stings and bites. She is shown with a scorpion on her head, an ankh and a was-sceptre.

long_description.id: Ia berhubungan dengan penyembuhan, sihir, dan perlindungan. Ia melindungi tempat pembalseman dan Qebehsenuef penjaga bejana kanopik. Kitab Dua Jalan menempatkannya sebagai penjaga belokan jalan dunia bawah. Patung emas Serket ditemukan dalam makam Tutankhamun.
long_description.en: She is associated with healing, magic and protection. She protects embalming tents and Qebehsenuef, a guardian of canopic jars. The Book of Two Ways makes her guardian of a bend in the underworld path. A golden statue of Serket is found in Tutankhamun’s tomb.

sources.title: Egyptian Gods - The Complete List - World History Encyclopedia

claims.quote: is the goddess of protection against the venomous stings and bites of scorpions in Egyptian mythology.

statement.id: Serket adalah dewi Mesir pelindung terhadap sengatan dan gigitan kalajengking.
statement.en: Serket is an Egyptian goddess protecting against scorpion stings and bites.

claims.quote: Serket is often depicted as a woman whose head is surmounted by a scorpion ... an ankh in one hand, and a was-sceptre in her other.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan dengan kalajengking di kepala, ankh, dan tongkat was.
statement.en: She is shown with a scorpion on her head, an ankh and a was-sceptre.

claims.quote: She is associated with healing, magic, and protection. Another interpretation of her name is, 'she who gives breath.' As many of the venomous creatures of Egypt could prove fatal, Serket was considered a protector of the dead, particularly being associated with venoms and fluids that cause stiffening.

statement.id: Ia berhubungan dengan penyembuhan, sihir, dan perlindungan.
statement.en: She is associated with healing, magic and protection.

claims.quote: During the Old Kingdom she held a protective role around the throne of the king. However, her primary role was with the funerary cult. She was said to be the protector of the tents of embalmers and is one of the tutelary goddesses depicted on the canopic chest which contains four canopic jars.

statement.id: Ia melindungi tempat pembalseman dan Qebehsenuef penjaga bejana kanopik.
statement.en: She protects embalming tents and Qebehsenuef, a guardian of canopic jars.

claims.quote: During the Middle Kingdom, Egyptian myth says that Serket's help is required in the Underworld where according to the Book of the Two Ways she guards a twist in the pathway. She is also given credit for binding and containing the snake deity, Apophis (or Apep).

statement.id: Kitab Dua Jalan menempatkannya sebagai penjaga belokan jalan dunia bawah.
statement.en: The Book of Two Ways makes her guardian of a bend in the underworld path.

claims.quote: She is best known from her golden statue found in the tomb of Tutankhamun.

statement.id: Patung emas Serket ditemukan dalam makam Tutankhamun.
statement.en: A golden statue of Serket is found in Tutankhamun’s tomb.

short_description.id: Shakchunni adalah hantu perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Bengali, roh perempuan Hindu yang mati sebelum suaminya.
short_description.en: Shakchunni is a female ghost in Bengali folklore, the spirit of a Hindu woman dying before her husband.

long_description.id: Shakchunni adalah hantu perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Bengali, roh perempuan Hindu yang mati sebelum suaminya. Ia mempertahankan gelang kerang shankha dan vermilion sindoor, lambang perkawinan.
long_description.en: Shakchunni is a female ghost in Bengali folklore, the spirit of a Hindu woman dying before her husband. She retains shankha conch bangles and sindoor vermilion, symbols of marriage.

long_description.id: Ia dikisahkan merasuki perempuan menikah untuk mengalami lagi kehidupan rumah tangga. Dalam banyak kisah, ojha akhirnya mengusir atau mengalahkan roh ini. Deskripsi artikel menyebut kulitnya kehijauan dan kain sari merah-putih. Catatan Lal Behari Day menyebut Sankchinni atau Sankhachurni berkulit putih dan tampak seperti kain putih di dekat pohon pada tengah malam. Dalam kisah A Ghostly Wife, Sankchinni menawan seorang istri di lubang pohon dan mengenakan pakaiannya untuk memasuki rumah.
long_description.en: She is said to possess married women to relive household life. In many tales an ojha eventually expels or defeats the spirit. The article's description gives her greenish skin and a red and white sari. Lal Behari Day's note calls Sankchinnis or Sankhachurnis white complexioned, appearing like white cloth near trees at midnight. In A Ghostly Wife a Sankchinni imprisons a wife in a tree hollow and wears her clothes to enter the house.

description.en: Taking a married woman's place

claims.quote: Shakchunni ... is a female ghost in Bengali folklore, ... The term refers to the spirit of a married Hindu woman who died while still married (i.e., before her husband).

statement.id: Shakchunni adalah hantu perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Bengali, roh perempuan Hindu yang mati sebelum suaminya.
statement.en: Shakchunni is a female ghost in Bengali folklore, the spirit of a Hindu woman dying before her husband.

claims.quote: The word Shakchunni is derived from the Sanskrit term Shankhachurni. In Bengali Hindu tradition, married women traditionally wear conch-shell bangles (shankha) and vermilion (sindoor) as symbols of marriage. The Shakchunni is believed to retain these symbols even after death, reflecting her continued attachment to married life.

statement.id: Ia mempertahankan gelang kerang shankha dan vermilion sindoor, lambang perkawinan.
statement.en: She retains shankha conch bangles and sindoor vermilion, symbols of marriage.

claims.quote: According to folklore, a Shakchunni is the spirit of a married woman whose desires and attachments to domestic life remain unfulfilled at the time of her death. She is often portrayed as longing for marital happiness and household life, and is said to possess or influence married women, especially those from affluent households, in order to relive such experiences.

statement.id: Ia dikisahkan merasuki perempuan menikah untuk mengalami lagi kehidupan rumah tangga.
statement.en: She is said to possess married women to relive household life.

claims.quote: Stories featuring Shakchunni appear in traditional Bengali folktales, including those found in collections such as Thakurmar Jhuli. In many narratives, an exorcist (ojha) ultimately defeats or expels her spirit.

statement.id: Dalam banyak kisah, ojha akhirnya mengusir atau mengalahkan roh ini.

short_description.en: Shamash is a Mesopotamian sun deity.

long_description.id: Shamash adalah dewa matahari Mesopotamia. Sippar dan Larsa menjadi pusat pemujaan Shamash yang menonjol.
long_description.en: Shamash is a Mesopotamian sun deity. Sippar and Larsa are prominent centers of Shamash’s worship.

long_description.id: Nanna dan Ningal disebut sebagai orang tua Shamash. Aya atau Sherida disebut sebagai istri Shamash. Shamash dipercaya menguasai keadilan dan melindungi musafir, pedagang, tentara, serta pelaut. Shamash digambarkan memakai bilah untuk membelah jalan melalui gunung saat fajar.
long_description.en: Nanna and Ningal are identified as Shamash’s parents. Aya, also named Sherida, is Shamash’s wife. Shamash governs justice and protects travelers, merchants, soldiers, and sailors. Shamash is depicted cutting a path through mountains with a blade at dawn.

short_description.id: Shu adalah dewa udara primordial dalam mitologi Mesir.
short_description.en: Shu is a primordial air god in Egyptian mythology.

long_description.id: Shu adalah dewa udara primordial dalam mitologi Mesir. Tefnut adalah saudari sekaligus istrinya. Atum menciptakan Shu dan Tefnut dalam kisah Heliopolis.
long_description.en: Shu is a primordial air god in Egyptian mythology. Tefnut is his sister and wife. Atum creates Shu and Tefnut in the Heliopolitan account.

long_description.id: Shu adalah ayah Nut dan Geb. Udara yang diwakilinya dianggap menyejukkan dan menenangkan. Ia digambarkan memakai bulu burung unta sebagai lambang ringan dan kosong. Kabut dan awan juga dikaitkan dengan Shu. Sebuah mitos mengisahkan Tefnut meninggalkan Mesir setelah bertengkar dengan Shu.
long_description.en: Shu is the father of Nut and Geb. The air he represents is considered cooling and calming. He is shown wearing an ostrich feather signifying lightness and emptiness. Mist and clouds are also associated with Shu. One myth tells of Tefnut leaving Egypt after a quarrel with Shu.

long_description.id: Orang Yunani menghubungkannya dengan Atlas yang menopang langit. Ia umumnya berupa manusia, kadang berkepala singa saat membela dewa matahari. Nama Shu diterjemahkan sebagai Kekosongan. Satu kisah mengisahkan Mata Ra mencari Shu dan Tefnut yang lama pergi. Kepulangan mereka membuat Atum menangis bahagia dan air matanya menjadi manusia. Kabut disebut Danau Shu dalam uraian sumber ini. Budge menjelaskan empat pilar di arah mata angin sebagai penopang langit Shu.
long_description.en: The Greeks associate him with Atlas who supports the heavens. He is usually human, sometimes lion-headed when defending the sun god. Shu’s name is translated as Emptiness. One tale has the Eye of Ra search for Shu and Tefnut after a long absence. Their return makes Atum weep for joy and his tears become humans. Mist is called Lakes of Shu in this source. Budge describes four pillars at the cardinal points as Shu’s sky supports.

short_description.id: Sin atau Nanna adalah dewa bulan dan kebijaksanaan Mesopotamia.
short_description.en: Sin, also known as Nanna, is the Mesopotamian deity of the moon and wisdom.

long_description.id: Sin atau Nanna adalah dewa bulan dan kebijaksanaan Mesopotamia. Nanna merupakan nama Sumerianya, sedangkan Sin dan Nanna-Suen adalah nama lainnya.
long_description.en: Sin, also known as Nanna, is the Mesopotamian deity of the moon and wisdom. Nanna is his Sumerian name; Sin and Nanna-Suen are alternative names.

long_description.id: Kuil dan ziggurat di Ur menjadi pusat pemujaannya. Sin disebut sebagai putra Enlil dan Ninlil. Ningal atau Nikkal, dewi kesuburan, disebut sebagai istrinya. Utu-Shamash disebut sebagai putra pasangan itu. Sin juga memiliki kuil penting di Harran. Salah satu penggambaran menunjukkan pria duduk berjanggut lapis lazuli dengan bulan sabit di atasnya. Angka 30 melambangkannya dengan merujuk jumlah hari bulan lunar. Pada bulan baru, Sin dikatakan berada di dunia bawah untuk mengadili orang mati. Dalam Perjalanan Nanna ke Nippur, ia membawa muatan persembahan dari Ur kepada Enlil. Enheduanna disebut sebagai pendeta tingginya yang paling terkenal. Sin dihubungkan dengan kesuburan perempuan dan ternak. Sumber pendamping menggambarkannya sebagai pria berdiri dengan bulan sabit. Dalam teks Turunnya Inanna, Nanna menjadi tujuan permohonan Ninshubur di Urim.
long_description.en: His major cult center is the temple and ziggurat at Ur. Sin is identified as the son of Enlil and Ninlil. Ningal, also called Nikkal, is his wife and a fertility goddess. Utu-Shamash is named as the couple’s son. Sin also has an important temple at Harran. One depiction shows a seated man with a lapis-lazuli beard and a crescent above him. The number 30 represents him through the days of a lunar month. At the new moon, Sin is said to judge the dead in the netherworld. In The Journey of Nanna to Nippur, he loads offerings at Ur to bring to Enlil. Enheduanna is identified as his best-known high priestess. Sin is associated with the fertility of women and cattle. The accompanying source depicts him as a standing man with a crescent moon. In the Descent of Inanna, Nanna is a recipient of Ninshubur’s appeal at Urim.

short_description.id: Sita adalah dewi Hindu dan tokoh perempuan utama dalam Ramayana.
short_description.en: Sita is a Hindu goddess and the principal female character of the Ramayana.

long_description.id: Sita adalah dewi Hindu dan tokoh perempuan utama dalam Ramayana. Siya, Janaki, dan Maithili merupakan nama lain Sita.
long_description.en: Sita is a Hindu goddess and the principal female character of the Ramayana. Siya, Janaki, and Maithili are other names of Sita.

long_description.id: Ia adalah pasangan Rama dan dipandang sebagai penjelmaan Lakshmi. Sita disebut putri Bhumi dan anak angkat Raja Janaka dari Videha. Ia memilih Rama dari Ayodhya sebagai suami dalam svayamvara. Ia mengikuti pengasingan Rama bersama Lakshmana. Ravana menculiknya dari hutan Dandaka dan menahannya di taman Ashoka Vatika di Lanka. Dalam sebagian versi, Sita membuktikan kesuciannya melalui ujian api Agni Pariksha. Versi lain menyebut Maya Sita menggantikannya saat diculik, sementara Sita asli berlindung dalam api. Sejumlah teks menghubungkan kehidupan terdahulunya dengan Vedavati. Dalam kelanjutan kisah, Sita berlindung di asrama Valmiki dan melahirkan anak kembar Kusha dan Lava. Akhir kisah tersebut menuturkan kembalinya Sita ke bumi, ibunya. Nama Sita berasal dari kata Sanskerta yang berarti alur bajakan. Mackenzie juga menempatkan Sita sebagai penjelmaan manusia Lakshmi dalam Ramayana. Lukisan yang dibahas Museum Carlos menggambarkan Ravana membawa Sita dari pertapaan di hutan.
long_description.en: She is Rama's consort and is regarded as an incarnation of Lakshmi. Sita is described as Bhumi's daughter and King Janaka of Videha's adopted child. She chooses Rama of Ayodhya as her husband in a svayamvara. She accompanies Rama into exile with Lakshmana. Ravana abducts her from the Dandaka forest and holds her in Ashoka Vatika garden in Lanka. In some versions, Sita demonstrates her chastity through the Agni Pariksha fire ordeal. Other versions say Maya Sita replaces her during the abduction while the real Sita shelters in fire. Some texts connect her previous birth with Vedavati. In the continuation, Sita shelters in Valmiki's ashram and gives birth to twins Kusha and Lava. That ending recounts Sita's return to the earth, her mother. The name Sita derives from a Sanskrit word meaning furrow. Mackenzie also places Sita as Lakshmi's human incarnation in the Ramayana. The painting discussed by the Carlos Museum depicts Ravana carrying Sita away from a forest hermitage.

claims.quote: Described as the daughter of Bhūmi (the earth), Sita is brought up as the adopted daughter of King Janaka of Videha. Sita, in her youth, chooses Rama, the prince of Ayodhya, as her husband in a svayamvara. After the svayamvara, she accompanies her husband to his kingdom but later chooses to accompany him along with her brother-in-law Lakshmana in his exile.

statement.id: Sita disebut putri Bhumi dan anak angkat Raja Janaka dari Videha.
statement.en: Sita is described as Bhumi's daughter and King Janaka of Videha's adopted child.

claims.quote: Described as the daughter of Bhūmi (the earth), Sita is brought up as the adopted daughter of King Janaka of Videha. Sita, in her youth, chooses Rama, the prince of Ayodhya, as her husband in a svayamvara. After the svayamvara, she accompanies her husband to his kingdom but later chooses to accompany him along with her brother-in-law Lakshmana in his exile.

statement.id: Ia memilih Rama dari Ayodhya sebagai suami dalam svayamvara.
statement.en: She chooses Rama of Ayodhya as her husband in a svayamvara.

claims.quote: Described as the daughter of Bhūmi (the earth), Sita is brought up as the adopted daughter of King Janaka of Videha. Sita, in her youth, chooses Rama, the prince of Ayodhya, as her husband in a svayamvara. After the svayamvara, she accompanies her husband to his kingdom but later chooses to accompany him along with her brother-in-law Lakshmana in his exile.

statement.id: Ia mengikuti pengasingan Rama bersama Lakshmana.
statement.en: She accompanies Rama into exile with Lakshmana.

claims.quote: While in exile, the trio settles in the Dandaka forest from where she is abducted by Ravana, the Rakshasa king of Lanka. She is imprisoned in the garden of Ashoka Vatika in Lanka until she is rescued by Rama, who slays her captor.

statement.id: Ravana menculiknya dari hutan Dandaka dan menahannya di taman Ashoka Vatika di Lanka.
statement.en: Ravana abducts her from the Dandaka forest and holds her in Ashoka Vatika garden in Lanka.

claims.quote: After the war, in some versions of the epic, Rama asks Sita to undergo Agni Pariksha (an ordeal of fire), by which she proves her chastity, before she is accepted by Rama. Such an episode of trial makes Lakshmana angry at Rama, for the first time.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian versi, Sita membuktikan kesuciannya melalui ujian api Agni Pariksha.
statement.en: In some versions, Sita demonstrates her chastity through the Agni Pariksha fire ordeal.

claims.quote: In some other versions of the epic, Maya Sita, an illusion created by Agni, takes Sita's place and is abducted by Ravana and suffers his captivity, while the real Sita hides in the fire.

statement.id: Versi lain menyebut Maya Sita menggantikannya saat diculik, sementara Sita asli berlindung dalam api.
statement.en: Other versions say Maya Sita replaces her during the abduction while the real Sita shelters in fire.

claims.quote: Some scriptures also mention her previous birth as Vedavati, a woman Ravana tries to molest.

statement.id: Sejumlah teks menghubungkan kehidupan terdahulunya dengan Vedavati.
statement.en: Some texts connect her previous birth with Vedavati.

claims.quote: She takes shelter at Sage Valmiki's ashram. She gives birth to twin sons there: Kusha and Lava.

statement.id: Dalam kelanjutan kisah, Sita berlindung di asrama Valmiki dan melahirkan anak kembar Kusha dan Lava.
statement.en: In the continuation, Sita shelters in Valmiki's ashram and gives birth to twins Kusha and Lava.

claims.quote: Years later, Sita reunites her two sons with their father Rama and then returns to the womb of her mother, the earth, as a testimony to her ultimate purity.

statement.id: Akhir kisah tersebut menuturkan kembalinya Sita ke bumi, ibunya.
statement.en: That ending recounts Sita's return to the earth, her mother.

claims.quote: The goddess is best known by the name "Sita", derived from the Sanskrit word sīta, ("furrow".)

statement.id: Nama Sita berasal dari kata Sanskerta yang berarti alur bajakan.
statement.en: The name Sita derives from a Sanskrit word meaning furrow.

claims.quote:
She has had several
human incarnations, and in each case was loved by the
incarnation of Vishnu. She is Sita in the Ramáyana, and
the beautiful herdswoman beloved by Krishna.

statement.id: Mackenzie juga menempatkan Sita sebagai penjelmaan manusia Lakshmi dalam Ramayana.
statement.en: Mackenzie also places Sita as Lakshmi's human incarnation in the Ramayana.

claims.quote: Ravana carries Sita away from her opulent hermitage in the highly stylized forest

statement.id: Lukisan yang dibahas Museum Carlos menggambarkan Ravana membawa Sita dari pertapaan di hutan.
statement.en: The painting discussed by the Carlos Museum depicts Ravana carrying Sita away from a forest hermitage.

summary.en: Sita is abducted by Ravana.

summary.id: Maya Sita menggantikannya.
summary.en: Maya Sita takes her place.

short_description.id: Sopdu adalah dewa langit dan kawasan perbatasan timur Mesir.
short_description.en: Sopdu is an Egyptian god of the sky and eastern border regions.

long_description.id: Sopdu adalah dewa langit dan kawasan perbatasan timur Mesir. Horus-Sopdu disebut anak Osiris-Sah dan Isis-Sopdet dalam Teks Piramida.
long_description.en: Sopdu is an Egyptian god of the sky and eastern border regions. Horus-Sopdu is called the offspring of Osiris-Sah and Isis-Sopdet in the Pyramid Texts.

long_description.id: Ia menjaga pos-pos perbatasan dan membantu firaun mengendalikan kawasan timur. Namanya diterjemahkan sebagai yang tajam dan dihubungkan dengan perlindungan gigi raja wafat. Ia digambarkan sebagai elang atau prajurit dengan kapak atau tombak. Ia membantu memastikan persediaan sampai ke garnisun timur.
long_description.en: He protects frontier outposts and helps the pharaoh control the eastern regions. His name is translated as sharp ones and connected with protecting the dead king’s teeth. He is depicted as a falcon or a warrior with an axe or spear. He helps ensure supplies reach eastern garrisons.

sources.title: Egyptian Gods - The Complete List - World History Encyclopedia

claims.quote:
Sopdu (also rendered Septu or Sopedu) was a god of the sky and of eastern border regions in the religion of Ancient Egypt.
He was Khensit's husband.

statement.id: Sopdu adalah dewa langit dan kawasan perbatasan timur Mesir.
statement.en: Sopdu is an Egyptian god of the sky and eastern border regions.

claims.quote: As a sky god, Sopdu was connected with the god Sah, the personification of the constellation Orion, and the goddess Sopdet, representing the star Sirius. According to the Pyramid Texts, Horus-Sopdu, a combination of Sopdu and the greater sky god Horus, is the offspring of Osiris-Sah and Isis-Sopdet.

statement.id: Horus-Sopdu disebut anak Osiris-Sah dan Isis-Sopdet dalam Teks Piramida.
statement.en: Horus-Sopdu is called the offspring of Osiris-Sah and Isis-Sopdet in the Pyramid Texts.

claims.quote: As a god of the east, Sopdu was said to protect Egyptian outposts along the frontiers and to help the pharaoh control those regions' foreign inhabitants. He was referred to as Lord of the East, and had his greatest cult centre at the easternmost nome of Lower Egypt, which was named Per-Sopdu, meaning place of Sopdu.

statement.id: Ia menjaga pos-pos perbatasan dan membantu firaun mengendalikan kawasan timur.
statement.en: He protects frontier outposts and helps the pharaoh control the eastern regions.

claims.quote: Sopdu's name is composed of the hieroglyph for sharp, a pointed triangle, and the 3rd person plural suffix (a quail); thus a literal translation of his name is sharp ones. He was said, in the Pyramid Texts, to protect the teeth of the deceased pharaoh.

statement.id: Namanya diterjemahkan sebagai yang tajam dan dihubungkan dengan perlindungan gigi raja wafat.
statement.en: His name is translated as sharp ones and connected with protecting the dead king’s teeth.

claims.quote: Sopdu was depicted as a falcon sitting on a religious standard, often with a two-feathered crown on his head and a flail over his shoulder. In his border-guarding role he was shown as a Near Eastern warrior, with a shemset girdle and an axe or spear.

statement.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai elang atau prajurit dengan kapak atau tombak.
statement.en: He is depicted as a falcon or a warrior with an axe or spear.

claims.quote: he ensured the proper resources reached the eastern border garrisons

statement.id: Ia membantu memastikan persediaan sampai ke garnisun timur.
statement.en: He helps ensure supplies reach eastern garrisons.

short_description.id: Sulis adalah dewi Kelt yang dipuja di mata air panas Bath, Britania, dan oleh orang Romawi-Britania disebut Sulis Minerva.
short_description.en: Sulis is a Celtic goddess worshipped at the hot spring of Bath in Britain, called Sulis Minerva by the Romano-British.

long_description.id: Dalam politeisme Kelt (Celtic) setempat di Britania Raya (Great Britain), Sulis adalah dewi yang dipuja di mata air panas Bath. Orang Romawi-Britania (Romano-British) memujanya sebagai Sulis Minerva; benda persembahan dan lempeng timah bertulisan menunjukkan bahwa ia dipandang sebagai dewi ibu yang memberi hidup sekaligus sebagai pelaksana kutukan yang diminta pemujanya. Makna namanya masih diperdebatkan, tetapi banyak ahli bahasa menganggapnya sekerabat dengan kata Irlandia Kuno (Old Irish) súil, "mata, penglihatan". Menurut artikel de, Sulis adalah dewi matahari (Sonnen) dan penyembuhan (Heil-Gottheit) bangsa Kelt Britania yang disamakan dengan Minerva.
long_description.en: In the local Celtic polytheism of Great Britain, Sulis was the goddess worshipped at Bath's thermal spring. The Romano-British honoured her as Sulis Minerva; offerings and inscribed lead tablets show her seen both as a life-giving mother goddess and as an agent of curses her worshippers called down. The meaning of her name is debated, but many linguists tie it to Old Irish súil, 'eye, sight'. According to the de article she was a sun (Sonnen) and healing (Heil-Gottheit) goddess of the British Celts, equated with Minerva.

long_description.id: Bentuk Sul adalah bacaan tradisional, tetapi tahun 1979 ditemukan lempeng kutukan timah di mata air suci Aquae Sulis yang memuat frasa "dea Sulis", satu-satunya contoh nama itu dalam kasus nominatif. Orang Romawi menamai tempat itu Aquae Sulis, "perairan Sulis"; ia kemungkinan dipuja sebagai penyembuh yang mata air panasnya dapat menyembuhkan penyakit, dan menurut Miranda Green pemujaannya di Bath aktif hingga pertengahan abad keempat Masehi. Di mata air itu ditemukan lebih dari 12.500 koin Romawi dan 18 koin Kelt, serta sekitar 130 lempeng kutukan yang kebanyakan ditujukan kepada Sulis.
long_description.en: Sul is the traditional reading, but in 1979 a lead curse tablet from the sacred spring of Aquae Sulis was found bearing the words 'dea Sulis', the only instance of the name in the nominative. The Romans called the place Aquae Sulis, 'the waters of Sulis'; she was probably honoured as a healer whose hot springs could cure illness, and according to Miranda Green her cult at Bath lasted until the mid-fourth century CE. Over 12,500 Roman and 18 Celtic coins were recovered from the spring, along with about 130 curse tablets, most addressed to Sulis.

claims.quote: Sulis was a deity worshipped at the thermal spring of Bath. She was worshipped by the Romano-British as Sulis Minerva, whose votive objects and inscribed lead tablets suggest that she was conceived of both as a nourishing, life-giving mother goddess and as an effective agent of curses invoked by her votaries.

statement.id: Sulis dewi mata air panas Bath, dipuja orang Romawi-Britania (Romano-British) sebagai Sulis Minerva, dewi ibu pemberi hidup dan pelaksana kutukan; Kelt (Celtic) di Britania Raya (Great Britain).
statement.en: Sulis was the deity of Bath's thermal spring, worshipped by the Romano-British as Sulis Minerva, a life-giving mother goddess and agent of curses.

claims.quote: an emerging consensus among linguists regards the name as cognate with Old Irish súil ("eye, sight").

statement.id: Banyak ahli bahasa menganggap nama itu sekerabat dengan Irlandia Kuno (Old Irish) súil, mata.
statement.en: Linguists increasingly see the name as cognate with Old Irish súil, eye.

statement.id: Sul bacaan baku sampai ditemukan lempeng kutukan 1979 di Aquae Sulis berisi dea Sulis, satu-satunya bentuk nominatif.
statement.en: Sul was standard until a 1979 curse tablet from Aquae Sulis read dea Sulis, the only nominative instance.

claims.quote: Sulis was the local goddess of the thermal springs that still feed the spa baths at Bath, which the Romans called Aquae Sulis ("the waters of Sulis"). Sulis was likely venerated as a healing divinity, whose sacred hot springs could cure physical or spiritual suffering and illness.

statement.en: The Romans called Bath Aquae Sulis, the waters of Sulis; she was likely a healing goddess.

statement.en: According to Miranda Green the cult of Sulis at Bath lasted to the mid-fourth century CE.

statement.id: Sulis dewi matahari dan penyembuhan (Sonnen- und Heil-Gottheit) Kelt Britania (britannischen Kelten), disamakan dengan Minerva menurut Interpretatio Romana.
statement.en: Sulis is a sun and healing goddess of the British Celts, equated with Minerva under the Interpretatio Romana.

short_description.id: Surya adalah dewa matahari dalam tradisi Hindu yang diceritakan melintasi langit dengan kereta tujuh kuda.
short_description.en: Surya is the Hindu sun god who travels across the sky in a chariot drawn by seven horses.

long_description.id: Surya, juga disebut Aditya, adalah dewa matahari dalam tradisi Hindu. Ia dipandang sebagai sumber kehidupan; kisahnya menempatkan Aruna sebagai pengemudi kereta emas yang ditarik tujuh kuda. Namanya telah muncul dalam Rigveda dan ia dikaitkan dengan sembilan benda langit kuno.
long_description.en: Surya, also called Aditya, is the Hindu sun god. He is regarded as a source of life; Aruna drives his golden chariot pulled by seven horses. He appears in the Rigveda and is regarded as chief of the nine ancient planets.

long_description.id: Silsilah Surya berbeda antar kisah: ia disebut putra Kasyapa dan Aditi, atau Dyaus, atau Brahma. Bersama Samjna ia memiliki Vaivasvata, Yama, dan Yami. Kisah lain mengatakan Surya menyamar sebagai kuda jantan untuk bertemu kembali dengan Samjna.
long_description.en: Surya has varying genealogies: he is named a son of Kasyapa and Aditi, or of Dyaus, or of Brahma. With Samjna he fathers Vaivasvata, Yama and Yami. Another account says he took the form of a stallion to reunite with Samjna.

long_description.id: Pemujaannya terkait dengan perayaan Pongal dan mantra Gayatri. Tradisi Smarta menghitungnya di antara lima dewa utama. Kuil di Konarak menjadi penggambaran raksasa kereta matahari dengan dua belas pasang roda dan tujuh kuda.
long_description.en: His worship is linked to Pongal and the Gayatri mantra. The Smarta tradition counts him among five major deities. The temple at Konarak depicts a monumental sun chariot with twelve pairs of wheels and seven horses.

note.en: Aruna drives Surya’s chariot.

note.en: Samjna is Surya’s consort in accounts of their children.

note.id: Yama disebut putra Surya dan Samjna.
note.en: Yama is named a child of Surya and Samjna.

claims.quote: Surya (also known as Aditya) is the Hindu god of the Sun.

statement.en: Surya is the Hindu god of the Sun.

claims.quote: Each day he travels across the sky in his golden chariot pulled by seven horses and driven by red Aruna, a personification of Dawn.

statement.id: Aruna mengemudikan kereta emas Surya yang ditarik tujuh kuda.
statement.en: Aruna drives Surya’s seven-horse golden chariot.

claims.quote: He is considered the creator of the universe and the source of all life.

statement.id: Surya dipandang sebagai sumber kehidupan.
statement.en: Surya is regarded as a source of life.

statement.id: Surya muncul dalam Rigveda.

statement.en: Some myths name Kasyapa and Aditi as Surya’s parents.

claims.quote: in others he is the offspring of Dyaus (Sky), and in still others his father is Brahma

claims.quote: Surya had three offspring with Samjna (Conscience), the daughter of Visvakarma.

claims.quote: These were Vaivasvata (one of the 14 original men or Manu), Yama (god of the dead), and Yami (goddess of the Yamuna river).

statement.id: Anak Surya dan Samjna ialah Vaivasvata, Yama, dan Yami.
statement.en: Their children are Vaivasvata, Yama, and Yami.

claims.quote: Surya was not to be so easily deprived though and disguised as a stallion mated with Samjna.

statement.id: Surya menyamar sebagai kuda jantan untuk bersatu dengan Samjna.
statement.en: Surya took stallion form to mate with Samjna.

claims.quote: Surya is considered the chief of the nine planets of Vedic antiquity.

statement.id: Surya dipandang sebagai pemimpin sembilan benda langit kuno.
statement.en: Surya is regarded as chief of the nine ancient planets.

claims.quote: He is celebrated during the harvest festival of Pongal in southern India and by Tamils in general.

statement.id: Surya dirayakan pada festival Pongal.

claims.quote: Surya appears in the important Gayatri mantra which is recited from the Vedas as a preliminary to its study.

short_description.id: Susanoo adalah kami Jepang yang kisahnya mencakup perselisihan di langit dan kemenangan atas ular Yamata no Orochi di Izumo.
short_description.en: Susanoo is a kami whose stories include conflict in heaven and victory over the serpent Yamata no Orochi in Izumo.

long_description.id: Dalam Kojiki, Susanoo muncul dari hidung Izanagi ketika sang dewa menyucikan diri setelah kembali dari Yomi. Nihongi menyajikan asal-usul lain: Susanoo lahir dari Izanagi dan Izanami. Kedua kisah menempatkannya bersama Amaterasu dan Tsukuyomi sebagai tiga anak mulia.
long_description.en: In the Kojiki, Susanoo emerges from Izanagi’s nose during purification after his return from Yomi. The Nihongi offers another origin: Susanoo is born to Izanagi and Izanami. Both accounts place him alongside Amaterasu and Tsukuyomi among the three noble children.

long_description.id: Susanoo dikaitkan dengan angin dan hujan. Kisahnya menceritakan bahwa ia diusir setelah tindakannya membuat Amaterasu bersembunyi dalam gua langit. Di Izumo ia membunuh Yamata no Orochi dan memperoleh pedang Kusanagi; kisah kuil setempat menyebut ia kemudian menikahi putri pasangan yang diselamatkannya.
long_description.en: Susanoo is associated with wind and rain. His story says he was banished after his actions drove Amaterasu into a heavenly cave. In Izumo he slew Yamata no Orochi and acquired the sword Kusanagi; a local shrine account says he then married the rescued couple’s daughter.

claims.quote: A kami introduced by (Kojiki) as having come into being from the nose of Izanagi no mikoto as he was performing ablutions (misogi) to rid himself of pollution encountered while in the underworld (Yomi).

statement.id: Menurut Kojiki, Susanoo adalah kami yang muncul dari hidung Izanagi ketika ia menyucikan diri sesudah mengunjungi Yomi.
statement.en: According to the Kojiki, Susanoo is a kami who emerged from Izanagi’s nose during purification after a visit to Yomi.

claims.quote: The Izumo region and Izumo Oyashiro Shrine feature prominently in several of Japan’s earliest myths.

statement.id: Kisah Izumo termasuk mitos awal Jepang.
statement.en: The stories of Izumo feature in Japan’s early myths.

claims.quote: In Nihongi, however, Susanoo is described as being produced by Izanagi and Izanami

statement.id: Nihongi menyebut Susanoo lahir dari Izanagi dan Izanami.
statement.en: The Nihongi says Susanoo was born to Izanagi and Izanami.

claims.quote: Both accounts describe Susanoo as one of a set of three kami known as the "three noble children," the other being Amaterasu and Tsukuyomi

statement.id: Kedua sumber menempatkan Susanoo bersama Amaterasu dan Tsukuyomi sebagai tiga anak mulia.
statement.en: Both accounts place Susanoo with Amaterasu and Tsukuyomi among the three noble children.

claims.quote: Susanoo has been associated with wind and rain, but many elements of his personality remain unclear.

statement.id: Susanoo dikaitkan dengan angin dan hujan.
statement.en: Susanoo has been associated with wind and rain.

claims.quote: Susanoo ran amok and caused Amaterasu to hide herself away in the heavenly cave, for which offense Susanoo was again banished.

statement.id: Susanoo diusir setelah menyebabkan Amaterasu bersembunyi di gua langit.
statement.en: Susanoo was banished after causing Amaterasu to hide in the heavenly cave.

claims.quote: Susanoo defeated the serpent Yamata no orochi, received the sword "Kusanagi"

statement.id: Susanoo mengalahkan Yamata no Orochi dan memperoleh pedang Kusanagi.

short_description.id: Takamimusubi adalah dewa penciptaan Jepang yang muncul di antara makhluk pertama.
short_description.en: Takamimusubi is a Japanese creation deity among the first beings.

long_description.id: Takamimusubi adalah dewa penciptaan Jepang yang muncul di antara makhluk pertama. Kojiki menggolongkannya sebagai hitorigami. Menurut Kojiki, ia muncul setelah Ame-no-Minakanushi dan sebelum Kamimusubi.
long_description.en: Takamimusubi is a Japanese creation deity among the first beings. The Kojiki classifies Takamimusubi as a hitorigami. The Kojiki places it after Ame-no-Minakanushi and before Kamimusubi.

long_description.id: Ia dikisahkan memerintah Takamagahara bersama Amaterasu. Sebuah kisah menyebut burung Nakime diutus menemui Amewakahiko. Dalam kisah itu Takamimusubi melempar panah kembali ke bumi dan menewaskan Amewakahiko. Pada masa kemudian, Takamimusubi juga dipuja sebagai dewa perjodohan.
long_description.en: It is said to rule Takamagahara with Amaterasu. One tale says Nakime the bird was sent to visit Amewakahiko. In that story Takamimusubi throws an arrow back to earth and kills Amewakahiko. In later periods Takamimusubi was also worshipped as a matchmaking deity.

short_description.id: Takehiratori adalah dewa Jepang yang disamakan dengan beberapa nama kronik melalui silsilah Izumo.
short_description.en: Takehiratori is a Japanese deity identified with several chronicle names through Izumo genealogies.

long_description.id: Takehiratori adalah dewa Jepang yang disamakan dengan beberapa nama kronik melalui silsilah Izumo. Satu tafsir membaca namanya sebagai burung pemberani yang melintasi batas. Kojiki menjadikannya anak Amenohohi dan leluhur beberapa garis keturunan daerah.
long_description.en: Takehiratori is a Japanese deity identified with several chronicle names through Izumo genealogies. One interpretation reads his name as a brave bird crossing a boundary. The Kojiki makes him Amenohohi’s child and an ancestor of several local lineages.

long_description.id: Nihon Shoki menyebutnya mengikuti tugas ayahnya ke bumi dan juga tidak mengirim laporan. Terjemahan universitas menegaskan Takehiratori sebagai anak Amenohohi. Catatan terjemahan menafsirkan take sebagai gagah, sementara hira tetap tidak pasti.
long_description.en: The Nihon Shoki says he follows his father’s earthly mission and likewise sends no report. The university’s translation confirms Takehiratori as Amenohohi’s child. The translation notes interpret take as stalwart while leaving hira uncertain.

short_description.id: Tam Kung adalah dewa laut yang dipuja di Hong Kong dan Makau.
short_description.en: Tam Kung is a sea deity worshipped in Hong Kong and Macau.

long_description.id: Tam Kung adalah dewa laut yang dipuja di Hong Kong dan Makau. Legenda memberinya kemampuan meramalkan cuaca dan menyembuhkan sejak kecil.
long_description.en: Tam Kung is a sea deity worshipped in Hong Kong and Macau. Legend credits him with forecasting weather and healing from childhood.

long_description.id: Kisah menyebut ia menjadi makhluk abadi pada usia dua puluh di Gunung Sembilan Naga. Penduduk mendanai pembangunan kuil di Shau Kei Wan pada 1905. Komite Kuil Tiongkok mengelola kuil tersebut sejak 1928. Komite Kuil menyebut penggambaran Tam Kung sebagai sosok muda berwajah segar dan memiliki kemampuan mengatur angin serta hujan.
long_description.en: The tale says he becomes immortal at twenty on Nine-dragon Mountain. Residents funded construction of the Shau Kei Wan temple in 1905. The Chinese Temples Committee has managed the temple since 1928. The Temples Committee describes Tam Kung as youthful and credits him with commanding wind and rain.

sources.title: Tam Kung Temple, Shau Kei Wan - Chinese Temples Committee

claims.quote: Tam Kung (Chinese: 譚公; lit. 'Lord Tam') or Tam Tai Sin (譚大仙) is a sea deity worshiped in Hong Kong and Macau.
