short_description.id: Aza adalah sebutan bagi roh jahat dalam mitologi Turk, Altai, Yakut, Chuvash, dan Mongol, yaitu makhluk tak berwujud yang tinggal di kegelapan bawah tanah.
short_description.en: Aza is the name for evil spirits in Turkic, Altai, Yakut, Chuvash and Mongol mythology: mostly formless beings that dwell in the darkness underground.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Turk, Altai, Yakut, Chuvash, dan Mongol, Aza adalah roh jahat. Namanya juga diucapkan Asa, orang Mongol menyebutnya Ada, dan dalam mitologi Yakut ia dikenal sebagai Abası. Secara umum, nama ini dipakai untuk seluruh roh dan makhluk yang berniat buruk.
long_description.en: In Turkic, Altai, Yakut, Chuvash and Mongol mythology the Aza is an evil spirit. The name is also pronounced Asa, the Mongols call it Ada, and Yakut mythology knows it as Abası. Broadly, the name covers every spirit and being of ill intent.

long_description.id: Menurut kepercayaan, para Aza tinggal di kediaman gelap di bawah tanah. Mereka biasanya tidak tampak; orang hanya mendengar suara dan kegaduhan mereka, sehingga banyak yang enggan melewati reruntuhan karena takut.
long_description.en: According to belief, the Aza live in dark dwellings below the earth. They are usually unseen; people hear only their voices and clamour, so many avoid passing through ruins out of fear.

long_description.id: Di kalangan Oyrot, nama ini mencakup ke-13 kategori roh jahat, dan lawannya adalah Aya. Ada sumber yang membaginya menjadi Azabuk (roh jahat), Azaşulbus (penyihir jahat), dan Azahortan (hantu jahat). Orang Kumandı membedakan dua golongan: Çertegri yang disamakan dengan Setan dan merupakan Aza paling berbahaya, serta Çor yang lebih mirip jin.
long_description.en: Among the Oyrots the name covers all 13 categories of evil spirit, and its opposite is Aya. Some sources divide it into Azabuk (evil spirits), Azaşulbus (evil witches) and Azahortan (evil revenants). The Kumandy distinguish two classes: the Çertegri, identified with Satan and the most dangerous of the Aza, and the Çor, who resemble jinn.

long_description.id: Ungkapan Azar-Bazar semula adalah nama roh-roh setan, tetapi kemudian bergeser makna menjadi 'segala macam penyakit'. Pada Rabu terakhir dalam setahun, orang di pedesaan Azerbaijan melompati api unggun sambil mengucapkan rumus pengusir Azar-Bazar. Karakurt juga mengaitkan Aza dengan Azar, roh yang dalam Syamanisme Asia memaksa calon syaman dengan menyiksanya lewat penyakit.
long_description.en: The phrase Azar-Bazar was originally the names of devilish spirits but later came to mean 'every kind of illness'. On the last Wednesday of the year, people in rural Azerbaijan jump over bonfires while reciting a formula casting off Azar-Bazar. Karakurt also links the Aza to the Azar, a spirit in Asian Shamanism that compels a would-be shaman by tormenting them with illness.

who.id: Aza adalah sebutan umum bagi roh-roh jahat.
who.en: Aza is a general name for evil spirits.

origin.id: Ia dikenal dalam mitologi Turk, Altai, Yakut, Chuvash, dan Mongol.
origin.en: It is known in Turkic, Altai, Yakut, Chuvash and Mongol mythology.

role.id: Para Aza dihubungkan dengan kejahatan dan penyakit yang menimpa manusia.
role.en: The Aza are linked to the harm and illness that befall people.

famous_for.id: Mereka jarang terlihat dan hanya terdengar suaranya di reruntuhan.
famous_for.en: They are rarely seen and are known only by their voices among ruins.

did_you_know.id: Ungkapan Azar-Bazar, yang kini berarti 'segala macam penyakit', semula adalah nama roh-roh setan.
did_you_know.en: The phrase Azar-Bazar, which now means 'every kind of illness', was originally the names of devilish spirits.

description.id: Nama Aza dalam mitologi Yakut.
description.en: The name of the Aza in Yakut mythology.

note.en: Aya is named as the opposite of the Aza.

note.id: Roh pemaksa calon syaman yang dikaitkan Karakurt dengan konsep Aza.
note.en: The spirit that compels would-be shamans, which Karakurt links to the Aza concept.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa makhluk yang tidak terlihat dapat membuat orang menghindari tempat tertentu seperti reruntuhan?
learning_questions.en: Why might beings that cannot be seen lead people to avoid certain places such as ruins?

claims.quote: Aza; Türk, Altay, Yakut, Çuvaş ve Moğol mitolojisinde kötü ruh. Asa şeklinde de söylenir. Moğollar Ada derler.

statement.id: Aza adalah roh jahat (kötü ruh) dalam mitologi Turk, Altai, Yakut, Chuvash (Çuvaş), dan Mongol (Moğol); juga diucapkan Asa, dan orang Mongol menyebutnya Ada.
statement.en: Aza is an evil spirit (kötü ruh) in Turkic (Türk), Altai (Altay), Yakut, Chuvash (Çuvaş) and Mongol (Moğol) mythology; it is also pronounced Asa, and the Mongols call it Ada.

claims.quote: Yeraltındaki karanlık yurtlarında yaşarlar. Genel olarak kötücül ruhların ve kötü varlıkların tamamına verilen bir addır.

statement.id: Para Aza tinggal di kediaman gelap di bawah tanah (yeraltı); nama ini secara umum dipakai untuk semua roh dan makhluk jahat.
statement.en: The Aza live in dark dwellings underground (yeraltı); the name is generally given to all malevolent spirits and evil beings.

claims.quote: Çoğu zaman, görüntüleri yoktur, yalnızca sesleri ve çıkardıkları gürültüler işitilir. İnsanlar onlardan korktukları için harabelerde ve kalıntılarda gezmeye çekinirler.

statement.id: Biasanya Aza tidak berwujud; hanya suara dan bunyi gaduh (gürültü) mereka yang terdengar, dan orang enggan berjalan di reruntuhan (harabe) karena takut kepada mereka.
statement.en: Usually the Aza have no visible form; only their voices and noises (gürültü) are heard, and people avoid walking among ruins (harabe) out of fear of them.

claims.quote: Oyrotlarda 13 farklı kötücül ruh kategorisinin tamamını anlatır. Karşıtı Aya’dır.

statement.id: Di kalangan Oyrot, nama ini mencakup ke-13 kategori roh jahat; lawannya adalah Aya.
statement.en: Among the Oyrots (Oyrotlarda) the name covers all 13 categories of evil spirit; its opposite is Aya.

claims.quote: Azabuk: Kötücül ruhlar. Azaşulbus: Kötücül cadılar. Azahortan: Kötücül hortlaklar.

statement.id: Beberapa sumber menyebut tiga jenis: Azabuk (roh jahat), Azaşulbus (penyihir jahat, cadı), dan Azahortan (hantu jahat, hortlak).
statement.en: Some sources list three kinds: Azabuk (evil spirits), Azaşulbus (evil witches, cadı) and Azahortan (evil revenants, hortlak).

claims.quote: Yakut mitolojisinde Abası adı ile kullanılır. Kumandılarda ise iki farklı sınıf olarak yer alırlar.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Yakut, Aza dikenal dengan nama Abası, sedangkan di kalangan Kumandı mereka dibagi menjadi dua golongan.
statement.en: In Yakut mythology the Aza go by the name Abası, while among the Kumandy (Kumandılarda) they form two separate classes.

claims.quote: Çertegriler Türk ve Altay mitolojisinde ve halk inanışında Şeytan ile özdeşleşmiştir. Azaların en tehlikeli ve en kötüleridir. İnsanlara geri dönüşü olmayan zararlar verebilirler.

statement.id: Çertegri, salah satu golongan itu, disamakan dengan Setan (Şeytan); mereka adalah Aza yang paling berbahaya dan paling jahat, dan dapat menimbulkan kerugian yang tidak terpulihkan bagi manusia.
statement.en: The Çertegri, one of these classes, are identified with Satan (Şeytan); they are the most dangerous and wicked of the Aza and can do people irreversible harm.

claims.quote: Çorlar ise daha çok cinlere benzeyen varlıklardır.

statement.id: Golongan lain, Çor, adalah makhluk yang lebih mirip jin (cin).
statement.en: The other class, the Çor, are beings more like jinn (cin).

claims.quote: Buradaki "Azar-Bazar", şeytanî ruhların adlarıdır. Sonradan anlam kaymasına uğrayarak "her türlü hastalık" içeriğini ifade etmeye başlamıştır.

statement.id: Ungkapan 'Azar-Bazar' semula adalah nama roh-roh setan (şeytanî ruhlar), lalu bergeser makna menjadi 'segala macam penyakit' (hastalık).
statement.en: The phrase 'Azar-Bazar' was originally the names of devilish spirits (şeytanî ruhlar) and later shifted to mean 'every kind of illness' (hastalık).

claims.quote: Yılın son Çarşamba gününde, Azerbaycan kırsal bölgelerinde tüm evlerin önünde ateşler yakılır ve herkes ateşin üstünden atlayarak, "Azarım-Bazarım, bu ateşin üstüne dökülsün" der.

statement.id: Pada hari Rabu (Çarşamba) terakhir dalam setahun, di pedesaan Azerbaijan (Azerbaycan) api dinyalakan di depan rumah dan orang melompatinya sambil berkata 'Azarım-Bazarım, bu ateşin üstüne dökülsün'.
statement.en: On the last Wednesday (Çarşamba) of the year, in rural Azerbaijan (Azerbaycan) fires are lit before houses and everyone jumps over them saying 'Azarım-Bazarım, bu ateşin üstüne dökülsün'.

claims.quote: (Az/Ad) kökünden türemiştir. Azmak, azarlamak fiilleri ile aynı kökene sahiptir.

statement.id: Nama ini berasal dari akar kata Az/Ad dan seakar dengan kata kerja azmak dan azarlamak.
statement.en: The name derives from the root Az/Ad and shares its origin with the verbs azmak and azarlamak.

claims.quote: Eski Moğolca Ad/Ada, eski Türkçe Ada/Aza sözcükleri tehlike ifâde eder.

statement.id: Kata Mongol Kuno (Eski Moğolca) Ad/Ada dan Turk Kuno (eski Türkçe) Ada/Aza bermakna bahaya (tehlike).
statement.en: The Old Mongolian (Eski Moğolca) words Ad/Ada and Old Turkic (eski Türkçe) Ada/Aza express danger (tehlike).

claims.quote: Anlam: (42/45). Kötülük yapan demektir.

statement.id: Menurut Karakurt, nama Aza berarti 'yang berbuat jahat' (kötülük yapan).
statement.en: According to Karakurt, the name Aza means 'one who does evil' (kötülük yapan).

claims.quote: Asya Şamanizm'inde “Azar” adı verilen bir ruh seçtiği kişiyi şaman olmaya zorlar. Ona eziyet eder ve peşini bırakmaz, sürekli hastalandırır.

statement.id: Dalam Syamanisme Asia (Asya Şamanizm), roh bernama Azar memaksa orang pilihannya menjadi syaman, menyiksanya dan terus membuatnya sakit.
statement.en: In Asian Shamanism (Asya Şamanizm), a spirit called Azar forces its chosen person to become a shaman, torments them and keeps making them ill.

claims.quote: Burada Azar her ne kadar şamanlık yeteneği vererek olumlu bir durum sergilese de hastalık getiren bir varlık olarak görülür ve Aza anlayışı ile bağlantılıdır.

statement.id: Karakurt menilai Azar, meski memberi kemampuan syaman (şamanlık), tetap dipandang pembawa penyakit dan berkaitan dengan konsep Aza.
statement.en: Karakurt holds that although the Azar grants shamanic ability (şamanlık), it is still seen as a bringer of illness and is linked to the Aza concept.

short_description.id: Baal adalah dewa cuaca dan kesuburan, terutama hujan dan badai, yang kisahnya terekam di Ugarit.
short_description.en: Baal is a Canaanite storm, rain and fertility god whose stories were recorded at Ugarit.

long_description.id: Baal, juga disebut Baal Hadad, dikaitkan dengan hujan, badai, dan kesuburan. Sebutan Baal juga bermakna penguasa dan dipakai bagi lebih dari satu dewa. Lempeng bertulis dari Ugarit menjadi sumber utama kisahnya; dalam sumber itu ia disebut putra El dan bertakhta di Gunung Zaphon.
long_description.en: Baal, also called Baal Hadad, is linked to rain, storms and fertility. His name also means lord and was used for more than one god. Tablets from Ugarit preserve his stories; he is called El’s son and placed on Mount Zaphon.

long_description.id: Pada sebuah prasasti, Baal membawa gada dan petir serta mengenakan helm bertanduk. Siklus kisahnya menampilkan pertarungan dengan Yamm, dewa laut, dan perselisihan dengan Mot, dewa kematian. Anat ikut berperan menghadapi Mot. Karena ada tafsir berbeda tentang apakah Baal sungguh mati dan hidup kembali, kisah itu perlu dibaca sebagai tradisi dengan perdebatan penafsiran.
long_description.en: A stele shows Baal with a mace, thunderbolt and horned helmet. His cycle includes conflict with Yamm, god of the sea, and Mot, god of death; Anat also confronts Mot. Interpretations differ over whether Baal actually dies and returns to life.

long_description.id: Sebagai dewa yang membawa hujan, Baal digambarkan menjaga kesuburan tanah dan dapat dipanggil penunggang awan. Dalam kisah tentang Mot, ketiadaan Baal dikaitkan dengan tanah yang menjadi tandus. Sebutan dan perannya berubah menurut tradisi setempat, sehingga setiap nama Baal tidak otomatis menunjuk figur yang sama.
long_description.en: As a rain god, Baal brings fertility and can be called rider of the clouds. In the story of Mot, Baal’s absence leaves the land barren. His title was applied across local traditions and does not always identify the same figure.

note.id: Baal disebut putra El dalam sumber dari Ugarit.
note.en: Baal is named El’s son in Ugaritic sources.

note.id: Baal mengalahkan Yamm dalam kisah pertarungan laut.
note.en: Baal defeats Yamm in the sea conflict.

note.id: Mot menjadi lawan Baal dalam siklus kisahnya.
note.en: Mot opposes Baal in the myth cycle.

short_description.id: Berehynia adalah roh rendah dalam mitologi Slavia Timur yang berkerabat dengan rusalka; gambaran modernnya sebagai dewi Ukraina kuno dianggap tidak berdasar oleh para peneliti.
short_description.en: Berehynia is a lesser spirit of East Slavic mythology related to the rusalki; her modern image as an ancient Ukrainian goddess is considered baseless by scholars.

long_description.id: Berehynia, mungkin sama dengan perehenia, adalah makhluk dalam mitologi Slavia Timur, roh rendah yang berkerabat dengan rusalka. Namanya dikaitkan dengan tepi sungai (bereh) dan bukit. Dalam sedikit sumber kuno yang menyebutnya, berehynia selalu muncul dalam bentuk jamak, dan wujud serta fungsinya tidak diketahui. Sebagian peneliti menganggapnya dekat dengan rusalka, yaitu gadis yang mati tenggelam atau meninggal sebelum dibaptis.
long_description.en: Berehynia, perhaps the same as perehenia, is a being of East Slavic myth, a lesser spirit akin to the rusalki. The name has been tied to riverbanks (bereh) and hills. In the few fragmentary old mentions, berehyni appear only in the plural, and their look and exact role are unknown. Some scholars placed them close to rusalki, drowned girls or girls who died unbaptised.

long_description.id: Sejak sekitar tahun 1980-an berehynia ditafsirkan sebagai roh perempuan penjaga rumah dan keluarga. Gambaran populer modern tentang Berehynia sebagai dewi pagan Ukraina kuno tidak punya dasar sejarah, etnografi, maupun arkeologi; kebanyakan akademisi menganggapnya produk pseudoilmiah dari karya sastra romantis. Pada akhir abad ke-20, nasionalisme romantis Ukraina memusatkan perhatian pada mitos matriarkal ini.
long_description.en: Since about the 1980s berehyni have been read as female spirits guarding home and family. The popular modern image of Berehynia as an ancient Ukrainian pagan goddess has no historical, ethnographic or archaeological basis; most scholars see it as a pseudoscientific product of romantic literature. In the late 20th century Ukrainian romantic nationalism focused on this matriarchal myth.

short_description.id: Bes adalah dewa Mesir pelindung rumah tangga, ibu, anak, dan kelahiran.
short_description.en: Bes is an Egyptian deity protecting households, mothers, children and childbirth.

long_description.id: Bes adalah dewa Mesir pelindung rumah tangga, ibu, anak, dan kelahiran. Beset adalah pasangan femininnya. Pemujaannya menyebar ke Siria dan Kepulauan Balearik.
long_description.en: Bes is an Egyptian deity protecting households, mothers, children and childbirth. Beset is his feminine counterpart. His worship spreads to Syria and the Balearic Islands.

long_description.id: Ia menjaga anak dan menghadapi roh jahat saat perempuan melahirkan. Berbeda dari kebanyakan dewa Mesir, gambarnya menghadap depan. Patungnya dipasang di rumah sebagai perlindungan terhadap setan. Bes juga mewakili musik, tari, dan kenikmatan seksual. Gambarnya terdapat pada masker, jimat, botol bayi, dan pisau magis.
long_description.en: He watches over children and fights evil spirits during childbirth. Unlike most Egyptian gods, his image faces forward. His statue is placed in homes for protection against demons. Bes also symbolizes music, dance and sexual pleasure. His image occurs on masks, amulets, infant bottles and magical knives.

long_description.id: Ruangan Saqqara bergambar Bes dan Beset dikaitkan dengan ritual penyembuhan. Gambar Bes ditemukan di Susa dan Asia Tengah. short_description.id: Bloody Bones adalah sosok momok dalam cerita rakyat Inggris dan Amerika Utara, tercatat sejak sekitar 1548, yang dipakai untuk menakuti anak-anak agar berkelakuan baik.
short_description.en: Bloody Bones is a bogeyman of English and North American folklore, recorded from about 1548, used to frighten children into good behaviour.

long_description.id: Bloody Bones adalah sosok momok (bogeyman) dalam cerita rakyat Inggris (English) dan Amerika Utara (North American) yang kemunculan tertulis pertamanya sekitar 1548; seperti momok lain, ia dipakai untuk menakuti anak agar berkelakuan baik. Ia kadang disebut Rawhead, Tommy Rawhead, atau Rawhead-and-Bloody-Bones. John Locke pada 1693 mencatat bahwa nama "Raw-Head and Bloody-Bones" dipakai untuk menakuti anak, dan Samuel Johnson dalam kamusnya (1755) mengartikan Rawhead sebagai "nama hantu untuk menakuti anak". Kisahnya berasal dari Britania Raya (Great Britain), terutama Lancashire dan Yorkshire, lalu menyebar ke Amerika Serikat bagian selatan (Southern United States).
long_description.en: Bloody Bones is a bogeyman of English and North American folklore whose first written appearance dates to about 1548; like all bogeymen he served to scare children into behaving. He is also called Rawhead, Tommy Rawhead or Rawhead-and-Bloody-Bones. John Locke noted in 1693 that 'Raw-Head and Bloody-Bones' was used to awe children, and Samuel Johnson's 1755 Dictionary glossed Rawhead as a spectre named to frighten children. The stories began in Great Britain, especially Lancashire and Yorkshire, and spread to the Southern United States.

long_description.id: Ia kadang dianggap iblis air yang menghantui kolam dalam dan lubang marl tua, menyeret anak ke kedalaman seperti grindylow dan Jenny Greenteeth. Ruth Tongue dalam Somerset Folklore menulis bahwa ia tinggal di lemari gelap di bawah tangga. Old Bloody Bones adalah versi Cornwall yang menghuni Knockers Hole dekat desa Baldhu. Menurut artikel de, ia menghadiahi anak yang sangat baik tetapi menghukum anak nakal dengan menyeret mereka ke saluran air atau ke dalam air dan menenggelamkannya.
long_description.en: He is sometimes seen as a water demon haunting deep ponds and old marl pits, dragging children into the depths like the grindylow and Jenny Greenteeth. Ruth Tongue, in Somerset Folklore, wrote that he lived in a dark cupboard under the stairs. Old Bloody Bones is a Cornish version living in Knockers Hole near the village of Baldhu. According to the de article he rewards very good children but punishes naughty ones by dragging them down the drain or into the water and drowning them.

short_description.id: Blue men of the Minch adalah makhluk mitologi Skotlandia yang menghuni selat antara Outer Hebrides utara dan daratan Skotlandia, menenggelamkan pelaut dan kapal.
short_description.en: The blue men of the Minch are Scottish mythological beings of the strait between the northern Outer Hebrides and mainland Scotland, who drown sailors and sink ships.

long_description.id: Blue men of the Minch, juga disebut storm kelpies (Gaelik Skotlandia/Scottish Gaelic: na fir ghorma), adalah makhluk mitologi yang menghuni perairan antara Outer Hebrides utara dan daratan Skotlandia (Scotland), mencari pelaut untuk ditenggelamkan dan kapal untuk dikaramkan. Selain warnanya yang biru, mereka mirip manusia dan seukuran manusia. Mereka dapat menciptakan badai, tetapi saat cuaca cerah mereka mengapung tidur di permukaan air. Mereka berenang dengan tubuh bagian atas terangkat dari laut, berputar dan menyelam seperti lumba-lumba.
long_description.en: The blue men of the Minch, also called storm kelpies (Scottish Gaelic na fir ghorma), are mythical beings of the waters between the northern Outer Hebrides and mainland Scotland who seek sailors to drown and boats to wreck. Blue in colour but otherwise human-like, they are about human size. They can raise storms, but in fair weather they drift asleep at or just under the surface. They swim with their upper bodies out of the sea, turning and diving like porpoises.

long_description.id: Mereka dapat berbicara; ketika sekelompok mendekati kapal, pemimpinnya kadang meneriakkan dua baris puisi kepada nakhoda dan menantangnya melengkapi bait itu, dan jika gagal mereka berusaha membalikkan kapalnya. Menurut sebagian penjelasan, mereka mungkin personifikasi laut, berasal dari bangsa Pict yang bertubuh dicat, atau dari budak Afrika Utara yang dibawa bangsa Viking ke Skotlandia. Menurut Donald A. Mackenzie, mereka tidak punya padanan di tempat lain, bahkan di wilayah Skotlandia lain. Menurut artikel es, mereka mungkin bagian dari suku "malaikat jatuh" yang terpecah tiga: peri darat, orang biru laut, dan "penari riang" Aurora di langit.
long_description.en: They can talk; when a group nears a ship its chief may shout two lines of verse to the skipper and dare him to finish the rhyme, and if he fails they try to overturn the vessel. Explanations suggest they personify the sea, or come from the painted Picts, or from North African slaves brought to Scotland by the Vikings. According to Donald A. Mackenzie they have no counterpart anywhere else, not even elsewhere in Scotland. According to the es article they may belong to a tribe of 'fallen angels' split in three: land fairies, the sea's blue men, and the 'merry dancers' of the Aurora in the sky.

short_description.id: Borvo (juga Bormo) adalah dewa Kelt kuno untuk mata air panas yang menyembuhkan, dipuja di Galia Romawi dan disamakan dengan Apollo.
short_description.en: Borvo (also Bormo) is an ancient Celtic god of hot healing springs, worshipped in Roman Gaul and equated with Apollo.

long_description.id: Borvo, juga Bormo, adalah dewa Kelt (Celtic) kuno untuk mata air panas dan mata air penyembuh. Pemujaannya tercatat di wilayah luas Galia Romawi dan mencapai barat laut Semenanjung Iberia. Dalam interpretatio romana ia biasanya disamakan dengan Apollo, dan di Aix-en-Provence dengan Hercules; pasangan ilahinya yang paling sering adalah dewi Damona. Nama Galia Boruō berarti "mata air panas", dari akar kata Proto-Kelt berw- ("mendidih, menyeduh").
long_description.en: Borvo, or Bormo, was the old Celtic god who presided over hot, health-giving springs. His cult is recorded across much of Roman Gaul and reached the north-west of the Iberian Peninsula. Under the interpretatio romana he was usually equated with Apollo, and at Aix-en-Provence with Hercules; his most frequent divine partner was the goddess Damona. The Gaulish name Boruō means 'hot spring', from the Proto-Celtic root berw- ('boil, brew').

long_description.id: Borvo umumnya ditafsirkan sebagai dewa air hangat yang memancar dari mata air panas, yang dianggap berkhasiat; bukti pemujaannya hampir seluruhnya berupa prasasti persembahan di tempat pemandian Galia-Romawi. Sebuah relief dari Entrains menggambarkannya dengan piala, kantong uang, dan piring buah, dan relief dari Vichy menampilkannya duduk telanjang di atas batu memegang cawan berbuih. Banyak nama tempat di dekat mata air berasal dari namanya, seperti Bourbon, Bourbonne, dan La Bourboule. Menurut artikel de, namanya berarti "yang mendidih/memancar", dan Borvo masih tersimpan dalam nama Bourbonne-les-Bains dan Bourbon-Lancy.
long_description.en: Borvo is generally read as the god of warm, welling waters of thermal springs held to be curative; the evidence is almost entirely votive inscriptions at Gallo-Roman spas. On a relief from Entrains he holds a cup, a purse and a dish of fruit, and one from Vichy shows him seated naked on a rock holding a bubbling cup. Many place names near springs come from his name, such as Bourbon, Bourbonne and La Bourboule. According to the de article his name means 'the boiling/bubbling one', and Borvo survives in the names Bourbonne-les-Bains and Bourbon-Lancy.

short_description.id: Božić adalah tokoh dalam kepercayaan Slavia Selatan yang melambangkan tahun baru, musim semi, dan masa muda; namanya kini menjadi kata untuk Natal.
short_description.en: Božić is a figure of South Slavic belief symbolising the new year, spring and youth; his name is now the word for Christmas.

long_description.id: Božić dalam paganisme Slavia adalah makhluk yang melambangkan tahun baru, musim semi, dan masa muda. Ia muncul dalam adat Natal bersama rusa bertanduk emas dan babi, sebagai lawan Badnjak (tahun yang lama). Dalam nyanyian ritual koliadki lambangnya rusa bertanduk emas, dan ia menandai awal siklus matahari yang baru pada titik balik musim dingin. Ia dianggap dewa muda, biasanya putra Badnjak.
long_description.en: Božić in Slavic paganism is a being symbolising the new year, spring and youth. He appears in Christmas customs with a golden-horned deer and a pig, as the opposite of Badnjak (the old year). In the ritual koliadki songs his symbol is the golden-horned deer, and he marks the start of the new solar cycle at the winter solstice. He is considered a young god, usually Badnjak's son.

long_description.id: Badnjak dibakar dalam api, sedangkan Božić membawa pembaruan matahari, kelahiran kembali musim semi, dan peremajaan alam. Ia dianggap perwujudan matahari yang konon mati dan lahir setiap tahun, dan mungkin gema pemujaan Svarog. Dalam bahasa Slavia Selatan kata ini beralih menjadi nama Natal, misalnya Божић dalam bahasa Serbia, Božić dalam bahasa Kroasia, dan Božič dalam bahasa Slovenia.
long_description.en: Badnjak burns in the fire while Božić brings the sun's renewal, spring's rebirth and nature's rejuvenation. He is seen as the personification of the sun that allegedly dies and is born each year, and probably as an echo of the cult of Svarog. In South Slavic languages the word passed into the name for Christmas, e.g. Serbian Божић, Croatian Božić and Slovenian Božič.

short_description.id: Brigid (Brigit, Bríg) adalah dewi Irlandia pra-Kristen dari Tuatha Dé Danann, putri Dagda, yang dikaitkan dengan kebijaksanaan, puisi, penyembuhan, perlindungan, dan pandai besi.
short_description.en: Brigid (Brigit, Bríg) is a goddess of pre-Christian Ireland from the Tuatha Dé Danann, daughter of the Dagda, associated with wisdom, poetry, healing, protection and smithing.

long_description.id: Brigid atau Brigit ("yang ditinggikan"), juga Bríg, adalah dewi Irlandia pra-Kristen. Dalam mitologi Irlandia ia anggota Tuatha Dé Danann, putri Dagda dan istri Bres, dengan putra bernama Ruadán. Ia dikaitkan dengan kebijaksanaan, puisi, penyembuhan, perlindungan, pandai besi, dan hewan ternak. Cormac's Glossary dari abad ke-9 menyebutnya "dewi yang dipuja para penyair" dan menyebut dua saudarinya, Brigid sang penyembuh dan Brigid sang pandai besi, sehingga ia mungkin dewi tiga rupa.
long_description.en: Brigid or Brigit ("exalted one"), also Bríg, is a goddess of pre-Christian Ireland. In Irish mythology she is one of the Tuatha Dé Danann, daughter of the Dagda and wife of Bres, with a son named Ruadán. She is tied to wisdom, poetry, healing, protection, smithing and domestic animals. Cormac's Glossary of the 9th century calls her "the goddess whom poets adored" and names two sisters, Brigid the healer and Brigid the smith, suggesting a triple deity.

long_description.id: Santa Brigid memiliki banyak atribut sang dewi, dan hari rayanya, 1 Februari, semula adalah perayaan Imbolc; karena itu ada yang berpendapat sang santa adalah kristenisasi sang dewi. Namanya berasal dari kata Proto-Kelt *Brigantī ("yang tinggi"), sekerabat dengan nama dewi Britania kuno Brigantia. Menurut artikel de, tempat sucinya di Kildare, tempat api sucinya dijaga; dalam bahasa Wales namanya Ffraid, dan ia dipuja dalam tiga wujud sebagai pelindung penyair, pembuat hukum, penyembuhan, kesuburan, dan pandai besi.
long_description.en: Much of the goddess lives on in Saint Brigid, whose 1 February feast began as the festival of Imbolc; some therefore see the saint as the goddess in Christian guise. Her name comes from Proto-Celtic *Brigantī ("the high one"), cognate with the ancient British goddess Brigantia. According to the de article her sanctuary was at Kildare, where her sacred fire was kept; her Welsh name is Ffraid, and she was worshipped in threefold form as patron of poets, lawgivers, healing, fertility and smiths.

long_description.id: Buchis adalah banteng suci sebagai perwujudan ka dewa perang Montu. Banteng terpilih harus berwarna putih dengan wajah hitam.
long_description.en: Buchis is a sacred bull embodying the war god Montu’s ka. The chosen bull must be white-bodied with a black face.

long_description.id: Banteng dan ibunya dimumi serta ditempatkan di pemakaman Bucheum. Kultusnya mulai menjelang akhir masa firaun; makam awal dikenal dari Nectanebo II. long_description.en: The bulls and their mothers are mummified and placed in the Bucheum cemetery. The cult begins toward the end of the pharaonic period, with an early burial known under Nectanebo II. The last stela cited by the article records a bull’s death in 340 CE. The accompanying source depicts Buchis as a running bull.

short_description.id: Cernunnos adalah dewa Kelt bertanduk rusa yang namanya hanya jelas tercatat sekali, pada Pillar of the Boatmen dari Paris abad ke-1 M; ia dikaitkan dengan kesuburan, hewan liar, dan dunia bawah.
short_description.en: Cernunnos is an antlered Celtic god known by name from a single clear inscription, on the Pillar of the Boatmen made in Paris in the 1st century CE; he is linked with fertility, wild beasts and the underworld.

long_description.id: Cernunnos adalah dewa Kelt (Celtic) yang namanya hanya jelas tercatat sekali, pada Pillar of the Boatmen dari Paris abad ke-1 M, yang dikaitkan dengan gambar sosok tua bertanduk rusa dengan torc tergantung di tanduknya. Dari artefak itu, nama Cernunnos dipakai untuk sekelompok gambar dewa bertanduk rusa, sering tua dan duduk bersila, yang terkait dengan torc, ular bertanduk domba, lambang kesuburan, dan hewan liar, terutama rusa. Sebanyak 25 gambar tipe Cernunnos telah dikenali, terutama di Galia timur laut, tetapi juga sampai ke Italia (Val Camonica) dan Denmark (Gundestrup).
long_description.en: Cernunnos is a Celtic god known by name from one clear inscription only: the Pillar of the Boatmen, set up in Paris in the 1st century CE, where the name stands beside an image of an aged, antlered figure with torcs hanging from his horns. From this artefact the name has been applied to a cluster of images of an antlered god, often aged and cross-legged, linked with torcs, ram-horned serpents, fertility symbols and wild beasts, especially deer. As many as 25 Cernunnos-type images are known, mostly in north-eastern Gaul but as far as Italy (Val Camonica) and Denmark (Gundestrup).

long_description.id: Cernunnos ditafsirkan sebagai dewa kesuburan, dunia bawah, dan dwiarah. Pemujaannya, yang terbukti secara ikonografis sejak abad ke-4 SM, tampaknya tak banyak terpengaruh penaklukan Romawi atas Galia. Pillar of the Boatmen ditemukan pada 1711 di bawah paduan suara Notre-Dame de Paris; kini huruf-hurufnya rusak sehingga sebagian ahli membacanya Cernennos. Menurut artikel id, Cernunnos adalah dewa bertanduk penguasa tempat-tempat liar dan dewa tumbuh-tumbuhan, dijuluki "Lord of the wild things", dan pada abad pertengahan dipakai gereja Kristen sebagai lambang antikristus.
long_description.en: Interpreters have seen in Cernunnos a fertility god, an underworld god, or a god facing two ways. His cult, attested in images from as early as the 4th century BCE, seems largely untouched by the Roman conquest of Gaul. The Pillar of the Boatmen was found in 1711 under the choir of Notre-Dame de Paris; its lettering is now damaged, and some scholars read Cernennos. According to the id article, Cernunnos is a horned god ruling wild places and a god of vegetation, called the "Lord of the wild things", and in the Middle Ages the Christian church used him as a symbol of the antichrist.

origin.en: Tied to fertility and wild beasts.

statement.en: Cernunnos is a Celtic god whose name is clearly attested only on the 1st-century CE Pillar of the Boatmen from Paris, with an aged, antlered figure wearing torcs.

claims.quote: the name "Cernunnos" has been applied to the members of an iconographic cluster, consisting of depictions of an antlered god (often aged and with crossed legs) associated with torcs, ram-horned (or ram-headed) serpents, symbols of fertility, and wild beasts (especially deer).

statement.id: Nama Cernunnos dipakai untuk gambar dewa bertanduk rusa yang duduk bersila, dengan torc, ular bertanduk domba, lambang kesuburan, dan hewan liar.
statement.en: The name Cernunnos is applied to images of an antlered, cross-legged god with torcs, ram-horned serpents, fertility symbols and wild beasts.

claims.quote: As many as 25 depictions of the Cernunnos-type have been identified. Though this iconographic group is best attested in north-eastern Gaul, depictions of the god have been identified as far off as Italy (Val Camonica) and Denmark (Gundestrup).

statement.id: Sebanyak 25 gambar tipe Cernunnos dikenali, terutama di Galia (Gaul) timur laut, hingga Italia (Italy, Val Camonica) dan Denmark (Gundestrup).
statement.en: As many as 25 Cernunnos-type images are known, mostly in north-eastern Gaul, as far as Italy (Val Camonica) and Denmark (Gundestrup).

claims.quote: Cernunnos has been variously interpreted as a god of fertility, of the underworld, and of bi-directionality. His cult, attested iconographically as early as the 4th century BCE, seems to have been largely unaffected by the Roman conquest of Gaul

statement.en: Cernunnos is read as a god of fertility, the underworld and bi-directionality; his cult from the 4th century BCE was largely unaffected by the Roman conquest of Gaul.

short_description.id: Chandra adalah dewa Bulan dalam Hindu yang terkait malam dan tumbuhan.
short_description.en: Chandra is the Hindu Moon god associated with night and plants.

long_description.id: Chandra adalah dewa Bulan dalam Hindu yang terkait malam dan tumbuhan. Ia termasuk Navagraha, sembilan planet dalam tradisi Hindu.
long_description.en: Chandra is the Hindu Moon god associated with night and plants. He belongs to the Navagraha, nine planets in Hindu tradition.

long_description.id: Chandra berarti terang atau berkilau dalam bahasa Sanskerta. Epitetnya mencakup Shashank, yang berarti bertanda kelinci. Waktu pemakaian Soma sebagai nama Bulan diperdebatkan oleh para sarjana. Mackenzie mengidentifikasi dewa Bulan Chandra dengan Soma.
long_description.en: Chandra means bright or shining in Sanskrit. His epithets include Shashank, meaning hare marked. The time when Soma became a name of the Moon is debated by scholars. Mackenzie identifies the Moon god Chandra with Soma.

cultural_context.id: Penyamaan Soma dengan Bulan memiliki perbedaan penanggalan menurut kajian yang dirangkum.
cultural_context.en: The identification of Soma with the Moon has differing datings in the summarized studies.

claims.quote: Chandra (Sanskrit: चन्द्र, romanized: Chandra, lit. 'shining' or 'moon'), also known as Soma (Sanskrit: सोम), is the Hindu god of the Moon, and is associated with the night, plants and vegetation. He is one of the Navagraha (nine planets of Hinduism).

statement.id: Chandra adalah dewa Bulan dalam Hindu yang terkait malam dan tumbuhan.
statement.en: Chandra is the Hindu Moon god associated with night and plants.

claims.quote: Chandra (Sanskrit: चन्द्र, romanized: Chandra, lit. 'shining' or 'moon'), also known as Soma (Sanskrit: सोम), is the Hindu god of the Moon, and is associated with the night, plants and vegetation. He is one of the Navagraha (nine planets of Hinduism).

statement.id: Ia termasuk Navagraha, sembilan planet dalam tradisi Hindu.
statement.en: He belongs to the Navagraha, nine planets in Hindu tradition.

claims.quote: The word "Chandra" literally means "bright, shining or glittering" and is used for the "Moon" in Sanskrit and other Indo-Aryan languages. It is also the name of various other figures in Hindu mythology, including an asura and a Suryavamsha king. It is also a common Indian name and surname.

statement.id: Chandra berarti terang atau berkilau dalam bahasa Sanskerta.
statement.en: Chandra means bright or shining in Sanskrit.

claims.quote: Some of the epithets of Chandra include Soma (distill), Indu (bright drop), Shashank (hare-marked), Atrisuta (son of Atri), Shashin or Shachin (the essence), Taradhipa (lord of stars), Nishakara (the night maker), Nakshatrapati (lord of the Nakshatra), Oshadhipati (lord of herbs), Uduraj or Udupati (water lord), Kumudanatha (lord of lotuses), and Udupa (boat).

statement.id: Epitetnya mencakup Shashank, yang berarti bertanda kelinci.
statement.en: His epithets include Shashank, meaning hare marked.

claims.quote: Soma is one of the most common other names used for the deity; but the earliest use of the word to refer to the Moon is a subject of scholarly debate. Some scholars state that the word Soma is occasionally used for the Moon in the Vedas, while other scholars suggest that such usage emerged only in the post-Vedic literature.

statement.id: Waktu pemakaian Soma sebagai nama Bulan diperdebatkan oleh para sarjana.
statement.en: The time when Soma became a name of the Moon is debated by scholars.

claims.quote:
The moon is the god Chandra, who became identified

statement.en: Mackenzie identifies the Moon god Chandra with Soma.

short_description.id: Circe adalah dewi dan penyihir yang mengubah manusia menjadi hewan dalam kisah perjalanan Odysseus.
short_description.en: Circe is a goddess and sorceress who transforms people into animals in the story of Odysseus.

long_description.id: Circe adalah putri Helios dan Perseis yang tinggal di pulau Aeaea. Ia mengenal ramuan dan tanaman serta dapat mengubah manusia menjadi hewan. Penggambaran dirinya mencakup dewi bersuara manusia dan penyihir dengan kekuatan sihir; dalam kisah Odysseus ia mengubah beberapa awak kapal menjadi babi.
long_description.en: Circe is the daughter of Helios and Perseis, living on Aeaea. She knows potions and herbs and can turn people into animals. Accounts call her a goddess with a human voice and a sorceress; in Odysseus’ tale she changes crew members into pigs.

long_description.id: Hermes memberi Odysseus tanaman moly sehingga ia dapat melawan sihir Circe. Setelah awak kapal dipulihkan, mereka tinggal bersama Circe selama setahun. Ia kemudian memberi petunjuk menuju Tiresias di dunia bawah dan memperingatkan tentang Sirens. Kisah lain menghubungkannya dengan perubahan Scylla menjadi monster laut.
long_description.en: Hermes gives Odysseus the herb moly to resist Circe. After the crew is restored, they stay with her for a year. She then directs him toward Tiresias in the underworld and warns him about the Sirens. Another story links her to Scylla’s transformation into a sea monster.

long_description.id: Sumber kuno tidak satu suara tentang keturunannya: beberapa menyebut Telegonus, Agrius, dan Latinus, sementara yang lain hanya Telegonus. Theoi juga mencatat versi silsilah yang menjadikannya putri Hyperion dan Aerope. Ragam ini memperlihatkan bahwa rincian keluarganya bergantung pada tradisi yang dikutip.
long_description.en: Ancient accounts differ on her children: some name Telegonus, Agrius and Latinus, while others name only Telegonus. Theoi also records a genealogy making her the daughter of Hyperion and Aerope. The details depend on the cited tradition.

description.en: Circe’s potions and wand turn people into animals in the tales.

note.en: Circe is linked to Scylla’s transformation into a sea monster.

short_description.id: Congolos adalah jin hilang dalam kepercayaan rakyat Türk dan Anadolu yang muncul pada musim dingin, memanggil nama penghuni rumah dari luar pintu, lalu menghilangkan orang yang mengikutinya.
short_description.en: Congolos is a lost jinn of Türk and Anadolu folk belief that appears in winter, calls a householder's name from outside the door and makes whoever follows it vanish.

long_description.id: Congolos adalah jin hilang dalam kepercayaan rakyat Türk dan Anadolu yang muncul pada masa terdingin musim dingin. Ia datang ke pintu rumah dan memanggil nama salah seorang penghuni dari luar; orang yang mengikutinya dibawa pergi dan tidak pernah terdengar kabarnya lagi.
long_description.en: Congolos is a lost jinn of Türk and Anadolu folk belief that shows up in the harshest part of winter. Standing at the door of a house, it calls out the name of one of the people inside; whoever follows it is led off and is never heard from again.

long_description.id: Kamus mitologi Türk mencantumkan padanan namanya, yaitu JONGOLOS, CONGALAS, dan CONGALAZ, dan menjelaskan bahwa makhluk itu memancing korbannya keluar sebelum menghilangkannya. Kamus yang sama mengaitkannya dengan Karakoncolos. Di Yozgat, ia dipandang sebagai varian karakoncolos yang muncul pada bulan zemheri.
long_description.en: The dictionary of Türk legend gives the related forms JONGOLOS, CONGALAS and CONGALAZ and explains that the being lures its victim outside before making them disappear. The same dictionary links it to Karakoncolos. In Yozgat it is regarded as a variant of the karakoncolos that comes in the month of zemheri.

long_description.id: Untuk mencegah gangguannya, orang meletakkan hidangan bit di depan pintu dan jendela. Makhluk lain bernama Mekir, si penipu, disebut sangat mirip dengannya: Mekir menyamar sebagai kenalan atau memanggil dengan suara yang dikenal, lalu membawa orang pergi dan menghilangkannya.
long_description.en: To keep it away, people set a dish of beets before the door and windows. Another being, Mekir the deceiver, is described as very close to it: Mekir takes on the look of an acquaintance or calls in a familiar voice, then carries people off and makes them disappear.

who.id: Congolos adalah jin hilang dari kepercayaan rakyat Türk dan Anadolu.
who.en: Congolos is a lost jinn of Türk and Anadolu folk belief.

origin.en: It is known, among other places, in Yozgat folk belief as a variant of the karakoncolos.

role.id: Ia memanggil penghuni rumah dari luar pintu dan menghilangkan orang yang mengikutinya.
role.en: It calls householders from outside the door and makes those who follow it vanish.

did_you_know.id: Orang yang terpikat panggilan Congolos dikatakan tidak pernah terdengar kabarnya lagi.
did_you_know.en: People lured by the call of Congolos are said never to be heard of again.

description.id: Hidangan bit di depan pintu dan jendela dipercaya membuatnya berhenti mengganggu.

description.id: Daerah tempat kepercayaan rakyat menyebut Congolos sebagai varian karakoncolos.

claims.quote: Kışın en soğuk zamanında ortaya çıkar. Evin kapısına gelerek dışarıdan, içeride bulunanlardan birisinin adını seslenir ve peşine takarak götürüp o kişiyi kaybeder.

claims.quote: Bir daha o kişiden haber alınamaz. Kapı ve pencere önüne pancar yemeği koyulursa musallat olmaktan vazgeçeceğine inanılır.

statement.en: That person is never heard of again; it is believed that if a beet dish (pancar yemeği) is placed in front of the door and windows, the creature gives up haunting.

statement.en: In Yozgat folk belief, Congolos is the name of an imaginary creature that appears in the coldest time of winter (the month of zemheri) and is a variant of the karakoncolos.

short_description.id: Coventina adalah dewi Romawi-Britania untuk sumur dan mata air, dikenal dari prasasti di sebuah mata air dekat Carrawburgh di Tembok Hadrianus.
short_description.en: Coventina was a Romano-British goddess of wells and springs, known from inscriptions at a spring near Carrawburgh on Hadrian's Wall.

long_description.id: Coventina adalah dewi Romawi-Britania (Romano-British) untuk sumur dan mata air. Ia dikenal dari banyak prasasti di satu situs di Northumberland, Inggris (England), sekitar mata air dekat Carrawburgh di Tembok Hadrianus (Hadrian's Wall). Mungkin ada prasasti lain, dua dari Hispania dan satu dari Narbonensis, yang merujuk kepadanya, tetapi ini diperdebatkan. Menurut artikel de, ia dewi penyembuhan dan mata air (Heil- und Quellgöttin) dalam mitologi Britania yang dipuja di Tembok Hadrianus (Hadrianswall), dan para legiuner (Legionäre) membangun tempat suci untuknya dekat benteng Brocolitia.
long_description.en: Coventina was a Romano-British deity of wells and springs. She is known from many inscriptions at a single site in Northumberland, England, around a spring near Carrawburgh on Hadrian's Wall. Other inscriptions, two from Hispania and one from Narbonensis, may also name her, but that is disputed. According to the de article she was a healing and spring goddess (Heil- und Quellgöttin) of British myth worshipped on Hadrian's Wall (Hadrianswall), and legionaries (Legionäre) built her a shrine near the fort of Brocolitia.

long_description.id: Pada 1879 persembahan untuk Coventina ditemukan di area berdinding yang menampung aliran mata air yang kini disebut Coventina's Well. Isi sumur itu antara lain 13.487 koin dari masa Mark Anthony hingga Gratian, relief tiga nimfa air, dua lempeng persembahan untuk Coventina, sepuluh altar untuk Coventina dan Minerva, serta berbagai benda persembahan. Bukti timbunan koin menunjukkan pemujaan berakhir cukup mendadak sekitar 388, mungkin terkait dekret anti-pagan Theodosius I. Beberapa altar menggambarkannya dalam rupa nimfa Romawi: berbaring, setengah berpakaian, dan dikaitkan dengan air; pada satu altar ia tampil dalam wujud tiga atau dengan dua pendamping.
long_description.en: In 1879 offerings to Coventina were found in a walled area built to hold the outflow of a spring now called Coventina's Well. Inside the well lay 13,487 coins spanning Mark Anthony to Gratian, a carving of three water nymphs, two dedication slabs to Coventina, ten altars to Coventina and Minerva, and many other votive objects. Coin-hoard evidence points to a rather sudden end around 388, perhaps linked to the anti-pagan edicts of Theodosius I. Some altars show her as a typical Roman nymph, reclining, half-clad and tied to water; on one she appears threefold or with two attendants.

short_description.id: Crom Cruach adalah dewa pagan Irlandia pra-Kristen yang menurut penulis Kristen dipuaskan dengan kurban manusia, sampai pemujaannya diakhiri Santo Patrick.
short_description.en: Crom Cruach was a pagan god of pre-Christian Ireland who, Christian writers say, was appeased with human sacrifice until Saint Patrick ended his worship.

long_description.id: Crom Cruach (Irlandia Kuno/Old Irish: Cromm Crúaich) adalah dewa pagan Irlandia (Ireland) pra-Kristen. Menurut penulis Kristen (Christian), ia dipuaskan dengan kurban manusia dan pemujaannya diakhiri oleh Santo Patrick (Saint Patrick). Ia juga disebut Crom Cróich, Cenn Cruach, dan Cenncroithi, dan berhubungan dengan tokoh kemudian Crom Dubh. Rujukan dalam puisi dinnsenchas abad ke-12 tentang kurban sebagai ganti susu dan gandum menunjukkan perannya sebagai dewa kesuburan; gambarannya sebagai sosok emas dikelilingi dua belas sosok batu atau perunggu ditafsirkan sebagian orang sebagai matahari dikelilingi zodiak.
long_description.en: Crom Cruach (Old Irish Cromm Crúaich) was a pagan god of Ireland in pre-Christian times. Christian authors say he was placated with human sacrifice and that Saint Patrick put an end to his cult. He is also called Crom Cróich, Cenn Cruach and Cenncroithi, and is related to the later figure Crom Dubh. A 12th-century dinnsenchas poem speaks of sacrifice in return for milk and grain, suggesting a fertility role; his image of a gold figure ringed by twelve stone or bronze ones has been read by some as the sun among the signs of the zodiac.

long_description.id: Menurut puisi dinsenchas dalam Book of Leinster, arca pemujaannya berdiri di Magh Slécht ("dataran sujud") di County Cavan dan dipuaskan dengan kurban anak sulung demi hasil susu dan gandum yang baik. Raja Agung awal Tigernmas, bersama tiga perempat pasukannya, dikatakan mati saat memujanya pada malam Samhain, tetapi pemujaan berlanjut sampai arca itu dihancurkan Santo Patrick dengan palu godam. Menurut artikel de, ia digambarkan sebagai dewa dunia bawah dan kematian, dan kadang dicampuradukkan dengan dewa kesuburan Cromm Dubh.
long_description.en: By a dinsenchas poem in the Book of Leinster, his cult image stood on Magh Slécht ('the plain of prostration') in County Cavan and was offered first-born children for good yields of milk and grain. The early High King Tigernmas, with three quarters of his host, is said to have died worshipping him on Samhain eve, yet the cult went on until Saint Patrick smashed the image with a sledgehammer. According to the de article he is cast as a god of the underworld and death, and is sometimes merged with the fertility god Cromm Dubh.

short_description.id: Danu adalah dewi yang diduga ada dalam mitologi Irlandia, yang satu-satunya jejaknya adalah nama Tuatha Dé Danann, "bangsa dewi Danu".
short_description.en: Danu is a presumed goddess of Irish mythology whose only trace is the name of the Tuatha Dé Danann, "the folk of the goddess Danu".

long_description.id: Danu diduga merupakan dewi dalam mitologi Irlandia (Irish mythology), yang satu-satunya kesaksian adalah nama Tuatha Dé Danann, biasa diterjemahkan "bangsa dewi Danu". Meski tokoh itu sama sekali tidak muncul dalam teks primer, sebagian folkloris era Victoria memberinya sifat-sifat seperti keibuan atau kemakmuran pertanian. Bentuk nominatif *Danu adalah rekonstruksi para sarjana modern dari bentuk genitif Danann, satu-satunya bentuk yang tercatat, dan tidak ada mitos atau legenda abad pertengahan tentang dirinya.
long_description.en: Danu is presumed to have been a goddess of Irish mythology, attested only in the name of the Tuatha Dé Danann, usually rendered "the folk of the goddess Danu". Although no such figure appears in the primary texts, some later Victorian folklorists gave her traits such as motherhood or farming prosperity. The nominative *Danu is a modern scholarly reconstruction from the genitive Danann, the only attested form, and no medieval myths or legends about her survive.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Irlandia, Anu adalah seorang dewi; ia mungkin dewi tersendiri atau nama lain Danu. Cormac's Glossary menyebut Anu sebagai ibu para dewa, dan sebagian sarjana mengira Danu merupakan perpaduan dengan Anu. Asal namanya diperdebatkan: sarjana awal mengaitkannya dengan dewi air Weda Danu dan akar kata "mengalir", yang mungkin juga menjadi asal nama sungai Danube. Ia mungkin sepadan dengan tokoh Wales Dôn dalam Mabinogion. Menurut artikel de, nama Danu sendiri tidak pernah muncul dalam mitologi Irlandia Kuno, melainkan disimpulkan dari istilah Túatha Dé Danann dan Tri Dée Dána.
long_description.en: In Irish mythology Anu is a goddess; she may be distinct or another name for Danu. Cormac's Glossary names Anu as mother of the gods, and some scholars think Danu is a blending with Anu. The origin of the name is debated: early scholars linked it to the Vedic water goddess Danu and a root meaning "to flow", which may also underlie the river name Danube. She may parallel the Welsh figure Dôn of the Mabinogion. According to the de article, the name Danu itself never appears in Old Irish mythology but is inferred from the terms Túatha Dé Danann and Tri Dée Dána.

short_description.id: Dea Matrona ("Ibu Ilahi") adalah dewi Kelt yang memberi nama Sungai Marne (Matrona kuno) di Galia dan ditafsirkan sebagai dewi ibu.
short_description.en: Dea Matrona ('Divine Mother') is the Celtic goddess who gave her name to the river Marne (ancient Matrona) in Gaul, read as a mother goddess.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Kelt (Celtic), Dea Matrona ("Ibu Ilahi") adalah dewi yang memberi nama Sungai Marne (Matrŏna kuno) di Galia (Gaul). Nama dewa Galia (Gaulish) Mātr-on-ā berarti "Ibu Agung", dan dewi Marne ditafsirkan sebagai dewi ibu. Banyak gambar keagamaan Galia, termasuk patung terakota murah untuk altar rumah, menggambarkan dewi ibu yang menyusui bayi atau memangku buah, makanan, atau anjing kecil; di banyak daerah Matronae seperti itu digambarkan bertiga atau berdua. Nama tokoh mitologi Wales (Welsh) Modron, ibu Mabon, berasal dari akar kata yang sama.
long_description.en: In Celtic myth Dea Matrona ('Divine Mother') is the goddess whose name the river Marne (ancient Matrŏna) in Gaul bears. The Gaulish divine name Mātr-on-ā means 'Great Mother', and the Marne's goddess is taken to be a mother goddess. Many Gaulish sacred images, among them cheap terracotta figures made in bulk for home shrines, show mother goddesses suckling infants or holding fruit, food or little dogs in their laps; in many regions such Matronae appear in threes or pairs. The Welsh mythological figure Modron, mother of Mabon, takes her name from the same root.

long_description.id: Menurut artikel de, Matrona adalah dewi sungai yang dipahami sebagai personifikasi Sungai Marne. Pemujaannya dibuktikan oleh sebuah prasasti persembahan yang ditemukan pada 1831 di daerah hulu sungai itu ("La Marnotte") dekat Bellesmes, Haute-Marne, tak jauh dari Langres. Gaius Iulius Caesar dalam De bello Gallico menyebut Matrona sebagai nama Sungai Marne, yang bersama Sequana (Seine) menjadi batas antara Galia dan Belgica. Nama Matrona berasal dari kata Galia mātīr ("ibu").
long_description.en: According to the de article, Matrona is a river goddess understood as the personification of the Marne. Her cult is attested by a votive inscription found in 1831 at the river's source ('La Marnotte') near Bellesmes in Haute-Marne, not far from Langres. Gaius Iulius Caesar, in De bello Gallico, gives Matrona as the name of the Marne, which with the Sequana (Seine) bordered Gaul and Belgica. The name comes from Gaulish mātīr, 'mother'.

who.en: Divine Mother.

role.en: Mother goddess.

did_you_know.en: The Marne river in France is named after the Celtic goddess Matrona, the 'Divine Mother'.

statement.en: The Gaulish name Mātr-on-ā means Great Mother; she is read as a mother goddess.

claims.quote: Many Gaulish religious images—including inexpensive terracotta statues mass-produced for use in household shrines—depict mother goddesses nursing babies or holding fruits, other foods, or small dogs in their laps. In many areas, such Matronae were depicted in groups of three (or sometimes two)

statement.en: Gaulish images show mother goddesses nursing or holding fruit or dogs; Matronae appear in threes or twos.

statement.en: The Welsh Modron, mother of Mabon, comes from the same etymon.

short_description.id: Devi adalah istilah Sanskerta untuk dewi dalam agama India.
short_description.en: Devi is the Sanskrit term for a goddess in Indian religions.

long_description.id: Devi adalah istilah Sanskerta untuk dewi dalam agama India. Pasangan istilah maskulinnya adalah Deva.
long_description.en: Devi is the Sanskrit term for a goddess in Indian religions. Its masculine counterpart is Deva.

long_description.id: Tradisi Shaktisme berpusat pada Devi. Literatur Purana abad pertengahan memperluas kisah Devi, termasuk Devi Mahatmya. Devi Mahatmya memujanya sebagai kebenaran tertinggi dan daya utama. Devi dan Deva dijelaskan mengacu pada yang ilahi, luhur, dan bersinar. Bhagavati menjadi sebutan kehormatan dewi seperti Lakshmi dan Durga. Artikel menghubungkan Devisukta dengan Rigveda 10.125. Weda menyebut Prithvi, Aditi, Vac, Ratri, dan Aranyani sebagai sejumlah dewi kosmis. Dalam tradisi Shakta Devi adalah sosok tertinggi; tradisi Smarta memasukkannya dalam lima bentuk utama Brahman. Tradisi lain menekankan daya aktif dewi yang melengkapi dewa pasangan. Devi Upanishad mengajarkan Shakti sebagai Brahman serta asal materi dan kesadaran. Dalam Devi Upanishad, Devi menyatakan dirinya pencipta bumi dan langit serta kesadaran tak terbatas. WHE menjelaskan sisi Uma yang ramah dan sisi Durga yang menakutkan sebagai penggambaran Devi berbeda. Pembicara perempuan dalam Rigveda 10.125 menyebut dirinya Ratu dan penghimpun harta yang layak dipuja.
long_description.en: Shaktism centres on Devi. Medieval Puranic literature expands Devi narratives, including the Devi Mahatmya. The Devi Mahatmya reveres her as ultimate truth and supreme power. Devi and Deva are explained as referring to the divine, exalted, and shining. Bhagavati is an honorific for goddesses such as Lakshmi and Durga. The article connects the Devisukta with Rigveda 10.125. The Vedas name Prithvi, Aditi, Vac, Ratri, and Aranyani among cosmic goddesses. In Shakta tradition Devi is supreme; Smarta tradition includes her among five primary forms of Brahman. Other traditions emphasise the goddess's active power complementing her divine partner. The Devi Upanishad teaches Shakti as Brahman and the origin of matter and consciousness. In the Devi Upanishad, Devi declares herself creator of earth and heaven and infinite consciousness. WHE explains benevolent Uma and fearsome Durga as different depictions of Devi. The female speaker in Rigveda 10.125 calls herself Queen and gatherer of treasures worthy of worship.

cultural_context.id: Devi menjadi pusat pemujaan Shakta dan salah satu bentuk Brahman dalam Smarta.
cultural_context.en: Devi is the centre of Shakta worship and one of Brahman's forms in Smarta.

claims.quote:
Devi and deva are Sanskrit terms found in Vedic literature around the 3rd millennium BCE. Deva is masculine, and the related feminine equivalent is devi. Monier-Williams translates it as 'heavenly, divine, terrestrial things of high excellence, exalted, shining ones'.
Etymologically, a cognate of devi is Latin dea. When capitalised, Devi maata refers to the mother goddess in Hinduism.

claims.quote: A synonym for the word Devi in the Vedas is Bhagavati. Bhagavatī (Devanagari: भगवती, IAST: Bhagavatī), is an Indian epithet of Sanskrit origin, used as an honorific title for goddesses in Hinduism and Buddhism. In Hinduism, it is primarily used to address the goddesses Lakshmi and Durga. In Buddhism, it is used to refer to several Mahayana Buddhist female deities, like Cundā.

However, the goddesses are not discussed as frequently as gods (devas).

short_description.id: Dirən adalah sosok 'pir setan' dalam kepercayaan rakyat Turk dan Altai: manusia yang telah menjadi setan, dan juga sebutan bagi roh jahat yang mengabulkan keinginan manusia.
short_description.en: Dirən is a 'devil's master' in Turkic and Altaic folk belief: a person turned devilish, and also a name for evil spirits that grant human wishes.

long_description.id: Dalam kepercayaan dan mitologi rakyat Turk dan Altai, Dirən disebut sebagai 'pir setan', yaitu manusia yang telah berubah menjadi setan. Ia juga dikenal dengan nama Tiren, Tiyren, atau Teyren, dan dalam kamus Karakurt disebut pula Seren dan Sereğen.
long_description.en: In Turkic and Altaic folk belief and mythology Dirən is called a 'devil's master', a human who has become devilish. It is also known as Tiren, Tiyren or Teyren, and Karakurt's dictionary adds Seren and Sereğen.

long_description.id: Nama yang sama dipakai untuk roh jahat yang memenuhi segala keinginan manusia. Namun, orang yang berurusan dengan roh itu begitu jahat sehingga akhirnya tertipu olehnya, dan orang-orang seperti itulah yang disebut Diren. Karakurt menyamakan gagasan ini dengan ungkapan 'Şeytan Evliyâsı' dalam Kuran-ı Kerim.
long_description.en: The same name is used for evil spirits that fulfil every human wish. Yet the person who deals with such a spirit is so wicked that he ends up deceived by it, and such people are the ones called Diren. Karakurt likens the idea to the expression 'Şeytan Evliyâsı' in the Kuran-ı Kerim.

long_description.id: Satu sumber juga memuat Təyrən atau Tayran, iblis dalam mitologi Turk yang berkaki satu, berlengan satu, dan bermata satu. Siapa pun yang melihatnya akan dilayani segala keinginannya, tetapi sebagai gantinya Təyrən menguasai jiwa orang itu.
long_description.en: One source also describes Təyrən or Tayran, a devil of Turkic mythology that is one-legged, one-armed and one-eyed. Whoever sees it has every wish carried out, but in return Təyrən takes possession of that person's soul.

long_description.id: Dirən dipandang sebagai kebalikan dari Ərən atau Eren. Karakurt mengartikan namanya sebagai 'setan terkutuk' dari akar Dir/Tir, dan kata-kata serumpun dalam bahasa Mongol dan Tungus bermakna memaki atau mengutuk.
long_description.en: Dirən is seen as the opposite of Ərən or Eren. Karakurt reads the name as 'accursed devil' from the root Dir/Tir, and related Mongolian and Tungusic words mean to curse or damn.

who.id: Dirən adalah manusia yang telah menjadi setan, juga sebutan bagi roh jahat pengabul keinginan.
who.en: Dirən is a human turned devilish, and also a name for wish-granting evil spirits.

role.en: It stands as the opposite of the Eren in that belief.

famous_for.en: It is known because those who seek its help end up deceived.

did_you_know.en: Təyrən, described in the same article, is one-legged and one-eyed, and trades granted wishes for a person's soul.

note.en: Dirən is regarded as the opposite of Ərən/Eren.

statement.en: Təyrən is one-legged (tək ayaqlı), one-armed (tək qollu), one-handed (tək əlli) and one-eyed (tek gözlüdür).

statement.en: It becomes the master (sahibi) of the person who sees it and does whatever that person wants, but in return takes possession of his soul (ruhuna sahib olur).

statement.en: The Mongolian word 'Tarhı' and Tungusic 'Türe', linked to the name, mean to curse, damn and despise (söymək, lanetlemek, xor görmək).

statement.en: Karakurt defines Diren as a human who has become devilish (şeytanlaşmış insan); the name is also given to malevolent spirits (kötücül ruhlar) that grant every human wish.

claims.quote: bu ruhun karşısındaki insan o kadar kötüdür ki, onun tarafından kandırılır. İşte bu kişilere Diren denilir.

statement.en: The person facing such a spirit is so wicked that he is deceived by it (kandırılır), and it is such people who are called Diren.

statement.en: The concept resembles the expression 'Şeytan Evliyâsı' (friends of the devil) mentioned in the Kuran-ı Kerim.

short_description.id: Dyaus Pita adalah dewa langit Rigveda dan pasangan Prithvi, dewi bumi.
short_description.en: Dyaus Pita is the Rigvedic sky deity and consort of Prithvi, the earth goddess.

long_description.id: Dyaus Pita adalah dewa langit Rigveda dan pasangan Prithvi, dewi bumi. Keduanya merupakan orang tua arketipal dalam Rigveda.
long_description.en: Dyaus Pita is the Rigvedic sky deity and consort of Prithvi, the earth goddess. Together they are archetypal parents in the Rigveda.

long_description.id: Kata dyaus tanpa kata ayah menunjuk langit siang. Kitab Weda menyebut Dyaus Pita bersama Prithvi Mata, Ibu Bumi. Ia diumpamakan sebagai kuda hitam bertabur mutiara yang menggambarkan langit malam. Mackenzie menghubungkan Dyaus dengan gambaran banteng merah yang gemuruhnya adalah guntur.
long_description.en: The word dyaus without the word father refers to the daylight sky. Vedic scriptures mention Dyaus Pita with Prithvi Mata, Mother Earth. short_description.id: Enbilulu adalah dewa air Mesopotamia yang bertanggung jawab atas Tigris dan Efrat.
short_description.en: Enbilulu is a Mesopotamian water deity caring for the Tigris and Euphrates rivers.

long_description.id: Enbilulu adalah dewa air Mesopotamia yang bertanggung jawab atas Tigris dan Efrat. Sumber pendamping menyebut Enbilulu sebagai dewa kanal, bersama Nergal dan Ninazu yang memiliki fungsi berbeda.
long_description.en: Enbilulu is a Mesopotamian water deity caring for the Tigris and Euphrates rivers. The accompanying source identifies Enbilulu as god of canals, alongside Nergal and Ninazu with other functions.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah Enlil dan Ninlil, Enbilulu adalah putra kedua dewa tersebut. Artikel juga mengaitkan Enbilulu dengan irigasi dan pertanian. Dalam uraian Enuma Elish, Enbilulu mengetahui rahasia air dan sungai di bawah bumi. Artikel mencatat nama Epadun, Enbilulugugal, dan Hegal sebagai versi dengan peran berbeda. Teks Sumeria dalam terjemahan Oxford menyebut Enbilulu sebagai pengawas kanal.
long_description.en: In the Enlil and Ninlil story, Enbilulu is the son of these two deities. The article also associates Enbilulu with irrigation and agriculture. In the article’s Enuma Elish account, Enbilulu knows the secrets of water and rivers below the earth. The article lists Epadun, Enbilulugugal, and Hegal as versions with differing roles. The Sumerian text in Oxford’s translation calls Enbilulu the inspector of canals.

short_description.id: Ennead Agung adalah kelompok sembilan dewa Mesir yang dipuja di Heliopolis.
short_description.en: The Great Ennead is a group of nine Egyptian gods worshipped at Heliopolis.

long_description.id: Ennead Agung adalah kelompok sembilan dewa Mesir yang dipuja di Heliopolis. Anggotanya mencakup Atum, Shu, Tefnut, Geb, Nut, Osiris, Isis, Set, dan Nephthys.
long_description.en: The Great Ennead is a group of nine Egyptian gods worshipped at Heliopolis. Its members include Atum, Shu, Tefnut, Geb, Nut, Osiris, Isis, Set and Nephthys.

long_description.id: Ennead Heliopolis merupakan salah satu dari beberapa kelompok sembilan dewa. Kata ennead berasal melalui bahasa Latin dari bahasa Yunani yang berarti sembilan. Teks Piramida menyebut Ennead Agung, Kecil, Ganda, dan Tujuh Ennead. Ennead mengadili sengketa Set dan Horus mengenai takhta.
long_description.en: Heliopolis’s Ennead is one of several groups of nine gods. The word ennead comes through Latin from Greek meaning nine. The Pyramid Texts mention the Great, Lesser, Dual and Seven Enneads. The Ennead judges Set and Horus’s dispute over the throne.

short_description.id: Faro adalah dewa air dalam mitologi Mande dan tradisi Bambara di Afrika Barat yang erat kaitannya dengan sungai Niger.
short_description.en: Faro is a water deity in Mande mythology and Bambara traditions of West Africa closely associated with the Niger River.

long_description.id: Fâro atau Faro merupakan dewa air dalam kepercayaan masyarakat Afrika Barat, khususnya pada kebudayaan Bambara dan Malinké. Sosok ilahi ini memiliki kedudukan sentral dalam mitos penciptaan dunia bersama kembarannya Pemba, serta didampingi oleh figur Koni.
long_description.en: Fâro or Faro is a water divinity in the beliefs of West Africa, notably within Bambara and Malinké cultures. This entity holds a central place in cosmic creation narratives alongside the twin Pemba, and is accompanied by Koni.

long_description.id: Keberadaannya terhubung erat dengan aliran sungai Niger yang menjadi urat nadi kehidupan masyarakat setempat. Dalam mitologi Mande, Faro menyucikan bumi dan menciptakan sungai Niger untuk menjamin kelangsungan hidup serta kesuburan seluruh makhluk hidup.
long_description.en: His presence remains deeply linked to the Niger River, sustaining the communities along its shores. Within Mande lore, Faro purified the world and shaped the Niger River, securing vital sustenance and continuity for living beings.

short_description.id: Finnbhennach adalah banteng istimewa milik Ailill mac Máta, raja Connacht, dalam mitologi Irlandia; namanya berarti "bertanduk putih".
short_description.en: Finnbhennach is a remarkable bull owned by Ailill, king of Connacht, in Irish mythology; the name means 'white-horned'.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi Irlandia, Finnbhennach (juga Findbennach) adalah banteng istimewa milik Ailill mac Mágach, raja Connacht; namanya berarti "bertanduk putih". Bersama banteng Donn Cuailnge ia tokoh sentral dalam kisah terkenal Táin Bó Cuailnge. Kelahirannya diceritakan dalam De chophur in da muccida: dua penggembala babi raja-raja peri Connacht dan Munster beradu sihir, berubah wujud berkali-kali hingga menjadi cacing air yang ditelan dua sapi, lalu lahir sebagai Finnbhennach dan Donn Cuailnge. Artikel ga menyebut salah satunya bernama Rucht, penggembala babi Ochall Ochne.
long_description.en: In Irish mythology Finnbhennach (also Findbennach) is a remarkable bull belonging to Ailill, king of Connacht; the name means 'white-horned'. With the bull Donn Cuailnge it is central to the famous Táin Bó Cuailnge. Its birth is told in De chophur in da muccida: two swineherds of the fairy kings of Connacht and Munster duel in magic through a run of shapes until, as water worms, they are swallowed by two cows and reborn as Finnbhennach and Donn Cuailnge. The ga article names one of them Rucht, swineherd of Ochall Ochne.

long_description.id: Banteng itu dulu milik Medb, ratu Connacht, tetapi karena tak sudi dimiliki perempuan, ia pindah ke kawanan Ailill. Agar setara dengan suaminya, Medb mengerahkan pasukan untuk merampas Donn Cuailnge dari Cooley di Ulster. Setelah Donn Cuailnge dibawa ke Connacht, kedua banteng bertarung; Finnbhennach terbunuh dan Donn Cuailnge terluka parah hingga mati.
long_description.en: The bull had once been Medb's, queen of Connacht, but scorning to be owned by a woman it joined Ailill's herd. To match her husband Medb gathered an army to seize Donn Cuailnge from Cooley in Ulster. Once Donn Cuailnge was brought to Connacht the two bulls fought; Finnbhennach was killed and Donn Cuailnge was fatally hurt.

short_description.id: Follet adalah roh rumah kecil yang usil dalam mitologi Katalan dan Aragon, setara dengan folletto Italia dan lutin Prancis, yang masuk ke rumah pada malam hari.
short_description.en: The follet is a mischievous little house spirit of Catalan and Aragonese mythology, akin to the Italian folletto and French lutin, that slips into homes at night.

long_description.id: Follet, dari kata foll, "gila", adalah roh usil mitologi Katalan, juga disebut fullet atau millet; dalam mitologi Aragon ia makhluk kecil yang masuk ke rumah pada malam hari untuk mencuri barang kesukaannya. Ia setara dengan brownie, duende, folletto, lutin, dan gripet, dan di wilayah Katalan peran serupa diisi "familiar" seperti cerdet.
long_description.en: The follet, from foll, 'mad', is a mischievous spirit of Catalan mythology, also called fullet or millet; in Aragonese mythology it is a tiny being that enters homes at night to steal what it likes. It is akin to the brownie, duende, folletto, lutin and gripet, and in the Catalan lands 'familiars' such as the cerdet play a similar role.

long_description.id: Dalam bahasa Italia folletto adalah nama umum untuk makhluk gaib kecil yang aktif pada malam hari, usil, dan terkait rumah dan kandang, yang bisa membantu atau mengganggu; namanya merujuk sifatnya yang tak menentu. Para peneliti menelusurinya ke Lares dan Penates Romawi.
long_description.en: In Italian, folletto is a generic name for tiny nocturnal, mischievous supernatural beings tied to house and stable, who may help or harass; the name points to their fickleness. Scholars trace them to the Roman Lares and Penates.

who.en: A mischievous house spirit.

role.id: Mengusili dan kadang membantu rumah tangga.
role.en: Pesters and sometimes helps the household.

statement.en: The follet (from foll, 'mad'; fullet in Mallorca), also millet, is a mischievous fantastic spirit of Catalan mythology.

statement.id: Ia kurang lebih setara dengan gnome, goblin, atau hobgoblin Eropa dalam sisi ramahnya, serta brownie Skotlandia, duende Kastilia, folletto Italia, lutin Prancis, dan gripet atau fadet Oksitan.
statement.en: It is roughly like the European gnome, goblin or hobgoblin in their kinder aspect, and comparable to the Scottish brownie, the Castilian duende, the Italian folletto, the French lutin and the Occitan gripet or fadet.

statement.id: Di wilayah Katalan sendiri peran follet juga diisi makhluk lain yang disebut "familiar", seperti cerdet di Alicante.
statement.en: Within the Catalan lands the follet's role is also filled by other creatures, often called 'familiars', such as the cerdet in Alicante.

claims.quote: Un follet ye un ser chicorrón d'a mitolochía aragonesa que dentra en os fogars per as nueiz pa furtar lo que mas le fa goyo.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Aragon, follet adalah makhluk kecil mitologi Aragon yang masuk ke rumah pada malam hari untuk mencuri apa yang paling disukainya.
statement.en: According to the Aragonese article, a follet is a tiny being of Aragonese mythology that enters homes at night to steal what it likes best.

claims.quote: Folletto è il nome con cui la lingua italiana designa genericamente una vasta categoria di esseri soprannaturali minori del folclore europeo: creature di piccola statura, notturne, dispettose e mutevoli, legate alla casa, alla stalla e alla campagna, capaci di rendere servizi agli uomini quanto di perseguitarli.

statement.id: Menurut artikel bahasa Italia, folletto adalah nama umum untuk banyak makhluk gaib kecil dalam cerita rakyat Eropa: bertubuh mungil, aktif pada malam hari, usil, dan berubah-ubah, terkait rumah, kandang, dan ladang, yang bisa membantu maupun mengganggu manusia.
statement.en: According to the Italian article, folletto is the generic Italian name for a broad class of minor supernatural beings of European folklore: tiny, nocturnal, mischievous and changeable, tied to house, stable and field, able to help or to plague humans.

claims.quote: Folletto è propriamente il diminutivo di folle, e allude all'incostanza e all'imprevedibilità attribuite alla creatura. La stessa motivazione è alla base del francese follet e del provenzale fadet: dal Medioevo il lutin francese è chiamato anche follet, cioè «piccolo folle», per i suoi sbalzi d'umore

statement.id: Folletto adalah bentuk kecil dari folle, "gila", merujuk sifat makhluk ini yang tak menentu; dasar yang sama ada pada kata Prancis follet dan Provençal fadet, dan sejak Abad Pertengahan lutin Prancis juga disebut follet, "si gila kecil".
statement.en: Folletto is the diminutive of folle, 'mad', alluding to the creature's fickleness; the same idea lies behind French follet and Provençal fadet, and since the Middle Ages the French lutin has also been called follet, 'little madman'.

claims.quote: La storiografia demologica riconduce la figura ai geni domestici del mondo antico — i Lari e i Penati romani — sopravvissuti alla cristianizzazione in forma clandestina e degradata

statement.id: Para peneliti tradisi rakyat menelusuri tokoh ini ke roh rumah dunia kuno, Lares dan Penates Romawi, yang bertahan setelah kristenisasi dalam bentuk tersembunyi dan merosot.
statement.en: Folklore scholarship traces the figure to the household spirits of antiquity, the Roman Lares and Penates, which survived Christianisation in hidden, degraded form.

short_description.id: Frigg adalah dewi kesuburan, istri Odin dan ibu Baldr, yang dikenal berkaitan dengan pernikahan serta ramalan.
short_description.en: Frigg is a Norse fertility goddess, Odin's wife and Baldr's mother, associated with marriage and prophecy.

long_description.id: Frigg adalah dewi kesuburan dan istri Odin. Ia dihubungkan dengan pernikahan, keibuan, kecerdikan dan ramalan; Baldr dan Hodr disebut sebagai putranya. Nama Friday berkaitan dengan namanya. Beberapa nama lainnya adalah Frigga, Frea, dan Fria.
long_description.en: Frigg is a fertility goddess and Odin's wife. She is linked to marriage, motherhood, cleverness and prophecy; Baldr and Hodr are named as her sons. English Friday is named for her. Other names include Frigga, Frea and Fria.

long_description.id: Dalam kisah kematian Baldr, Frigg meminta segala sesuatu berjanji tidak melukainya, tetapi melewatkan mistletoe. Loki memanfaatkan kelalaian itu sehingga Hodr melempar tumbuhan tersebut dan Baldr tewas. Frigg juga dikisahkan tinggal di Fensalir, yang letaknya tidak dijelaskan.
long_description.en: In the death of Baldr, Frigg asks all things to promise not to hurt him but overlooks mistletoe. Loki exploits this omission; Hodr throws the plant and Baldr dies. Frigg is also said to dwell in Fensalir, whose location is unspecified.

long_description.id: Sebuah tradisi Lombards menyebutnya Freia, istri Odin yang membantu kemenangan mereka. Hubungan asal-usulnya dengan Freyja tetap diperdebatkan; sebuah ensiklopedia lama bahkan mengingatkan agar keduanya tidak diidentifikasi begitu saja. Sumber modern menegaskan Frigg bukan ibu Thor.
long_description.en: A tradition of the Lombards calls her Freia, Odin's wife who helps the Lombards win. Her possible historical connection to Freyja remains speculative, and an older encyclopedia warns against identifying the two outright. A modern source says she is not Thor's mother.

short_description.id: Fūjin adalah dewa angin yang digambarkan bersama Raijin, dewa guntur, dalam seni Jepang.
short_description.en: Fūjin is the wind god depicted with Raijin, the thunder god, in Japanese art.

long_description.id: Fūjin adalah dewa angin, sedangkan pasangannya Raijin melambangkan guntur. Keduanya dipahami sebagai kekuatan alam yang dipersonifikasikan dan dahulu dipandang dalam Buddhisme Jepang sebagai pengiring Kannon Berlengan Seribu. Sepasang layar lipat karya Sōtatsu menempatkan dua dewa itu sebagai tokoh utama, sebuah pilihan komposisi yang disebut khas bagi karya tersebut. Lukisan aslinya termasuk Pusaka Nasional.
long_description.en: Fūjin is the wind god, paired with Raijin as the thunder god. The two personify natural forces and were regarded in Japanese Buddhism as attendants of the Thousand-Armed Kannon. A pair of screens by Sōtatsu makes the two gods its central figures, a composition described as distinctive to this work. The original is a National Treasure.

long_description.id: Seni lukis kemudian terus menampilkan pasangan itu. Pada layar lipat karya Ogata Kōrin, Fūjin tampil hijau di kanan, berhadapan dengan Raijin yang berkulit putih di kiri. Kain pakaian mereka tampak tertiup angin dan awan gelap memperkuat kesan cuaca bergerak. Catatan museum mengaitkan kedua tokoh dengan daya angin dan guntur, sehingga penggambaran mereka juga menyampaikan kekuatan alam.
long_description.en: Artists continued to depict the pair. On Ogata Kōrin’s folding screens, green Fūjin appears on the right opposite a white Raijin on the left. Their clothes flutter in the wind, and dark clouds intensify the sense of moving weather. The museum interprets the pair as images of the force of wind and thunder.

short_description.id: Greenbrier Ghost adalah hantu Zona Heaster Shue dari West Virginia, yang menurut kesaksian ibunya mengungkap bahwa ia dibunuh suaminya pada 1897.
short_description.en: The Greenbrier Ghost is the ghost of Zona Heaster Shue of West Virginia, who according to her mother's testimony revealed she had been murdered by her husband in 1897.

long_description.id: Greenbrier Ghost adalah sebutan populer bagi hantu Elva Zona Heaster Shue, perempuan muda dari Greenbrier County, West Virginia. Zona berkenalan dengan Edward Stribbling Trout Shue pada Oktober 1896. Pada 23 Januari 1897 ia ditemukan tewas di rumahnya, dan juri koroner memutuskan ia meninggal karena penyakit jantung.
long_description.en: The Greenbrier Ghost is the popular name for the ghost of Elva Zona Heaster Shue, a young woman of Greenbrier County, West Virginia. Zona met Edward Stribbling Trout Shue in October 1896. On 23 January 1897 she was found dead at home, and a coroner's jury ruled death by heart disease.

long_description.id: Ibunya, Mary Jane Heaster, mengaku didatangi arwah Zona yang menyatakan Edward membunuhnya dengan mematahkan lehernya. Berbekal cerita itu ia mendatangi jaksa John Alfred Preston, dan pengadilan akhirnya menyatakan Zona dibunuh suaminya.
long_description.en: Her mother, Mary Jane Heaster, said Zona's spirit told her Edward had killed her by breaking her neck. With that story she went to prosecutor John Alfred Preston, and the court eventually found Zona had been murdered by her husband.
